title: Parts Buyer
description:
Responsibilities:

· Procurement and Sourcing: Issue and manage purchase requisitions and purchase orders for MRO supplies, replacement parts, tooling, equipment, and external technical services using SAP, Ariba, and SmartSheet. Negotiate pricing for non-contracted materials and services, delivery schedules, and payment terms.

· Inventory Management: Maintain optimal min/max inventory levels for critical spare parts using SAP, SmartSheet, and Qlik, as well as assist in cycle counts and audits.

· Vendor Management: Evaluate supplier performance on lead times, pricing accuracy, and quality. Resolve order discrepancies, shipping issues, and return material authorizations (RMA’s)

· Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner directly with Maintenance Technicians, Engineers, Corporate Procurement, and Operations Managers to ensure MRO material availability for scheduled shutdowns, overhauls, emergency repairs, spares, and consumables.

· Cost Savings and Process Improvement: Identify cost-reduction opportunities, standardization of components, purchasing agreement compliance, slow-moving inventory, stock-outs and supply chain risks, and vendor consolidation without compromising machine reliability or safety.

· Compliance and Recordkeeping: Maintain accurate purchase documentation, match invoices/packing slips / Purchase orders, and enforce internal procurement control and ISO policies.

· TPM Equipment Owner: Learn and implement Lean Manufacturing, 6S, and continuous improvement methodologies.

· Technical Aptitude: Comfort identifying mechanical, electrical, pneumatic, and hydraulic replacement parts.

· Other duties as assigned

Requirements:

· Associate's degree in a technical field or equivalent work experience

· Ability to function highly with minimal supervision

· Must have strong skills in the following;

· SAP PM / PROCUREMENT

· Task and time management

· Interpersonal skills and customer focus

· Organizational skills with attention to detail

· Microsoft Excel, Smartsheet, PowerPoint, and Word

· Written and oral communication

· Math Skills

title: Visual Security Associate - Full Time
description:
The Visual Security Associate supports the execution of store asset protection initiatives by providing consistent visual theft deterrence and ensuring a positive customer experience. This role provides excellent customer service while monitoring and reporting suspicious activities in a strategic location within the store. This is an hourly position.

What you will do

  • Demonstrate ownership and initiative in achieving personal goals, store objectives, and daily priorities.

  • Greet, engage, and assist customers warmly, creating a welcoming environment and providing personalized service to enhance customer shopping experience.

  • Serve as a visible presence in designated areas of responsibility to deter potential theft and maintain a secure environment.

  • Observe customer behaviors and identify activities that may indicate potential theft.

  • Effectively communicate customer concerns, suspicious behaviors, or potential security issues to store leadership promptly.

  • Collaborate with store leaders and associates to protect store assets and uphold safety standards.

  • Support store operations by maintaining a clean, organized, and welcoming environment.

  • Demonstrate adaptability and respond to changing circumstances, adjusting tactics and shifting focus based on business needs.

  • Leverage training tools, use resources, and embrace feedback to continuously build skills and strengthen performance. Stay informed of products, promotions, policies, and store events to enhance execution.

  • Contribute to a positive store culture by building connections with teammates, sharing knowledge, and celebrating individual and team achievements.



Skills and Abilities

  • Dedication to customer service and a drive to achieve store objectives.

  • Skills and experience to perform in the role and a commitment to continuously learn.

  • Ability to use data and guidance to support timely and effective decisions.

  • Ability to take ownership of assigned tasks and contribute to store success.

  • Communicate with excellence.

  • Comfortable with technology, including smart phones, tablet computers and Windows-based operating systems.

  • Must bend, reach, stretch for product as well as lift, carry, and move at least 40 lbs.

  • Available to work a flexible schedule based on business needs, including nights, weekends, and holidays.

  • Must regularly move around all store areas and be accessible to customers.

title: Property Adjuster - Field Estimating - Philadelphia, PA
description:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

A day in the life of a Field Property Adjuster, and what it takes to do the job!

As a Field Property Adjuster, you will be dedicated to providing exceptional service to our policyholders. Your primary responsibility will involve traveling to our customers' homes to conduct on-site inspections, investigate coverage, prepare estimates, and settle claims promptly and efficiently. Additionally, you will handle virtual claims countrywide, leveraging various platforms and software such as Xactimate and ClaimsX Video Collaboration. Your expertise will be particularly focused on water losses, ensuring our customers receive the highest level of support and resolution for these specific claims.

You'll wear a few hats that will require a level of experience:

  • The Customer Service Expert –you’ll live into Allstate’s Claims Culture by caring, empowering, and restoring, and you will accomplish that by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each claim. You lead with empathy, always.
  • The Investigator – you’ll confidently and independently investigate property claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies to determine coverage.
  • The Effective Communicator – you’ll use phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process. You’ll also incorporate a specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on the claim progress.
  • The Negotiator – You will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants, in accordance with all legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations.
  • The Problem Solver –you’ll utilize multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills.
  • The Recorder – you’ll protect the company financially by executing policies along policy agreements, and you keep a clear record of your work in a claims system that you will be trained on. You’ll accomplish this by ensuring timely and accurate documentation is completed as you work on each claim.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Reside in or near Philadelphia, PA area.
  • 2-3 years previous experience as outside adjuster is highly desired.
  • Proficiency in using Xactimate and other relevant software for estimating preferred.
  • Strong critical thinking and technical skills to assess damages accurately and expedite claims settlements.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to provide exceptional customer service.
  • Ability to travel to customers' homes and handle virtual claims countrywide effectively.
  • Detail-oriented and organized, with a focus on delivering high-quality work.
  • Residency within the posted location is mandatory for this role.

Required Qualifications:

  • Are willing and able to carry a 50-pound ladder and access up to a 6/12 pitch on either a one to two-story roof.
  • Valid driver's license and willingness to travel as part of the job requirements.

You’re provided with comprehensive training:

  • The training program is designed to help you build a claims foundation and understand the systems and processes in your day-to-day work
  • Ongoing training opportunities for continuous improvement happen regularly on the job

** Please note, you will be required to attend 2-weeks of training that will take place in Dallas, TX **

Notice of Licensing Requirement:

  • As a condition of employment, your office/area may require you to obtain an adjuster and/or an appraiser license which includes passing an additional background check with the Department of Labor. If applicable, you will be required to secure license(s) within 60 days of hire.
  • If required, the Hiring Manager will work with you along with the Centralized Licensing team to ensure that you are properly licensed.
  • As a requirement of employment, individuals who currently hold an active insurance license must terminate all existing appointments prior to onboarding and must not hold any outside appointments at any point during employment.
  • Applicants seeking an adjuster role who also hold a resident producer license must formally surrender that license when instructed to by the licensing team. By proceeding with the application process, applicants acknowledge and accept these licensing requirements and agree to comply.

Sign On Bonus:

  • You may be eligible for a $1000 Licensing Sign on Bonus if you have the applicable active licenses needed for this role. This could include Home Resident Property & Casualty License, Designated Home State (DHS) Florida or Texas License, and/or applicable Appraiser License.

**Current employees or candidates who have previously worked for Allstate, including its family of companies, are not eligible for this sign-on bonus.

Company Car:

Based on our Company Car Guidelines, this role may qualify for a company car. Our leadership team determines this based on annual work mileage for this location. You may be required to use your personal vehicle until these guidelines are met. We offer mileage reimbursements for personal vehicle usage during work.

Allstate Benefits:

Being a part of Allstate means you receive a benefits package from Day 1 of employment. This includes time off, healthcare, retirement, and more. That is why as an Allstater, you’ll enjoy a Total Rewards package that includes:

  • Competitive pay with needed support for continuous development and career advancement.
  • Flexibility in scheduling and a time off policy that helps support your work/life balance.
  • Initial and ongoing training to get you proficient in your new role.
  • Comprehensive benefits like a 401K/pension, education reimbursement, and programs to help you balance work with the rest of your life. Visit www.allstategoodlife.com to learn more. #LI-TW1

Skills

Active Listening, Communication, Critical Thinking, Customer Service, Empathy, Multitasking, Working Independently

Compensation

Base compensation offered for this role is $65,000 - $105,000 annually and is based on experience and qualifications.

The candidate(s) offered this position will be required to submit to a background investigation.

Joining our team isn’t just a job — it’s an opportunity. One that takes your skills and pushes them to the next level. One that encourages you to challenge the status quo. One where you can shape the future of protection while supporting causes that mean the most to you. Joining our team means being part of something bigger – a winning team making a meaningful impact.

title: Lead, Operations Strategy - Specialty Services Implementation
description:
At LifeStance Health, we strive to help individuals, families, and communities with their mental health needs. Everywhere. Every day. It’s a lofty goal; we know. But we make it happen with the best team in mental healthcare.

Thank you for taking the time to explore a career with us. As the fastest growing mental health practice group in the country, now is the perfect time to join our team!

LifeStance Health Values

  • Belonging: We cultivate a space where everyone can show up as their authentic self.

  • Empathy: We seek out diverse perspectives and listen to learn without judgment.

  • Courage: We are all accountable for doing the right thing - even when it's hard - because we know it's worth it.

  • One Team: We realize our full potential when we work together towards our shared purpose.

Benefits
As a full-time employee of LifeStance Health, the following benefits are offered: medical, dental, vision, AD&D, short and long-term disability, and life insurance. Additional benefits include a 401k retirement savings with employer match, paid parental leave, paid time off, holiday pay and an Employee Assistance Program.


ROLE OVERVIEW


As a Lead, Operations Strategy - Specialty Services Implementation, you will play an integral role in developing and implementing new service lines that improve the experience of LifeStance clinicians and patients across the country and further the mission of the organization. In this role, you will be a catalyst for change, driving growth, business process improvement, and initiatives aimed at growing LifeStance’s business offerings. As a member of the Ops Strategy - Specialty Services Team, you will leverage your expertise to lead and influence stakeholders, ensuring the seamless execution of national initiatives. You will work cross-functionally with all corporate teams, including Technology, People, Finance, Clinical Leadership & Shared Services to lead teams toward solving complex problems. Additionally, you will have the opportunity to build relationships with Operations leaders across the business to understand their needs and develop initiatives that allow them to better service patients across the geographies they lead.


Consistent with LifeStance’s values, every member of the LifeStance team is expected to support each other and the mission, which may mean participating in projects and initiatives and performing functions and responsibilities not specifically outlined in this job description.


KEY RESPONSIBILITES


  • Drive the implementation of new service lines through a combination of direct involvement, partnership with the local operating team, and influence over internal stakeholder partners (shared services, corporate support, etc.).
  • Execute, document and optimize on a scalable, repeatable playbook for launching new national programs at the site level.
  • Provide subject matter expertise to all internal partners to ensure successful implementation and ongoing support of local Specialty Services programs.
  • Collaborate with management to understand Specialty Services training needs and identify areas for improvement.
  • Accountable for reporting standard key performance indicators, performance root causes, and action plans for improvement to management.
  • Assess and analyze current business practices and procedures, identifying weaknesses and opportunities for enhancement.
  • Develop comprehensive cross-functional project plans to drive changes and improvements in service line launches and performance.
  • Lead the development of training content in various forms (live meetings, asynchronous Workday trainings, etc.)
  • Organize and manage Specialty Services projects, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and objectives.
  • Liaise between departments to ensure effective communication related to Specialty Services initiatives.

REQUIREMENTS


Required Skills/Abilities:


  • Microsoft Office experience; Excel skills (pivot tables, formulas, etc.), PowerPoint presentation skills.
  • Strong stakeholder management and influence skills, with the ability to align diverse perspectives, drive consensus, and facilitate decision-making in complex environments.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills and ability to handle sensitive and confidential information.
  • Demonstrated ability to quickly learn and synthesize new information, becoming a subject matter expert to drive informed decision-making and strategic insights.
  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Familiarity with project management software and applications is a plus.
  • Qualified candidates must be legally authorized to be employed in the United States
  • LifeStance is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of age, race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status.
  • Demonstrates awareness, inclusivity, sensitivity, humility, and experience in working with individuals from diverse ethnic backgrounds, socioeconomic statuses, sexual orientations, gender identities, and other various aspects of culture.

Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience required
  • 3+ years of healthcare experience required, with at least 1 year of healthcare leadership or management experience preferred. Experience at a high-growth company, a plus.
  • Demonstrated experience collaborating with clinical and operational teams to design and implement programs that enhance clinical workflows and support patient care initiatives.
  • Proven track record in managing EHR systems, billing, coding, and compliance processes to streamline operations.

Key Behaviors:

  • Behave Ethically: Understand ethical behavior and business practices and ensure own behavior and the behavior of others are consistent with these standards and align with the values of the company.
  • Focus on Stakeholder Needs: Anticipate, understand, and respond to the needs of key stakeholders to meet or exceed their expectations within the organization’s parameters.
  • Build Relationships: Establish and maintain positive working relationships with others both internally and externally to achieve the goals of the organization.
  • Communicate Effectively: Speak, listen, and write in a clear, thorough, and timely manner using appropriate and effective communication tools and techniques.
  • Foster Teamwork: Work cooperatively and effectively with across teams to set goals, resolve problems and make decisions that enhance organizational effectiveness.
  • Make Decisions: Assess situations to determine the importance, urgency, and risks, and make clear decisions which are timely and in the best interests of the organization.
  • Organization: Set priorities, develop a work schedule, and monitor progress towards goals, and track details, data, information, & activities.
  • Solve Problems: Assess problem situations to identify causes, gather and process relevant information, generate possible solutions, and make recommendations and/or resolve the problem.
  • Flexibility and Adaptability: Willingness to be flexible in responsibilities and duties and easily adapt to the needs of the company.
  • Attention to Detail and Accuracy: Understands the need for accurate information in data analysis and communication with internal teams and stakeholders.
  • Appreciation for Diverse Backgrounds & Thought: Demonstrates awareness, inclusivity, sensitivity, humility, and experience in working with individuals from diverse ethnic backgrounds, socioeconomic statuses, sexual orientations, gender identities, and other various aspects of culture.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS


  • Remote; flexibility to travel up to 10% of time to support projects or initiatives onsite at LifeStance practice locations or to attend team meetings.

  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit, stand, bend, talk and hear. The employee is frequently required to walk. The employee must be able to lift and/or move objects up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and the ability to adjust focus.

description:
Are you looking for a unique opportunity to be a part of something great? Want to join a 17,000-member team that works on the technology that powers the world around us? Job Description:

Position Overview

Microchip’s Frequency and Timing Division is a world leader in precise time solutions and sets the world's standard for time. The division generates, distributes and applies precise time for the communications, aerospace/defense, IT infrastructure, and metrology industries. Microchip's customers, from communications service providers and network equipment manufacturers to governments and their suppliers worldwide, are able to build more reliable networks and systems by using the company's advanced timing technologies, atomic clocks, services, and solutions. Microchip products support today's precise timing standards, including GPS-based timing, IEEE 1588 (PTP), Network Time Protocol (NTP), and Synchronous Ethernet.

Our Government Systems group in Boulder, CO is seeking a Technical Staff Engineer - Information Security Systems (ISSE) to provide technical support in the design, implementation, and sustainment of cybersecurity capabilities across complex enterprise and mission systems. The ISSE ensures compliance with governing standards and frameworks, including NIST Risk Management Framework (RMF), NIST SP 800-53, ICD 503, CNSSI 1253, and DISA STIGs. This role requires technical aptitude to troubleshoot Linux and Windows servers, end-user nodes, Cisco switches, and enterprise shared storage systems, while applying continuous monitoring practices to maintain compliance and strengthen mission assurance.


Key Responsibilities

Security Engineering & Architecture

  • Engineer and integrate security controls into system and network architectures, including virtualized platforms, shared storage, and mission networks.
  • Translate NIST and CNSS security controls into technical designs and secure implementations.

Technical Troubleshooting & Support

Provide advanced troubleshooting for:

  • Linux and Windows servers (configuration, patching, service integrity).
  • Linux and Windows end-user workstations/nodes (endpoint compliance and hardening).
  • Cisco switches and network devices (VLANs, ACLs, port security, logging).
  • Shared drives and enterprise file systems (permissions, access auditing, data protection).
  • Collaborate with administrators and engineers to resolve technical issues while maintaining compliance.

Continuous Monitoring

  • Implement and sustain continuous monitoring for common and system-specific controls, including automated vulnerability scanning, patch compliance, and SIEM log analysis.
  • Correlate monitoring results across systems, assess control effectiveness, and recommend remediation strategies.
  • Conduct technical security assessments using Tenable, DISA STIGs, CSO Benchmarks, and related NIST guidelines.
  • Analyze results, prioritize risk, and lead remediation with system and network teams.

Requirements/Qualifications:

  • Active Top Secret/SCI clearance w/ CI Poly.
  • US citizenship
  • Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, or related discipline (or equivalent experience).
  • 10+ years of cybersecurity engineering experience with demonstrated expertise in NIST RMF and related standards.
  • Proven ability to troubleshoot and support Linux/Windows servers and endpoints, Cisco network devices, and enterprise storage systems.
  • Hands-on experience with compliance and monitoring tools (Tenable/ACAS, Splunk/ELK, HBSS/ESS).
  • Occasional travel to client sites in other states. Trips typically last 3-5 days and occur less than once per quarter.

title: Global Head of Professional Services
description:
Redefine the future of live entertainment tech

Welcome to vivenu, the global leader in event ticketing tech and one of the world’s fastest-growing live entertainment tech firms. We are transforming event ticketing for global leaders like the Grammys, the Golden Globes, Stanford University and the Hockenheimring turning what was once a simple transaction into a strategic business advantage. With six offices worldwide and growing, we deliver a customizable, intuitive solution and industry-leading support that simplify even the most complex ticketing challenges – helping organizers deliver exceptional experiences and drive real growth.

Join us and build the future of live entertainment.

With over 10 million end users and usage quadrupling annually, our infrastructure now handles over 1 billion requests per month — and counting. Our API-first platform solves complex system challenges at
scale — delivering performance, flexibility, and reliability for the world’s leading live entertainment brands.
As Global Head of Professional Services, you will build and scale vivenu’s services organization across EMEA, North America into a profitable, high-performing business unit. You will own the unit P&L, set commercial frameworks, define solution boundaries, and convert field technical wins into repeatable delivery models for internal teams and partner ecosystems.

As a your responsibilities of Global Head of Professional Services will include:

  • Founding Strategy & Organization: Define the global professional services strategy, operating model, and service catalog. Build the hiring pipeline, make the first key hires, and scale the team across EMEA, North America and Australia.
  • Full P&L accountability: Own the services revenue, margins, utilization, and pricing, including the pricing model for implementation work.
  • Commercial framework: Work with Legal to create the MSA, SOW templates, change-order process and related contract documents. Own pre-sales scoping and SOW creation for headless website builds, integrations with third-party systems, and customers' digital ecosystem. Collaborate closely across Sales, Customer Success, Solutions and Product.
  • Delivery: Lead implementations for vivenu's most strategic customers and marketplace partners, including integrations and custom work. Build and maintain implementation playbooks for common use cases.
  • Technical & Product Alignment: Guide complex scoping using architecture and API expertise. Build internal tooling that shortens delivery time. Strong collaboration with Engineering and Product on product roadmap and field learnings, to define the boundaries between core product, marketplace solutions, and custom work.
  • Commercial & Partner Execution: Structure enterprise deals in partnership with Sales; collaborate with the VP of Partnerships to build a partner network of systems integrators and agencies that deliver on the vivenu platform.
  • Team Growth & Operations: As part of our performance based culture, define KPIs for delivery speed, quality, margin and customer satisfaction, and report against them. Define career paths and required certifications for excellence. Hire, develop, motivate and inspire a talented workforce.

What you will need to succeed in this role:

  • Leadership & SaaS Experience: 10+ years in Professional Services or Enterprise Delivery leadership, including 4+ years managing global teams.
  • Technical Background: Prior experience as a VP/Head of Services, Consulting Practice Lead.
  • Domain Expertise: Prior background in high-scale ticketing systems, system integrator/agency models or similar.
  • People Management: Exceptional ability to define career ladders, set delivery KPIs (speed, quality, CSAT, margins), and cultivate a high-performance culture across distributed teams.
  • Financial Acumen: Proven track record managing unit P&L, project margins, and billable utilization.
  • Nice to have: Ideal candidates have also had roles as an engagement manager, project management, and architect/developer.



Why join vivenu?

Live Entertainment Tech
Play a mission-critical role for global brands, redefining fan experiences from festivals to major sports events. Here, you’re part of the business of fun — powered by cutting-edge technology that brings moments to life for millions.

Sustainable Growth
We scale sustainably on a profitable, VC-backed foundation with true product-market fit. This means continuous investment in our people, products, and long-term vision.

Top-tier Team
Collaborate with over 160 dedicated professionals, including leaders from Google, Slack, and Salesforce. Together, we’re shaping the future of live entertainment technology, one decision at a time.

Global DNA
We’re a diverse, merit-driven team spread across six global offices. Talent and impact are what matter here — not hierarchy or background.

Fast Growing, in All Aspects
Sifted consistently ranks us among the fastest-growing scale-ups in Europe. We’re driven by daily learning, shared wins, and collective growth.

Next-Gen Leaders & Insights
Work alongside some of tech’s brightest minds — from Forbes 30 Under 30 founders to Executive of the Year award winners. At vivenu, you’ll help set the standard for the ticketing industry’s future.

vivenu Inclusion Statement
At vivenu, we believe our people define our success – and that we win with bold, diverse minds. The strongest teams are built on different perspectives, experiences, and voices. We’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels empowered to contribute, grow, and thrive to shape the future of live entertainment globally.

Operating Engineer

Responsible to ensure the efficient operation and maintenance of mechanical, electrical and plumbing equipment and systems for the assigned property(s). Responsibilities include (but are not limited to) maintaining a clean and safe working environment, performing rounds, conducting routine assessments, performance of day-to-day preventive and corrective maintenance, painting, and housekeeping for assigned properties

title: Shift Lead
description:
Insomnia Cookies was founded in a college dorm room by then-student, Seth Berkowitz. Fast forward 20 years and so... many....cookies... later, our innovative bakery + delivery concept has become a cult brand known for its rabid following of cookie lovers who crave Insomnia’s warm, delicious delivery all day and late into the night. With an expanding footprint of over 350 stores globally, an experiential, “sweet-easy” flagship concept, and large scale operations and delivery capabilities ... Insomnia Cookies is revolutionizing the cookie game by truly "Imagining What’s Possible"!


As a Shift Leader at our Chattanooga store located at 1351 Broad St Suite 103 you are the captain of our bakery day or night! You understand what it takes to “Own the Night” (and beyond), by predicting the flow of business during a successful shift. Your hands-on leadership style should not only include building orders, suggestive selling, baking, and interacting with customers – it will also mean taking pride in knowing that your prowess as a leading Insomniac attributes to a productive and fun night for your store! SOME OUR SWEET SHIFT LEADER PERKS: • Flexible part-time work schedules • Pay on Demand (why wait until the end of the week…get paid your earned wages at the end of the day!) • Paid vacation and sick time off • Interactive training & mentorship • Pet insurance for your furry loved ones • Job stability with a rapidly growing and reputable company • Achievable growth/promotion opportunities • You get to work in a fun, exciting team environment • Employee discount and FREE cookies with every shift! WHAT WILL I DO AS A SHIFT LEADER? • Provide incredible customer service and quality products to all of our guests throughout their experience within our bakeries • Support store leadership by maintaining operations during your shift, communicating pertinent information, monitoring production efficiency, holding the team accountable to company standards and procedures, and assisting in the training and coaching of team members • Prioritize and delegate tasks for baking, cashiering, packaging, and cleaning while leading the cookie crew team • Support and work alongside the Cookie Crew • Provide a safe, clean, working environment for our guests and staff and adhere to safe food handling practices • Manage cash handling and deposits DESIRED SKILLS/EXPERIENCE: • At least 1 year of working experience in a customer service focused role • Point of Sales systems experience • Outstanding communication, time management, and people skills • Outgoing/friendly/patient • Detail focused and results-oriented • Ability to lead-by-example and motivate others • Ability to lift up to 40 lbs. • Legally eligible to work in the United States • Must be 18 years or older to be employed

At Insomnia Cookies, our Shift Leaders are the leaders in action. As the person leading the shift, you'll work side-by-side with your Cookie Crew to deliver warm, delicious cookies and an exceptional guest experience. From baking and packing orders to coaching teammates and keeping the bakery running smoothly, you'll lead by example every shift.

If you enjoy fast-paced environments, love working with people, and aren't afraid to roll up your sleeves, this is the role for you.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

As the leader on duty, you will:

  • Lead bakery operations during your shift, ensuring an exceptional guest experience from start to finish.
  • Bake, package, and prepare orders while providing exceptional guest service.
  • Coach and motivate Cookie Crew members, providing direction, feedback, and support throughout the shift.
  • Prioritize and delegate tasks to keep operations running efficiently and meet guest demand.
  • Help maintain our standards for product quality, food safety, cleanliness, and speed of service.
  • Handle cash management, register accountability, and deposits.
  • Communicate important updates and partner with store leadership to keep the bakery operating at its best.
  • Jump in wherever needed to help your team succeed.
QUALIFICATIONS
  • 1+ year of experience in retail, restaurant, hospitality, or another customer-focused environment
  • Strong communication, organization, and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment
  • Positive attitude with a passion for delivering exceptional guest experiences
  • Must be 18 years of age or older
  • Ability to obtain any required food safety certifications applicable to the location
  • Ability to perform the essential functions of the position with or without reasonable accommodation.

Physical Requirements

This position regularly requires the ability to:

  • Stand and walk for extended periods of time (up to 8 hours per shift).
  • Frequently reach, bend, stoop, twist, kneel, and lift.
  • Lift, carry, push, and pull up to 30 pounds regularly.
  • Occasionally lift up to 50 pounds with assistance.
  • Use hands and fingers to handle bakery equipment, food products, and a point-of-sale system.
  • Work in environments with varying temperatures, including around ovens, freezers, and refrigeration units.
  • Safely operate kitchen equipment in accordance with company procedures.
  • Read order screens, recipes, and safety information.
  • Communicate effectively with guests and team members in a fast-paced environment.

Work Environment

This position works in a fast-paced bakery environment that includes frequent interaction with guests, exposure to heat from ovens, refrigerated storage areas, cleaning chemicals, and moderate noise levels. Evening, late-night, weekend, and holiday shifts are a regular part of the business.

Schedule Expectations

Our bakeries are busiest during evenings, late nights, weekends, and holidays. Team Members should have availability during these peak business hours. Scheduling needs vary by location.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Insomnia Cookies is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome. We consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable federal, state, or local law.

Reasonable Accommodation

If you require a reasonable accommodation during any part of the application or hiring process, please let us know. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.

Additional Information

Employment with Insomnia Cookies is contingent upon successful completion of any background checks, employment verification, and other pre-employment requirements applicable to the position and permitted by law.

Ready to Join?

Whether this is your first job or your next step, we're looking for people who bring great energy, take pride in their work, and love making someone's day a little sweeter.

When you join Insomnia Cookies, you'll enjoy:

  • Competitive hourly pay
  • Early Wage Access (get paid the next day!)
  • Flexible scheduling
  • Employee discount (free cookies!)

This is more than a shift supervisor role—it's your opportunity to develop your leadership skills, make an impact every day, and grow your career with one of the fastest-growing bakery brands in the country. Many of our Assistant Managers and Store Managers began their journey as Shift Leaders.

If you're ready to lead a great team, delight guests, and help create warm moments one cookie at a time, we'd love to have you join the Insomnia Cookies family.

title: Sr Product Manager (Agentic User Interface)
description:
Your Future Evolves Here

Evolent partners with health plans and providers to achieve better outcomes for people with most complex and costly health conditions. Working across specialties and primary care, we seek to connect the pieces of fragmented health care system and ensure people get the same level of care and compassion we would want for our loved ones.

Evolent employees enjoy work/life balance, the flexibility to suit their work to their lives, and autonomy they need to get things done. We believe that people do their best work when they're supported to live their best lives, and when they feel welcome to bring their whole selves to work. That's one reason why diversity and inclusion are core to our business.

Join Evolent for the mission. Stay for the culture.

What You’ll Be Doing:

Job Title: Sr Product Manager (Agentic User Interface)


Evolent is building a new AI platform from the ground up, and this role designs how people will actually work with it. As Sr Product Manager for the agentic user interface, you will own the experience through which clinicians, nurses, and operations teams collaborate with AI agents every day: what an agent surfaces, when it asks for a human decision, how it explains itself, and how a reviewer stays in control while practicing at the top of their license. The architecture is still being shaped, the first capabilities are moving into production now, and the company is backing the platform as a central piece of its strategy with dedicated product, engineering, applied AI, and data science teams and standing visibility to the executive team. This is a role for someone who is passionate about user interfaces, working alongside clinicians to design them, and genuinely curious about how the nature of work changes when AI becomes a teammate rather than a tool. If you want to define what that looks like in healthcare, and see it change how care actually gets delivered, this is that role.


Responsibilities

  • Lead the product lifecycle for the agentic user interface from strategic planning to tactical activities, including ideation, discovery, development, launch, and post-launch analysis.
  • Define and articulate the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for how users interact with AI agents, ensuring alignment with the overall AI platform roadmap, Evolent's company goals, and market trends.
  • Conduct thorough user research, competitive analysis, and customer feedback gathering (clinicians, operations teams, and clients) to identify unmet needs and opportunities.
  • Translate complex business requirements and user needs into detailed product specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
  • Collaborate closely with UX design, engineering, architecture, applied AI, data science, and other cross-functional teams to ensure successful product development and delivery.
  • Prioritize the product backlog and manage feature development, ensuring optimal resource allocation and timely delivery against platform and capability delivery dates.
  • Develop and execute go-to-market and adoption strategies, including positioning, messaging, training, and enablement materials for the internal teams and clients who use the interface.
  • Monitor product performance, analyze key metrics such as adoption, task completion, and user trust in agent output, and identify areas for improvement and iteration.
  • Act as a product evangelist, communicating product value and benefits to internal and external stakeholders.
  • Mentor and provide guidance to junior product managers and team members.
  • Lead AI product strategy and roadmap development for the GenAI-enabled capabilities surfaced through the agentic user interface.
  • Partner with data science and engineering leaders to define scalable AI architectures, model evaluation frameworks, and production readiness criteria.
  • Own definition, execution, and measurement of proof-of-concepts and pilot initiatives to validate emerging technologies and interaction patterns.
  • Define product requirements for AI-powered features, including model quality expectations, human-in-the-loop and governance requirements, and user adoption measures.
  • Drive decisions regarding AI feature prioritization based on customer value, operational efficiency, and technical feasibility.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Business, Healthcare Administration) or equivalent practical experience.
  • Minimum 5-7+ years of experience in product management, with a strong emphasis on software products in the healthcare technology sector, including 2+ years owning user-facing applications or platform products consumed by other teams.
  • Proven track record of successfully launching and managing complex software products.
  • Demonstrated ability to define and execute product strategy, roadmap, and go-to-market plans.
  • Strong grounding in user experience (UX) principles and design thinking, with experience partnering with designers and researchers to ship interfaces that people adopt and trust.
  • Hands-on product experience with generative AI systems in production, such as LLM-based workflows, retrieval and document processing pipelines, evaluation and monitoring, and human-in-the-loop review patterns.
  • Working knowledge of modern AI technologies and the trade-offs among them: model selection, prompting and orchestration approaches, retrieval-augmented generation, fine-tuning versus prompting, and agentic patterns.
  • Proven ability to partner with architects and engineers on technical trade-offs, including build versus buy versus partner, canonical data models, and API and event contracts.
  • Experience delivering software in a regulated environment with sensitive or protected data (PHI/PII), including audit, traceability, and access-control requirements.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and make data-driven decisions.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively communicate with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience with Agile development methodologies (e.g., Scrum, Kanban) and proficiency in product management tools (e.g., JIRA, Confluence, Aha!).
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and manage multiple priorities effectively.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Business, Computer Science, Data Science, Human-Computer Interaction, Healthcare Administration, Engineering).
  • Deep understanding of the healthcare industry, including payer, provider, and value-based care models; experience in prior authorization, utilization management, appeals, or payer and provider clinical operations is a plus.
  • Direct experience leading GenAI or machine learning product initiatives from concept through launch, and bringing AI-enabled products to enterprise scale.
  • Experience shipping conversational, copilot, or agent-driven interfaces, including patterns for explainability, confidence and citation display, escalation to a human, and reviewer override.
  • Working knowledge of healthcare interoperability standards such as FHIR, X12 278, and HL7, and of CMS Interoperability and Prior Authorization rules.
  • Depth in Microsoft Azure as a primary platform (e.g., AKS, Service Bus, Azure SQL and Cosmos DB, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Document Intelligence, AI Search). Comparable AWS or Google Cloud depth considered.
  • Experience with agent architectures and orchestration frameworks, embedding and retrieval pipelines, and model routing through a centralized AI gateway.
  • Knowledge of MLOps and LLMOps practices, including evaluation datasets and scoring, shadow-mode validation, drift and quality monitoring, and observability tooling such as OpenTelemetry.
  • Exposure to identity, access, and lifecycle governance for AI systems and agents, and to HITRUST or SOC 2 certification programs.
  • Experience with product analytics and experimentation tools, including A/B testing and usability research methods.
  • Experience collaborating with data scientists on experimentation, model tuning, and deployment strategies.

To ensure a secure hiring process we have implemented several identity verification steps, including submission of a government issued photo ID. We conduct identity verification during interviews, and final interviews may require onsite attendance. All candidates must complete a comprehensive background check, in-person I-9 verification, and may be subject to drug screening prior to employment. The use of artificial intelligence tools during interviews is prohibited and monitored. Misrepresentation will result in immediate disqualification from consideration.

Technical Requirements:

We require that all employees have the following technical capability at their home: High speed internet over 10 Mbps and, specifically for all call center employees, the ability to plug in directly to the home internet router.

If you need reasonable accommodation to access the information provided on this website, please contact recruitingteam@evolent.com for further assistance.

As part of our total compensation package, Evolent is proud to offer comprehensive benefits (including health insurance benefits) to qualifying employees. All compensation determinations are based on the skills and experience required for the position and commensurate with experience of selected individuals, which may vary above and below the stated amounts.

title: Senior Workday HR Reporting & Analytics Analyst
description:
🚀 We're Hiring: Senior Workday HR Reporting & Analytics Analyst

That feeling when your insights help leaders make better people decisions across a global organization…

📍 Location: Remote (Europe Preferred)
🕒 Employment Type: Full-Time
💼 Department: HR Operations

🔍 About the Role

As our new Senior HR Reporting & Analytics Analyst (Workday), you will play a critical role in transforming how HR data is accessed, analyzed, and consumed across JBT Marel.

This role goes beyond traditional reporting.

  • You will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining reporting and analytics solutions that provide business leaders with actionable workforce insights.
  • You will serve as the primary owner of Workday reporting, dashboards, calculated fields, Discovery Boards, and reporting governance.
  • You will work at the intersection of HR technology, analytics, data visualization, and artificial intelligence to deliver scalable and trusted reporting solutions.
  • You will collaborate closely with HR, HR Business Partners, functional Workday teams, and business stakeholders to translate complex business questions into meaningful insights and reporting capabilities.

The ideal candidate combines strong expertise in Workday reporting, analytics, data governance, and stakeholder management with a passion for continuous improvement and digital innovation.

Key Responsibilities

Workday Reporting Ownership & HR Insights

  • Own and continuously enhance JBT Marel's Workday reporting ecosystem, including custom reports, calculated fields, report groups, dashboards, Discovery Boards, and BIRT reports.
  • Deliver accurate, timely, and actionable workforce insights that support HR leaders, HR Business Partners, and business stakeholders in decision-making.
  • Support recurring and ad-hoc reporting requirements across headcount, turnover, compensation, talent, recruiting, payroll, and workforce planning.
  • Translate business questions into scalable reporting solutions that improve visibility and drive data-informed decisions.

HR Analytics, Data Visualization & Digital Innovation

  • Expand HR analytics capabilities beyond Workday through Power BI, Databricks, and other modern analytics technologies.
  • Design and develop interactive dashboards and cross-functional reporting solutions that combine data from multiple HR and business systems.
  • Leverage AI-enabled tools such as Copilot to accelerate report development, improve documentation, and enhance data quality processes.
  • Continuously identify opportunities to automate, simplify, and modernize reporting and analytics processes while improving user experience and self-service capabilities.

Data Governance, Quality & Stakeholder Partnership

  • Partner closely with Workday functional teams, HR Operations, HR Business Partners, and governance stakeholders to ensure reporting solutions align with business needs and enterprise standards.
  • Maintain high standards for data accuracy, compliance, security, documentation, and reporting governance within a SOX-controlled environment.
  • Conduct data validation, troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis to ensure reporting integrity and reliability.
  • Drive standardization and governance by documenting reporting logic, data lineage, refresh schedules, and identifying opportunities to consolidate and optimize reporting solutions across the organization.

🛠️ What Kind of Person Are You?

You will recognize yourself in the following:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Data Analytics, Human Resources, Business Analytics, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience developing reporting solutions within Workday.
  • Strong experience building custom reports, calculated fields, dashboards, and reporting frameworks within Workday.
  • Workday Report Writer Certification is preferred.
  • Proficiency in Power BI, including dashboard design and data modeling.
  • Experience working with HR, workforce, or people data.
  • Strong SQL skills and understanding of relational data structures.
  • Exposure to Databricks or comparable cloud-based analytics platforms.
  • Comfortable utilizing AI-assisted tools such as Copilot to improve productivity and reporting quality.
  • Strong attention to detail with a focus on accuracy, compliance, and data governance.
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex reporting and data quality issues.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to translate technical concepts into business language.
  • Proactive, analytical, and solution-oriented mindset.
  • Collaborative team player with experience working in global and cross-functional environments.
  • Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal.

⭐ Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Workday Prism Analytics.
  • Experience supporting Global People Services or HR Shared Services environments.
  • Experience supporting global, multi-region reporting requirements.
  • Knowledge of change control, data governance, or compliance frameworks.
  • Experience supporting SOX-controlled reporting environments.

🎯 What Success Looks Like

Within the first six months, you will become the trusted owner of key Workday reporting processes and solutions. You will improve reporting efficiency, enhance dashboard capabilities, and expand analytics solutions through Power BI and modern data platforms while maintaining the governance, documentation, and compliance standards required within a global organization.

🏬 Who we are

At JBT Marel, what we do matters. Our people make the difference, and their contribution drives our success.

Our purpose is to transform the future of food, guiding our vision to be the leading partner in sustainable food industry solutions. Partnership is at the heart of everything we do, enabling us to deliver exceptional, end-to-end solutions that build long-term customer trust.

Our values reflect who we are at our best:

  • Serve with integrity
  • Create with collaboration
  • Grow with excellence
  • Advance with innovation

title: Repair Tech - Commission + Free Ski Pass
description:

description:

Our purpose is to help clients exceed their financial health goals. Across the reimbursement cycle, our scalable solutions and clinical expertise help solve programmatic needs. JOB SUMMARY:

CDI Specialists will collaborate extensively with physicians, nursing staff, other patient caregivers, and medical records coding staff to improve the quality, specificity, accuracy and completeness of the documentation of care provided and coded. CDI Specialist will review medical records for opportunities for diagnosis clarification and validity as it pertains to DRG assignment, severity of illness, risk of mortality, and case mix data as well as timely, accurate and complete documentation of clinical information used for measuring and reporting physician and facility outcomes. These goals will be accomplished by chart review and query placement when appropriate following AHIMA guidelines and CorroHealth policies and procedures.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Conduct clinical documentation tasks, meeting productivity and quality standards as set for each project.
  • Adhere to all coding and clinical documentation improvement guidelines as endorsed by AHIMA and ACDIS.
  • Perform review on clinical documentation and issue queries when appropriate.
  • Review medical records for completeness and accuracy for severity of illness and risk of mortality.
  • Accurate and timely record review.
  • Demonstrate knowledge of DRG payer issues, documentation opportunities, and clinical documentation requirements.
  • Analyze findings and identify potential root causes of produced errors.

  • Experience with telecommuting, working with EMRs and other electronic tools.
  • Strong analytical skills.
  • Strong Microsoft Office skills.

  • Ability to work with minimal supervision.

Education & Experience:

  • CCDS, CDEI, or CDIP certification required or be willing to obtain within 6 months from start date.
  • Current clinical license (RN).
  • Two years CDI experience.
  • Two years or more clinical experience in an acute care setting preferred.
  • Coding professional with CCS or RHIT/RHIA and CDI credential. Minimum three years CDI experience in IP CDI reviews required.

title: Data Reviewer, Quality Control Microbiology
description:
Life at BMS

At RayzeBio, every day is an opportunity to ignite meaningful change. As a wholly-owned subsidiary of Bristol Myers Squibb, RayzeBio blends the nimble, pioneering spirit of an emergent biotech with the global expertise and resources of a leading innovator in oncology. Our mission is to develop transformative radiopharmaceutical therapies that offer new hope for patients living with cancer. Here, you’ll join a multidisciplinary team where your ideas are valued, your expertise is amplified, and collaboration is at the heart of everything we do. From day one, expect to make an immediate impact—on our science, on our teams, and most importantly, on patients. Learn more about RayzeBio:


Summary

RayzeBio is seeking a Quality Control Microbiology Data Reviewer, reporting to the Director- Microbiology Quality Control. The Data Reviewer will collaborate with the Radiation Safety Officer (RSO) to ensure laboratory compliance with the radiation safety program at the Indianapolis site. The position will require the applicant to work with and around ionizing radiation and hazardous chemicals.

The position will be located at RayzeBio’s manufacturing plant, in Indianapolis, IN.


Regarding work hours, we ask for candidates to be able to work a flexible schedule, including occasional weekend or off‑shift support based on business needs. This position is an on-site position.

Job Responsibilities

Essential duties and responsibilities include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

· Review and approve raw microbiological data including, but not limited to:

o Sterility testing

o Bioburden testing

o Endotoxin testing

o Media qualification and growth promotion testing

o Environmental Monitoring (viable air, surface, and personnel)

· Verify that out-of-specification (OOS), out-of-trend (OOT), and atypical results are properly identified, documented, and investigated

· Support microbiological investigations at the site.

· Ensure data is reviewed within defined timelines to support batch release and regulatory reporting

· Ensure all reviewed data meets cGMP, FDA, EMA, USP, and ICH requirements

· Support internal and external audits and inspections; serve as a subject matter expert for data review processes

· Author, review, and approve SOPs, batch records, protocols, and technical reports related to microbiological testing

· Compile and trend EM and microbiological data for periodic review reports and management review

· Identify data integrity issues and escalate appropriately in accordance with site procedures

· Partner with Production, Quality Assurance, Validation, and Regulatory Affairs teams to resolve data discrepancies and support investigations (e.g., CAPAs, deviation reports)

· Support method validation and qualification activities by reviewing generated data packages

· Identify non-value-add review steps and propose process improvements to streamline workflows and reduce cycle times

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree (BS) in Microbiology, Biology, or a related life science discipline required.
  • Minimum 3-5 years of experience in a QC Microbiology or related laboratory within a cGMP‑regulated environment.
  • Experience supporting sterile manufacturing and/or radiopharmaceutical operations is highly desirable.
  • Strong working knowledge of microbiological methods, EM programs, and regulatory expectations.

Skills and Qualifications

· Highly organized, detail‑oriented, and capable of managing multiple priorities in a fast‑paced environment.

· Strong knowledge of cGMP, USP <61>, <62>, <71>, <85>, EU GMP Annex 1, and data integrity principles.

· Ability to manage multiple review tasks under tight deadlines

· Effective communication skills — able to clearly document findings and interface with cross-functional teams

· Proactive in identifying process gaps and challenging the status quo to drive improvements

· Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

· Ability to work in classified cleanroom environments while wearing appropriate gowning.

· Uses AI tools to enhance individual productivity and quality of work

Regular interaction within office, warehouse, and manufacturing environments, with PPE required in certain areas.

Work Environment

Moderate noise levels.

Exposure to manufacturing, laboratory, and logistics environments.

description:

From informing customers about unusual charges to answering their questions in real time, our applications of AI & ML are bringing humanity and simplicity to banking. At Capital One, you will help bring the transformative power of emerging AI capabilities to reimagine how we serve our customers and businesses who have come to love the products and services we build.


Team Description:

The AI Foundations team is at the center of bringing our vision for AI at Capital One to life. Our work touches every aspect of the research life cycle, from partnering with Academia to building production systems. We work with product, technology and business leaders to apply the state of the art in AI to our business.


This is a people leader role that will lead teams to drive strategic direction through collaboration with Applied Science, Engineering and Product leaders across Capital One. As a well-respected technologist and people leader, you will guide and mentor a team of applied scientists. You will be expected to be an external leader representing Capital One in the research community, collaborating with prominent faculty members in the relevant AI research community.


What You’ll Do:

  • Partner with a cross-functional team of applied researchers, data scientists, AI engineers, machine learning engineers and product managers to deliver AI-powered products that change how customers interact with their money.
  • Leverage a broad stack of technologies — Pytorch, AWS Ultraclusters, Huggingface, Lightning, and more — to reveal the insights hidden within huge volumes of numeric and textual data.
  • Build and apply AI foundation models through all phases of development, from design through training, evaluation, validation, and implementation.
  • Engage in high impact applied research to take the latest AI developments and push them into the next generation of customer experiences.
  • Flex your interpersonal skills to translate the complexity of your work into tangible business goals.
  • Set the strategic research vision and roadmap for the organization, ensuring alignments between long-term scientific discovery and business transformation priorities

The Ideal Candidate:

  • You love the process of analyzing and creating, but also share our passion to do the right thing. You know at the end of the day it’s about making the right decision for our customers

We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.



Summary

We are building out RayzeBio's intellectual property (IP) function and are looking for an experienced IP attorney dedicated to leading IP strategy and operations for RayzeBio. This role will report into the BMS Law Department and is responsible for developing the vision and managing the execution of global IP strategy for RayzeBio's radiopharmaceutical portfolio.


This position also comes with the opportunity to build and grow RayzeBio's IP team, including leading team members as the function scales, making this a strong opportunity for an IP attorney ready to take on leadership responsibilities.


Key Responsibilities

  • Own and drive global IP strategy for RayzeBio's radiopharmaceutical pipeline, partnering closely with R&D, regulatory, business development, and commercial teams.
  • Serve as the IP lead for RayzeBio, providing IP input into business development, licensing, and other strategic transactions.
  • Manage RayzeBio's high complexity and strategically significant patent matters, including patentability, freedom-to-operate, and validity/invalidity analyses.
  • Lead IP due diligence for M&A, licensing, and collaboration activities, evaluate the IP portfolios of potential partners and acquisition targets, and advise on risk.
  • Develop and implement trade secret protection policies and procedures.
  • Help build and develop RayzeBio's growing IP team, providing technical guidance and supporting career development of team members.
  • Own relationships with, and manage the performance and budget of, outside patent counsel globally to ensure high-quality, cost-effective legal services.
  • Draft, review, and negotiate IP provisions for RayzeBio's most complex and strategically significant transactional agreements, including license agreements, R&D/collaboration agreements, and other high-value strategic transactions.
  • Monitor developments in IP laws and regulations relevant to radiopharmaceuticals and small-molecule chemistry, and advise leadership on their implications.
  • Represent RayzeBio's IP function to internal stakeholders, BMS colleagues, and external partners, including at the leadership-team level as needed.

Qualifications & Experience

  • 12+ years of patent prosecution and IP strategy experience, with substantial focus on small molecule, radiopharmaceutical, and/or peptide chemistry; a combination of law firm and in-house experience is strongly preferred.
  • Registered to practice before the U.S. Patent and Trademark Office.
  • J.D. degree or equivalent and admission to practice law in any U.S. state or the District of Columbia; admission in California preferred.
  • Bachelor's degree in chemistry, biochemistry, or pharmaceutical sciences (or equivalent); an advanced degree and/or scientific research experience with radiopharmaceutical and/or peptide chemistry is preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience mentoring and managing patent attorneys and/or patent agents, or clear readiness to step into a people-leadership role.
  • Substantial experience providing IP due diligence and risk assessment in support of business development, licensing, and transactional activities.
  • Excellent judgment and the demonstrated ability to operate as a trusted strategic partner to senior legal and business leadership.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities across multiple therapeutic programs and stakeholders.
  • Excellent analytical, written, and verbal communication and negotiation skills.
  • Highest integrity, and the ability to proactively recognize and assess business risk and communicate legal issues to patent, legal, and general management.

title: Cookie Crew
description:
Insomnia Cookies was founded in a college dorm room by then-student, Seth Berkowitz. Fast forward 20 years and so... many....cookies... later, our innovative bakery + delivery concept has become a cult brand known for its rabid following of cookie lovers who crave Insomnia’s warm, delicious delivery all day and late into the night. With an expanding footprint of over 350 stores globally, an experiential, “sweet-easy” flagship concept, and large scale operations and delivery capabilities ... Insomnia Cookies is revolutionizing the cookie game by truly "Imagining What’s Possible"!


As a member of the Cookie Crew at our Chattanooga store located at 1351 Broad St Suite 103, you are the ultimate Insomniac. Not only are you the point person at the front of the store for interacting with our customers, but you also get to bake all of our awesome Warm and Delicious cookies as well! Check out some of our content vids below to learn more: Who We Are! Insomnia Cookies Timeline Core Values SOME OF OUR SWEET COOKIE CREW PERKS: · Flexible part-time work schedules · Pay-on-Demand (no longer do you have to wait until the end of the week. Get paid daily for your total shift earnings from the day before!) · Paid vacation and sick time off · Pet insurance for your furry loved ones · Interactive training & mentorship · Job stability with a rapidly growing and reputable company · Achievable growth/promotion opportunities · You get to work in a fun, exciting team environment · Employee discount and FREE COOKIES with every shift! WHAT ELSE WILL I DO AS A MEMBER OF THE COOKIE CREW? · Promptly greet guests entering the store and take their orders according to procedure · Help customers understand menu items, answer clarifying questions, and repeat orders for accuracy · Give each customer a warm experience with a smile in person & over the phone · Bake our delicious cookies to perfection & a scoop of ice cream · Ensure fast, warm, and correct delivery orders are packaged and sent out · Handle cash and payments accurately and have no shortages or overages · Cleaning, sanitizing, and maintaining the bakery DESIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE: · At least 6 months of experience in a customer service focused role - preferred · Personable, genuine, outgoing demeanor · Customer service focused and a willingness to exceed guest expectations · Great communication, organizational and math skills · Must be able to lift up to 40 lb boxes of product · Must be 18 years or older to be employed · Must be able to work nights, weekends and holidays · Legally eligible to work in the United States

At Insomnia Cookies, warm cookies are just the beginning.

As a Cookie Crew Member, you're part baker, part hospitality expert, and part late-night hero. Whether you're welcoming guests into the bakery, pulling a fresh tray of cookies from the oven, or packing the perfect delivery order, you'll help create the experience that keeps our fans coming back night after night.

Our bakeries move fast, especially after the rest of the world has called it a night. Every shift is a team effort, and every warm cookie, friendly interaction, and perfectly packed order matters.

If you enjoy working with great people, thrive in an energetic environment, and love making someone's day just a little sweeter, you'll fit right in.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

Every shift is a little different, but you can expect to:

  • Welcome every guest with genuine hospitality and make every interaction memorable.
  • Prepare, bake, and package our warm cookies, brownies, ice cream, and other treats to Insomnia's quality standards.
  • Accurately prepare in-store, pickup, delivery, and online orders.
  • Operate the register and process guest transactions.
  • Keep the bakery clean, stocked, organized, and food-safe throughout every shift.
  • Jump in wherever your team needs you, whether that's restocking supplies, helping a teammate, or keeping the line moving.
  • Resolve guest concerns with empathy and urgency, partnering with your Shift Leader when needed.
  • Deliver the kind of experience that turns first-time guests into lifelong Insomniacs.
QUALIFICATIONS
  • Must be 18 years of age or older
  • Ability to obtain any required food safety certifications applicable to the location
  • Ability to perform the essential functions of the position with or without reasonable accommodation.

Physical Requirements

This position regularly requires the ability to:

  • Stand and walk for extended periods of time (up to 8 hours per shift).
  • Frequently reach, bend, stoop, twist, kneel, and lift.
  • Lift, carry, push, and pull up to 30 pounds regularly.
  • Occasionally lift up to 50 pounds with assistance.
  • Use hands and fingers to handle bakery equipment, food products, and a point-of-sale system.
  • Work in environments with varying temperatures, including around ovens, freezers, and refrigeration units.
  • Safely operate kitchen equipment in accordance with company procedures.
  • Read order screens, recipes, and safety information.
  • Communicate effectively with guests and team members in a fast-paced environment.

Work Environment

This position works in a fast-paced bakery environment that includes frequent interaction with guests, exposure to heat from ovens, refrigerated storage areas, cleaning chemicals, and moderate noise levels. Evening, late-night, weekend, and holiday shifts are a regular part of the business.

Schedule Expectations

Our bakeries are busiest during evenings, late nights, weekends, and holidays. Team Members should have availability during these peak business hours. Scheduling needs vary by location.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Insomnia Cookies is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome. We consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable federal, state, or local law.

Reasonable Accommodation

If you require a reasonable accommodation during any part of the application or hiring process, please let us know. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.

Additional Information

Employment with Insomnia Cookies is contingent upon successful completion of any background checks, employment verification, and other pre-employment requirements applicable to the position and permitted by law.

Ready to Join the Cookie Crew?

Whether this is your first job or your next step, we're looking for people who bring great energy, take pride in their work, and love making someone's day a little sweeter.

When you join Insomnia Cookies, you'll enjoy:

  • Competitive hourly pay
  • Early Wage Access (get paid the next day!)
  • Flexible scheduling
  • Employee discount (free cookies!)
  • Opportunities for growth into Shift Leader and other bakery leadership roles

Many of our leaders started as Cookie Crew Members and Delivery Drivers. If you're looking for more than just a job, you'll find plenty of opportunities to grow with us.

We can’t wait to meet you!

title: Steward
description:
Pyramid Global Hospitality is a leading hospitality management company with a portfolio of more than 200 hotels and resorts and over 18,000 associates across the United States, Caribbean, and Europe. title: Python Developer Trading Team
description:
Well-reputed proprietary trading firm that builds its own trading technology and runs its own trading desks across a range of markets and asset classes are looking to a hire a talented junior-mid level python developer to be embedded in their core trading team as a dedicated engineer.

job is not building a single product - it is solving many problems of different sizes, helping traders use code effectively, and building the shared tools and foundations the desks need to grow into new products and markets. Your success is measured by what the desks can do, not by how much code you write yourself. Success looks like traders building confidently on what you have put in place, and a codebase that keeps pace with the business.

If you relish working in a small team, side by side with traders and other technical stakeholders, this role is for you!

What you will do: Work with traders to understand their problems and turn them into practical solutions, whether they want a tool built for them or help building it themselves Build and own shared tooling across the trading workflow: reference and market data processing, pricing and strategy configuration, trade analysis, reporting and monitoring Shape the desks' codebase into generic, configurable, well-tested components, and keep it in step with our trading platform as it evolves Champion good engineering practice, including testing, reproducible environments, source control and code review, and make the right approach the easy one

What we're looking for: A bachelor's degree in Computer Science or similar 2-6 years experience (either in or outside of finance) Strong Python. You write code that other people can read, test and extend. Real software engineering judgement: separating concerns, isolating side effects, designing configuration well, and deciding when to generalise and when not to. You have improved or migrated an existing messy codebase without stopping the people who depend on it. Clear written and spoken English. You can explain a technical trade-off to a trader in their terms, and a trader's problem to an engineer in theirs. Curiosity about markets and how trading actually works. Nice to haves: Experience with ETFs, futures, or reference and market data pipelines. Experience reading or debugging C++ well enough to follow an interface or a bug across the boundary. You use AI coding tools confidently and critically. They make you faster and your work better, and you hold what they produce to the same standard as your own code.

This is a full-time role, based in Singapore. Compensaton is highly competitive and contingent on experience.

  • Strong business development skills with the ability to build trust with prospects, clients, and professional partners.
