title: Project Restore Program Manager
description:
The Program Manager provides day-to-day operational, administrative, and programmatic management for Project Restore. Reporting directly to the Program Director, the Program Manager directly supervises the frontline team and coordinates closely with the Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW). This role leads cohort recruitment, attendance tracking, scheduling, crisis response coordination, stipend management, and event logistics for community activations and immersive retreats across the grant term.

About Kings Against Violence Initiative (KAVI)

KAVI is a nonprofit 501(c)(3) youth-serving organization with a mission to prevent and eliminate interpersonal violence from the lives of young people through advocacy, peer leadership, community mobilization, and social justice.


KAVI promotes community wellness and healing by operating high-impact youth violence prevention and intervention programs in Brooklyn. Our programs take place in hospital-based, school, and community settings. We are building a team of individuals willing to work hard, be creative, build on opportunities, and think “out of the box.”


About Project Restore

Project Restore is an intensive, restorative community-based intervention initiative designed to support 28–30 young men (ages 15–28) across two cohorts in the Flatbush neighborhood of Brooklyn. Operated by KAVI in close partnership with the Kings County District Attorney’s Office (KCDA), CUNY Institute for State & Local Governance (ISLG), Center for Justice Innovation (CFJ), and Inside Circle, Project Restore delivers a holistic, trauma-informed model that integrates transformative credible mentoring, clinical mental health support, comprehensive case management, paid career-building internships, community activation events, and immersive retreats.


Job Description:

The Program Manager provides day-to-day operational, administrative, and programmatic management for Project Restore. Reporting directly to the Program Director, the Program Manager directly supervises the frontline team and coordinates closely with the Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW). This role leads cohort recruitment, attendance tracking, scheduling, crisis response coordination, stipend management, and event logistics for community activations and immersive retreats across the grant term.

  • Supervise the Case Managers, Credible Mentors, and Internship Coordinator.
  • Manage day-to-day program activities, staff coordination, logistics, and administration for Project Restore.
  • Supervise the Case Managers, Credible Mentors, and Internship Coordinator.
  • Coordinate session schedules and program locations.
  • Oversee participant recruitment and engagement across both cohorts.
  • Manage logistics for community activation events and retreats.
  • Lead daily check-ins with Case Managers and Credible Mentors to ensure consistent communication on participant engagement, crisis response needs, and emerging concerns.
  • Support weekly all-staff meetings to discuss participant progress and coordinate across roles.
  • Support hiring and onboarding of project staff including Case Managers, Credible Mentors, and the Internship Coordinator during the Pre-Programming phase.
  • Perform other duties as assigned by the Program Director.

Qualifications & Competencies

  • College degree, graduate degree preferred, in criminal justice, social work, or youth development.
  • Experience with program management in a nonprofit, criminal justice, or youth development setting.
  • Experience directly supervising multidisciplinary teams.
  • Prior experience collaborating with courts, probation departments, or legal system partners in New York City preferred.
  • Strong computer skills and proficiency in database management software, Microsoft Suite, Google Suite, and Zoom.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
  • Empathetic communication skills; able to engage and work with individuals and organizations of diverse backgrounds.
  • Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills; solution-oriented and able to think creatively.
  • Excellent time management skills, able to prioritize, coordinate, and organize multiple activities.
  • Flexibility and willingness to adjust and respond to changing situations.
  • Interest in restorative and social justice, and a passion for serving Central Brooklyn communities.
  • Connections to education, workforce development, and youth development organizations a plus.


Compensation: This position is a range budgeted for an annual salary of $70,000-$80,000. Health Benefits and a 403 (b) are available.

How to Apply: Apply via Careers at KAVI - Kings Against Violence Initiative or send your resume to [email protected] and include the position title in the subject line.

title: Market Intelligence Analyst, Cranial and Spinal Technologies - Multiple Locations
location: Minneapolis, Minnesota, United States of America
description:
We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on - 23 Oct 2026


Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

A Day in the Life

As one of Medtronic’s three comprehensive portfolios, Neuroscience is dedicated to improving the lives of people living with neurological disorders, spine conditions, and chronic pain. Guided by our Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life, our Cranial & Spinal Technologies (CST) Operating Unit develops and delivers an integrated ecosystem of spinal implants, navigation and robotic guidance systems, advanced imaging, and data-driven planning tools for complex spine and cranial procedures. Platforms such as AiBLE connect these technologies to enhance surgical precision, streamline workflows, and support improved patient outcomes around the world.

As a Market Intelligence Analyst within the Market Intelligence organization, you develop and maintain procedure market models across Spine, Advanced Energy, and Enabling Technologies, while supporting global model expansion and standardization. You execute primary and secondary market research to track adoption trends and competitive dynamics, and operationalize customer and technology segmentation to enable digital marketing and Big Picture strategic initiatives. You also define and track Medical Education metrics for new program launches, helping ensure clear measurement of impact and performance.


In this role, you support the enterprise market insights strategy by delivering data-driven analyses that inform Marketing, R&D, and Business Development decisions. You provide responsive coverage for investor relations and ad hoc strategic requests, ensuring timely insight delivery across the Operating Unit, Portfolio, and Enterprise. In addition, you own PRM data quality and cleanup efforts in preparation for system consolidation, helping strengthen data integrity and support broader organizational readiness.


Primary Responsibilities:


Market Modeling

  • Maintain and refresh segment-level market models (procedure volumes, pricing, market size, share, and growth) on the annual planning cycle, documenting methodology and sources
  • Support the deepening of market models in global regions, standardizing structure and definitions
  • Manage syndicated and third-party data sources: validate data, track deliverables, and map vendor categories to internal product hierarchies

Research & Competitive Intelligence

  • Execute primary and secondary research to track technology adoption and competitive dynamics
  • Analyze competitor quarterly earnings, product launches, and strategy, and translate the findings into market share and model implications

Segmentation & Program Measurement

  • Maintain customer and technology segmentation and package it for digital marketing and strategic initiatives
  • Partner with Marketing and Medical Education to define and track success metrics for programs and new product launches, including the customer data quality needed to measure them

Insight Delivery

  • Prepare inputs for quarterly market share and investor relations deliverables on a fixed close calendar
  • Turn analysis into clear written summaries, presentations, and recurring updates for Marketing, R&D, Business Development, and leadership
  • Build and maintain Power BI reports and datasets that make market insights self-service
  • Triage ad hoc requests and deliver answers that state the source, scope, and caveats

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree with a minimum of 2 years of relevant experience, or an advanced degree with 0 years of relevant experience
  • Advanced Excel skills (modeling, lookups, pivot tables)

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in market research, market sizing, competitive intelligence, consulting, or financial analysis
  • Coursework or experience in computer science, data science, statistics, or another quantitative field
  • Experience with Power BI and SQL; Snowflake
  • Experience with syndicated healthcare data (procedure volumes, claims, or market reports)
  • Strong written communication, such as experience writing reports, newsletters, or executive summaries
  • Comfort using AI tools for research and analysis, with the judgment to verify their output
  • Demonstrated ability to quickly learn new tools, data sources, and subject matter
  • Medical device, healthcare, or life sciences experience; familiarity with spine or neurosurgery

title: Global AML/KYC Vice President
description:
Do you want your voice heard and your actions to count?

Discover your opportunity with Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG), one of the world’s leading financial groups. Across the globe, we’re 150,000 colleagues, striving to make a difference for every client, organization, and community we serve. We stand for our values, building long-term relationships, serving society, and fostering shared and sustainable growth for a better world.

With a vision to be the world’s most trusted financial group, it’s part of our culture to put people first, listen to new and diverse ideas and collaborate toward greater innovation, speed and agility. This means investing in talent, technologies, and tools that empower you to own your career.

Join MUFG, where being inspired is expected and making a meaningful impact is rewarded.

The selected colleague will work at an MUFG office or client sites four days per week and work remotely one day. A member of our recruitment team will provide more details.

Overview

The Global AML/KYC Vice President sits within the Global Financial Crimes Department (GFCD) and serves as the subject-matter expert for Global KYC requirements, Customer Risk Rating Methodology, Product Risk Rating Methodology, Financial Crimes Geographic Risk Ratings, AML/KYC Screening, and related quality assurance activities. The role is responsible for supporting the implementation, execution, and continuous enhancement of Global KYC requirements to ensure the Bank maintains a consistent and effective approach to customer due diligence, screening, and financial crimes risk management globally.


This role partners closely with GFCD Quality Assurance, GFCD Operations (Technology, Intelligence & Analytics, and Centers of Excellence), Regional Financial Crime Offices, and the Global KYC Office within the First Line of Defense to provide guidance on KYC standards, methodologies, screening requirements, quality assurance activities, and issue remediation efforts.


Responsibilities

• Serve as subject-matter expert for Global KYC requirements, Customer Risk Rating Methodology, Product Risk Rating Methodology, Financial Crimes Geographic Risk Ratings, and AML/KYC Screening, with responsibility for the quality, consistency, and effective application of associated requirements globally.

• Support the development, implementation, operation, and refinement of financial crime risk rating methodologies for customers, geographies, products and services, approved regulators, and stock exchanges.

• Support global AML/KYC screening standards and related advisory activities, including screening requirements, list management, adverse media screening, PEP screening, vendor screening criteria, and related control expectations.

• Assist in the development and analysis of Key Risk Indicators (KRIs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) supporting KYC screening and financial crimes compliance programs.

• Act as a Global KYC point of contact for Quality Assurance escalations, supporting interpretation of Global KYC Standards, QA methodology, scoring guidance, and variance assessments.

• Collaborate with Quality Assurance and regional stakeholders to review findings, assess remediation considerations, and support the resolution of identified control issues.

• Monitor regulatory developments and emerging financial crime risks and support updates to KYC guidance, procedures, standards, and program materials.

• Partner with Sanctions and Anti-Bribery & Corruption teams to ensure alignment on cross-financial crime initiatives and related compliance activities.

• Provide advice, guidance, and subject-matter expertise to regional compliance teams to support effective implementation of KYC and financial crime requirements globally.


Experience

• Minimum 8 years of financial industry compliance experience, preferably within a global organization.

• Must have proven experience related to KYC, Customer Due Diligence (CDD), customer risk rating methodologies, AML/KYC screening programs, and financial crimes risk management frameworks.

• Demonstrated experience working with compliance technology systems and KYC operational processes, including case management, workflow, screening, requirements mapping, and implementation activities.

• Experience supporting quality assurance reviews, issue management, remediation efforts, and regulatory compliance initiatives.


Functional Skills

• Expertise in KYC, Customer Due Diligence (CDD), customer risk rating methodologies, AML/KYC screening, and financial crimes risk management.

• Extensive knowledge of banking laws, regulations, and supervisory expectations administered by the Federal Reserve, OCC, state banking regulators, and other relevant authorities.

• Experience designing and analyzing Key Risk Indicators (KRIs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).

• Strong understanding of compliance technology systems, case management solutions, workflow tools, and screening platforms.

• Strong stakeholder management experience and ability to quickly establish rapport, credibility, trust, and respect throughout the organization, and be viewed as a collaborative business partner.


Foundational Skills

• Strong understanding of financial crimes risk management principles and application of risk-based judgment.

• Effective communication and interpersonal skills.

• Ability to operate in a global, matrixed environment.

• Analytical mindset with ability to evaluate issues, assess risk, and support decision-making.

• Operates strategically to support continuous enhancement of KYC and financial crimes compliance programs.

• Demonstrates a proactive approach to identifying and addressing compliance risks and control issues.

• Leads through collaboration, partnership, and effective stakeholder engagement.

• Exceptional organizational skills with ability to manage multiple priorities while adhering to established milestones and timelines.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to research, draft, and present policies, standards, reports, and presentations for a range of audiences.


Education

• BA or BS Degree required.

• JD, MBA, or Master's Degree in a related field preferred.

description:
Job Title

Electrical and Instrumentation Technician

Job Description Summary

Job Description

Electro-Mechanical Technician - Skilled

Who Are We?

C&W Services is the industry leader in cutting-edge maintenance and janitorial programs for facilities ranging corporate office portfolios and manufacturing plants to large public venues—keeping our client’s facility running smoothly all the time.

What’s The Job?

Title: Electro-Mechanical Technician - Skilled

Location: Memphis, TN

Salary: Up to $44.00/hour depending on experience

Hours: 7:00 am - 3:30 pm (Monday – Friday)

Some On-Call hrs / Weekends / Overtime

What’s in it for me?

  • Weekly pay on Fridays
  • Comprehensive benefits day one, including Employee Perks and Daily Pay Program
  • Advancement opportunities
  • Training to work in a cutting-edge facility
  • Company provided safety apparel and uniforms

What Will I Be Doing?

Here are just a few things you can expect to do daily:

  • Team member must be able to work in a team oriented and safety conscious environment. “Safety First” expectations include, but are not limited to, PJHA process, Observation process, and compliance with all company / site safety guidelines and procedures.
  • Assigned tasks list to include, but not limited to, testing, calibration, and repairs of pneumatic, mechanical, electrical, electromechanical, and electronic measuring, recording, indicating, and control instruments / equipment. Tasks also include repairs and preventive maintenance on pumps, conveying systems, piping, heat exchangers, power transmissions, and other power-driven rotating equipment, repairs and preventive maintenance on heating/air conditioning and/or refrigeration systems. Repairs and preventive maintenance to be performed in conformance with established standards. Responsibilities include equipment installation; repairs to heating, ventilation and air conditioning equipment, troubleshooting malfunctions and preventive maintenance on such equipment, refrigeration troubleshooting and repairs; and other mechanical related work as assigned
  • This position requires the employee to work without supervision.
  • Assist in formulating calibration standards / work procedures while performing those duties and provide work order feedback on discrepancies noted in service delivery.
  • Must have working knowledge of the following topics: pH, flow, temperature, pressure, conductivity and mass measurements, AC and DC control methods, 24V – 480V electrical systems and troubleshooting, VFD’s, burner controls, smart meters, PLC/DCS control methods, automated systems, load cells, control valves, blueprint reading, mathematics, and preventive/predictive maintenance.
  • Must have working knowledge of the following topics: using hand / power tools, precision alignment, rigging, pipefitting, welding, blueprint reading, mathematics, and Preventive / Predictive maintenance.
  • Must be able to use hand tools on a daily basis such as power tools (hand grinders, saws, impact wrenches, drill press, and hydraulic pullers), and rigging equipment. Also perform welding, using a cutting torch as required.
  • Work from elevated areas (ladders, platforms, scaffolding, and others as required) utilizing fall protection equipment when needed.
  • Must be able to operate and have knowledge of simple and complex heavy industrial such as forklifts, scissors lifts, basket trucks, and bobcats.
  • Must have the flexibility to work all shifts including holidays and weekends as demanded by the job.
  • Ensures compliance with all company / customer regulations, policies, and procedures.
  • Achieve performance expectations set forth as part of performance appraisals to include employee development planning.
  • Communications with all team members to assist the development of short and long range planning in assist of the company’s goals and objectives
  • Maintain personal tools required for your job to include an up to date documented personal tool lists. Required tool listing to be supplied as part of employment.
  • Perform assigned tasks in a safe, effective, and efficient manner.
  • Accurate and timely administrative duties to include, but not limited to, time accounting and work order completion.
  • Must maintain positive customer and employee relations.

What Makes Me Qualified?

Don’t meet all of the requirements but are still interested in working for us? Please apply and we will review your resume for other roles!

  • Education: AA degree in Industrial Instrumentation, Electronics or equivalent experience.
  • Industrial Electricity preferred but not required. Ability to obtain Journeyman’s Electrical License upon state required qualifications being met.
  • Experience: 2 – 5 years' experience in industrial instrumentation and electrical maintenance preferred.

What are the physical demands of the role?

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

  • The ability to observe details at close range (within a few feet of the observer).
  • Control Precision — The ability to quickly and repeatedly adjust the controls of a machine or vehicle to exact positions.
  • Manual Dexterity — The ability to quickly grasp, manipulate, or assemble objects.
  • Substantial lifting (up to 50 pounds) is required
  • Ability to move for extended or continuous periods of time
  • Ability to ascend and descend staircases, ladders, and/or step stools
  • Ability to operate applicable hand tools, power tools, and equipment
  • Ability to operate forklifts or other vehicles in a safe manner
  • Ability to wear a respirator while performing job duties
  • Communication/ Expression —The ability to communicate information and ideas so others will understand.
  • Information Ordering — The ability to arrange things or actions in a certain order or pattern according to a specific rule or set of rules (e.g., patterns of numbers, letters, words, pictures, mathematical operations).

What is the work environment?

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable employees with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently exposed to moving mechanical parts; high, precarious places; fumes or airborne particles; toxic or caustic chemicals; risk of electrical shock and vibration. The employee is occasionally exposed to extreme heat and extreme cold, wet and/or humid conditions. The noise level in the work environment is usually very loud.


Cushman & Wakefield also provides eligible employees with an opportunity to enroll in a variety of benefit programs, generally including health, vision, and dental insurance, flexible spending accounts, health savings accounts, retirement savings plans, life, and disability insurance programs, and paid and unpaid time away from work. In addition to a comprehensive benefits package, Cushman and Wakefield provide eligible employees with competitive pay, which may vary depending on eligibility factors such as geographic location, date of hire, total hours worked, job type, business line, and applicability of collective bargaining agreements.


The compensation that will be offered to the successful candidate will depend on factors such as whether the position is covered by a collective bargaining agreement, the geographic area in which the work will be performed, market pay rates in that area, and the candidate’s experience and qualifications.


The company will not pay less than minimum wage for this role.


The compensation for the position is: $37.40 - $44.00

title: Senior Director, Global Industrial Business Unit
description:
The Senior Director, Global Industrial Business Unit will lead Eriez’ global Industrial business, integrating Commercial and Product activities across markets outside the defined Mining vertical. Creating focus and profitable growth across a diverse portfolio, ranging from repeatable products and shorter-cycle transactions to engineered solutions. Owning BU commercial results, product priorities, channel effectiveness, and coordinated global execution.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop Industrial strategy, operating plan, budget, and forecast for approval. Own BU orders, revenue, commercial contribution, controllable expense, and corrective action.
  • Identify priority markets and applications and allocate approved resources accordingly. Define where Eriez will grow, defend, simplify, partner, or recommend exit, supported by customer and product economics.

  • Build global commercial and product capability, succession, and performance discipline. Reduce avoidable duplication while preserving local responsiveness and justified certifications and routes to market.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, engineering, science, or a related field; advanced degree beneficial. Typically, 12–15+ years of progressive experience, including global or multi-country commercial/product leadership.

We are seeking a talented Full Stack Developer (AI-Enabled) to join us. This role combines strong full stack engineering expertise with hands-on fluency in AI-assisted development tools to design, build, and deliver modern digital solutions at speed and scale. You'll work across the entire application stack - from intuitive user interfaces to robust APIs and data services - while leveraging AI coding assistants and, where appropriate, integrating AI capabilities into the products you build. You will help the team raise engineering productivity and quality through smart, responsible use of AI, and contribute to shaping how NCS delivers AI-enabled software to our clients.

Key Responsibilities

Full Stack Application Development

  • Design, develop, test, and deploy end-to-end web applications spanning frontend, backend services, APIs, and data layers
  • Translate functional and non-functional requirements into well-architected, maintainable software components using established design patterns
  • Build and maintain microservices and RESTful / GraphQL APIs using modern stacks such as Java/Spring Boot, .NET, Python, or Node.js
  • Model data and work with both SQL and NoSQL databases; design efficient queries, schemas, and integration patterns
  • Contribute to architecture discussions and trade-off analyses for performance, scalability, security, and cost

AI-Assisted Software Engineering

  • Use AI-assisted coding tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, Amazon Q Developer, Gemini Code Assist, JetBrains AI Assistant, or equivalent) as a daily part of the development workflow
  • Leverage AI tools to accelerate coding, refactoring, code review, unit test generation, test data creation, and documentation
  • Apply prompt engineering and context-design techniques to get high-quality, trustworthy outputs from AI coding assistants
  • Critically review AI-generated code for correctness, security, performance, licensing, and alignment with project and NCS coding standards before committing
  • Measure and communicate the productivity and quality impact of AI-assisted workflows on project delivery

AI Solution Integration & Delivery

  • Integrate AI and Generative AI capabilities into enterprise applications - including LLM-powered features, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), chatbots and virtual assistants, intelligent document processing, recommendations, and agentic workflows
  • Build against foundation model APIs and managed AI services such as Azure OpenAI, Amazon Bedrock, Google Vertex AI / Gemini, Anthropic Claude, and OpenAI
  • Work with vector databases and AI application frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel; pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS) to deliver context-aware experiences
  • Design AI features with clear evaluation criteria, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints
  • Partner with data scientists, AI/ML engineers, and solution architects to take AI capabilities from prototype to production
  • Contribute to pre-sales and client engagements by prototyping AI-enabled features and shaping practical, value-driven solution designs
  • Integrate the application with existing enterprise and operational systems through REST APIs, streaming/event interfaces, databases, and other approved integration mechanisms, working closely with client cloud and data teams
  • AI-enabled application development, including real-time data-driven applications, AI/ML and LLM integration, agentic workflows, and operational decision-support systems

Quality Engineering & Secure Coding

  • Follow secure coding principles and NCS security guidelines to prevent common vulnerabilities across frontend, backend, and AI integrations
  • Write and maintain unit, integration, and end-to-end tests; meet project and organisation test coverage targets
  • Perform static code analysis, code reviews, and threat-aware reviews of AI-generated code and AI-integrated features
  • Address defects, performance issues, and production incidents through disciplined root-cause analysis
  • Adopt Agile, DevOps, and CI/CD practices to deliver software iteratively and reliably
  • Build and maintain pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI) for automated build, test, and deployment
  • Containerise applications and deploy to container platforms (Docker, Kubernetes) and cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Instrument applications for observability - logs, metrics, traces, and, where applicable, AI-feature evaluation telemetry
  • Partner with business analysts, designers, data scientists, and product owners to translate user needs into working software
  • Participate in and lead peer reviews, design reviews, and knowledge-sharing sessions
  • Mentor junior developers on full stack engineering fundamentals and effective, responsible use of AI tools
  • Document designs, APIs, and AI-integration patterns in a clear and reusable way
  • Champion responsible use of AI tools, including IP protection, client data handling, confidentiality, and licence-compliance considerations
  • Help define and uphold team guardrails and standards for AI-assisted development and AI-integrated products
  • Stay current with the rapidly evolving AI tooling, model, and framework landscape, and bring relevant advances back to the team
  • Contribute to NCS assets, reusable components, and reference implementations that accelerate future AI-enabled delivery

Qualifications

  • Diploma, Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field; relevant coding certifications are also welcome
  • 3 to 8 years of professional experience building and delivering production web applications as a full stack developer
  • Strong hands-on proficiency in at least one backend stack: Node.js (Express, NestJS), Golang, Python.
  • Solid understanding of API design (REST, JSON; GraphQL a plus), microservices, event-driven patterns, and integration with third-party systems
  • Experience with SQL and NoSQL databases (e.g., Oracle, MS SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis)
  • Experience with Git-based source control, Agile delivery, test-driven development, and CI/CD toolchains
  • Working experience with containers and cloud platforms (Docker, Kubernetes; AWS, Azure, or GCP)
  • Demonstrated day-to-day use of AI-assisted coding tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, Amazon Q Developer, Gemini Code Assist, JetBrains AI Assistant, Tabnine, Windsurf, or equivalent) and ability to articulate how these tools have improved your delivery quality and speed
  • Working knowledge of prompt engineering and how to structure effective context and instructions for AI coding assistants
  • Familiarity with Large Language Models and Generative AI concepts - tokens, context windows, embeddings, vector search, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
  • Exposure to at least one LLM / GenAI platform or SDK (OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Amazon Bedrock, Google Vertex AI / Gemini, Hugging Face)
  • Involvement in at least one project that delivered an AI solution capability - such as a GenAI / LLM-powered application, RAG system, chatbot or virtual assistant, intelligent document processing, ML-powered feature, or AI agent - is a strong plus
  • Exposure to AI application frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel), vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector, FAISS), agentic patterns, tool/function calling, Model Context Protocol (MCP), and AI evaluation or guardrail practices is a plus
  • Awareness of responsible AI principles, data privacy, IP considerations, and security implications of using AI tools on client engagements
  • Strong problem-solving, analytical thinking, and sound judgement in when - and when not - to rely on AI-generated output
  • Excellent written and spoken English, with strong communication and collaboration skills in a team environment
  • Self-motivated, customer-focused, and committed to high engineering and delivery standards

Additional Information

Why Join NCS

Lead high-impact AImanagement consultingprograms for major enterprises and public sector clients.

Shape enterprise strategies and governance frameworks that drive real transformation.

Work with a talented, multidisciplinary team in a collaborative environment.

Competitive compensation and strong professional development support.

We are driven by our AEIOU beliefs—Adventure, Excellence, Integrity, Ownership, and Unity—and we seek individuals who embody these values in both their professional and personal lives. We are committed to our Impact: Valuing our clients, Growing our people, and Creating our future.

Together, we make the extraordinary happen.

Learn more about us at ncs.co and visit our LinkedIn career site.

title: Digital Business Expert - Accounts & Services
description:
At ING we are looking for a Digital Business Expert - Account & services



Your role and work environment:


We are looking for a talented and enthusiastic Digital Business Expert to join our Surfing Account squad of Daily Banking & Savings Tribe


The responsibility of this team is to give an outstanding service to transactional customers, as well as develop them towards MPB. In addition, there are added value services such as travel plan, Global Exchange or Tax Down, that we want to offer in the best way to our customers, to increase their engagement and satisfaction with the bank.


Your key responsibilities:


As a Digital Business Expert of Surfing Account, you will:


- Contributing to the development of our customers, by offering added value services that they can contract and promoting that they bring their payroll to become into Mobile Primary Bank

- Continuous follow-up of different campaigns, hand-by-hand with Marketing and CI.

- Designing communication strategy to increase the penetration in the different services

- Having the operative and financial risk under control, according to the internal and external regulatory framework

- Leading our partners relationship, ensuring smooth communication.

- Building strong and healthy communication with all the ING Stakeholders to reach our goals

- Increase customer satisfaction, managing the Voice of the Customers and proposing improvements


What are we looking for?


Want to know if this job is made for you? These are some of the qualities that we value the most for this role. And if the shoe fits… don’t hesitate to apply!


  • Customer-centric mindset, with experience analyzing customer trends, behaviors and usage patterns.
  • able to work in an autonomous way, to take initiative and to make things happen with a can-do attitude.
  • Problem solving mindset.
  • Strong analytical skills, with advanced knowledge of Excel, Power BI and/or MicroStrategy.
  • Excellent communication skills in English and Spanish, with the ability to influence and align diverse stakeholders.
  • High adaptability to changing environments and priorities.




What do we offer?


The time you spend at work, the challenges you face or the lessons you get are very important, but… What about your personal life? At ING we want your work to fulfill you in every way, and that is why we take care of even the smallest details.


Check out what is waiting for you!


Balance That Works.

We put balance to work, so you can do it too. With our customers’ needs first, the team´s and your own, we agree when to come to ING MAD and when to work best from home. More time together when it matters, more freedom when you need it.


Restaurant card.

So that thinking about what to have for lunch doesn’t take up your time or your cravings.


Our house will be your home.

In our offices you can find electric mobility solutions, doctor, hairdresser, gym, The Good Service (to help you with your errands) and much more!


Health insurance.

For you and all your family (spouse/partner and children).


Life insurance.

We help you protect what matters most to you.


Flexible remuneration.

In addition, you will enjoy our flexible remuneration model, through a more tax-advantaged way, you will be able to access other services such as nursery, transport card, training aids…


Free company shuttle.

It doesn't matter where you live. We have 6 routes (North, Central, South, A5, A42 and A6) to get you to our ING office in Madrid comfortably.


Banking benefits.

Special loans with more beneficial conditions.

Special mortgage conditions after 6 months working at the bank.

And you can benefit from our pension plan after 1 month with us!


More vitality and more belonging

360º care of the employee (physical, mental, social connection & purpose).

Physiotherapy service on site.

Clinics with professional, world-class athletes.

Gympass service.

Employee Networks: Rainbow Lions (LGBTQI+), Leonas & RIÑG.

International Remote work program.


Get to know Us


We are a team of more than 1800 people sharing one idea: doing our bit in helping our clients create a better future for themselves, by providing them with the tools they need to get where they want to go.


A fully online bank where technology, innovation, simplicity and transparency are the main ingredients, and the first one to work with agile methodologies.


And although we are based in Spain, we are lucky to work in an international bank with presence in more than 40 countries.


We are proud to have a diverse team, and we are committed to continue developing a culture of Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging to foster a culture of collaboration and innovation that represents all collectives in the society.


And even though we look orange on the outside, we are green on the inside. Our ambition in Sustainability is Empowering (y)our Sustainability journey. We are embarking on our path, for us, but we are also there for when our clients decide to embark on this journey.


Making things happen, helping others be successful, always being one step ahead—that’s our DNA. If you look at yourself in the mirror and your reflection matches our way of being and working…we are looking forward to meeting you!


At ING, you belong just as you are. We hire and support people for their talent and potential — and we know that when you can be yourself, you do your best work.


Job Application Safety Reminder


We’re seeing an increase in fraudulent job offers. To protect yourself, please follow these key guidelines when applying for roles at ING:

  • Apply only via official ING platforms: ING uses Workday and LinkedIn as its internal recruitment system. Applications should be submitted only via our official career site or via ING job postings on LinkedIn.
  • Check the sender’s email carefully: Legitimate communication will always come from @ing.com and/or @myworkday.com.
  • No payments or banking details will ever be requested: If someone asks for this information, it’s a scam.

______________________________________________________________

En ING estamos buscando un/a Digital Business Expert - Surfing Account


Tu función y entorno de trabajo:


Estamos buscando una persona con talento y entusiasmo para el puesto de Digital Business Expert que se incorpore a nuestra squad de Surfing Account dentro de la Daily Banking & Savings Tribe.


La responsabilidad de este equipo es ofrecer un servicio excepcional a la clientela transaccional, así como desarrollarla hacia MPB. Además, existen servicios de valor añadido como Travel Plan, Global Exchange o Tax Down, que queremos ofrecer de la mejor manera a nuestra clientela para incrementar su engagement y satisfacción con el banco.


Tus principales responsabilidades:


Como Digital Business Expert de Surfing Account, te encargarás de:

  • Contribuir al desarrollo de nuestra clientela, ofreciendo servicios de valor añadido que puedan contratar y promoviendo que domicilien su nómina para convertirse en Mobile Primary Bank.
  • Realizar un seguimiento continuo de diferentes campañas, mano a mano con Marketing y CI.
  • Diseñar la estrategia de comunicación para incrementar la penetración de los distintos servicios.
  • Mantener bajo control el riesgo operativo y financiero, de acuerdo con el marco regulatorio interno y externo.
  • Liderar la relación con nuestras entidades colaboradoras, garantizando una comunicación fluida.
  • Construir una comunicación sólida y saludable con todas las personas stakeholder de ING para alcanzar nuestros objetivos.
  • Incrementar la satisfacción de la clientela, gestionando la Voz de la Clientela y proponiendo mejoras.

¿Qué estamos buscando?

¿Quieres saber si este puesto está hecho para ti? Estas son algunas de las cualidades que más valoramos para esta posición. Y si te identificas con ellas… ¡no dudes en inscribirte!

  • Orientación a la clientela, con experiencia en el análisis de tendencias, comportamientos y patrones de uso de clientes.
  • Capacidad para trabajar de forma autónoma, tomar la iniciativa y hacer que las cosas sucedan con una actitud proactiva.
  • Mentalidad orientada a la resolución de problemas.
  • Sólidas capacidades analíticas, con conocimiento avanzado de Excel, Power BI y/o MicroStrategy.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicación en inglés y español, con capacidad para influir y alinear a distintos grupos de stakeholders.
  • Alta capacidad de adaptación a entornos y prioridades cambiantes.

¿Qué ofrecemos?


El tiempo que pasas en el trabajo, los retos a los que te enfrentas o los aprendizajes que obtienes son muy importantes, pero… ¿qué hay de tu vida personal? En ING queremos que tu trabajo te llene en todos los sentidos, y por eso cuidamos hasta el más mínimo detalle.

¡Descubre lo que te está esperando!


Balance That Works

Ponemos el equilibrio en valor, para que tú también puedas hacerlo. Con las necesidades de nuestros/as clientes/as en primer lugar, el equipo y tú acordáis cuándo venir a ING MAD y cuándo trabajar mejor desde casa. Más tiempo juntos cuando importa, más libertad cuando la necesitas.

Tarjeta restaurante.

Para que pensar qué comer no te quite tiempo ni te genere antojos.


Nuestra casa será tu hogar.

En nuestras oficinas encontrarás soluciones de movilidad eléctrica, servicio médico, peluquería, gimnasio, The Good Service (para ayudarte con tus gestiones) ¡y mucho más!


Seguro médico.

Para ti y toda tu familia (cónyuge/pareja e hijas e hijos).


Seguro de vida.

Te ayudamos a proteger lo que más te importa.


Retribución flexible

Además, disfrutarás de nuestro modelo de retribución flexible, a través del cual, de una forma fiscalmente más ventajosa, podrás acceder a otros servicios como guardería, abono transporte, ayudas a la formación…


Servicio de lanzadera gratuito en la empresa

No importa dónde vivas. Contamos con 6 rutas (Norte, Centro, Sur, A5, A42 y A6) para llevarte cómodamente a nuestra oficina de ING en Madrid.


Beneficios bancarios

Préstamos especiales con condiciones más beneficiosas.

Condiciones especiales en hipotecas tras 6 meses trabajando en el banco.

¡Y podrás beneficiarte de nuestro plan de pensiones después de 1 mes con nosotras y nosotros!


Más vitalidad y más sentimiento de pertenencia

Cuidado 360º de la persona empleada (físico, mental, conexión social y propósito).
Servicio de fisioterapia en las oficinas.
Clínicas con deportistas profesionales de primer nivel mundial.
Servicio Gympass.
Employee Networks: Rainbow Lions (LGBTQI+), Leonas & RIÑG.
Programa de trabajo remoto internacional.


Conócenos


Somos un equipo de más de 1.800 personas que compartimos una misma idea: poner de nuestra parte para ayudar a nuestras personas clientas a crear un futuro mejor para sí mismas, proporcionándoles las herramientas que necesitan para llegar donde quieren.


Un banco 100 % digital, donde la tecnología, la innovación, la simplicidad y la transparencia son los principales ingredientes, y el primero en trabajar con metodologías agile.


Y aunque estamos en España, tenemos la suerte de trabajar en un banco internacional con presencia en más de 40 países.


Estamos orgullosas y orgullosos de contar con un equipo diverso, y estamos comprometidas y comprometidos a seguir desarrollando una cultura de Diversidad, Inclusión y Pertenencia para fomentar una cultura de colaboración e innovación que represente a todos los colectivos de la sociedad.


Y aunque por fuera seamos naranjas, por dentro somos verdes. Nuestra ambición en Sostenibilidad es Empowering (y)our Sustainability journey. Estamos recorriendo este camino para nosotras y nosotros, pero también acompañamos a nuestras personas clientas cuando deciden emprenderlo.


Hacer que las cosas sucedan, ayudar a que otras personas tengan éxito, ir siempre un paso por delante: ese es nuestro ADN. Si te miras al espejo y tu reflejo encaja con nuestra forma de ser y de trabajar… ¡estamos deseando conocerte!


En ING, perteneces tal y como eres. Contratamos y apoyamos a las personas por su talento y potencial — y sabemos que cuando puedes mostrarte tal y como eres, haces tu mejor trabajo.


Job Application Safety Reminder


Estamos detectando un aumento de ofertas de empleo fraudulentas. Para protegerte, sigue estas pautas clave al aplicar en posiciones de ING:

  • Inscríbete solo a través de plataformas oficiales de ING: ING utiliza Workday y LinkedIn como su sistema interno de reclutamiento. Las candidaturas deben enviarse únicamente a través de nuestro sitio oficial de carreras o mediante ofertas de empleo de ING en LinkedIn.
  • Revisa cuidadosamente el remitente del correo electrónico: Las comunicaciones legítimas siempre procederán de @ing.com y/o @myworkday.com.
  • Nunca se solicitarán pagos ni datos bancarios: Si alguien te pide esta información, se trata de un fraude.

title: Senior Manager, Full-stack Engineer (Java, Golang, AWS)
description:
Senior Manager, Full-stack Engineer (Java, Golang, AWS)

Do you love building and pioneering in the technology space? Do you enjoy solving complex business problems in a fast-paced, collaborative, inclusive and iterative delivery environment?

At Capital One, you'll be part of a big group of makers, breakers, doers and disruptors who solve real problems and meet real customer needs. We are seeking Full-stack Software Engineering leaders who are passionate about building high-performing teams, driving technical strategy and leveraging cutting-edge open-source frameworks alongside emerging technologies. In this role, you’ll be at the forefront of mentoring engineering talent and leading major technology transformations across Capital One.


What You’ll Do:

  • Lead a portfolio of diverse technology projects and a team of developers with deep experience in distributed microservices, and full stack systems to create solutions that help meet regulatory needs for the company
  • Share your passion for staying on top of tech trends, experimenting with and learning new technologies, participating in internal & external technology communities, mentoring other members of the engineering community, and from time to time, be asked to code or evaluate code
  • Collaborate with digital product managers, and deliver robust cloud-based solutions that drive powerful experiences to help millions of Americans achieve financial empowerment
  • Lead teams utilizing programming languages like Java, Scala, Python, Go, Node.js, JavaScript and TypeScript, Open Source RDBMS and NoSQL databases, Container Orchestration services including Docker and Kubernetes, and a variety of AWS tools and services
  • Lead multiple Agile engineering teams or programs, providing strategic direction and ensuring delivery of large-scale, cross-functional initiatives
  • Partner with product, architecture, and platform leaders to define multi-year technology roadmaps and investment priorities
  • Develop and manage Lead Engineers and leads, building succession plans and scaling leadership capability across teams
  • Drive alignment between engineering execution and enterprise goals, influencing portfolio-level decisions and trade-offs
  • Drive end-to-end design and implementation of large-scale, distributed, or cloud-native systems with high reliability and performance requirements

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree or higher in Computer Science or a related quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Engineering)
  • At least 6 years of experience in software engineering (Internship experience does not apply)
  • At least 3 years of experience with public cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure), cloud-based productivity tools, or virtualization technologies
  • At least 3 years of people management experience

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Master’s Degree in Computer Science or a related field
  • 1+ year of experience leading architectural design reviews and influencing enterprise-wide technical standards and methodologies
  • 4+ years of experience with database and database management systems
  • 4+ years of experience with AWS, GCP, Azure, or cloud-based productivity tools or virtualization technologies
  • 4+ years of experience with CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, and automated testing frameworks
  • 4+ years of experience using Git-based version-control systems (e.g., Git, GitHub, Bitbucket)
  • 4+ years of experience troubleshooting technical issues within cloud environments
  • 5+ years of experience contributing to open source frameworks
  • 5+ years of experience with front-end JavaScript or TypeScript frameworks
  • 5+ years of experiencing creating synchronous and asynchronous APIs
  • 9+ years of experience coding with more than two of the following: Go, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Rust, C#, Scala
  • Experience leveraging modern AI-based coding tools and IDE copilots
  • Experience managing multi-team engineering organizations or leading strategic technical programs spanning multiple domains
  • Experience defining and tracking engineering OKRs that align to business outcomes
  • Experience shaping organization design and talent strategy for scaling engineering capabilities
  • Experience presenting technology roadmaps and investment cases to executive leadership

Capital One will consider sponsoring a new qualified applicant for employment authorization for this position.

This role is also eligible to earn performance based incentive compensation, which may include cash bonus(es) and/or long term incentives (LTI). Incentives could be discretionary or non discretionary depending on the plan.

Capital One offers a comprehensive, competitive, and inclusive set of health, financial and other benefits that support your total well-being. Learn more at the Capital One Careers website. Eligibility varies based on full or part-time status, exempt or non-exempt status, and management level.

This role is expected to accept applications for a minimum of 5 business days.

No agencies please. Capital One is an equal opportunity employer (EOE, including disability/vet) committed to non-discrimination in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. Capital One promotes a drug-free workplace. Capital One will consider for employment qualified applicants with a criminal history in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable laws regarding criminal background inquiries, including, to the extent applicable, Article 23-A of the New York Correction Law; San Francisco, California Police Code Article 49, Sections 4901-4920; New York City’s Fair Chance Act; Philadelphia’s Fair Criminal Records Screening Act; and other applicable federal, state, and local laws and regulations regarding criminal background inquiries.

If you have visited our website in search of information on employment opportunities or to apply for a position, and you require an accommodation, please contact Capital One Recruiting at 1-800-304-9102 or via email at RecruitingAccommodation@capitalone.com. All information you provide will be kept confidential and will be used only to the extent required to provide needed reasonable accommodations.

For technical support or questions about Capital One's recruiting process, please send an email to Careers@capitalone.com

title: HR Communication Intern
description:
A day in the life of an HR Communication intern

  • You’ll contribute to the development and delivery of internal communications campaigns and initiatives related to HR topics.
  • You’ll sharpen your copywriting skills: you’ll write for the intranet, the HR newsletter, Viva Engage, ING Belgium’s LinkedIn account and create copy for Employer Branding social media ads.
  • You’ll analyse the impact of communication campaigns.

How to succeed
We hire smart people like you for your potential. Our biggest expectation is that you’ll stay curious. Keep learning. Take on responsibility. In return, we’ll support you to develop into an even more awesome version of yourself.

  • You are a Bachelor or Master student in Communications, Marketing or Modern Languages
  • You are interested in people topics and enjoy diving into subjects like workplace culture, employee wellbeing, and human connection, always eager to make a positive difference
  • You speak native French and/or Dutch and are fluent in English
  • You have excellent writing skills, are organized, creative and a real team player

As an HR Communication Intern, you will have the opportunity to:

  • Get a hands-on experience of HR Communication and Employer Branding in a fast-paced and varied environment.
  • The tasks/projects you might work on include (among others):
  • Coordinating an internal newsletter
  • Copywriting internal news articles, Viva engage posts and organic/paid LinkedIn posts
  • Supporting in the development of internal and external communication projects and campaigns
  • Analyzing communication performances

The team
You’ll join a close-knit HR Communication team, where 5 creative minds collaborate to shape impactful campaigns across a wide spectrum of HR topics; from learning and wellbeing to rewards and recognition, and everything in between.
In addition to internal communication, the team is also in charge of Employer Branding and (co)manages ING Belgium’s LinkedIn account, career website and the launch of standout Employer Branding campaigns that attract top talent and showcase our vibrant culture.
In a nutshell: you’ll immerse yourself in the dynamic world of internal and external HR communications, collaborating with passionate professionals who are eager to mentor you. Every day brings new opportunities to learn, experiment, and grow, helping you build skills that will set you apart in your career.
ING favors an open, empowering culture, and this is also the case in this team. All ideas are valued, and everyone is encouraged to be their true self at work.



French

Une journée type en tant que Stagiaire en Communication RH


  • Vous contribuez à la création et à la mise en œuvre de campagnes et d’initiatives de communication interne liées aux sujets RH.
  • Vous mettez en pratique vos compétences rédactionnelles : articles pour l’intranet, newsletter RH, publications Viva Engage, publications sur le compte LinkedIn d’ING Belgique et contenus pour des campagnes d’Employer Branding sur les réseaux sociaux.
  • Vous analysez l’impact des campagnes de communication.

Comment réussir
Nous recrutons des personnes talentueuses pour leur potentiel. Notre plus grande attente : que vous restiez curieux·se, continuiez à apprendre et preniez des responsabilités. En retour, nous vous aiderons à devenir une version encore plus exceptionnelle de vous-même.

  • Vous êtes étudiant·e en Bachelier ou Master en Communication, Marketing ou Langues Modernes.
  • Vous vous intéressez aux sujets RH et aimez explorer des thèmes tels que la culture d’entreprise, le bien-être des employés et la connexion humaine.
  • Vous parlez français et/ou néerlandais (langue maternelle) et maîtrisez l’anglais.
  • Vous avez d’excellentes compétences rédactionnelles, êtes organisé·e, créatif·ve et aimez travailler en équipe.

En tant que Stagiaire en Communication RH, vous aurez l’opportunité de :

  • Acquérir une expérience concrète en Communication et Employer Branding dans un environnement dynamique et varié.
  • Participer à des projets tels que :
    o Coordination d’une newsletter interne
    o Rédaction d’articles internes, de publications viva Engage et de posts LinkedIn (organiques et sponsorisés)
    o Soutien au développement de projets et de campagnes de communication interne et externe
    o Analyse des performances des campagnes

L’équipe
Vous rejoindrez une équipe de communication soudée composée de 5 esprits créatifs qui collaborent pour concevoir des campagnes impactantes sur une large gamme de sujets RH : apprentissage, bien-être, bénéfices, et bien plus encore.
En plus de la communication interne, l’équipe gère l’Employer Branding, le compte LinkedIn d’ING Belgique, le site carrière et le lancement de campagnes attractives qui mettent en valeur notre culture dynamique.
En résumé : vous plongerez dans l’univers passionnant de la communication RH interne et externe, aux côtés de professionnels enthousiastes prêts à vous accompagner. Chaque jour sera une occasion d’apprendre, d’expérimenter et d’évoluer, en développant des compétences qui feront la différence dans votre carrière. Chez ING, nous favorisons une culture ouverte et l’empowerment, et cela vaut aussi pour cette équipe : toutes les idées sont valorisées et chacun·e est encouragé·e à être soi-même au travail.



Dutch

Een dag in het leven van een HR Communication Intern

  • Je draagt bij aan de ontwikkeling en uitvoering van interne communicatiecampagnes en -initiatieven rond HR-thema’s.
  • Je scherpt je copywritingskills aan: je schrijft voor het intranet, de HR-nieuwsbrief, Viva Engage, de LinkedIn-pagina van ING België en maakt copy voor Employer Branding-advertenties op sociale media.
  • Je analyseert de impact van communicatiecampagnes.

Wanneer ben je succesvol
We werven slimme mensen aan zoals jij vanwege je potentieel. Onze grootste verwachting is dat je nieuwsgierig blijft. Blijf leren. Neem verantwoordelijkheid. In ruil daarvoor ondersteunen we je om een nog betere versie van jezelf te worden.

  • Je bent een Bachelor- of Masterstudent in Communicatie, Marketing of Moderne Talen
  • Je hebt interesse in mensgerichte thema’s en duikt graag in onderwerpen zoals werkcultuur, welzijn van medewerkers en menselijke connectie, altijd met de ambitie om een positieve impact te maken
  • Je spreekt Frans en/of Nederlands (moedertaal) en bent vloeiend in Engels
  • Je hebt uitstekende schrijfvaardigheden, bent georganiseerd, creatief en een echte teamspeler

Als HR Communication Intern krijg je de kans om:

Hands-on ervaring op te doen in HR Communicatie en Employer Branding in een dynamische en gevarieerde omgeving.


Mogelijke taken/projecten:

  • Coördineren van een interne nieuwsbrief
  • Copywriting van interne nieuwsartikelen, Viva Engage- posts en organische/betaalde LinkedIn-posts
  • Meewerken aan de migratie van het HR-intranet
  • Ondersteunen bij de ontwikkeling van interne en externe campagnes
  • Analyseren van communicatieresultaten

Het team
Je sluit aan bij een hecht HR Communicatieteam, waar 5 creatieve geesten samenwerken om impactvolle campagnes te creëren rond een breed scala aan HR-thema’s: van leren en welzijn tot verloningen en erkenning, en alles daartussen.
Naast interne communicatie is het team ook verantwoordelijk voor Employer Branding en (co)beheert het LinkedIn-account van ING België, de carrièrewebsite en de lancering van onderscheidende Employer Branding-campagnes die toptalent aantrekken en onze levendige cultuur in de kijker zetten.
Kortom: je dompelt je onder in de dynamische wereld van interne en externe HR-communicatie, samenwerkend met gepassioneerde professionals die je graag begeleiden. Elke dag biedt nieuwe kansen om te leren, experimenteren en groeien, zodat je vaardigheden ontwikkelt die je onderscheiden in je carrière.
ING staat voor een open, stimulerende cultuur, en dat geldt ook voor dit team. Alle ideeën zijn welkom en iedereen wordt aangemoedigd om zichzelf te zijn op het werk.

title: Enterprise Systems Director
description:
Blueland is reimagining everyday cleaning essentials with safe, products that are free from single-use plastic and eliminate the need to choose between what’s safe for your family, good for the planet, and proven to work. With 45 patents granted & 39 patents pending worldwide, Blueland’s innovative products have diverted over 1 billion single-use plastic bottles from landfills and oceans and 7.5 million pounds of CO2 from the atmosphere since 2019. While traditional cleaners are packaged in plastic and may contain up to 95% water, all Blueland products utilize tablet or powder formats, designed to be used directly or mixed with household tap water, and come in compostable or recyclable packaging. From the kitchen sink to the laundry room, we create products families can trust and afford to use over and over (and over) again. Available on and nationwide at Target, Costco, Whole Foods and select local retailers.
In a world where half of the planet’s carbon emissions come from just 36 companies, we believe that business should be a force for good and that mission and profit are not mutually exclusive—in fact, we’re proof of it. We’re committed to holding ourselves to the highest parental and environmental standards—which includes ongoing and unbiased certifications from trusted third-party organizations like Cradle to Cradle, EPA Safer Choice, USDA BioPreferred, Leaping Bunny, and EWG Verified. We’re also a Certified Climate Neutral business and certified B Corp “Best for the World.”
Blueland was featured on the Season 11 premiere of Shark Tank and successfully secured an investment. We’re also well-funded by top tier venture capital firms as well as notable investors including Gwyneth Paltrow, Justin Timberlake and founders of Sweetgreen, Thrive Market, Honest Company, Rent the Runway, and Bonobos. Our products have been featured across top tier outlets including the New York Times, Fast Company, TechCrunch, VOGUE, Wall Street Journal, Inc., and more.

About the Role

Blueland is looking for a Director, Enterprise Systems to serve as the company's first dedicated Enterprise Systems and IT leader and build the technology foundation needed to support our next stage of growth.

Reporting to the CFO, this role will own Blueland's enterprise systems and day-to-day IT operations. You will partner closely with Finance, Operations, Data & Analytics, and other functions to improve business processes, manage our systems roadmap, and ensure employees have reliable, secure and effective technology.

This is a hands-on builder role. As our first dedicated Enterprise Systems hire, you will both set the direction and do the work. On any given day, that could mean prioritizing the enterprise systems roadmap, redesigning a NetSuite process with Finance or Operations, managing an implementation partner, provisioning access for a new hire, resolving an employee technology issue, or evaluating a new application.

This role requires someone equally comfortable setting the systems roadmap and rolling up their sleeves to execute it. You will be the first dedicated Enterprise Systems leader at Blueland, supported by external partners and business stakeholders. You should enjoy creating structure where it doesn't yet exist, solving day-to-day problems yourself, and building processes that make those problems easier to solve the next time. We are looking for someone excited to build the foundation and develop the function without a large team to execute.

We expect the role to evolve as Blueland grows. Initially, you will personally handle many day-to-day systems and IT activities while leveraging managed service providers and other external partners for specialized support. Over time, you will help determine the right internal and external resources required to scale the function.

Responsibilities

NetSuite & Business Process Management
  • Serve as the business systems owner for NetSuite and the primary point of contact for our NetSuite managed service provider.
  • Partner closely with Finance and Operations to understand business processes, identify pain points and translate requirements into scalable NetSuite solutions.
  • Own and execute the NetSuite enhancement roadmap, including configuration, workflows, reporting, integrations and process improvements.
  • Personally handle routine NetSuite administration and troubleshooting while determining when more complex technical work should be escalated to our external NetSuite partner.
  • Manage and prioritize work performed by our NetSuite MSP, including requirements, scope, timeline, cost, testing and quality of delivery.
  • Own NetSuite integrations with key platforms and partners, including ecommerce, EDI, 3PL/fulfillment and other enterprise applications.
  • Maintain appropriate governance over roles, permissions, configurations, workflows and system changes.
  • Partner with the Data & Analytics team to implement master data governance standards within NetSuite and other enterprise systems.
  • Lead testing, documentation, training and change management for significant enhancements.
  • Identify opportunities to automate manual processes, strengthen controls and improve data quality across Finance and Operations.
Enterprise Systems Roadmap & Project Pipeline
  • Own Blueland's enterprise systems project pipeline from business need through implementation and ongoing optimization.
  • Establish and run a consistent intake and prioritization process for systems requests across the organization.
  • Work directly with functional leaders to define the problem to solve, business requirements, expected value, resource needs and recommended solution.
  • Maintain the enterprise systems roadmap and provide visibility into priorities, status, dependencies, risks, costs and resource constraints.
  • Lead systems implementations directly, coordinating business owners, external vendors and other resources as needed.
  • Ensure projects have clear requirements, ownership, testing, training, documentation and post-launch support.
  • Drive adoption after implementation and measure whether solutions are delivering the intended business outcome.
  • Continually evaluate opportunities to simplify the technology stack, improve existing platforms and automate manual work.
Day-to-Day IT Operations
  • Serve as the primary internal owner and hands-on point of contact for employee IT needs.
  • Personally manage and resolve routine IT requests and tickets, escalating specialized technical issues to our MSP or other external partners as appropriate.
  • Build a scalable IT ticketing and support process, including clear service expectations, documentation, escalation paths and recurring issue analysis.
  • Own employee technology onboarding and offboarding in partnership with People, including laptops, accounts, software access and permissions.
  • Provision and remove user access across core enterprise applications.
  • Maintain accurate documentation of users, systems, devices, licenses and access.
  • Coordinate laptop and device procurement, setup, replacement and lifecycle management.
  • Troubleshoot common employee technology and application issues and ensure more complex issues are resolved quickly by the appropriate external partner.
  • Develop repeatable processes and self-service documentation that reduce recurring support needs as Blueland grows.
IT Vendors & Technology Management
  • Own relationships with Blueland's IT MSP, NetSuite MSP and other enterprise technology vendors.
  • Serve as the internal point of accountability for vendor performance, ensuring external partners are responsive, cost-effective and delivering against Blueland's priorities.
  • Manage technology vendors throughout their lifecycle, including evaluation, onboarding, contracting, implementation, ongoing performance, renewal and offboarding.
  • Maintain a centralized inventory of technology vendors, systems, business owners, licenses, contracts, costs and renewal dates.
  • Partner with Finance to manage technology spend and identify opportunities to consolidate tools, eliminate unused licenses and improve ROI.
  • Coordinate with external cybersecurity and infrastructure partners to ensure required security and technology standards are implemented.
  • Ensure technology vendors are appropriately integrated into Blueland's onboarding, offboarding, access management and security processes.
Enterprise Applications & Governance
  • Serve as the internal owner or governance lead for Blueland's core enterprise applications.
    Administer core applications directly where appropriate and establish clear business and technical ownership for function-specific platforms.
  • Manage user access, permissions, licensing and basic configuration across enterprise applications.
  • Establish documentation and change-management standards for critical systems.
  • Evaluate new systems and functionality based on business need, integration requirements, security, scalability and total cost of ownership.
  • Identify and implement opportunities to leverage automation and AI within enterprise platforms and business processes to increase productivity, improve user experience and reduce manual work.

Qualifications

  • 7+ years of progressive experience in enterprise systems, business applications, ERP, IT/business technology or related roles.
  • Strong hands-on NetSuite experience, ideally supporting both Finance and Operations in a growing organization.
  • Strong understanding of business processes including order-to-cash, procure-to-pay, inventory, fulfillment and financial close.
  • Experience administering enterprise applications and troubleshooting day-to-day systems issues.
  • Experience managing NetSuite consultants, MSPs, technology vendors and other external technical resources.
  • Experience leading systems implementations and integrations from requirements through go-live and ongoing optimization.
  • Strong project management skills and the ability to manage a portfolio of competing systems priorities.
  • Experience leveraging AI and automation tools to improve business processes, systems administration or employee productivity, with an interest in staying current as these capabilities evolve.
  • Working knowledge of IT fundamentals including user provisioning, identity and access management, endpoint/device management, SaaS administration and IT support processes.
  • Strong business judgment and an ability to distinguish between problems that require technology investment and those better solved through process changes.
  • Ability to translate between business and technical audiences.
  • Experience in consumer products, retail, e-commerce or another omnichannel environment is strongly preferred.
  • Familiarity with e-commerce, EDI, 3PL/fulfillment and related integrations strongly preferred.

Salary

The salary range for this position is $175,000-195,000 per year.
We prioritize our planet and our people. In addition to salary compensation, we offer various other benefits to ensure our team members can be their best self, both in and outside of work. Benefits for full time roles include: health benefits, stock options, generous paid time off, paid holidays, paid civic engagement days, paid parental leave, 401k (employee contribution), professional development stipends, remote work reimbursements, various discounts to like-minded companies and more.
At Blueland we believe in order to build a better future and planet, we must advocate for diversity, equity and inclusion. We are proud to have assembled a diverse team and strongly encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every qualification.
