title: Analyst - Blockchain Technology & Analytics
description:
About Us
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Job Description

Job Description: Analyst - Blockchain Technology & Analytics


Visa’s Stablecoin team is building cutting-edge onchain infrastructure to change the way money moves. While onchain solutions began as niche and speculative, they are now transforming how value moves across the global financial ecosystem.


Visa is at the forefront of this transition. We are rapidly expanding our stablecoin and tokenized money infrastructure to enhance our network and develop solutions for partners around the world. Visa brings trust, scale, and security to the evolving onchain ecosystem, creating the opportunity for generational impact in payments and beyond.

Role Summary


We are looking for a technically curious and highly motivated Blockchain Technology & Analytics Analyst to support the evaluation, monitoring, and implementation of blockchain and digital asset technologies.


This role combines blockchain data analytics, AI-assisted development and research, technical due diligence, and project execution. The ideal candidate is comfortable working hands-on with blockchain data and infrastructure while also being able to translate technical concepts into clear insights and presentations for business, product, technology, and client stakeholders.

The candidate does not need to be a blockchain expert on day one, but should have a strong technical foundation, curiosity about emerging technologies, and the ability to rapidly learn new platforms and tools using AI-assisted development and research.


A successful candidate will be someone who can take a relatively open-ended question such as "How is this validator performing?", "How does this blockchain network work?", or "Should we evaluate this technology provider?" and independently turn it into a structured technical investigation.

They will be comfortable using AI tools, data, APIs, documentation, and hands-on experimentation to quickly develop an informed point of view, and then communicate the findings clearly to stakeholders.

Responsibilities

Blockchain Technology Research

  • Develop a working understanding of Ethereum and EVM-compatible blockchains, including transactions, smart contracts, validators, nodes, RPC interfaces, and common infrastructure components.
  • Develop familiarity with blockchain ecosystems outside EVM, particularly Solana and Canton.
  • Use AI-driven research and analysis to evaluate the technical architecture, APIs, integration models, security considerations, and capabilities of blockchain and digital asset technology providers.
  • Conduct technical evaluations of platforms and providers such as Fireblocks, Turnkey, Zerohash, Chainalysis, Notabene, and other emerging blockchain infrastructure and compliance solutions.
  • Compare technology providers and clearly document capabilities, architectural tradeoffs, integration considerations, and potential use cases.

Prototyping & Technical Experimentation

  • Assist with the development and deployment of proofs of concept (POCs) for blockchain and digital asset use cases.
  • Deploy and test applications, blockchain infrastructure, APIs, and supporting components on AWS and virtual machines.
  • Work with engineering and product teams to evaluate new blockchain technologies through hands-on experimentation.
  • Use AI-assisted development tools to accelerate prototyping, troubleshooting, documentation, and technology evaluation.

Blockchain Analytics & Validator Monitoring

  • Use Claude Code and other AI-assisted development tools to rapidly build dashboards, scripts, and analytical tools for monitoring blockchain infrastructure and validator performance.
  • Develop dashboards and analytics covering metrics such as validator fees and rewards, transaction volumes, transaction counts, aggregate transaction value, and other network performance indicators.
  • Use Allium, SQL, and blockchain datasets to conduct on-chain data analysis and answer product, technical, and business questions.
  • Write and troubleshoot JSON-RPC queries against blockchain nodes and RPC endpoints to retrieve blockchain, transaction, validator, and network information.
  • Analyze blockchain data to identify trends, anomalies, and insights relevant to product development and infrastructure operations.

Technical Communication & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Translate complex blockchain concepts into clear explanations for technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Create executive-ready presentations, architecture diagrams, technical assessments, and recommendations for stakeholders across Visa.
  • Present findings from technology evaluations, blockchain analytics, and POCs to product, engineering, security, and business teams.
  • Support client engagements by contributing to technical discovery and due diligence, researching client technology requirements, and evaluating potential integration approaches.

Project & Process Management

  • Coordinate cross-functional activities required to advance blockchain technology initiatives from evaluation through POC.
  • Project manage internal Visa processes associated with new technologies, including Security Assessments and other technology review processes.
  • Track dependencies, risks, decisions, action items, and approvals across technical and business stakeholders.
  • Work with internal teams, external technology providers, and clients to move technical evaluations and POCs forward.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.


Qualifications

Basic Qualifications

  • 2+ years of relevant work experience and a Bachelor’s degree, OR 5+ years of relevant work experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 3 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or more than 2 years of work experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD)
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Data Science, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Basic understanding of Ethereum, EVM-compatible blockchains, smart contracts, transactions, wallets, nodes, and blockchain validators.
  • Familiarity with blockchain ecosystems such as Solana and/or Canton.
  • Experience writing SQL queries and analyzing structured datasets.
  • Ability to work with REST APIs and JSON-RPC interfaces.
  • Familiarity with Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or another scripting/programming language.
  • Experience or strong interest in using AI coding and research tools to accelerate technical work.
  • Basic familiarity with AWS, cloud infrastructure, Linux, and virtual machines.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to independently research unfamiliar technologies.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple technical workstreams simultaneously.
  • Hands-on experience querying blockchain data using Allium or similar blockchain analytics platforms.
  • Experience interacting directly with Ethereum or other blockchain nodes through JSON-RPC.
  • Exposure to blockchain infrastructure, custody, wallet, compliance, or analytics platforms.

title: Senior Product Manager, Client Integrations & Solutions
description:
About Us
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Job Description

Overview:

Visa’s Stablecoin team is building cutting-edge on chain infrastructure to change the way money moves. While on chain solutions began as niche and speculative, they are now transforming how value moves across the global financial ecosystem.


Visa is at the forefront of this transition. We are rapidly expanding our stablecoin and tokenized money infrastructure to enhance our network and develop solutions for partners around the world. Visa brings trust, scale, and security to the evolving on chain ecosystem, creating the opportunity for generational impact in payments and beyond.


We are seeking a Senior Product Manager, Client Integrations & Solutions to lead the technical solutioning and implementation experience for clients and partners adopting Open USD and related stablecoin capabilities. This role combines hands-on client integration leadership with product ownership for the documentation, tools, processes, and platform improvements required to make implementations repeatable, reliable, and scalable.


In this role, you will guide clients from early solution design through technical onboarding, testing, service activation, launch, and post-launch stabilization. You will help client teams understand product capabilities and integration requirements, troubleshoot complex implementation issues, and coordinate resolution across Product, Engineering, Operations, Compliance, Risk, Client Services, and other subject matter experts. You will also own and continuously improve core implementation assets, including the product implementation guide, API documentation, service activation guide, integration checklists, troubleshooting content, sample flows, and other technical enablement materials.


As a Senior Product Manager on the Stablecoin team, you will work at the intersection of product, technology, operations, compliance, data, and client-facing teams. You will translate real-world client integration needs into clear product requirements and roadmap improvements while ensuring clients have the guidance and support needed to launch successfully.

This role requires a hands-on product leader who is technically credible with client and engineering teams, comfortable working through ambiguous integration challenges, and able to convert one-off implementation learning into scalable product capabilities and reusable guidance.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead the end-to-end technical solutioning and implementation journey for clients and partners, from discovery and integration planning through development, testing, service activation, launch, and post-launch stabilization.
  • Partner directly with client product, engineering, architecture, operations, risk, and compliance teams to understand their use cases, technical environments, dependencies, and readiness, and translate these into a clear implementation approach.
  • Provide hands-on technical guidance on APIs, authentication, data and message flows, environments, error handling, testing, operational processes, and production-readiness considerations.
  • Act as a primary product-side escalation point for complex client integration issues; structure troubleshooting, coordinate root-cause analysis, engage the appropriate internal teams, and drive issues to clear resolution.
  • Own and maintain key client enablement materials such as product implementation guide, service activation guide, and integration checklists.
  • Translate product and engineering designs into accurate, usable implementation content for different audiences, from client developers and solution architects to operations and program teams.
  • Participate in UAT process as the product lead to ensure delivered features meet the acceptance criteria.
  • Gather structured feedback from implementations and identify recurring integration friction, documentation gaps, tooling needs, and product limitations; convert these insights into prioritized product requirements and roadmap recommendations.
  • Define product requirements and acceptance criteria for capabilities that improve integrability and developer experience, including onboarding workflows, sandbox and testing capabilities, diagnostics, observability, configuration, and self-service tooling.
  • Partner with Engineering and other product managers to assess implementation impacts of new capabilities, ensure integration readiness before release, and align documentation, testing, activation, and support plans.
  • Establish implementation readiness criteria and governance, including dependency tracking, risk and issue management, launch checklists, go/no-go inputs, and clear handoffs into ongoing operational support.
  • Develop technical training and enablement for client-facing teams and internal stakeholders so they can accurately position the product, support implementations, and identify when specialist engagement is required.
  • Contribute to client solution workshops, product demonstrations, technical deep dives, and architecture reviews, clearly communicating trade-offs, constraints, requirements, and recommended approaches.
  • Monitor implementation outcomes and recurring support themes and use data and client feedback to improve product quality, documentation effectiveness, implementation efficiency, and the overall developer experience.
  • Prepare clear, executive-ready updates on implementation progress, client risks, product gaps, launch readiness, and opportunities to scale the integration model.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

Basic Qualifications:

  • 5 or more years of relevant work experience with a bachelor's degree or at least 2 years of work experience with an Advanced degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 0 years of work experience with a PhD.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 6 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor's Degree or 4 or more years of relevant experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or up to 3 years of relevant experience with a PhD.
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8 or more years of experience in product management, solutions engineering, implementation consulting, or a related client-facing technology role.
  • Demonstrated experience leading complex client or partner integrations for API-based platforms, payment products, financial technology, or other similar technology services.
  • Strong working knowledge of REST APIs, JSON, authentication and authorization patterns, webhooks or event-driven integration patterns, API testing tools, and error handling.
  • Ability to read and discuss API specifications, sequence diagrams, system flows, logs, and technical designs with engineers and client architects, and to translate them into practical implementation guidance.
  • Experience creating and maintaining high-quality technical product documentation, such as implementation guides, API documentation, and service activation guides.
  • Proven ability to troubleshoot ambiguous technical issues across organizational boundaries, isolate likely causes, communicate clearly during escalations, and coordinate resolution with engineering and operational teams.
  • Strong product management skills, including requirements definition, prioritization, and continuous improvement based on client feedback and operational evidence.
  • Excellent client-facing communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to lead technical workshops and explain complex concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Ability to operate effectively in a highly cross-functional environment involving Product, Engineering, Operations, Compliance, Legal, Risk, Data, Client Services, and regional teams.
  • Strong ownership, judgment, organization, and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple client implementations, documentation deliverables, and product priorities concurrently.

title: Animal Care Specialist - ACA2
company: British Columbia Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals
description:
POSITION: Animal Care Specialist - ACA2
STATUS: Temporary; Full-Time
SHIFT: 40 hours per week - Tuesday - Saturday.
LOCATION: Parksville, BC
CLASSIFICATION: Exempt
WAGE: Hourly
CLOSING DATE: Open Until Filled

About the Position:
Ensuring that optimal levels of care are administered to the animals based on the Five Freedoms. Provides primary care and support to all shelter based animals including feeding and cleaning of kennels, socialization of animals and transportation of animals as may be required. Assumes a leadership role in designated area of responsibility, through facilitating clear and effective communication of staff and volunteers as it relates to the provision of care and the completion of administrative functions.

Some specific duties:

To assume a leadership role responsible and accountable for a designated area(s) of the shelter (areas include: dogs, cats, cruelty investigations).
To oversee the activities of the animal care attendants (ACA 1) and volunteers assigned to area of responsibility, including ensuring that training has been provided and proper procedures are being followed.
To assist with the recruitment, selection, scheduling and management of volunteers in the area of responsibility utilizing volunteer squared (V2) or other tracking mechanism where applicable.
To maintain clear communication with staff and volunteers regarding the day-to-day operation and duties/tasks requiring completion.
To maintain the entire physical plant in a clean, sanitary and efficient manner on an ongoing basis and in a collaborative manner.
To ensure kennels, runs, and cat cages are kept in a manner that is best suited for the animal’s health and welfare as per the ShelterSense protocols.
To monitor the health and welfare of the animals through the maintenance of up-to-date kennel cards, recording information on whiteboard and daily logs, and completing daily welfare sheets.
To maintain animals on a proper diet ensuring daily feeding, watering, exercise, and enrichment.
To treat animals humanely, with compassion and concern, and in a manner consistent with the BC SPCA’s five freedoms.
To immediately report any health or welfare concerns to the Manager or designate.
To ensure animals’ health and well-being are maintained in accordance with the BC SPCA policies and procedures with respect to animal health. This includes the administration of approved medications as specified by the Animal Health Technologist or other authorized shelter staff and ensuring related supplies are re-stocked and ordered as needed.
To perform welfare and temperament assessments on animals as needed, ensuring that all ShelterSense protocols are followed and are consistent with the animal’s current assessment.

To conduct contractual animal control duties as required (where applicable).
To conduct preliminary cruelty investigations and submit a review of findings through Shelter Buddy for continuing investigation purposes.
To act as an ambassador of the BC SPCA at all times and ensure customer and community relations are consistently professional and positive.
To answer telephones and walk-in inquiries in a courteous manner providing information satisfactory to the needs of the customer.
To perform reception duties including greeting members of the public, answering telephones, responding to emails promptly, entering information in Shelter Buddy, uploading photos, filing and cash-out procedures.
To assist with adoptions, redemptions and intake of animals including reviewing lost and found book and adoption applications.
To ensure all procedures for receiving, licensing, or adopting all animals are conducted according to procedure and meet the needs of customers.
To assesses suitability of potential animal adoptive customers for the purposes of best possible match between adopter and animal.
To support and implement BCSPCA provincial initiatives and adhere to all operational policies and procedures.
To assist in local and provincial fund-raising initiatives.
To work in compliance with the Occupational Health and Safety Act and its regulations.
To review inventory of all shelter supplies including but not limited to: food, blankets, towels, personal protective equipment, cages, crates, etc. to ensure that supplies are ordered as needed and prior to running out.
To ensure the security of the building when entering and exiting by ensuring all doors and gates are locked when required.
To operate the Animal Centre vehicle(s) as needed including transporting animals to and from the veterinarian clinic(s) and ensure proper cleanliness and maintenance of the vehicle
To work together and collaboratively with other staff and volunteers to benefit and enhance the health and welfare of shelter animals and create a harmonious team environment.
To regularly participate in meetings with other members of staff to share ideas and suggestions designed to improve the enjoyment of working for the BCSPCA and to increase its productivity.
To perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications you need to have:

High School Diploma or equivalent
Valid Class N or 5 BC Drivers’ License and driver’s abstract
A sound knowledge of animals, their breeds, characteristics, and common diseases
Previous kennel or animal care experience will be considered an asset
Demonstrable interest in all aspects of animal welfare
Must be able to work with other staff, volunteers, and the public in a positive, practical manner and be able to work with minimum supervision
Ability to prioritize demands on time
Must possess excellent verbal, written and organizational skills
Basic computer skills sufficient to deal effectively with the necessary front desk duties including answering emails, and updating animal records
Position is physically demanding and includes heavy lifting, pushing and pulling which requires an individual with the ability to maintain a level of fitness and endurance to fulfill the required duties
Minimum of one year animal care experience with the BC SPCA or related agency preferred.

Philosophical harmony with the vision, mission, and strategic directions of the BC SPCA.

title: Head of Service - Growth Markets
description:
Head of Customer Services


Growth Markets | Flexible Location (Spain, Italy, Germany considered)


Lead Customer Service Across Multiple European Markets


Exceptional customer experiences don't happen by chance. They are created by leaders who can balance customer needs, operational excellence, commercial performance and compliance at scale.


We're looking for an experienced Head of Customer Services to lead our end-to-end customer service operation across our Growth Markets business, covering customer service, complaints, repairs, claims and service delivery. Reporting to the Director of Operations, you'll lead a large, multi-market operation of approximately 200 colleagues across internal teams and strategic outsourcing partners.


This is a highly visible leadership role with accountability for delivering outstanding customer outcomes, improving operational performance and building a service model that supports continued international growth.


We are particularly keen to hear from candidates based within our Growth Markets locations, including Spain, Italy and Germany, who can bring valuable local market knowledge and an understanding of our customer landscape.


The Opportunity


As Head of Customer Services, you will be responsible for creating a consistently excellent customer experience across all markets and service channels.


You'll lead the teams and partnerships that support customers throughout their journey, ensuring enquiries, complaints, repairs and claims are handled efficiently, professionally and in line with regulatory requirements. At the same time, you'll drive continuous improvement, optimise costs, strengthen supplier performance and identify opportunities to make the customer experience simpler, faster and more effective.


This role combines strategic leadership with operational delivery and requires someone who can confidently influence senior stakeholders, manage large-scale operations and use data and insight to drive performance.


What You'll Be Doing


Leading Customer Service Excellence


  • Own customer service performance across all Growth Markets, ensuring consistent delivery, service quality and customer outcomes across every market and channel.
  • Create a customer-centric culture that delivers exceptional experiences and strengthens customer loyalty, retention and lifetime value.
  • Ensure complaints, claims, repairs and service enquiries are resolved effectively, efficiently and compliantly.

Driving Operational Performance


  • Lead and develop a large operational function, including internal teams and outsourced partners, creating a high-performance culture built on accountability, engagement and continuous improvement.
  • Deliver against service levels, customer commitments and operational targets while balancing quality, efficiency and cost performance.
  • Use performance data and customer insight to identify trends, solve operational challenges and drive measurable improvements.

Managing Strategic Partners & Service Networks


  • Build strong relationships with BPO partners, repair networks, OEMs and suppliers, ensuring consistent service standards and sustainable business performance.
  • Lead governance, performance reviews and improvement initiatives across all outsourced and third-party service providers.
  • Escalate and resolve service risks, supplier issues and structural challenges to protect customer outcomes and business performance.

Transforming Customer Journeys


  • Lead continuous improvement initiatives that simplify customer journeys, remove inefficiencies and improve service quality.
  • Conduct root cause analysis on complaints, service failures and operational challenges, implementing long-term solutions rather than short-term fixes.
  • Leverage technology, best practice and innovation to enhance customer experience and operational effectiveness across multiple markets.

Ensuring Strong Governance & Compliance


  • Maintain the highest standards of regulatory compliance, data integrity and operational control.
  • Ensure customer records, processes and service delivery activities meet business, legal and regulatory requirements.
  • Create an environment where quality, customer outcomes and compliance are embedded into everyday operations.

What We're Looking For


We're looking for an accomplished customer service leader who combines strategic thinking with strong operational execution.


You'll ideally bring:


  • Significant leadership experience within customer service, operations, claims, service delivery or contact centre environments.
  • Experience leading large, complex, multi-site or multi-market customer operations.
  • Proven success managing outsourcing partners, third-party suppliers and service delivery networks.
  • Strong commercial acumen with experience managing operational budgets and driving efficiency improvements.
  • A track record of improving customer satisfaction, operational performance and service quality.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to turn data into action and measurable business outcomes.
  • Experience operating within regulated environments with a strong appreciation for customer outcomes and compliance.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills across multiple levels of an organisation.

Why Join Us:


This is an opportunity to shape the customer service strategy for a growing international business operating across multiple European markets.


You'll have the autonomy to drive meaningful change, influence senior stakeholders, lead large-scale operations and make a direct impact on customer experience, commercial performance and future growth.


If you're passionate about building high-performing service operations, developing great teams and creating exceptional customer experiences at scale, we'd love to hear from you.


Apply today and help us redefine customer service across our Growth Markets business.

At Domestic & General, we are proud of our 100-year legacy and excited about our future growth plans. We are expanding our horizons, entering new markets and territories internationally and we need your expertise to help us on the journey.

title: interim klantenadviseur preventie & welzijn grote ondernemingen
description:
Word klantenadviseur preventie en welzijn bij Liantis en kies voor een werkplek waar je omringd wordt door warme collega’s en partners. Betrokken en toegankelijk, net zoals jij de klant begeleidt. Want als centraal aanspreekpunt achterhaal je klanten hun noden met betrekking tot hun preventie- en welzijnsbeleid. Maar dat is nog niet alles. Als een echte organisator regel je alles tot in de puntjes zoals medische onderzoeken, griepcampagnes, planning van opleiding, … Klaar voor deze uitdagende rol? Solliciteer snel.


Functie loopt tot eind februari 2027.


Zo ziet jouw job eruit

“Het beste aan de job? De afwisseling, en hoe je zelf je agenda bepaalt. Daarin laat Liantis ons erg vrij”, vertelt Karen, klantenadviseur preventie en welzijn. Wat er allemaal op die agenda staat?

  • Voor vragen omtrent het preventie- en welzijnsbeleid kan de klant bij jou terecht, via mail of telefoon. Want jij bent het aanspreekpunt voor je klantenportefeuille.
  • De planning van de aan jouw toegewezen artsen ligt in jouw handen. Dit gaat van medische onderzoeken, werkvergaderingen, afspraken voorbereiden,… Van begint tot eind, door jou loopt alles vlot.
  • Je verbindt alle puntjes met elkaar: de klant, boekhouding, arts, verpleegkundigen, experten, andere dienstverleningen en de planning. Want door jou kan de klant op beide oren rusten.
  • Met meerdere klantenbezoeken per jaar pols je waar je proactief kan ondersteunen. Hoe verliep het onderzoek? Heeft de klant vlot toegang tot MyLiantis? De klant vertrouwt je, want je wijst de weg waar nodig.
  • Tijdens het teamoverleg deel je kennis en uitdagende dossiers, of haal je verbeterpunten aan. Samen – ook met collega’s van andere afdelingen – zoeken jullie naar oplossingen.

Goed om weten: op je eerste werkdag heten we je warm welkom en krijg je een startersopleiding. Zo sta je meteen sterk in je schoenen. Tegelijk geven we jou ook daarna tijd om in te werken. Zodat je kan groeien als klantenadviseur preventie en welzijn.


Herken je jezelf hierin?

  • Al een eerste relevante ervaring met planningen en klantencontact achter de rug? Bonuspunten. Maar het allerbelangrijkst voor ons: je goesting om ervoor te gaan.
  • De materie preventie en welzijn wordt jouw thuishaven. Meer zelfs: je bijt je erin vast. En blijft zo altijd up-to-date.
  • Je bent een organisator, in hart en nieren. Uurwijziging? Oké. Locatie vastgelegd? Check. Een nieuwe klant op de planning? Komt in orde. Je neemt alles in rekening tot de planning klopt. En het strafste: je behoudt het overzicht.
  • Als klantenadviseur ben je service- en mensgericht. Vlot in omgang en met een luisterend oor naar de klant om hun noden te detecteren en in te lossen.
  • Proactief denken en inspelen op commerciële opportuniteiten zijn jouw troeven, want je kijkt vooruit. Zo analyseer je de juiste behoeften van de klant en koppel je deze aan de juiste diensten.
  • Dat maakt jou ook flexibel. Altijd klaar om in te springen. Je agenda aan te passen. Want bij Liantis doen we het samen.

Liantis, Een grote familie die jaar na jaar groeit. Een plaats waar elke medewerker zich ten volle inzet om de zelfstandige vooruit te helpen. En net als elke medewerker ben jij ook een coach in hart en nieren. Als adviseur van het bedrijfsleidersteam begeleidt je jouw collega’s en bouw je mee aan een kwalitatieve dienstverlening en klantentevredenheid binnen de divisies zelfstandig ondernemen, payroll services en risk solutions.


​​Word jij onze nieuwe ​adviseur van het bedrijfsleidersteam?​

Zo ziet jouw job eruit

  • Als adviseur werk je samen met de verschillende managers binnen het domein zelfstandig ondernemen. Verder heb je ook nauw contact met het bedrijfsleidersteam (10p)
  • Je staat dicht bij het team, en bent het aanspreekpunt voor de materie die jij beheerst. Zo weten adviseurs dat ze op jouw expertise mogen rekenen.
  • Je staat in voor de permanente ontwikkeling en continue verbetering van je eigen werkorganisatie. Zo kan je een actuele toegevoegde waarde betekenen en een kwalitatief hoogstaande dienstverlening waarborgen. Je staat in voor het monitoren en analyseren van behoeftes van de business, en vertaalt deze naar realistische en bruikbare instructies, oplossingen en processaanpassingen over de drie divisies heen.
  • Je begeleidt vooropgestelde veranderprojecten van idee tot een concrete (business)case. Je werkt mee in alle fases van de verandering. Je actualiseert de probleemanalyse, kosten/baten, potentieel en de risico’s van de beoogde opportuniteit of improvement.
  • Je crëert een draagvlak voor die ontwikkelingen bij jouw team en past deze toe in de dagelijkse werking.
  • Je volgt de tendensen in onze sector op en draagt optimaal bij aan de ontwikkeling van een visie naar verdere digitalisering en optimalisatie toe. Dit in een nauwe samenwerking met de improve organisatie en de solutionsorganisatie.

Herken je jezelf hierin?

  • Kennis in payroll, sociaal statuut of verzekeringen? Super. het allerbelangrijkst voor ons: je goesting om ervoor te gaan.
  • Als adviseur ben je service- en mensgericht. Vlot in omgang en met een luisterend oor naar de collega’s, om hun noden te detecteren en op te lossen. Je voert deze gesprekken vlot in het Nederlands en Frans.
  • Je bent ondernemend en communicatief vaardig, zowel verbaal als schriftelijk en bent diplomatisch in je contacten naar klanten. Als een echte peoplemanager weet je de betrokken medewerkers te inspireren, stimuleren en ondersteunen.
  • Analytisch, dat ben jij! Je kan de vragen van medewerkers als geen ander ontleden en omzetten naar waardevolle inzichten voor onze organisatie. Jij weet knopen door te hakken.
  • Het merendeel van de collega’s zijn gevestigd in Brugge, maar met de nieuwe communicatiemiddelen kan je vanuit eender welk Liantiskantoor werken.

Wat wij je te bieden hebben

Waarom je bij Liantis wilt werken? We zetten het op een rijtje.

  • Voor je comfort;

Je krijgt een aantrekkelijk loonpakket, dat je zelf deels samenstelt met ons flexibel verloningssysteem (extra vakantiedagen, een fietsleasing …). Naast je basisloon, krijg je ook maaltijd-, eco- en cadeaucheques. En als we de vooropgestelde doelstellingen bereiken, is ook de loonbonus een comfortabele extra. Maar de hoogste prioriteit: het welzijn van de medewerkers. Tijdens de job en erbuiten. Vandaar onze hospitalisatieverzekering en pensioenfonds.

  • Voor je persoonlijke ontwikkeling;

Mensen zijn het kloppende hart van onze organisatie. Daarom zetten we bij Liantis sterk in op persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Zo krijg je de kans om je talenten te ontplooien, in een moderne en professionele werkomgeving in volle beweging. Met e-learnings en georganiseerde opleidingen. Resultaat? Een mooie loopbaan en voortdurende groei.

  • Voor je werk-privébalans.

Belonen is meer dan verlonen. We hechten waarde aan jouw werk-privébalans. Daarom werk je met een glijdend uurrooster van 38 uur per week. Telewerken? Tijdens je startersopleiding nog niet, maar daarna: zeker en vast. Ook mooi meegenomen: je krijgt 32 vakantiedagen bij een voltijdse tewerkstelling.


Wil je ook graag deel uitmaken van onze warme Liantis-familie? Of je nu op zoek bent naar een nieuwe uitdaging of gewoon wat meer informatie nodig hebt. Solliciteer online of contacteer ons via myrthe.devestele@liantis.be of 0495278072


Word je klantenadviseur preventie en welzijn? Dan word je ambassadeur van Liantis. Je herkent jezelf in onze waarden: schouder aan schouder, handen uit de mouwen, echt en oprecht. En draagt ze mee uit.

Ontdek de kansen, voel de sfeer: onze vacatures in beweging!

  • Strong communication, organization, and time management skills
  • Detail-oriented with strong analytical and problem-solving abilities

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Self-starter who can work independently and collaboratively

Nice to Have

What you'll receive

As part of Nutreco, you'll be a member of the SHV family, a diverse group of companies with a global footprint. Join us and you'll gain access to a wide network of expertise and global career paths. You'll also benefit from the backing of one of the world's largest privately owned businesses, known for its stability and long-term focus.

title: RayzeBio Safety MD Senior Director
description:
Life at BMS

At RayzeBio, every day is an opportunity to ignite meaningful change. As a wholly-owned subsidiary of Bristol Myers Squibb, RayzeBio blends the nimble, pioneering spirit of an emergent biotech with the global expertise and resources of a leading innovator in oncology. Our mission is to develop transformative radiopharmaceutical therapies that offer new hope for patients living with cancer. Here, you’ll join a multidisciplinary team where your ideas are valued, your expertise is amplified, and collaboration is at the heart of everything we do. From day one, expect to make an immediate impact—on our science, on our teams, and most importantly, on patients. Learn more about RayzeBio:


The Safety MD role for RayzeBio will provide medical safety leadership across clinical development and pharmacovigilance activities, with a strong focus on proactive safety surveillance, signal detection, risk management, and benefit-risk assessment. The role will partner closely with clinical, regulatory, medical affairs, and safety teams to support product development, regulatory submissions, health authority interactions, and safety governance. This individual will serve as a key safety representative for RayzeBio/BMS programs, mentor cross-functional colleagues, and help strengthen safety science processes and patient safety practices.

Responsibilities

  • Lead or co-lead global pharmacovigilance strategy, proactive safety surveillance, signal detection, risk management, and compliance with FDA, EMA, ICH, and other applicable regulations.

  • Establish and maintain safety governance structures, SOPs, and continuous improvement processes aligned with company objectives and industry best practices.

  • Partner with BMS safety, clinical development, regulatory, medical affairs, and cross-functional teams to integrate safety insights into product development, clinical trials, labeling, and risk minimization strategies.

  • Direct safety evaluation and benefit-risk assessment for clinical development and post-marketing products, including AE profile management and product safety strategy.

  • Represent Safety Science as lead or co-lead Safety MD in Safety Management Teams/Committees, study team meetings, health authority interactions, regulatory submissions, periodic safety reports, audits, and inspections.

  • Drive safety-related content for protocols, investigator brochures, DSURs, PSURs, RMPs, ICFs, RSLs, CSRs, regulatory filings, and responses to regulatory inquiries.

  • Perform daily ICSR/SAE case reviews and support appropriate safety management across all phases of clinical trials.

  • Serve as a key PV representative for global regulatory authorities, external experts, scientific bodies, and industry groups while advocating for patient safety.

  • Mentor cross-functional colleagues, direct reports, and safety team members on core PV concepts and practices.

  • Leverage AI to improve program, portfolio, or functional performance through prioritization and scaled adoption

  • Serve as backup Safety MD for the PV Head as needed.

Basic Qualifications

  • MD or equivalent

  • 10+ years of experience in pharmacovigilance, safety science, or related area within the pharmaceutical/biotechnology industry.

  • Demonstrated knowledge/awareness of existing/current global pharmacovigilance regulations and guidelines, including FDA, EMA, and ICH

  • Demonstrated expertise in signal detection, risk management, benefit-risk assessment, and aggregate safety reporting.

  • Experience interacting with global regulatory authorities and scientific advisory bodies

Preferred Qualifications

  • Radiopharmaceutical experience

  • Oncology Safety experience

  • NDA/MAA/JNDA submission experience

Skills and Qualifications

  • Strong leadership and communication skills

  • Proven ability to work effectively in a matrixed, cross-functional environment.

  • Demonstrated commitment to patient safety and ethics in medical practice.

title: Sr Security Engineer
description:
The Senior Security Engineer is a senior individual contributor on Inotiv’s Information Security team, working across the organization’s security tool stack to support the company’s detection, incident response, cloud security, and vulnerability management capabilities across a global, hybrid (cloud and on-premises) environment. As part of the team, this role builds and tunes detections, hunts for threats, and supports incident response to rapidly detect, contain, and remediate threats, and helps deploy, maintain, and optimize the security tools and controls that protect company and client data. The role also contributes to cloud security and the vulnerability management program and provides technical security support for audits and vendor reviews. Reporting to the Vice President, Infrastructure & Information Security, the Senior Security Engineer is a hands-on technical contributor who participates in the on-call response rotation within a global drug discovery and development organization.

Key Accountabilities

  • Build, tune, and maintain security detections and monitoring across the organization’s security tooling – EDR, endpoint, email, cloud, and network telemetry – mapping detections to the MITRE ATT&CK framework using native tool analytics and available log sources.
  • Support security incident response end-to-end – detection, triage, investigation, containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident review – perform proactive threat hunting and forensic/root-cause analysis, and participate in the on-call response rotation.
  • Deploy, configure, maintain, and optimize existing and new security tools across the environment, and monitor their ongoing health and performance.
  • Contribute to cloud security across Azure, AWS, and Microsoft 365 – security posture management, secure configuration and hardening, monitoring, and remediation.
  • Support the vulnerability management program – scanning, risk-based prioritization, and remediation across endpoints, servers, applications, and cloud – with clear reporting and metrics.
  • Administer and improve security controls and system hardening (including Windows server and workstation security), and partner with IT and infrastructure teams on remediation and security architecture.
  • Provide technical information security support for audits, risk assessments, and third-party/vendor security reviews in partnership with the GRC team, and collaborate with teammates to share knowledge and improve processes.
  • Other special projects and duties as assigned

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Security, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 5 to 8 years of experience in security engineering, security operations, incident response, and/or vulnerability management.
  • Advanced knowledge of endpoint detection and response (EDR), cloud security (Azure/AWS/Microsoft 365), vulnerability management, incident response, and the MITRE ATT&CK framework, including deploying and maintaining security tooling across a hybrid (cloud and on-premises) environment.
  • Working knowledge of business-related processes, procedures, terminology, and compliance.
  • Analytical thinker with the ability to understand problems, determine root cause, and recommend appropriate solutions.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, able to relate complex concepts in a concise and easy-to-understand manner.
  • Ability to prioritize and handle multiple projects, often under tight time constraints.
  • Ability to work effectively with peers, leadership, and stakeholders in a productive, collaborative environment.
  • Ability to understand and comply with confidentiality and privacy rules and protect company property and confidential information.

Preferences

  • 2+ years of experience in a regulated life sciences environment or a large/complex enterprise.
  • Certifications preferred: GCIH, GCIA, GCFA, GREM, OSCP, CISSP, or a cloud security certification (e.g., AZ-500, AWS Security).
  • Experience with EDR, cloud security posture management (CSPM), and vulnerability management platforms.
  • Scripting and automation experience (e.g., Python, PowerShell, KQL).
  • Preference given to relevant work experience.

Working Conditions & Physical Requirements

  • Extended computer and display screen equipment usage
  • Ability to read and interpret materials, verbally communicate, and hear required.

Critical Success Factors

  • Results Driven. Internal drive toward action to efficiently, timely, and accurately achieve results. Sets high but achievable standards for self and others. Seeks opportunities to improve process and outcomes. Constantly reviews performance to identify areas to develop.
  • Efficient. Takes responsibility for own time and effectiveness. Identifies what needs to be done and does it before being asked or before the situation requires it. Able to work things out without having to be shown too often. Seeks opportunities to contribute appropriately without direction.
  • Communication. Able to communicate information and ideas clearly and articulately both in oral and written form. Uses appropriate language, style and methods depending on audience and the purpose of communication. Able to convey complex information clearly. Anticipates the information that others will need. Expresses ideas effectively. Practices attentive and active listening.
  • Collaboration. Actively supports and contributes to the success of the team. Actively encourages and practices collaboration and cooperation on the team. Shares information and supports other team members. Can get things done with and through others and set realistic objectives. Seeks opportunities to develop others.
  • Critical Thinking and Problem Solving. Able to identify and separate out the key components of problems and situations. Able to manipulate and interpret information from a range of sources to spot patterns and trends in information and to deduce cause and effect from this. Can generate a range of creative solutions, evaluate, and choose the most appropriate option
  • Improvement Driven. Inspires and generates new solutions and approaches to issues and challenges to maximize efficiency and effectiveness through everyday practice of root cause analysis and critical thinking problem solving; Continually works to refine skills and abilities; Builds on ideas of others to come up with new ways to address issues or problems; Generates creative new solutions and approaches to issues and processes.

*This position could be offered at different levels for candidates who qualify with a combination of advanced levels of education and/or years of experience. The salary range will adjust along with the level of the role to match the person’s relevant experience and/or education level.


At Inotiv, our work helps advance the development of new medicines and therapies that can improve people's lives. As a leading global contract research organization (CRO), we partner with researchers to tackle complex scientific challenges, drive innovation, and help build a healthier, safer world. Bringing together scientists, researchers, technical experts, and business professionals, we provide the expertise and collaboration needed to move research forward. Our people make this work possible, and we value the knowledge, ideas, and contributions each person brings to the team. Whether you are starting your career or bringing years of experience, Inotiv offers opportunities to learn, grow, and play a meaningful role in advancing treatments for patients around the world.


Salary will be commensurate with experience and responsibilities. Benefits include health and dental coverage, short- and long-term disability, paid time off, paid parental leave, 401K, and more!

title: Analista Fiscal Júnior
description:
O Analista Fiscal Júnior é responsável por realizar conciliações fiscais referentes ao mês de competência, apoiando a organização em todos os processos relacionados aos programas tributários. A posição reporta-se diretamente ao Coordenador Fiscal ou Gerente Fiscal, que, por sua vez, se reporta funcional e operacionalmente ao Diretor Fiscal. Atua como suporte técnico para políticas e procedimentos tributários, interagindo com auditores internos e externos, consultores externos, órgãos governamentais e outras áreas da organização.

Reportando-se ao Gerente Fiscal Brasil, a posição é responsável por atividades tributárias, com foco principal em ISS.

A função também atua como suporte técnico para as equipes fiscal e contábil, interagindo com auditores externos e consultores em assuntos relacionados à conformidade tributária local, contabilidade e reportes financeiros.

O que você fará

  • Analisar transações de entrada e notas fiscais, garantindo a correta classificação de CFOPs, CSTs, tipos de operação e tributações;
  • Controlar e gerenciar documentos fiscais eletrônicos (NF-e e NFS-e), assegurando que todos os documentos fiscais recebidos sejam registrados dentro dos prazos estabelecidos;
  • Calcular e validar impostos municipais (ISS retido), federais (IPI, INSS, IRRF e CSRF – PIS/COFINS) e estaduais (ICMS, DIFAL e ICMS-ST);
  • Apoiar a entrega das obrigações acessórias relacionadas à área fiscal;
  • Realizar conciliações contábeis e tributárias;
  • Aplicar conhecimento nas principais rotinas de apuração de tributos estaduais, municipais e federais;
  • Analisar a legislação tributária e acompanhar alterações que impactem o negócio, incluindo a Reforma Tributária;
  • Apoiar auditorias internas e externas, fornecendo informações e documentação quando necessário.

O que buscamos

  • Graduação em Administração de Empresas, Ciências Contábeis ou Direito;
  • Conhecimento de SAP (módulos GRC e DRC) para processos de entrada;
  • Conhecimento desejável em sistemas fiscais (ex.: Synchro);
  • Experiência em rotinas fiscais (nível pleno/júnior avançado), com no mínimo 1 ano de atuação;
  • Excel intermediário/avançado, incluindo funções como PROCV (VLOOKUP), SOMASE (SUMIF) e Tabela Dinâmica;
  • Profissional proativo, organizado, com perfil analítico, capacidade de trabalho colaborativo e atenção aos detalhes em reportes fiscais;
  • Inglês fluente será considerado um diferencial;
  • Pós-graduação ou MBA será considerado um diferencial.

  • Patrocínio de visto disponível: Não

title: Senior Linux System Administrator - 306502
description:
Delaware Nation Industries is seeking a Linux System Administrator – Senior to provide advanced systems administration and engineering support for the Air Force Joint Worldwide Intelligence Communications System/Joint Interoperability Test and Services mission. This position will help maintain secure, resilient, and highly available Linux infrastructure across classified and unclassified environments supporting mission-critical operations.

The Senior Linux System Administrator will serve as a technical authority for Linux platforms, virtualization, automation, system security, performance, and lifecycle management. The position requires the ability to independently solve complex problems, lead technical efforts, develop repeatable processes, and coordinate with Government stakeholders and other engineering disciplines.

Responsibilities

  • Administer, engineer, optimize, and maintain enterprise Linux systems and services across multiple security levels and operational environments.
  • Install, configure, harden, patch, upgrade, and decommission Linux operating systems, applications, services, and supporting infrastructure.
  • Support Red Hat Enterprise Linux and other approved Linux distributions, including system services, package management, storage, networking, authentication, logging, and performance tuning.
  • Design and implement repeatable procedures for system builds, provisioning, configuration management, patching, backup, recovery, restoration, and lifecycle operations.
  • Analyze complex system, application, hardware, virtualization, storage, and network problems; conduct root-cause analysis and implement durable corrective actions.
  • Monitor system availability, resource utilization, capacity, performance, and security posture; identify risks and recommend improvements before they affect mission operations.
  • Administer and troubleshoot VMware or comparable virtualized infrastructure, including virtual machines, images, templates, virtual networking, and storage dependencies.
  • Develop and maintain scripts and automation using Bash, Python, Ansible, Puppet, or comparable tools to improve consistency, reduce manual effort, and support troubleshooting.
  • Support DevSecOps practices, source-code or configuration repositories, automated workflows, and controlled deployment processes when applicable to the environment.
  • Apply DISA STIGs, security baselines, vulnerability-remediation procedures, and other DoD cybersecurity requirements to Linux systems and applications.
  • Execute or support ACAS/Nessus scans, vulnerability analysis, remediation, validation, and compliance reporting.
  • Maintain secure system access, including accounts, roles, privileges, SSH, authentication services, certificates, keys, and least-privilege controls.
  • Support SAN/NAS storage, NFS, iSCSI, file systems, backup infrastructure, and data-transfer services as assigned.
  • Support authorized electronic and manual data transfers between network environments and troubleshoot transfer failures, integrity issues, and related operational problems.
  • Participate in system integration, testing, acceptance, change control, technical interchange meetings, exercises, and mission-readiness activities.
  • Produce and maintain system documentation, architecture diagrams, standard operating procedures, configuration records, plans of action and milestones, and technical reports.
  • Provide technical leadership, mentoring, knowledge transfer, and cross-training to Mid-level administrators and other team members.
  • Coordinate with cybersecurity, network, Windows, application, database, service desk, and Government teams to resolve escalated incidents and maintain continuity of operations.
  • Participate in scheduled maintenance, planned outages, incident response, and after-hours or on-call support as required by the contract.

Requirements

  • Active DoD TS/SCI security clearance.
  • At least six (6) years of professional Unix/Linux systems administration experience.
  • DoD 8570/8140-compliant IAT III certification, such as CISSP, CASP+ or another current DoD-approved equivalent.
  • Demonstrated experience administering enterprise Linux systems in a DoD, intelligence, classified, or similarly regulated environment.
  • Strong knowledge of Linux system architecture, networking, storage, system services, access control, logging, troubleshooting, and performance tuning.
  • Experience with system backup and recovery, software and patch management, security hardening, vulnerability remediation, and configuration control.
  • Experience with virtualization technologies, preferably VMware vSphere and related management components.
  • Proficiency with shell scripting and demonstrated ability to automate or streamline system administration tasks.
  • Experience diagnosing complex technical issues, performing root-cause analysis, and communicating solutions to technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work independently, lead technical efforts, and collaborate across functional teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting Air Force, JWAC, JITS, Joint, intelligence, or other DoD mission environments.
  • Experience with Red Hat Enterprise Linux 7/8/9 or successor supported releases, CentOS, Scientific Linux, Debian, or comparable distributions.
  • Experience with Puppet Enterprise, Ansible, CloudBolt, Git, Docker, or comparable automation and DevSecOps technologies.
  • Experience supporting multi-level security, cross-domain solutions, classified networks, data-transfer systems, or mission-essential communications environments.
  • Experience with ACAS/Nessus, HBSS/endpoint security tools, STIG Viewer, vulnerability-management platforms, or comparable DoD cybersecurity tools.
  • Experience with SAN/NAS technologies, NFS, iSCSI, RAID, LVM, XFS, ext4, ZFS, or other enterprise file systems.
  • Experience with DNS, DHCP, NTP, LDAP/Active Directory integration, RADIUS, PKI, certificates, SSH, TCP/IP, and firewall-related troubleshooting.
  • Experience with monitoring, logging, configuration-management, ticketing, and IT service-management platforms.
  • Bachelor’s degree in information technology, computer science, cybersecurity, engineering, or a related field; equivalent experience may be considered.
  • Linux, VMware, automation, security, or other relevant industry certifications.

Benefits

Benefits Include:

  • Covers 100% of employee benefit premiums, including Medical (PPO or HDHP Option), Vision, Dental
  • Matching 401K
  • Short- and Long-Term Disability
  • Pet Insurance
  • Professional Development/Education Reimbursement
  • Parking and Transit Benefits for NY, NJ, ATL, and DC Metro areas

Salary Compensation: $120,000-$125,000

title: Project Specialist, IKE
description:
About the role

The Project Specialist keeps IKE deployments moving by owning the administrative and coordination work behind every site. This role supports the Project Managers in an assigned region on scheduling, vendor and invoice processing, material tracking, documentation, and data accuracy in SiteTracker.


This is the role that catches what falls between the cracks. When a permit expires, an invoice ages, a kiosk ships to the wrong market, or a date in SiteTracker no longer matches reality, the Project Specialist is the one who finds it and fixes it before it costs the schedule.


The right person is organized, persistent, and comfortable chasing people for answers. They are not waiting to be told what to look at. They notice when something is off and say so.


This role is also where the program's reporting lives. The Project Specialist builds and maintains the reports and dashboards in SiteTracker that Project Managers and leadership run the business on, and uses that data to spot where sites are slipping before anyone has to ask.


This role is remote eligible and aligned to an assigned region, with occasional travel.


What you'll do

  • Maintain SiteTracker data for assigned markets, including dates, statuses, costs, and documentation, and keep it accurate enough that leadership can trust it without re-checking
  • Run the weekly data hygiene pass and flag records where the data and the field do not agree
  • Process purchase orders, vendor invoices, and change orders, track them to payment, and chase aging items before they become disputes
  • Track kiosk fabrication, shipment, and delivery, and tell Project Managers when a unit is landing ahead of or behind site readiness
  • Build and maintain reports and dashboards in SiteTracker for Project Managers, the Associate Director, and program leadership
  • Compile and distribute weekly status, go-live forecast, and jeopardy reporting for assigned markets
  • Analyze cycle times across siting, permitting, construction, and energization, and surface where markets are trending off plan
  • Track vendor performance on schedule, first-pass permit approval, and cost, and turn it into reporting the team can act on
  • Collect and file closeout documentation, including as-builts, inspection sign-offs, warranties, and photos, so markets close cleanly
  • Schedule site walks, pre-construction meetings, and inspections, and keep the calendar current for the team
  • Set up new vendors, route agreements and insurance certificates for review, and keep vendor records current
  • Support Project Managers with meeting notes, action item tracking, and follow-up so commitments do not get lost
  • Serve as a first point of contact for vendor and agency questions that do not require a Project Manager
  • Contribute to templates, trackers, and process documentation as the program scales
  • Travel occasionally to assigned markets as business needs require

Qualifications

Required

  • 4+ years in project coordination, administration, or operations support, preferably in construction, infrastructure, telecom, or utility work, including at least 2 years in a reporting or analytics capacity.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to track many open items at once without dropping any.
  • Comfort following up with vendors, agencies, and internal teams until a question is answered.
  • Experience with purchase orders, invoices, and basic project cost tracking.
  • A data analytics background, with demonstrated experience turning raw project data into reporting that drives decisions.
  • Advanced Excel skills, including pivot tables, lookups, and building reports others rely on.
  • Experience building reports or dashboards in a project tracking or CRM system.
  • Clear written communication, particularly in status reporting and email follow-up.
  • Experience with SiteTracker, Salesforce, or a similar project tracking system, or demonstrated ability to learn one quickly.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite.

Preferred

  • Experience supporting projects in the public right-of-way.
  • Familiarity with permitting processes and agency submittal requirements.
  • Exposure to utility service applications or power make-ready coordination.
  • Experience building SiteTracker or Salesforce reports, dashboards, and list views.
  • Working knowledge of SQL, Power BI, Tableau, or a similar analytics tool.
  • Experience building or improving a tracker, template, or reporting process.
  • Associate or Bachelor's degree, or equivalent experience.

title: Quality Assurance Inspector
description:
UTLX

As a part of the global industrial organization Marmon Holdings—which is backed by Berkshire Hathaway—you’ll be doing things that matter, leading at every level, and winning a better way. We’re committed to making a positive impact on the world, providing you with diverse learning and working opportunities, and fostering a culture where everyone’s empowered to be their best.

The Inspector is responsible for conducting thorough in‑process & NDT of railcars as required; researching and identifying required repairs; and ensuring all documentation is accurate and compliant with U.S. and Canadian regulations, AAR Interchange/MSRP standards, DOT/TC requirements, and company procedures. The incumbent ensures all maintenance, qualification, and inspection activities are completed in accordance with governing regulations, identifies nonconformances, and ensures cars are properly approved and released. This role carries full authority to stop work on railcars or components pending issue resolution.

Primary responsibilities and/or essential functions include, but are not limited to:

  • Performs visual, dimensional, mechanical, and regulatory inspections of railcars and components throughout all stages of the repair and qualification process.
  • Ensures that all identified nonconforming conditions are reported through the appropriate forms, checklists, and nonconformance reporting system.
  • Maintains complete and accurate inspection records and ensures the final car file is compliant and ready for release.
  • Reviews shop-floor documentation to ensure completeness, accuracy, and regulatory compliance.
  • Identifies repairs and assigns responsibility based on company policies, pricing matrices, and RBU profitability guidelines.
  • Conducts audits to ensure production activities align with applicable standards and requirements.
  • Works with production to plan shipments and ensure inspections are completed in a timely manner.
  • Verify cars are properly secured, marked, closed, and identified prior to release for interchange.
  • Interfaces with railroads, lessees, outside inspectors, and internal departments to resolve inspection findings and expedite the repair process.
  • Conduct function specific training with employees
  • Perform quality assurance administrative functions as needed including but not limited to: audit participation, document control, measuring and test equipment, root cause corrective action, etc.
  • Identifies potential claims such as corrosion or loading‑rack damage and follows through to resolution.
  • Participates in and supports quality initiatives and Responsible Care activities.
  • Uses judgment and discretion inspection and documentation activities, escalating only unusual or unprecedented issues.

Skills/Specifications:

  • Ability to communicate technical information verbally and in writing.
  • Proficient with applicable electronic systems.
  • Working knowledge of AAR and FRA regulations, Fleet Repair Standards, and company procedures.
  • General mechanical aptitude and ability to use industry gauges (including AAR Rule 1 gages), test equipment, weld inspection tools, and dimensional inspection tools.
  • Ability to interpret standards, drawings, regulations, repair instructions, and specifications.
  • Near visual acuity correctable to a J2 on a McKesson Jaeger Eye Chart
  • Stamina to work across large shop areas and recognize danger signals to ensure safety.

Required Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or equivalent
  • Minimum of 3-5 years of related work experience in railcar repair or manufacturing.
  • Ability to gain NDT Visual Testing (VT) Level II Certification per the requirements AAR M1002 Appendix T, ASNT SNT-TC-1A, ASNT CP-189, ASNT-9712 or ISO-9712.
  • On-site work arrangement: 5 days per week, with the ability and availability to work any shift and overtime as operational needs require

Preferred Qualifications:

  • AWS Certified Welding Inspector, AMPP Coating Inspector, ASQ Certified Quality Inspector/Technician certifications.
  • Knowledge of railcar components, airbrakes, welding and nondestructive testing.
  • NDT Visual Testing (VT) Level II Certification

Work Environment & Schedule:

  • Performing duties in an industrial railcar repair environment involves regular exposure to challenging physical and environmental conditions.
  • Work is frequently conducted outdoors and may require extended periods in varying weather conditions.
  • Employees are exposed to dirt, dust, fumes, smoke, heat, and noise associated with manufacturing and repair operations.
  • The role requires moderate to heavy physical exertion, including lifting and carrying materials, climbing in and out of railcars, working at heights and in confined spaces.
  • Ability to enter tank cars through 20‑inch manway openings.
  • Manual dexterity and physical coordination are necessary to operate tools and safety equipment.
  • Employees may experience minor cuts, bruises, or other risks typical of an industrial setting and must maintain constant awareness to safely operate equipment, particularly in confined or elevated areas.
  • There is potential exposure to hazardous materials due to leaks or spills.
  • Must be willing and able to work in an industrial repair environment, complying with all required personal protective equipment (PPE) and safety protocols
  • Vision correctable to 20/30 for inspection activities.
  • On-site work arrangement: 5 days per week, with the ability and availability to work any shift and overtime as operational needs require

They are not to be construed as a complete list of the many duties normally to be performed under a job title or those to be performed temporarily outside an employee's normal line of work. Duties, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

title: AI Engineer 4 (AI Foundations)
description:
AI Engineer 4 (AI Foundations)

Overview:

At Capital One, we are creating responsible and reliable AI systems, changing banking for good. For years, Capital One has been an industry leader in using machine learning to create real-time, personalized customer experiences. Our investments in technology infrastructure and world-class talent — along with our deep experience in machine learning — position us to be at the forefront of enterprises leveraging AI. From informing customers about unusual charges to answering their questions in real time, our applications of AI & ML are bringing humanity and simplicity to banking. We are committed to continuing to build world-class applied science and engineering teams to deliver our industry leading capabilities with breakthrough product experiences and scalable, high-performance AI infrastructure. At Capital One, you will help bring the transformative power of emerging AI capabilities to reimagine how we serve our customers and businesses who have come to love the products and services we build.


Team Description:

The Intelligent Foundations and Experiences (IFX) team is at the center of bringing our vision for AI at Capital One to life. We work hand-in-hand with our partners across the company to advance the state of the art in science and AI engineering, and we build and deploy proprietary solutions that are central to our business and deliver value to millions of customers. Our AI models and platforms empower teams across Capital One to enhance their products with the transformative power of AI, in responsible and scalable ways for the highest leverage impact.


What You’ll Do:

  • Partner with a cross-functional team of engineers, research scientists, technical program managers, and product managers to deliver AI-powered products that change how our associates work and how our customers interact with Capital One.
  • Design, develop, test, deploy, and support AI software components including foundation model training, large language model inference, agents and multi-agent workflows, similarity search, guardrails, model evaluation, experimentation, governance, and observability, etc.
  • Leverage a broad stack of Open Source and SaaS AI technologies such as AWS Ultraclusters, Huggingface, VectorDBs, PyTorch, and more.
  • Invent and introduce state-of-the-art foundation model optimization techniques to improve the performance — scalability, cost, latency, throughput — of large scale production AI systems.
  • Contribute to the technical vision and the long term roadmap of foundational AI systems at Capital One.
  • Own the end-to-end architecture for complex AI systems - ensuring maintainability, observability, and ethical alignment
  • Define and maintain service-level objectives (SLOs) for AI reliability, including latency, uptime, and model performance drift
  • Collaborate with infrastructure engineering to optimize GPU/TPU utilization and accelerate model inference pipelines
  • Lead cross-functional technical reviews for new AI system deployments, ensuring security, data governance, and compliance standards are met
  • Mentor Principal and Senior Associates on scalable design, performance tuning and research-to-production translation

The Ideal Candidate:

  • You love to build systems, take pride in the quality of your work, and also share our passion to do the right thing. You want to work on problems that will help change banking for good
  • Passion for staying abreast of the latest research, and an ability to intuitively understand scientific publications and judiciously apply novel techniques in production
  • You adapt quickly and thrive on bringing clarity to big, undefined problems. You love asking questions and digging deep to uncover the root of problems and can articulate your findings concisely with clarity. You have the courage to share new ideas even when they are unproven
  • You are deeply Technical. You possess a strong foundation in engineering and mathematics, and your expertise in hardware, software, and AI enables you to see and exploit optimization opportunities that others miss
  • You are a resilient trailblazer who can forge new paths to achieve business goals when the route is unknown

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, AI, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related fields plus at least 4 years of experience developing AI and ML algorithms or technologies, or a Master's degree in Computer Science, AI, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related fields plus at least 2 years of experience developing AI and ML algorithms or technologies
  • At least 4 years of experience programming with Python, Go, Scala, CUDA, or Java

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience leading development AI systems with tradeoff decisions around cost, latency, throughput and accuracy
  • 6 years of experience deploying scalable and responsible AI solutions on cloud platforms (e.g. AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, or equivalent private cloud)
  • Experience designing, developing, delivering, and supporting AI services
  • Experience developing AI and ML algorithms or technologies (e.g. LLM Inference, Similarity Search and VectorDBs, Guardrails, Memory) using Python, C++, C#, Java, CUDA, or Golang
  • Experience developing and applying state-of-the-art techniques for optimizing training and inference software to improve hardware utilization, latency, throughput, and cost
  • Experience in building agentic AI systems and agentic workflows
  • Passion for staying abreast of the latest AI research and AI systems, and judiciously apply novel techniques in production
  • Proficiency in designing distributed systems for model training, evaluation, and online inference at petabyte scale

description:
Are you ready to get ahead in your career?

  • To realise our vision to become Malaysia’s leading converged solutions company, we are looking for a new talent to innovate and grow with us in a culture that values commitment, performance and possibilities.

Why does this job exist and why is it critical?​

1. Lead assigned CSR programme delivery

Develop and implement strategic objectives, delivery plans, and performance measures for assigned CSR programmes (eKelas, eKelas Usahawan). Lead cross-functional contributors and delivery partners, managing risks and driving improvements to ensure approved outcomes are achieved within agreed timelines and budgets.


2. Drive eKelas participation, engagement and digital growth

Drive the strategic growth, usage, and engagement of eKelas as a premier digital learning and knowledge hub. Steer cross-functional efforts with content, digital, and communications teams, orchestrating high-impact content development, programme visibility, and engagement activities to exceed overarching corporate objectives.


3. Develop stakeholder relationships and partnerships

Lead stakeholder engagement—spanning both high-level strategic alignment and working-level execution—for assigned CSR programmes, including briefings, roadshows, and complex partnership discussions. Cultivate relationships with key stakeholders to drive high-impact collaboration, content, and co-creation opportunities.


4. Drive vendor performance, budgets and programme resources

Define, negotiate, and govern complex vendor deliverables within approved programme plans. Oversee expenditure, commitments, and variances against assigned budgets, and drive corrective actions to mitigate risks where delivery quality, timing, or cost is compromised.


5. Design CSR impact measurement and verification frameworks

Act as the subject matter expert to design, own, and institutionalise the measurement methodology and verification framework for corporate responsibility impact metrics. Ensure frameworks are rigorously aligned with recognised global standards (such as Social Return on Investment - SROI) to accurately quantify and demonstrate the strategic value of social impact to executive stakeholders.

Ensure impact reporting for relevant CSR projects (Menuju Gemilang, eKelas Usahawan, GEN AI) strictly aligns with recognised global frameworks. Review the completeness and substantiation of reported metrics, proactively driving the resolution of evidence gaps. Present substantiated impact updates to executive management and external stakeholders, and utilise data-driven insights to implement strategic improvements to programme design and execution.


7. Drive CSR governance and community initiatives

Actively shape and drive CSR policy reviews, formulating strategic updates to ensure robust governance. Evaluate and adjudicate complex donation, festive charity, and humanitarian proposals against approved criteria, providing expert recommendations to leadership.


8. Support strategic sustainability projects and initiatives

Provide high-level support in the planning and implementation of assigned sustainability projects. Translate overarching goals from the Head of Sustainability & CSR into actionable delivery plans, collaborating autonomously with relevant project owners to ensure seamless execution.
