title: Cyber Security Engineer
description:
At 1st Central, everything starts with our people.

As one of the UK’s leading motor and home insurers, we use smart technology, data and great service to make insurance fast, fair and simple for over 1.4 million customers. We’re proud to create an environment where people feel supported, trusted and able to grow - whether that’s developing new skills, taking on fresh challenges or making a real impact every day. If you’re looking for a role where you can make a difference, we’d love to hear from you.

We’re looking for a Cyber Security Engineer to join our Cyber and Information Security team, this technically focused role is responsible for implementing, maintaining and improving specialist cyber security controls, tooling, telemetry and automation across the organisation.

Working closely with teams across Technology & Data you’ll ensure that security controls are designed in line with best practice and are effective, scalable and aligned to business and regulatory requirements.

We’re big on flexible hybrid working. This role is predominantly home-based, with just one day a week in the office in either Salford Quays (Manchester), Haywards Heath (West Sussex) or Guernsey. Of course, if you’d like to spend more time working alongside the team, you’re always welcome to come into the office more frequently.

Core skills we’re looking for to succeed in the role:

  • Cyber Security Engineering: Practical experience in cyber security engineering, security platform engineering, or a closely related technical security role.
  • Microsoft Security Technologies: Hands-on experience with Microsoft security technologies, including Defender XDR, Purview, Sentinel, Defender for Cloud, and Entra security capabilities.
  • Technical Security Expertise: A relevant technical security qualification or equivalent practical experience, such as AZ-500, SC-200, SC-300, SC-100, CISSP, or similar.
  • Troubleshooting & Analysis: Strong technical troubleshooting and analytical skills, with the ability to investigate and resolve security-related issues.
  • Communication & Stakeholder Management: Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain technical security matters clearly to different audiences.
  • Organisation & Prioritisation: Good organisational skills, with the ability to manage and prioritise engineering activity across multiple stakeholders.

What’s involved:

  • You’ll engineer, configure and maintain cyber security controls across the Microsoft security estate, including Microsoft Defender XDR, Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Entra, Microsoft Purview and associated integrations.
  • You’ll develop and maintain security telemetry, data connectors, alerting integrations, workbooks and technical monitoring coverage across cloud, identity, endpoint, email, applications and agentic services.
  • You’ll build, test and maintain security automation, orchestration and response workflows, including SOAR playbooks and approved automated containment actions.
  • You’ll implement and maintain technical security policies, baselines and guardrails defined by Information Security, Cyber and Architecture.
  • You’ll work with Cyber and the SOC to translate threat intelligence, incident learning and detection requirements into effective technical controls and monitoring capabilities.
  • You’ll support the engineering and continuous improvement of security controls for end users, Azure workloads, cloud services, identities, workloads and non-human or agent identities.
  • You’ll integrate security controls into DevOps and value-stream delivery practices, including relevant security tooling, telemetry and automated control checks.
  • You’ll contribute to the implementation of runtime controls, monitoring, containment and security guardrails for AI agents, autonomous workflows and connected tools.
  • You’ll contribute to the implementation and maintenance of AI defence capabilities.
  • You’ll monitor the health, coverage, effectiveness and lifecycle of cyber security tooling, identifying control gaps, technical debt and opportunities for rationalisation or automation.
  • You’ll provide technical support to cyber incident investigations, threat hunting, control validation and recovery activities when required.
  • You’ll remediate and/or work with Technology teams and value streams to support the remediation of security weaknesses and confirm that corrective controls have been implemented effectively.
  • You’ll undertake Cyber control reviews of 3rd party platforms and integrations against best practice.
  • You’ll maintain technical documentation, configuration standards, operating procedures and evidence relating to security platforms and controls.
  • You’ll assess proposed technical changes to security tooling and controls, identifying risks, dependencies and implementation requirements.
  • You’ll contribute to cyber metrics and reporting, including control coverage, platform health, automation effectiveness and remediation progress.
  • You’ll ensure compliance with company policies, security standards and relevant regulatory requirements at all times.
  • You’ll comply with the requirements, and act in accordance with, the Group Code of Conduct and Fitness and Propriety policies at all times

Experience & knowledge

  • Practical experience in cyber security engineering, security platform engineering or a closely related technical security role.
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft security technologies, such as Defender XDR, Purview, Sentinel, Defender for Cloud, Entra security capabilities
  • Experience with Security Copilot and other AI defence capabilities highly desirable.
  • Experience implementing and maintaining security telemetry, integrations, automation and response workflows.
  • Knowledge of cloud security controls and Azure security concepts, while working effectively with separate cloud platform and operations teams.
  • Understanding of identity security, workload identities, privileged access, Conditional Access and non-human or agent identity risks.
  • Experience supporting detection engineering, incident response, vulnerability or exposure management and control validation.
  • Understanding of DevOps, CI/CD and secure delivery practices in an Agile, value-stream environment.
  • Understanding of security frameworks, such as ISO27001, NIST and PCI-DSS.


Skills and Qualifications

  • Relevant technical security qualification or equivalent experience, for example AZ-500, SC-200, SC-300, SC-100, CISSP or similar.
  • Strong technical troubleshooting and analytical skills.
  • Ability to automate security activities using scripting, APIs, workflow tools or infrastructure-as-code approaches.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain technical security matters clearly.
  • Good organisational skills and the ability to manage engineering priorities across multiple stakeholders.


Behaviours

  • Demonstrates an engineering mindset focused on reliable, repeatable and measurable security outcomes.
  • Works collaboratively with teams including Cyber, Technology, Architecture and value-stream maintaining clear accountability boundaries.
  • Willingness to continually develop knowledge of Microsoft security, cloud, automation and agentic security capabilities.
  • Self-motivated and proactive, with a strong focus on delivery and continuous improvement.
  • A pragmatic and risk-based approach to implementing security controls.
  • Emphasis on attention to detail, technical accuracy and secure change management.
  • Strives to improve control effectiveness, resilience and business outcomes.


Ready to engineer better security? Bring your expertise, ideas and drive for continuous improvement and help us strengthen our cyber defences.

Ready to join us?

We’re looking for talented people who want to make a real impact for our customers, colleagues and business. Apply today and discover where a career at 1st Central could take you.

Job Description:

Senior Cybersecurity Specialist - SOC Level 2 (12 months contract)


We are ready to take this game to the next level and need someone passionate to join the SOC team, responsible for conducting advanced threat analysis, validating and responding to security incidents and enhancing detection capabilities. This role plays a critical role in protecting OLG’s assets across various sectors by applying threat intelligence, refining response playbooks and supporting continuous improvement of SOC Operations. They investigate network, endpoint and cloud environment activities using advanced security tools, leverage threat intelligence to enrich investigations and proactively identify potential threats to maintain a resilient cybersecurity posture. They play a key role in incident response, evidence gathering, root cause investigation, maintaining detailed records of security events and providing comprehensive reports to stakeholders.

YOUR ROLE IN THE GAME

Reporting to the Director, Cybersecurity Operations, you will be empowered to:

  • Investigate escalated alerts or incidents using established procedures and analytical tools; correlate data across sources (SIEM, EDR, NDR, firewall, AD logs) to build timelines.
  • Execute containment steps (e.g., isolate host, disable accounts, block IPs) and resolve security events to maintain system integrity.
  • Manage incident lifecycle: prioritize, categorize, document investigations, escalate unresolved issues, and coordinate recovery and closure.
  • Provide feedback for alert tuning, perform routine threat intelligence tasks, and collaborate with HR on incidents involving employee data or policy violations.
  • Participate in on-call rotations and troubleshoot escalated access issues within SLA commitments.
  • Assist in implementing and monitoring security policies, protocols, and compliance standards; support risk assessments and information assurance activities.
  • Help identify, document, and prioritize problems in systems and processes; maintain records and contribute to playbook/SOP updates to improve SOC effectiveness.
  • Support threat detection and response by validating detection during simulations, creating investigation guides, and proactively searching data for undetected threats.

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE GAME

title: Payrolladviseur met focus op uitzendarbeid
description:
Ben je sterk in administratie en geprikkeld door payroll en sociale wetgeving met focus op uitzendarbeid? Solliciteer snel voor deze vacature in ons payroll team!


Zo ziet jouw job eruit

Ons payroll team zorgt voor een vlotte en efficiënte administratieve dienstverlening bij het inschakelen van tijdelijke medewerkers (uitzendcontracten). Vanuit ons centraal team van 8 collega’s in Brugge werken we voor klanten over heel België. Als payroll adviseur groei je stapsgewijs in expertise en verantwoordelijkheid.


Jouw functie bestaat uit volgend takenpakket:

  • In eerste fase volg je de (aan)vragen van onze klanten op en sta je in voor het opmaken van de (dag- en week-) contracten en verlengingen. Hierbij kom je alle wettelijk verplichte formaliteiten na. Als je dit onder de knie hebt, verzorg je ook de correcte en tijdige loonberekening en -uitbetaling van uitzendkrachten.
  • Je hebt diverse administratieve taken: o.a. het versturen van maaltijdcheques, de opvolging van arbeidsongevallen en het accuraat beheer van mailbox en database, ...
  • Daarnaast sta je klanten vlot telefonisch te woord. Je geeft hen informatie, beantwoordt vragen of helpt hen verder bij een probleem of klacht.
  • Je werkt nauw samen met je collega’s en rapporteert aan de teamleader payroll.

Herken je jezelf hierin?

  • Je hebt bij het liefst een bachelor, maar het allerbelangrijkste is je goesting om ervoor te gaan. Ervaring binnen de uitzendsector, een personeelsdienst of sociaal secretariaat is een mooie troef.
  • Je hebt sterke interesse in of minimaal een basiskennis van sociale wetgeving.
  • Je bent stressbestendig, leergierig en bereid tot het volgen van bijkomende opleidingen.
  • Je hebt een professionele houding en legt vlot contacten met zowel interne collega's als klanten.
  • Je hebt oog voor detail en bent resultaatsgericht in aanpak.
  • Je bent een constructieve teamspeler met een proactieve en flexibele houding.
  • Je beschikt over een gezond verantwoordelijkheidsgevoel;

Word je klantenadviseur payrolladviseur? Dan word je ambassadeur van Liantis. Je herkent jezelf in onze waarden: schouder aan schouder, handen uit de mouwen, echt en oprecht. En draagt ze mee uit.


Wat wij je te bieden hebben

Waarom je bij Liantis wilt werken? We zetten het op een rijtje.

  • Voor je comfort;

Je krijgt een aantrekkelijk loonpakket, dat je zelf deels samenstelt met ons flexibel verloningssysteem (extra vakantiedagen, een fietsleasing …). Naast je basisloon, krijg je ook maaltijd-, eco- en cadeaucheques. En als we de vooropgestelde doelstellingen bereiken, is ook de loonbonus een comfortabele extra. Maar de hoogste prioriteit: het welzijn van de medewerkers. Tijdens de job en erbuiten. Vandaar onze hospitalisatieverzekering en pensioenfonds.

  • Voor je persoonlijke ontwikkeling;

Mensen zijn het kloppende hart van onze organisatie. Daarom zetten we bij Liantis sterk in op persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Zo krijg je de kans om je talenten te ontplooien, in een moderne en professionele werkomgeving in volle beweging. Met e-learnings en georganiseerde opleidingen. Resultaat? Een mooie loopbaan en voortdurende groei.

  • Voor je werk-privébalans.

Belonen is meer dan verlonen. We hechten waarde aan jouw werk-privébalans. Daarom werk je met een glijdend uurrooster van 38 uur per week. Telewerken? Tijdens je startersopleiding nog niet, maar daarna: zeker en vast. Ook mooi meegenomen: je krijgt 32 vakantiedagen bij een voltijdse tewerkstelling.


Dit is Liantis

Bij Liantis zijn we meer dan een compagnon voor ondernemers en werkgevers; we zijn hun compagnon de route. Dit geldt niet alleen voor onze klanten, maar ook voor onze collega's. Onze compagnon cultuur staat voor samenwerken met een flexibele, mens- en klantgerichte mindset.


Wij geloven in het aanbieden van oplossingen die op het juiste moment inspelen op de behoeften van onze klanten. Daarbij zorgen we voor een werkomgeving waarin medewerkers zich gewaardeerd en ondersteund voelen, zodat iedereen bij Liantis zich met enthousiasme en trots kan inzetten. We organiseren onze oplossingen op een efficiënte en kwalitatieve wijze. Bij alles wat we doen draagt een persoonlijke en geïntegreerde dienstverlening bij aan onze collega's, klanten en partners. Kortom iedereen rondom ons.


Bij Liantis engageren we ons om een werkplek te bieden waar iedereen zich thuis voelt en waar jouw welzijn en professionele groei voorop staan. Ben je klaar om deel uit te maken van een team dat met trots compagnon is van meer dan 235.000 klanten? Solliciteer dan via bovenstaande knop! Heb je nog extra vragen na het lezen van deze vacature? Contacteer ons via myrthe.devestele@liantis.be of 0495278072.


Meer informatie over wie we zijn? Bezoek .

Ontdek de kansen, voel de sfeer: onze vacatures in beweging!

description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. Bristol Myers Squibb is seeking a dynamic and strategic global media relations professional to help shape and elevate the company's voice with external audiences. This role is responsible for supporting and executing a global media strategy that spans business, trade, and consumer/lifestyle press, ensuring BMS's story reaches both traditional stakeholders and broader mainstream audiences.


This individual will build and maintain strong relationships across a diverse media landscape, drive proactive and opportunistic storytelling, and support media opportunities for senior executives, including select international engagements. The role requires a collaborative, globally minded communicator who can partner effectively with colleagues across geographies and functions to ensure consistency, judgment, and impact across every media interaction.


Major Responsibilities and Accountabilities:

  • Execute a global media strategy aligned with corporate positioning to advance the company narrative and enhance reputation through proactive and opportunistic engagement across print, broadcast, digital, and consumer/lifestyle media, reaching key audiences beyond traditional business and trade press.
  • Closely monitor external trends across media publications to advise on where and how BMS should have a voice, and to continually inform media strategy development.
  • Drive continual cadence of news flow, managing sequence and strategy of announcements.
  • Identify, develop and pitch unique storylines and content opportunities, including human-interest angles, patient stories, and culturally resonant narratives, that make company news accessible and engaging to mainstream and general-interest audiences.
  • Build and maintain relationships across a diverse media landscape, from business and trade outlets to consumer, lifestyle, international, and general-interest publications (e.g., health/wellness outlets), managing incoming media requests and executing proactive and opportunistic outreach with strong judgment and media acumen.
  • Develop and refine core messages, pitches, talking points, Q&As, and other media materials that translate complex corporate, scientific, and business priorities into clear, compelling narratives tailored to the tone and format expectations of both trade and consumer media.
  • Plan logistics and train spokespeople for a range of media and public speaking opportunities, from industry panels to broader public-facing engagements.
  • Collaborate closely with communications colleagues and business partners across geographies to identify, guide, and help execute select international media opportunities for senior executives, sharing best practices across media opportunities to ensure alignment with local market nuances, global messaging, and company priorities.
  • Socialize external announcements to internal audiences to advance workforce knowledge of BMS people, medicines, positions and performance.
  • Support response to issues management and rapid response.
  • Oversee the development and maintenance of best-in-class media resources, driving consistency, usability and operational excellence across teams.
  • Champion the thoughtful use of AI and emerging tools to drive smarter insights, elevate content and improve the efficiency and impact of media engagement.
  • Engages agency partners on projects, ensuring effective delivery within budget.

Qualifications

Minimum Requirements

  • Minimum education of a bachelor’s degree is required. Communications, journalism or related field is preferred. Advance degree preferred.
  • Minimum of seven (7) years of media relations experience, preferably in pharmaceutical or similar industry is required. Existing relationships with print, broadcast, digital, and consumer/lifestyle media is highly preferred. Issues management experience preferred.
  • Strong writing and storytelling capabilities, with the ability to translate complex scientific, business, policy, or societal issues into clear, compelling messaging.
  • Excellent writing and research skills, with knowledge of AP style and a keen attention to detail.
  • Strong business acumen, with a demonstrated ability to understand and translate business strategy.
  • Ability to interact effectively with many levels of colleagues across a complex, highly collaborative organization.

title: Kitchen Steward
description:
The Role

Head Chefs run the kitchen for one of our chapter houses — planning and executing fresh, from-scratch menus every week, working directly with the chapter on what lands on the table. You lead the kitchen team, keep the space spotless and up to code, and make sure every plate reflects the standard the house signed up for. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who's as comfortable running a line as they are training the person next to them.

Instructions

  • Plan and execute fresh, from-scratch weekly menus, with regular menu meetings with the chapter
  • Create high-quality meals with excellent presentation and flavor, and send photos of plated meals to management
  • Keep the kitchen and dining room clean and sanitary — tables, grills, fryers, ovens, refrigeration, floors, and everything in between
  • Train and oversee kitchen staff, manage schedules, and assess performance with management's approval
  • Order supplies within budget and keep inventory stocked
  • Enforce food safety and sanitation standards per state and local regulations
  • Plan and execute special events as directed by management
  • Communicate regularly with management and the chapter by phone, email, and text
  • Hold the team accountable to every UCFS policy

Ingredients

  • 3+ years in professional, high-volume food production or catering, or equivalent experience
  • Culinary degree a plus, not required
  • Manager-level sanitation certification, or ability to obtain one within 30 days of employment
  • Proficiency across cooking methods, cuisines, and kitchen equipment
  • A steady hand under pressure and a clear head in a crisis
  • Ability to pass a background check

Chef's Notes

  • The work environment can be loud and busy, with kitchen hazards such as hot surfaces and liquids, sharp knives, and slippery floors
  • Exposure to extreme heat or cold is possible depending on the kitchen environment
  • Required to stand for long periods, up to 8+ hours, as well as walk, bend, and stoop
  • Must be able to lift and/or move objects up to 50 pounds
  • Exposure to cleaning chemicals

If you're looking for meaningful work, real ownership, and a team that believes hospitality can make a difference, we'd love to meet you.

The Senior Specialist, Artwork Coordinator is the primary point of contact and is responsible for the end-to-end coordination and project management of artwork changes and lifecycle activities for assigned products and markets within the Manufacturing Science & Technology (MS&T) organisation. The role is responsible for managing artwork projects from initiation through implementation, ensuring artwork deliverables are completed accurately, on time and in compliance with regulatory, quality and business requirements. The Senior Specialist will develop and maintain project plans, coordinate cross-functional activities, and drive alignment between internal stakeholders and external partners to ensure successful execution of artwork changes.

Working closely with Regulatory, Quality, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Packaging, Contract Manufacturing Organisations (CMOs) and artwork service providers, the Senior Specialist will ensure timely delivery and implementation of artwork updates while maintaining continuity of supply. The role will also serve as the key contact for artwork-related activities, support process improvements, monitor project performance and provide metrics and reporting to support operational excellence across the artwork function.

• Manage and maintain artwork records, databases and tracking systems to ensure accurate control, status visibility and reporting of artwork changes.

• Support Contract Manufacturing Organisations (CMOs) in the planning, implementation and lifecycle management of artwork changes across commercial product portfolios.

• Drive continuous improvement of artwork and change management processes, including support for investigations, CAPAs and compliance with cGMP and quality requirements

· Relevant qualification in related field or equivalent

· 3+ years’ experience in a similar role

We're driven by fearless curiosity, bold innovation, and a collective of authentic people working together to redefine what's possible. Technology isn’t just part of our strategy, it is our strategy. Everything we do serves our vision and the creation of what's next.


About the Team

At Capital One, we are creating responsible and reliable AI systems, changing banking for good. For years, Capital One has been an industry leader in using machine learning to create real-time, personalized customer experiences. Our investments in technology infrastructure and world-class talent — along with our deep experience in machine learning — position us to be at the forefront of enterprises leveraging AI. From informing customers about unusual charges to answering their questions in real time, our applications of AI & ML are bringing humanity and simplicity to banking. We are committed to continuing to build world-class applied science and engineering teams to deliver our industry leading capabilities with breakthrough product experiences and scalable, high-performance AI infrastructure. At Capital One, you will help bring the transformative power of emerging AI capabilities to reimagine how we serve our customers and businesses who have come to love the products and services we build.


The Intelligent Foundations and Experiences (IFX) team is at the center of bringing our vision for AI at Capital One to life. We work hand-in-hand with our partners across the company to advance the state of the art in science and AI engineering, and we build and deploy proprietary solutions that are central to our business and deliver value to millions of customers. Our AI models and platforms empower teams across Capital One to enhance their products with the transformative power of AI, in responsible and scalable ways for the highest leverage impact.

About the Role

In this role, you will:

  • Partner with a cross-functional team of engineers, research scientists, technical program managers, and product managers to deliver AI-powered products that change how our associates work and how our customers interact with Capital One.
  • Design, develop, test, deploy, and support AI software components including foundation model training, large language model inference, similarity search, guardrails, model evaluation, experimentation, governance, and observability, etc.
  • Leverage a broad stack of Open Source and SaaS AI technologies such as AWS Ultraclusters, Huggingface, VectorDBs, Nemo Guardrails, PyTorch, and more.
  • Invent and introduce state-of-the-art LLM optimization techniques to improve the performance — scalability, cost, latency, throughput — of large scale production AI systems.
  • Contribute to the technical vision and the long term roadmap of foundational AI systems at Capital One.

The ideal candidate:

  • You love to build systems, take pride in the quality of your work, and also share our passion to do the right thing. You want to work on problems that will help change banking for good.
  • You have a passion for staying abreast of the latest research, and an ability to intuitively understand scientific publications and judiciously apply novel techniques in production.
  • You adapt quickly and thrive on bringing clarity to big, undefined problems. You love asking questions and digging deep to uncover the root of problems and can articulate your findings concisely with clarity. You have the courage to share new ideas even when they are unproven.
  • You are deeply technical. You possess a strong foundation in engineering and mathematics, and your expertise in hardware, software, and AI enable you to see and exploit optimization opportunities that others miss.
  • You are a resilient trail blazer who can forge new paths to achieve business goals when the route is unknown.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, AI, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related fields plus at least 4 years of experience developing AI and ML algorithms or technologies, or a Master's degree in Computer Science, AI, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related fields plus at least 2 years of experience developing AI and ML algorithms or technologies
  • At least 4 years of experience programming with Python, Go, Scala, or Java

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 6 years of experience deploying scalable and responsible AI solutions on cloud platforms (e.g. AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, or equivalent private cloud)
  • Experience designing, developing, delivering, and supporting AI services
  • Experience developing AI and ML algorithms or technologies (e.g. LLM Inference, Similarity Search and VectorDBs, Guardrails, Memory) using Python, C++, C#, Java, or Golang
  • Experience developing and applying state-of-the-art techniques for optimizing training and inference software to improve hardware utilization, latency, throughput, and cost
  • Passion for staying abreast of the latest AI research and AI systems, and judiciously apply novel techniques in production

Working at Capital One

You’ll be empowered to take end-to-end ownership of your work and your career, backed by a high-performance, hybrid culture and holistic suite of benefits designed to support your whole self.

  • Take ownership of your own potential: Whether you’re looking to upskill, pivot into new business areas, or master your craft, you’ll have access to tools and mentorship to reach your potential and define your career trajectory.
  • Find your rhythm: We believe trust fosters the flexibility and autonomy required to balance personal needs with a focus on high performance. We support a hybrid model – with 3 days in the office per week – that gives room for both collaboration and personal commitments.
  • Benefits built for your life: We take a holistic approach to well-being, providing support for you and those who are most important to you. This includes: full coverage for spouses, domestic partners and dependents, a one-time Work From Home allowance to build your comfortable workspace, up to $3,000 in mental health coverage and up to $5,000 in annual tuition subsidies.

You’ll find that Capital One is committed to helping you thrive and evolve every step of the way.


This posting is for an existing vacancy.


The expected annual salary range for this position is $173,000 to $197,400. This role is also eligible to earn performance-based incentive compensation, which may include cash bonus(es). Incentives could be discretionary or non-discretionary depending on the plan.

title: Vice President, Operations East
description:
About Zūm:

Zūm is revolutionizing mass mobility with its Connected Mobility Experience (Zūm CMX™) system that connects and coordinates people, vehicles, and operations in real time. In the $50 billion student mobility market – the largest segment of the mass mobility industry – Zūm CMX is transforming a daily source of anxiety and disruption into a reliable, transparent, and efficient mobility experience for students and families. Today, more than 6,500 schools rely on Zūm CMX. Recognized globally for its innovative approach and operational execution, Zūm has been named to Fast Company’s World’s Most Innovative Companies, CNBC Disruptor 50 and Changemakers, the World Economic Forum, and the Financial Times’ Fastest Growing Companies lists. Zūm is backed by leading investors including Sequoia Capital, GIC, TPG, and Softbank.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Zum provides safe, reliable, technology-enabled student transportation for school districts. We are growing quickly: new districts, new yards, and new markets launch while existing ones are still being built out. The VP of Operations runs a multi-market in the east region P&L, leads general managers and their teams, and owns the operating rhythm that keeps buses running safely and on time. This is a hands-on, start-up-mode role for someone who can build, manage the process, and still step into a yard and roll up their sleeves when needed.


OPERATING RHYTHM

  • Daily: Route coverage, dispatch, on-time performance, driver safety messages, same-day escalations

  • Weekly: KPI release and action plans, labor review, customer launch calls, payroll dashboard review, AR collections

  • Monthly: Safety themes, union dues and benefits compliance, forecast-to-actual review, liquidated damages reconciliation

  • Seasonal: Back-to-school readiness, budget planning, renewals, 45-day scaling forecast

  • As needed: Involvement in bargaining, grievances, discipline, incident investigations, service-disruption planning

START-UP MODE

  • Launch new districts and yards while running existing ones, moving people and fleet across markets as needed

  • Write and standardize SOPs, RACIs, and protocols where none exist

  • Be decisive, often with incomplete information

  • Step in directly when a manager leaves or a launch stalls

NEW CONTRACT IMPLEMENTATION

Own the handoff from Sales through Day One and stabilization:

  • Handoff: Review contracts, pricing, and commitments with Sales, Legal, and Finance

  • Plan: Name an owner and build backward from first day of service

  • Staffing and training: Size teams including spares; lead recruiting, CDL training, and background checks

  • Labor and compliance: Determine CBA coverage and set up payroll and benefits

  • Customer readiness: Launch meetings, dry runs, and written scope changes

  • Stabilize: Provide go-live support, move to steady-state KPIs, and hold a post-launch review

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Regional operations: Own on-time performance, coverage, and service quality

  • Financials: Own the regional P&L, budget, forecast accuracy, and expense control

  • Renewals and collections: Lead renewals and AR, including disputed invoices and liquidated damages

  • Escalations: Be the escalation point for district and union contract disputes, working with Legal and HR

  • HQ liaison: Connect field operations with Sales, Customer Success, Finance, HR, Legal, Safety, and Technology

  • People leadership: Lead and coach GMs and field managers, handle performance issues, and run promotion panels

  • Safety and compliance: Lead incident reviews, make documented discipline decisions, and oversee training and records

  • Labor relations: Support bargaining, grievances, arbitration, and CBA implementation

  • Customer relationships: Serve as senior operational contact for district leaders

  • Driver pipeline: Oversee hiring, spare ratios, CDL training, retention, and recognition

  • Fleet and technology: Evaluate routing vendors and support yard and equipment readiness

REQUIREMENTS

  • 10+ years in operations, including 5+ leading multi-site or multi-region teams in student transportation, logistics, or similar safety-critical field operations

  • Experience in high-growth or turnaround settings, launching sites and building process from scratch

  • Strong financial skills: budgeting, forecasting, expense control, and AR management

  • Direct union experience (CBA administration, grievances, discipline, bargaining) and skill in renewals and escalations with districts and unions

  • Command of DOT/FMCSA, CDL, and state pupil-transportation requirements

  • Public-sector contract experience, including SLAs and liquidated damages

  • Fluency with operational and workforce data, turned into weekly action

  • Strong multitasking and proactive planning; exceptional written and verbal communication

  • Willingness to travel

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience

title: Technical Program Manager
description:
Job Title

Technical Program Manager

Job Description Summary

The Program Manager is responsible for leading and overseeing complex programs composed of multiple, interrelated projects to ensure delivery aligns with strategic business objectives, service commitments, and contractual obligations. This role defines and implements program governance, integrates delivery across workstreams, and provides leadership with clear visibility into progress, risks, financial health, and outcomes. Operating independently with urgency and rigor, the Program Manager drives decision‑making, resolves program‑level issues to closure, and serves as a primary liaison between program teams, technology team alignment and executive leadership while setting high standards for quality, accountability, and continuous improvement.

Job Description

Responsibilities:

  • Own end‑to‑end program delivery and quality, ensuring alignment with business objectives, statements of work, and defined success criteria.
  • Define, implement, and maintain program‑level governance and controls, including status reporting, risk and issue management, stakeholder engagement routines, and required artifacts.
  • Independently track and manage program‑level milestones, dependencies, risks, issues, and decisions with urgency and rigor; proactively identify barriers and drive resolution to closure.
  • Drive program‑level decision‑making by framing options, risks, and trade‑offs and ensuring leaders receive decision‑ready information at the right time.
  • Proactively manage changes to program scope by assessing impacts to schedule, budget, quality, risk, and outcomes; making recommendations; securing approvals; and ensuring alignment with contractual and business commitments.
  • Partner with leadership, technical leads, and functional partners to define roles and responsibilities, staff and resource the program, and ensure effective onboarding/offboarding.
  • Manage program financials — budgeting, forecasting, and reporting — to meet financial expectations and provide clear visibility into program health and profitability.
  • Ensure program‑level procurement reporting and financial transparency align with delivery plans and statements of work.
  • Translate complex program data into clear, actionable insights through synthesized cross‑project information and executive‑level reporting on progress, critical path, risks, and financial status.
  • Drive stakeholder engagement and act as a liaison between program teams and senior leadership, ensuring appropriate communication, alignment, and timely decision‑making.
  • Monitor and assess customer satisfaction, delivery quality, and program performance; identify and drive improvement opportunities.
  • Provide leadership, coaching, and mentorship to Project Managers, Senior Project Managers, and other team members to drive execution discipline and high‑quality outcomes.
  • Establish long‑term goals and roadmaps for the program or portfolio, adapting delivery approaches to support continuous improvement and evolving service delivery models.


Qualifications:

  • 8- 10 years of progressive project management experience, including a minimum of 5 years of active program management experience leading complex, cross‑functional initiatives.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and track proactively to program timelines, milestones, risks, and issue resolution.
  • Extensive problem‑solving skills with the judgment and perseverance to drive complex issues and risks to resolution.
  • Strong understanding of service delivery models, with experience adapting delivery approaches to support continuous improvement.
  • Proven experience managing, tracking, and forecasting financials and budgets for large‑scale or external customer programs.
  • Experience working with global solution providers and distributed teams.
  • Strong leadership presence with the ability to influence senior executives and cross‑functional stakeholders.
  • Bachelor’s degree required; PMP, PgMP, Prosci, or Agile/Scrum certifications preferred.
  • Knowledge of real estate, professional services, or service‑based delivery environments is helpful.
  • Experience with data, analytics, CRM, enterprise applications, or technology transformation programs preferred.


Skills (and experience level):

  • Program Leadership & Governance — Advanced/Expert. Designs and runs program‑level governance and operating rhythms.
  • Executive Communication & Strategic Message Distillation — Advanced. Synthesizes cross‑project data into decision‑ready insight.
  • Financial Management — Advanced. Owns budgeting, forecasting, and program profitability reporting.
  • Risk, Issue & Dependency Management — Advanced. Drives resolution to closure with rigor.
  • Stakeholder Influence & Negotiation — Advanced. Influences executives and resolves senior stakeholder conflict.
  • Adaptability & Pivot Management — Advanced. Flexes between structured and agile approaches based on evolving needs.
  • Tools — Advanced. Smartsheet and Microsoft 365; effective use of AI‑enabled tools for reporting and insight. Experience with Azure DevOps (ADO) and the Salesforce toolkit is preferred.
  • Resource & Capacity Planning – Advanced: Identifies resource constraints, competing priorities, and impacts to program sequencing.
  • Business Readiness & Change Coordination – Advanced: Integrates adoption, communications, training, support, and operational readiness into delivery planning.

title: Employment Specialist
description:
Reed in Partnership has been delivering public services since 1998. We are a British, family-owned company, whose mission has always been to positively transform people and their communities. This is reflected in our services, which we deliver to help people from all backgrounds and circumstances to change their lives for the better.

Pay Range

£31,000 to £35,000

Job Description

Are you passionate about making a difference and helping others to fulfil their potential?


Would you like to work in a role that puts the customer at the heart of everything we do, making a genuine positive impact?


Then consider the role of Employment Specialist at Reed in Partnership!


Who we are

Reed in Partnership's Employability Division aims to positively transform lives by helping individuals who are unemployed, economically inactive, or facing challenges such as health conditions, disabilities, or caring responsibilities to find sustainable employment. Through a wide range of tailored support services including one-to-one careers guidance, CV writing, interview preparation, and skills training, we have supported over 250,000 people on their journey into work.

Our Connect to Work programme, funded by East Midlands Combined Authority, focuses specifically on supporting unemployed participants with complex barriers to employment, including those with a disability or health condition. We provide them with up to 12 months of personalised support to enter or re-enter the workforce.


What is the role about?

Employment Specialists are the front line of Reed in Partnership, directly contributing to our mission by supporting jobseekers (our participants), engaging with individuals within communities across Derbyshire to generate referrals onto the programme, as well as promoting the benefits of the Connect to Work programme. Our participants are the lifeblood of our business and providing them with an excellent service is at the very core of the Employment Specialist role.


*Please note this role will require you to work and travel within Derbyshire and the surrounding areas*


Just some of your day-to-day responsibilities will include:

Taking Ownership

  • Meeting with and supporting a caseload of jobseekers in the community, identifying their barriers and creating tailored action plans to progress them into employment.
  • Delivering personalised, one-to-one guidance to our participants including CV writing, interview preparation, and skills development.
  • Meeting and exceeding performance targets and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).

Working Together

  • Collaborating with participants to shift their mindset and build the confidence they need to find and sustain work.
  • Engaging with local employers to identify job opportunities.
  • Signposting participants to internal and external stakeholders to address specific barriers such as health, housing, or financial challenges.
  • Promoting the Connect to Work programme within the community to generate referrals, raising awareness of its benefits and impact.
  • Attending events within the local community to promote the Connect to Work programme to generate referrals, raising awareness of its benefits and impact.

Being Fair, Open, and Honest

  • Providing inclusive support and advice to people from all backgrounds.

What’s in it for you?

A generous base salary (pro-rata for part time), and great flexibility with your working schedule, we offer training, development and progression opportunities. You will have access to the range of Reed in Partnership benefits, which include:

  • 25 days annual leave (pro-rata for part time) plus statutory bank holidays
  • Reed Pension Scheme
  • Award Winning Management & Leadership training
  • Professional & Personal Development Funds
  • Bi-annual pay reviews
  • Plus, much more that can be found on our website.

The Employment Specialist role offers immense satisfaction of connecting people with the tailored support that they need to fulfil their potential. At Reed in Partnership, our values - Fair, Open & Honest, Take Ownership, and Work Together, guide everything we do. Join us in delivering services that make a real difference.

To be successful in this role, we are looking for someone with:

  • Ability to demonstrate coaching/mentoring experience and persuasion/influencing skills through previous work or social activities.
  • Experience of working in a customer facing environment (i.e. Customer Services, Hospitality, Social Care, Customer Services, Sales)
  • Experience of working in a fast paced, performance target driven environment.
  • Willingness to travel locally (e.g. to meet customers/employers).
  • A minimum of 2 A-Levels or an equivalent Level 3 Diploma.
  • GCSE English Language at a minimum of a Grade B (or equivalent Level 2 qualification). OR achievement of a Level 2 in Literacy Assessment at interview stage OR International Equivalents.
  • A minimum of 2 A-Levels or an equivalent Level 3 Diploma.
  • GCSE English Language at a minimum of a Grade B (or equivalent Level 2 qualification). OR achievement of a Level 2 in Literacy Assessment at interview stage OR International Equivalents.

  • Experience working within a Community Engagement role (i.e. Business Development, Outreach)
  • Fluency in more than one language

title: Head of Software Engineering
description:
The Opportunity

We’re looking for a Head of Software Engineering to lead the software behind advanced electro-optical products that protect people and critical assets around the world.

Reporting directly to the CTO, you’ll lead a growing team of over 10 software engineers, with the team continuing to expand as OpenWorks grows. You’ll shape its capability, standards and delivery from early concepts through to deployment and in-service improvement.

This is an opportunity for an experienced software leader who enjoys technical complexity, develops talented people and brings clarity to competing priorities. You’ll have the scope to build the team, strengthen how we work and make a visible impact on our products.

Who We Are

OpenWorks is a rapidly growing business operating globally with a passion for exceptional engineering and building on a legacy of defence innovation in the North East of England.

Our products provide ultra-high performance, real-time detection, tracking, identification and targeting of dynamic aerial threats. They have been deployed internationally to protect high profile military and civilian assets, and contribute towards the defeat of nuisance, misguided and maliciously deployed drones during operations.

We are very proud to have supported a wide range of law enforcement and military operators, protecting many of the most high profile sites and individuals around the world.

The amazing things we do are only possible because of a dedicated and passionate team.

Security Vetting Information

OpenWorks Engineering operates within the defence sector. As part of our recruitment and onboarding processes, we collect information that may be required to support future security vetting and clearance requirements, should these become necessary during employment.

Why You’ll Love Working With Us

Join a high-energy, collaborative team where great ideas thrive, challenges are embraced, and people genuinely love what they do.

Here’s what our benefits have to offer:

Rewarding Success - Competitive salary, starting from £90,000, plus a discretionary annual bonus of up to 25% of salary alongside a structured pay progression framework.

Enhanced Pension – Up to 8% employer-matched contributions to help you plan for the future.

More Time to Recharge – 25 days’ holiday plus public holidays, long-service rewards, and the option to buy up to 5 extra days.

Breakfast & Lunch on Us – Enjoy team breakfasts and freshly prepared lunches every day courtesy of Chef Mark and his team.

Health & Wellbeing – Private healthcare and life assurance for added peace of mind.

Sustainable Travel – Salary sacrifice schemes, including EV car and Cycle to Work options.

Team Socials – Regular events, from quiz nights and football to board games and more.

Learning & Growth – A culture that empowers you to challenge, grow and make an impact, plus a £250 annual learning budget to invest in the development that matters most to you.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Lead and develop the team: Build a high-performing Software Engineering function through clear objectives, performance management, coaching and recruitment.
  • Drive engineering delivery: Turn product, customer and business priorities into achievable plans, managing capacity, resources and commitments across multiple projects.
  • Provide technical leadership: Shape software architecture, standards and development practices, challenge complex decisions and empower engineers to own delivery.
  • Take concepts into service: Lead software development from prototyping through verification, release and deployment, building in supportability and configuration control.
  • Deliver integrated products: Work with Hardware & Systems, Intelligence & Autonomy, Product and Operations to turn emerging capabilities into reliable products.
  • Align teams and remove barriers: Clarify priorities, ownership, interfaces and dependencies across functions, resolve blockers and escalate trade-offs that need wider business decisions.
  • Strengthen how we work: Give the CTO clear visibility of progress and risks, improve productivity and use production and customer feedback to drive product improvements.

What we’re looking for:

Essential

  • Proven software leadership: Significant experience leading and developing software teams within complex R&D and product development environments.
  • Technical credibility: A strong software engineering background and C++ development experience, supported by a relevant degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Engineering, Physics or a related technical discipline.
  • Embedded product experience: Experience delivering complex software on real-time embedded platforms, integrating with mechanical and electronic engineering.
  • Architecture and lifecycle expertise: Strong understanding of system design, hardware, operating systems and software interfaces, alongside code review, source control, testing, release management and configuration control.
  • People and delivery focus: A track record of developing high-performing teams, managing priorities and resources across multiple projects, and maintaining momentum as priorities change.

Desirable

  • Relevant product experience: Experience in electro-optical, autonomous, radar, surveillance or counter-UAS technologies, or regulated, safety-critical environments and defence standards.
  • Relevant technologies: Experience with NVIDIA Jetson, Linux hardware drivers, network configuration, TCP/IP, CMake, DevOps, Python, cyber security or video streaming.
  • Professional development: A relevant master’s qualification, Chartered Engineer status or equivalent professional recognition.

You must have the right to work in the UK; we are unable to offer visa sponsorship. Occasional travel may be required.

More about us:

Vision

Help protect the territory and airspace of NATO countries and their allies.

Mission

Be a world-leading provider of autonomous technology for Surveillance applications and Defence

Values

Be a Good Egg: Earn respect, have mutual trust and be honest

Do cool stuff: We develop cool tech with an awesome team, and we get stuff done

Be empowered: We are autonomous, reliable and take personal responsibility

We are one team: Look out for each other and the team

Things go wrong: Fail fast, learn and move on

Have fun: We’re doing amazing things with passionate people

We Get It Done: Focus on what matters and work with energy to bring ideas to life

title: Senior Data Scientist - Delivery Tech
description:
Are you passionate about data science? Do you describe yourself as an innovative problem solver? Looking for an opportunity that will directly impact the customer experience at Gopuff? Come join the Gopuff Data Science team and #ChangeTheGame. Gopuff is a high-growth startup that is revolutionizing hyper-local instant e-commerce. We warehouse and deliver tens of thousands of products to your door super fast.

As a Senior Data Scientist at Gopuff working on the Delivery Technology Team, you will lead the vision and delivery of data driven models to optimize the delivery experience for consumers and delivery partners on our platform across dispatch optimization, delivery routing/ETAs, driver pricing/incentives, as well as the delivery partner experience. All of that, with a direct impact on the delivery experience that is so core to serving our customers’ immediate needs, means you’ll have the opportunity to make a huge impact on the future success of Gopuff.

We’re looking for a doer, problem solver, and thought-leader.

What We Offer

  • Medical/Dental/Vision Insurance
  • 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan
  • HSA or FSA eligibility
  • Long and Short-Term Disability Insurance
  • Fitness Reimbursement Program
  • 25% employee discount & FAM Membership
  • Flexible PTO
  • Group Life Insurance
  • EAP through AllOne Health (formerly Carebridge)

You Will

  • Optimize delivery fees: Design, build and iterate on algorithmic delivery fee strategies (e.g., dynamic or contextual pricing by location, time, basket and capacity) that balance conversion, customer experience and profitability.

  • Solve the driver dispatch problem: Develop optimization and ML approaches to order batching, assignment and routing that lower overall delivery cost while keeping speed and reliability high.

  • Forecast demand: Build accurate, well-calibrated demand forecasts at the right granularity (location × time) to inform driver supply planning, scheduling, incentives and pricing decisions.

  • Run rigorous experiments: Design and analyze high-quality tests, including A/B, switchback and geo/market-level designs, that account for marketplace interference, and use causal inference to measure true impact on customer and business metrics.

  • Own solutions end to end: frame the problem, build features and models, deploy with engineering partners, then monitor, explain and improve performance in production.

  • Partner with product, engineering, operations and finance to turn ambiguous business questions into well-defined technical objectives and shipped solutions.

  • Deeply understand our customers, delivery partners and data to find new opportunities for ML, optimization and causal inference.

You Have

  • MS or PhD in Operations Research, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, with 2+ years of experience in delivery, logistics, marketplace or pricing problems (or 8+ years of industry experience in data science).

  • Strong background in at least two of the following: pricing/revenue optimization, mathematical optimization (e.g., MIP, assignment and routing problems, heuristics), time-series and demand forecasting, experimentation and causal inference.

  • Hands-on experience designing experiments in two-sided or operational marketplaces where standard A/B tests break down (e.g., switchback or cluster-randomized designs, variance reduction).

  • A proven ability to translate ambiguous business problems into clear technical objectives and deliver concrete, measurable results.

  • Expertise in machine learning and statistics.

  • Proficiency in Python, SQL and source control; experience shipping models to production with engineering teams.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in on-demand delivery, ride-hailing or gig-economy marketplaces.

  • Familiarity with optimization solvers (e.g., OR-Tools, Gurobi) and forecasting libraries.

  • Experience with ETA prediction or driver incentive and pay design.

Compensation

  • Gopuff pays employees based on market pricing and pay may vary depending on your location. The salary range below reflects what we’d reasonably expect to pay candidates. A candidate’s starting pay will be determined based on job-related skills, experience, qualifications, interview performance, and market conditions. These ranges may be modified in the future. Exceptions may be made for exceptional individuals. For additional information on this role’s compensation package, please reach out to the designated recruiter for this role.
  • This role is eligible for a discretionary annual cash bonus and participation in Gopuff’s equity incentive plan.
  • Remote Base Salary Range: $160,000 - $200,000
At Gopuff, we know that life can be unpredictable. Sometimes you forget the milk at the store, run out of pet food for Fido, or just really need ice cream at 11 pm. We get it—stuff happens. But that’s where we come in, delivering all your wants and needs in just minutes.
And now, we’re assembling a team of motivated people to help us drive forward that vision to bring a new age of convenience and predictability to an unpredictable world.
Like what you’re hearing? Then join us on Team Blue.

location: Remote CW Site - USA - Flexible United States
description:
Job Title

Principal Machine Learning Engineer

Job Description Summary

We are seeking a Principal ML Engineer to build and maintain artificial intelligence and machine learning systems for our business. This role combines deep technical execution with broad influence: tackling the most complex machine learning problems, designing and implementing data architectures/models, MLOps and LLMOps, and monitoring and optimization as key software, while raising the bar for engineering excellence across the Data Organization.
Reporting to the Senior Director, Data Science & AI, the Principal ML Engineer is expected to move fluidly across project/product teams — embedding in projects for days or months at a time to unblock, accelerate, and uplift delivery. They will mentor other engineers at every level, push standards for technical excellence, and help establish the ML engineering, and architectural principles that guide our work. The primary platform is Databricks and the Azure cloud ecosystem, with the expectation of evaluating and adopting additional data technologies as the platform evolves.

Job Description

Role Summary

We are seeking a Principal ML Engineer to build and maintain artificial intelligence and machine learning systems for ourbusiness. This role combines deep technical execution with broad influence: tackling the most complex machine learning problems, designing and implementing data architectures/models, MLOps and LLMOps, and monitoring and optimization as key software, while raising the bar for engineering excellence across the Data Organization.

Reporting to the Senior Director, Data Science & AI, the Principal ML Engineer is expected to move fluidly across project/product teams — embedding in projects for days or months at a time to unblock, accelerate, and uplift delivery. They will mentor other engineers at every level, push standards for technical excellence, and help establish the ML engineering, and architectural principles that guide our work. The primary platform is Databricks and the Azure cloud ecosystem, with the expectation of evaluating and adopting additional data technologies as the platform evolves.

Key Responsibilities

AI/ML Model Development

  • Demonstrable experience shaping the end-to-end architecture, development, and deployment of AI, including machine learning, GenAI, and Agentic models that are tailored to business use cases.
  • Design and develop agentic AI systems — including multi-agent orchestration, tool-use, evaluation, and autonomous task-execution pipelines — to automate complex enterprise workflows.
  • Enforce model development standards encompassing data preprocessing, feature engineering, model selection, hyperparameter tuning, evaluation, and documentation.
  • Partner with data engineering teams to ensure robust, scalable, and high-quality data pipelines that support model training and inference.

AI Operations (MLOps / LLMOps)

  • Implement the organization's MLOps and LLMOps capabilities, including CI/CD pipelines for data wrangling, feature engineering, model training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring.
  • Help define and enforce standards for model versioning, experiment tracking, reproducibility, and model registry management.
  • Implement robust model monitoring frameworks to detect performance degradation, data drift, concept drift, and bias in production systems, with automated alerting and retraining triggers.

AI Governance

  • Implement AI governance frameworks, including policies for model risk management, fairness, explainability, privacy, and security.
  • Champion sound AI principles across the global business, ensuring that human oversight and accountability are embedded in every stage of the AI development lifecycle.

Essential Skills, Knowledge & Experience

  • 10+ years building software or machine learning systems, including 6+ years shipping and operating machine learning in production — served, monitored, and maintained after launch.
  • Prior experience as the senior-most or near-senior-most engineer on a production ML or data platform, with responsibility for architectural decisions others had to live with.
  • A track record of setting technical standards that outlasted your own involvement, and of leading through influence without formal authority.
  • Strong hands-on Python and SQL, and the software engineering fundamentals that keep ML systems maintainable at scale — version control, automated testing, code review, modular design — plus the discipline to enforce them across teams.
  • Expert hands-on proficiency with Databricks (Spark, Lakeflow Declarative Pipelines, Delta Lake, Lakebase/Postgres, Unity Catalog, Model Serving) and the Azure data ecosystem. Deep experience on a comparable lakehouse platform will be considered, with the expectation of becoming effective on Databricks quickly.
  • Experience with MLflow or an equivalent for experiment tracking, model registry, tracing, and reproducibility.
  • At least one year building agentic systems that reached production use, or equivalent demonstrated work. You should be able to walk us through a system you built: how it was orchestrated, how you evaluated it, what guardrails you put around it, how it failed, and what standard you set for whoever built the next one.
  • Proven ability to mentor engineers at every level and materially raise the technical standard of the teams you work with.
  • Familiarity with modern machine learning frameworks and a strong instinct for reusable, scalable engineering patterns.

Preferred Skills, Knowledge & Experience

  • Experience establishing an ML or AI platform capability in an organisation that did not previously have one.
  • Experience embedding across multiple teams, geographies and time zones as a principal-level technical contributor.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD and infrastructure-as-code tooling for data pipelines using Azure DevOps, Databricks Declarative Automation Bundles (DABs), GitHub Actions, Terraform, or equivalent.
  • Good understanding of data governance, metadata management, and cataloguing in enterprise environments.
  • Exposure to model serving and inference at scale — containers, REST endpoints, latency and throughput targets — or to feature stores, retrieval pipelines, or LLM cost-attribution tooling.
  • Model Context Protocol (MCP) or comparable tool-integration standards.
  • Commercial real estate, professional services, or another domain where the data is messy, entities are inconsistently defined, and subject matter experts are the source of truth.

You are an autonomous AI Engineer, responsible for creating the harness for designing and building the AI harness, agent framework, and reusable engineering components required to operate a modern data platform based on Apache Iceberg, Trino, and Parquet.

Your primary responsibility is not only to build data pipelines, but also to establish the agentic execution framework (AI Harness) that enables multiple specialized agents to collaborate, execute tasks, maintain state, orchestrate workflows, and deliver end-to-end data engineering capabilities.

Depending on your level of experience, your focus in the team will be on either task execution, independent delivery, or technical leadership.

Key Responsibilities

AI Harness Development

  • Design and implement the foundational agent framework that provides:
  • Agent orchestration and coordination
  • Workflow execution and state management
  • Memory and context handling
  • Tool and function calling
  • Agent-to-agent communication
  • Human approval workflows
  • Logging and audit trails
  • Error handling and recovery
  • Security and access controls
  • Observability and monitoring

The harness must support autonomous and multi-agent execution patterns.

Specialized Agents Creation

  • Discover Iceberg catalogs and schemas
  • Profile datasets
  • Generate metadata and lineage
  • Ingest data from databases, APIs, files, and streams
  • Create Parquet datasets
  • Register and maintain Iceberg tables
  • Generate Trino SQL
  • Build transformation workflows
  • Create curated and business-ready datasets
  • Validate schemas and data integrity
  • Detect anomalies
  • Generate reconciliation reports
  • Analyze Trino workloads
  • Recommend partitioning strategies
  • Optimize Iceberg tables and Parquet files
  • Classify sensitive information
  • Manage metadata and lineage
  • Apply retention and compliance policies
  • Monitor pipelines and agent activities
  • Detect failures and bottlenecks
  • Generate alerts and operational insights

Expected Deliverables

  • Iceberg table definitions and schemas
  • Trino SQL scripts and views
  • Python data pipeline code
  • Data quality validation suites
  • Metadata and lineage documentation
  • CI/CD deployment artifacts
  • Monitoring and observability configurations
  • Technical documentation and runbooks

Qualifications

Skills and Experience

  • Experience with Generative AI, Agentic AI, or LLM-based solutions.
  • Proficiency in Python, including FastAPI, Pydantic and Pandas.
  • Experience designing and implementing AI Harness or multi-agent frameworks.
  • Hands‑on experience with LangChain & LangGraph.
  • Experience with Apache Iceberg, Trino, and Parquet-based lakehouse architectures.
  • Experience building data ingestion, transformation, and orchestration pipelines.
  • Strong knowledge of metadata management, data lineage, and data governance practices.
  • Experience developing REST APIs, SDKs, and reusable engineering frameworks.
  • Experience with observability, monitoring, tracing, and operational support practices.
  • Strong understanding of distributed systems, event-driven architectures, and microservices patterns.
  • Proven ability to design, develop, and operationalize enterprise-grade AI agents for data discovery, ingestion, transformation, optimization, governance, and observability.
  • Familiar with modern data engineering technologies, including DuckDB, dbt, and related engineering tools for data transformation, modelling, and pipeline development.
  • Senior engineers will be expected to have demonstrated evidence of leading technical designs, guiding junior engineering team members, working independently with clients and delivery teams, and translating AI/data requirements into scalable, secure, and deployable solutions.

title: AWS Cloud Infrastructure Senior Engineer/ Tech Lead
description:
For the NN Public Cloud AWS Foundation team we are looking for a skilled AWS Infrastructure Engineer who can drive the improvements and modernization of our platform to enable cloud capabilities for our customers. This job opportunity resides within Group IT, the central IT department of NN. The AWS Cloud Foundation Team delivers the cloud foundation (access management, accounts, security, networking and more) in a standardized and automated way at a large scale (>750 AWS accounts). It’s your job to lead the team to modernize and improve automation further to become future proof, all the while maintaining the stability of the platform.


What you’re going to do

NN’s cloud journey started in 2015 with a hybrid cloud strategy and transformed to its current state where the platforms are growing daily with more than 750 AWS accounts and 1000 Azure subscriptions. Your team provides secure, scalable and self-service access to the AWS Cloud.

To support this hybrid cloud strategy, you and your team will continue to deliver a solid and secure foundation with enough freedom for application teams to build and manage their solutions.

Responsibilities of the team, including you:

  • Innovate while maintaining the stability and security of our platform
  • Keep an eye on AWS releases and implement relevant features to improve our platform
  • Continuously improve our automation to reduce the OPS work of the team
  • Run OPS and standby for the foundation every 5-8 weeks

What we offer you

  • Salary between €5,933 and €7,910 depending on your knowledge and experience
  • 13th month and holiday allowance are paid with your monthly salary
  • 27 vacation days for a 5-day working week and three Diversity Day's
  • A modern, collective pension scheme administered by BeFrank
  • Plenty of training and learning opportunities for personal development
  • NS Business Card 2nd class, which gives you unlimited travel, also privately. Do you prefer to travel with your own transport? Then you can declare the kilometres travelled
  • We work hybrid at NN. Together with your team, you decide where, how and when you work. The official location of this job is The Hague
  • Allowances for setting up your home office and for internet use

Who you are

You enjoy working in a team, like to take on a challenge, even if the boundaries are not immediately clear, and are proud of what you achieve together. You have a scout mentality that emphasizes curiosity and ownership to take immediate action on what you discover. You also want to continue to develop in the field of AWS, just as the platform continues to develop on a daily basis. Furthermore, we look for someone with:

  • a minimum of 5 years of experience with implementing AWS cloud solutions
  • experience with Platform as a Service, scripting with Python and Infrastructure as a Code with Terraform and CDK
  • architectural and platform/ solution design knowledge
  • experience working with stakeholders on enterprise scale
  • experience working within large multi-account environments
  • recent AWS Certifications
  • take ownership and not afraid to take on a task from start to finish, delivering real results and sharing the knowledge gained in the process
  • Fluently in Dutch is requires
  • Soft skills
  • you can make informed decisions (not authoritative but decisive)
  • pragmatic, grounded, structured, stays calm, mature (doesn’t get overwhelmed or too emotional when things become hectic)
  • someone who can maintain an overview and keep the team focused

If you are enthusiastic about this vacancy and think that you would be a good fit for the team at NN, we would like to invite you to apply. During your first interview we are very keen to find out who you are, what motivates you and what you can contribute to this role at NN. Your second (and possibly third) interview will be with AWS DevOps engineers to find out if there is a technical match on your experiences, your way of working and your interests.


Who you will work with

The AWS Cloud Foundation Team consists of six skilled AWS infrastructure engineers. The team is part of the Public Cloud Domain of NN where we have an open culture with honest and fun people.​ Your direct colleagues will consist of the AWS enablement team and the Azure foundation and enablement teams Together with the Public Cloud domain we have multiple days per year where we align on work and celebrate achievements. We also have teamdays and other smaller events within the team and outside of it. Every Wednesday we work from the office in The Hague, but you are free to come to the office whenever you like. All in all, there is plenty of opportunity to work with passion and to have fun while doing it.


Any questions?

If you have any questions about the job, you can reach out to Elmira van der Schee (Talent Acquisition Specialist) via Elmira.van.der.schee@nn-group.com.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

description:

This individual will conduct an assessment of physical, psychosocial, cognitive, and functional components; develop a treatment plan; order and interpret diagnostic components of the plan; and prescribe non-pharmacological and pharmacological agents. The incumbent in this position will support the mission, vision, values and strategic initiatives of Mary Washington Healthcare and must demonstrate a commitment to quality service to patients, physicians, Associates and the public.

Essential Functions & Responsibilities:

  • In collaboration with Medical Director, Palliative and Hospice, medical staff, and Palliative/Hospice Team, demonstrate ability to consult patients and family members about diagnosis, goal setting, and end of life; completes necessary documentation to meet regulatory requirements.
  • Perform comprehensive health assessments for the purpose of evaluating, treating, and providing comfort care to individuals as appropriate.
  • Formulate appropriate differential evaluation, develops treatment plan to include appropriate diagnostics; identifies non-pharmacological interventions, prescribes appropriate pharmacological agents, and provides education. The plan is based on mutually established priorities to maximize the health potential and wishes of the patient and family.
  • Provide relevant patient and family education; makes appropriate referrals to other professional and community agencies.
  • Assist Hospitalist with Palliative Team patient rounding and discharge planning.
  • Perform face-to-face visits and completes documentation for recertification of Mary Washington Hospice patients in compliance with regulatory requirements; assists with recertification process.
  • Effectively communicate with attending physicians regarding changes in plan of care and patient and family goals.
  • Act as educational resource to community physicians regarding palliative care and end-of-life issues.
  • Positively impact goals of the organization, including Hospice transition, mortality rate, hospital length of stay, patient satisfaction, and participation in screening programs and educational activities.
  • Demonstrate the ability to use effective organizational/prioritization problem-solving and decision-making abilities in practice.
  • Meet all the requirements of the practice agreement with the supervising physician under the regulations and requirements of the Commonwealth of Virginia.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications:

  • Registered Nurse licensed to practice in Virginia or eligible to attain licensure in Virginia.
  • MSN required.
  • Currently licensed as a Nurse Practitioner in Virginia; Adult or Family Board Certified Nurse Practitioner (ANCC, ACHPN, or AANP). Prefer candidate who is currently ACHPN certified, but will consider candidate who can complete this certification within 24 months of date of hire. Current approval for prescriptive authority in Virginia.

The Technical Staff Engineer-Applications & Systems role combines applications engineering (customer support) and systems engineering (product definition) for Microchip’s clocking and timing products. Based in Addison, TX, the engineer will work closely with design, marketing, and product teams to support the full product lifecycle.

Responsibilities include defining product specifications, leading technical aspects of development, writing datasheets, supporting customers, and troubleshooting complex issues in the lab. The role focuses on synchronization, jitter attenuation, clock generators, and clock buffers, while also supporting broader Microchip timing solutions, including related software and drivers.

The engineer will collaborate with global teams across the U.S., Canada, Europe, and India.


Key job responsibilities/duties include

• Maintain up-to-date industry knowledge related to clock & timing

• Author product definition specifications

• Lead technical trade-off decisions (such as power, size, cost, jitter)

• Author product datasheets and application notes

• Perform competitive analysis and create competitive analysis reports

• Visit customers for product promotion

• Review schematics

• Solve technical problems with customer’s system related to clock & timing

• Debug and troubleshoot product operation using specialized clock & timing equipment in Microchip’s lab

• Visit customers for on-site debug of escalated issues

Requirements/Qualifications:

• USA citizenship (required for supporting some USA defense companies)

• USA residency (required for supporting some USA defense companies)

• Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering with 12.5+ years of relevant industry experience

• Strong knowledge of clock & timing technology

• Strong knowledge of clock & timing products and product operation

• Knowledge of specialized clock & timing equipment (such as phase noise analyzers) and the control thereof (such as writing python or TCL scripts)

• Working knowledge of embedded C programming language

• Ability and willingness to travel globally


Competencies

• Good technical leadership and ability to find the best trade-offs between technical and business elements of product development

• Strong problem solving and debugging skills

• Detail oriented, ensuring all the i’s are dotted and the t’s are crossed, handling large technical documentation (e.g. 100+ page datasheets or product specifications)

description:
AI Engineer 5

At Capital One, we are creating responsible and reliable AI systems, changing banking for good. For years, Capital One has been an industry leader in using machine learning to create real-time, personalized customer experiences. Our investments in technology infrastructure and world-class talent — along with our deep experience in machine learning — position us to be at the forefront of enterprises leveraging AI.
