title: Director of Maintenance Operations
description:
Position Description

The Director of Maintenance Operations is the senior leader responsible for Jubilee Housing's maintenance function across the portfolio. The Director provides direct leadership to all maintenance staff, porters, and the Maintenance Coordinator, and is accountable for the day-to-day performance, systems, standards, and long-term effectiveness of the department.


This role owns the full maintenance lifecycle, including work order intake and completion, preventive maintenance, unit turns, inspections, life-safety systems, vendor performance, inventory, procurement, maintenance-driven capital projects, and regulatory compliance. The Director is expected to build strong systems and accountability while remaining technically capable of stepping in to diagnose, guide, or assist with large, complex, or unusual maintenance issues when needed. This is not a routine technician position and does not participate in the regular on-call rotation; however, the Director serves as a management escalation point for significant after-hours emergencies.


Who You Are

  • A Leader. You lead by example and are committed to coaching, developing, and holding your team accountable every day.
  • A Systems Thinker. You identify workflow breakdowns and build durable processes, standards, and accountability measures that scale with the portfolio.
  • Technically Savvy. You have a strong hands-on understanding of building systems and are quick to learn new tools and technology.
  • A Strong Communicator. Your writing and speaking skills are clear and effective, helping you connect well with staff, residents, and senior leadership.
  • A Team Player. You are united with teammates across departments in delivering the best experience to residents.
  • Proactive. You act like an owner, building programs and habits that prevent emergencies rather than just reacting to them.
  • Personable. You are respectful, pleasant to be around, and enjoy engaging with others.
  • Levelheaded. You keep your cool during maintenance emergencies and quickly find solutions.
  • Solution-Oriented. You follow through on commitments, letting teammates and residents know they matter.


Specific Duties

Department Leadership and Staff Development

  • Directly supervise all Maintenance Technicians, Porters, and the Maintenance Coordinator; establish clear expectations, provide coaching and feedback, and manage performance and accountability.
  • Develop staffing schedules and deployment strategies that provide appropriate coverage across the portfolio.
  • Build a department culture centered on safety, follow-through, quality workmanship, resident service, teamwork, and continuous improvement.
  • Coordinate and provide technical training for maintenance staff; identify skill gaps and establish development plans.
  • Provide hands-on technical guidance and, when necessary, assist with major, difficult, or unusual maintenance issues that require advanced troubleshooting or leadership.

Work Order Management and Maintenance Systems

  • Own the end-to-end work order process, including intake, triage, assignment, tracking, escalation, quality control, and closure using OneSite/RealPage.
  • Establish and enforce clear service standards for routine, urgent, and emergency maintenance requests.
  • Monitor open work orders, aging, response times, completion rates, repeat issues, and resident-impacting trends; take corrective action when performance falls below expectations.
  • Maintain dashboards and reporting routines that provide the Vice President of Property Management, Director of Property Management, Community Managers, and organizational leadership with clear visibility into maintenance performance.
  • Continuously improve maintenance workflows, system configuration, documentation standards, and data quality.

Unit Turns and Vacancy Readiness

  • Maintain portfolio-wide accountability for unit turns and established make-ready timelines.
  • Oversee and guide the Maintenance Coordinator in maintaining the make-ready schedule, coordinating vendors and staff, tracking progress, and escalating delays.
  • Review vacant-unit status regularly and ensure units are completed to Jubilee Housing standards and ready for occupancy within established timelines.
  • Coordinate closely with Property Management regarding vacancy priorities, move-in dates, access, and completion status.

Preventive Maintenance, Inspections, and Physical Operations

  • Design, implement, and maintain a comprehensive preventive maintenance program for HVAC, plumbing, electrical, roofing, elevators, fire alarms, sprinkler systems, and other building systems.
  • Use OneSite/RealPage or related systems to schedule, assign, document, and verify recurring preventive maintenance tasks.
  • Conduct routine property inspections and identify, assign, and track corrective actions.
  • Ensure life-safety systems are maintained, tested, inspected, and documented in accordance with applicable requirements.
  • Oversee grounds maintenance, snow removal, trash removal, common-area conditions, and porter operations.
  • Maintain inventory controls for parts, supplies, tools, and equipment; establish appropriate stocking and reorder practices.

Emergency Response

  • Serve as a management escalation point for significant after-hours maintenance emergencies when the on-call and backup process requires additional leadership or technical support.
  • Provide technical direction during emergencies and coordinate vendors, staff, Property Management, and senior leadership as necessary.
  • Review emergency incidents and recurring failures to identify corrective actions, training needs, or preventive measures.
  • The Director does not participate in the routine technician on-call rotation.

Compliance and Safety

  • Ensure maintenance operations comply with HUD, NSPIRE/REAC, OSHA, District of Columbia building and housing codes, life-safety requirements, and other applicable regulations.
  • Lead maintenance preparation for agency, governmental, owner, lender, and partner inspections and ensure findings are tracked through timely closure.
  • Maintain current contractor licenses, certificates of insurance, and other required vendor documentation in coordination with applicable departments.
  • Participate in organizational safety initiatives and promote safe work practices across the maintenance department.

Vendors, Procurement, and Capital Projects

  • Develop scopes of work, solicit and evaluate competitive bids, and oversee maintenance vendors and contractors.
  • Manage maintenance-related RFPs, contracts, renewals, amendments, and vendor performance in accordance with organizational procurement requirements.
  • Lead maintenance-driven capital improvement projects from planning through completion, including scope, bidding, scheduling, quality control, and closeout.
  • Partner with Development on major redevelopment, construction, warranty, and property transition matters while representing the operational needs of Property Management and Maintenance.
  • Verify completed vendor work for quality, completeness, and alignment with approved scope before recommending payment.

Budget and Financial Management

  • Collaborate with the Director of Property Management and Vice President of Property Management in developing annual maintenance operating and capital budgets.
  • Monitor maintenance spending against approved budgets, identify variances, and recommend corrective action or reforecasting as needed.
  • Support long-term capital planning by identifying building-system needs, recurring failures, and replacement priorities.
  • Review maintenance-related invoices, purchasing activity, and contract costs for accuracy, appropriateness, and budget alignment.

Policies, Procedures, and Cross-Department Collaboration

  • Assess, develop, maintain, and implement maintenance policies, procedures, standards, checklists, and the Jubilee Housing Maintenance Manual.
  • Ensure maintenance procedures are practical, consistently understood, and applied across the portfolio.
  • Partner closely with Community Managers, the Director of Property Management, and the Vice President of Property Management to resolve resident concerns, coordinate property priorities, and improve service delivery.
  • Maintain effective working relationships with vendors, contractors, community partners, and District agencies as required.
  • Support new property transitions, operational readiness, and systems onboarding.


Desired Qualifications

Experience and Education

  • Seven (7) or more years of progressively responsible experience in multifamily property maintenance, facilities management, affordable housing, construction, or a closely related field.
  • Three (3) to five (5) years of supervisory or management experience with demonstrated success leading maintenance teams and building accountability.
  • Strong hands-on knowledge of HVAC, plumbing, electrical, appliances, carpentry, drywall, painting, and general building systems.
  • Demonstrated experience managing work order systems, preventive maintenance programs, unit turns, inspections, vendors, and contractors.
  • Experience with OneSite/RealPage or a comparable property management platform; ability to configure, improve, and use the system for accountability and reporting is strongly preferred.
  • Experience developing or managing maintenance and capital budgets, procurement processes, contracts, and vendor relationships.
  • Bachelor's or Associate's degree preferred; equivalent combination of education, trade training, certifications, and experience will be considered.

Required Certifications and Licenses

  • EPA Universal Certification required.
  • Valid driver's license with an acceptable driving record and reliable transportation.
  • OSHA 10/30, CAMT, CAMT II, CMM, trade-school, military, or other relevant technical certifications are preferred.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Strong leadership, coaching, performance management, and employee-development skills.
  • Advanced troubleshooting ability and sufficient technical depth to guide staff through difficult or unusual maintenance issues.
  • Strong systems thinking and the ability to translate operational needs into practical workflows, standards, and accountability measures.
  • Ability to prioritize competing maintenance, compliance, resident, staffing, and capital needs across multiple properties.
  • Strong vendor, contract, procurement, and budget management skills.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively with staff, residents, senior leadership, vendors, and external partners.

title: Software Developer - Artificial Intelligence
description:
Oxford Economics, a leading economic forecasting and consulting firm, is looking for an ambitious, passionate Software Engineer with a strong interest in AI to join our Technology team and help us build, ship and scale the next generation of AI-enabled capabilities at Oxford Economics.

Mission (Why this role exists)

AI is changing how research-led businesses like ours work, and we're building the team and the capabilities to stay ahead of it. We're growing our dedicated AI engineering team whose job is to design, build, and ship the next generation of AI-enabled capabilities at Oxford Economics: agents, retrieval pipelines, conversational tools, internal platforms, and client-facing features that people use every day.

This is a hands-on role for an engineer early in their career who writes great software and is genuinely excited about where AI is going. You'll spend your time building alongside the rest of the AI team, turning promising ideas into working software and learning fast as the technology moves. Part of the team's remit is partnering closely with our Content, Data, and Models teams, and over time you'll grow into embedding with them directly to understand their work and find where AI can make a real difference.

You'll work with engineers, economists, product owners, and stakeholders across the business, and we'll back you to develop quickly into a trusted expert in building with AI.
You'll spend most of your time building within the AI team, with the balance of your work shifting as you grow. Day to day you will:

Build
  • Design, build, and ship production software that brings AI capabilities to OE: agents, RAG pipelines, conversational interfaces, internal tools, and other client-facing features.
  • Take ideas from prototype to production, contributing across the software lifecycle: discovery, design, coding, testing, CI/CD, observability, cost monitoring, and safe rollout.
  • Help build and operate the services, agents, MCPs, shared libraries, Claude skills, and evaluation harnesses that make up OE's AI platform.
  • Apply solid engineering fundamentals: clean code, testing, modularity, performance, security. Because quality and reliability matter as much in AI systems as anywhere else.
Collaborate & partner
  • Work with product owners and the rest of the team to turn business needs into tangible, well-scoped deliverables, adapting as those needs evolve.
  • Partner with our Content, Data and Models teams to understand what they need, growing into embedding alongside them directly as you build context and credibility.
  • Build with safety and responsible use in mind. Sensible data handling, prompt-injection defences, and alignment with ISO 27001 controls and OE's AI Acceptable Use Policy.
Learn & share
  • Experiment with new models, frameworks, and techniques, and help the team form an evidence-based view of what's hype and what's worth betting on.
  • Share what you learn: patterns, write-ups, brown-bag sessions; helping colleagues across OE raise their own AI fluency as you grow into it.
We care more about trajectory than a tick-box list. For the AI-specific parts especially, real curiosity and hands-on tinkering count for as much as years of experience. If you've explored these things, have views on them and want to go deeper, that's what we're looking for.

Core engineering
  • Around 2+ years of professional experience shipping production software in a modern cloud environment.
  • Solid engineering fundamentals: testing, version control, code review, modular design, and a developing sense of when to be pragmatic versus principled.
  • Proficiency in C# and experience with TypeScript, comfortable working from APIs through to lightweight user interfaces.
  • Some hands-on experience with cloud services (e.g. Azure) and modern delivery practices such as CI/CD.
Building with AI
  • You've built things with LLMs, even side projects or prototypes, and understand concepts like prompting, tool calling, embeddings, and RAG.
  • You've integrated a model API (e.g. OpenAI) and have at least a working feel for cost, latency, context windows, and rate limits.
  • An awareness of how building and evaluating LLM systems differs from traditional software, and an interest in getting good at it.
  • Familiarity with, or genuine curiosity about, vector databases, embeddings, and retrieval techniques such as semantic and hybrid search.
How you work
  • Genuine curiosity and a tinkerer's instinct. You build with AI because you find it interesting, not just because it's the job.
  • A bias for shipping: you'd rather get something working in front of people than polish it indefinitely.
  • Valuing good engineering practices: fast feedback, testing, and simple design; and wanting to get better at them. You might already follow the people who champion XP-style ways of working; if you don't have deep experience with them yet, the enthusiasm to learn matters more.
  • You pick things up fast across unfamiliar domains and can build enough understanding of someone else's problem to be useful.
  • You communicate clearly and can explain trade-offs to engineers and non-engineers alike.
Bonus points
  • Experience using agentic coding tools (e.g. Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex) to ship real software.
  • Hands-on time with MCP, agent frameworks (e.g. Microsoft Agent Framework, LangChain) or your own orchestration.
  • Experience with content, publishing, or knowledge-management workflows (CMS integrations, editorial tooling, document processing).
  • Exposure to modern data platforms (e.g. Snowflake, ClickHouse, Databricks, BigQuery) or working with data engineering teams.
  • A background or coursework in machine learning, NLP, or data science.
  • Open-source contributions, side projects, or writing that show you build for the love of it.
  • An interest in economics, forecasting, financial services, or research-led businesses.
  • A degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or equivalent practical experience.
What success looks like
We don't expect you to arrive doing all of this. Here's the trajectory we'd hope to see:

In your first 3 months
  • You're set up and contributing. Your first pieces of AI-enabled software have shipped and are in proper use, with support from the team.
  • You understand how OE's AI platform fits together and where your work sits within it.
By 6 months
  • You're shipping regularly and driving features forward. Taking the lead in pairing and mobbing sessions, increasingly steering ideas rather than waiting for direction.
  • You're a dependable contributor to the team's core work and are starting to support other teams with AI.
By 12 months
  • You're putting AI to work in product discovery, building rapid prototypes that test ideas quickly and spark new ones.
  • Working software you've built is landing regularly and being used across OE and by our clients, with a short, safe path from prototype to production.
  • You've embedded with a team to understand their work and find where AI genuinely helps them, and people come to you for an honest, well-informed answer to "should we do this with AI?"
Key working relationships

Internal: The AI team, Software Engineers, Product Owners, Economists / Consulting and Content teams, IT Operations, Business Development / Marketing.

External: Frontier model providers (OpenAI, Anthropic), cloud providers (Azure), AI tooling and SaaS vendors.
Here are some of the benefits we offer in the UK to ensure you feel valued, supported, and thrive at work:

- Private Healthcare
- Employee Assistance Program
- Enhanced Maternity and Paternity Leave
- Workplace Nursery Scheme
- Cycle to Work Scheme

Your closest partners are the National Account Managers and their associated accounts. Your work will support and complement their seasonal strategies within a narrow set of accounts and categories. You will support sell–in, whilst taking a lead on analyzing sell-through and maximizing in-season business. Your work will contribute to the development of 3-year account planning; further driving the brand’s excellence in North American wholesale.

This is a remote role, based in New York City or within a reasonable commute to New York City. Frequent market travel is required, to key US epicenters.

We meet the guest where they are shopping, and ensure Arc’teryx is represented in an authentic, consistent way. As the retail landscape changes, we will work together to evolve our approach with creativity and teamwork.

title: Senior Specialist, CSO Packaging and Labelling
description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.



As a Senior Specialist, CSO Packaging and Labelling, you’ll support the production of clinical trial labels and finished clinical supplies, contributing to projects using both internal BMS resources and external supplier partners. You’ll report into the CSO Project Management Lead (Moreton), and you’ll have the chance to learn the fundamentals of clinical supply packaging and labelling while contributing to a fast-moving team.


Key Requirements

  • Support the delivery of clinical supplies by assisting with assigned clinical projects — liaising with Trial Supply Managers (TSMs) on packaging and labelling design, production scheduling, SAP demand entry, and SAP material creation.
  • Support multiple projects at once — helping track deliverables (product, code, and label text) against production schedules and flagging issues as they arise.
  • Assist in generating internal packaging, labelling, and label print production orders in line with clinical trial design and regulatory requirements, including supporting the creation of BOMs and process orders within SAP.
  • Collaborate with CSO, Analytical, and Quality colleagues to support on-time testing and release of assigned projects.
  • Support supplier coordination activities, helping track compliance with Master Service, Technical, and Quality Agreements.
  • Help prepare project specifications and supporting purchasing documentation, including purchase justification memos and purchase orders, following company policy.
  • Assist with reviewing production order schedules and contribute data used for Master Production Plan (MPP) compliance tracking.
  • Support the review of vendor- and in-house-generated production orders and related documentation.
  • Help compile supporting documentation and batch records that underpin the release of finished clinical supplies, liaising with Quality Assurance as directed.
  • Contribute ideas for improving business processes and take part in continuous improvement initiatives as part of the wider team.
  • Participate in assigned training, including cGMP training, to build your knowledge and capability over time.

Required / Desired Experience

  • Experience within pharmaceutical clinical supply packaging and labelling, with a proven ability to manage complex activities, coordinate cross-functional stakeholders, and ensure delivery within a regulated environment.
  • Proven ability to coordinate multiple priorities and stakeholders in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong organisational skills, attention to detail, and a commitment to quality.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence to work across functions.
  • Proactive, solutions-focused, and able to identify and escalate issues effectively.
  • Understanding of regulatory and cGMP principles, or experience working within a regulated environment.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, with the ability to quickly learn new systems and tools.
  • Strong collaboration and stakeholder management skills, with a track record of delivering through cross-functional teams.
  • Continuous improvement mindset, with a focus on driving efficiency and enhancing ways of working

Responsibilities:

The Medical Coder III functions as an advanced coder in the abstraction and in-depth analysis of a variety of medical documentation and assigns appropriate procedural terminology and medical codes in accordance with applicable coding rules and policies (e.g. ICD-10, CPT-4, HCPCS, DRG). Analyzes, enters and manipulates database. Responds to or clarifies internal requests for medical information.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

  • Uses thorough knowledge of coding systems and system logic to review codes created by electronic charge capture and/or assign codes (ICD-10-CM, E/M, CPT, HCPCS and modifiers) through medical record documentation in accordance with universally recognized coding guidelines.
  • Reviews and resolves coding denials. Resolves problems with claims having errors related to improper coding and provides feedback for correction and follow-up.
  • Abstracts data and reviews codes for accuracy. Performs system edit checks and corrects errors as needed.
  • Responds to coding information requests from various sources. Communicates document improvement opportunities and coding issues to providers, department, and/or designated leader for follow up and resolution.
  • Consults with internal customers and external vendors to obtain greater specificity and/or clarification when documentation appears inconsistent or incomplete.
  • Other duties as assigned

MINIMUM EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE

  • High School diploma or equivalent and 2 years of experience as a medical coder required
  • Associate's degree in Health Information Technology or health related field preferred
  • Additional coding experience in area of assignment preferred
  • Or equivalent combination of education and experience

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES

  • Knowledge of ICD-10CM, CPT and HCPSC required
  • Working knowledge of medical terminology and anatomy required

LICENSES AND CERTIFICATIONS

  • American Health Information Management Association (AHIMA) accreditation examination for Registered Health Information Administrator (RHIA) or (Registered Health Information Technician) RHIT or Certified Coding Specialist (CCS) preferred or
  • Certified Professional Coder (CPC) from American Academy of Professional Coders (AAPC) or Certified Medical Coder (CMC) from Practice Management Institute preferred

title: Senior Associate, Product Management, Card Data
description:
Senior Associate, Product Management, Card Data

Product Management

Product Management at Capital One is a booming, vibrant craft that requires reimagining the status quo, finding value creation opportunities, and driving innovative and sustainable customer experiences through technology.


We believe our portfolio of businesses and investments in growth and transformation will result in a company with the scale, brand, capabilities, talent, and values to succeed as the digital revolution transforms our society and our industry.


Do you dream of well-designed and intuitive products and customer experiences? Do you want to be the one who introduces change to help tens of millions of customers make smarter financial choices? Do you want to change the way people manage their money? If you answered yes to all of these questions, then product management at Capital One may be a fit for you

In this role, you’ll learn the essentials of being a product manager, and we’ll invest in you to grow in four key areas:

  • Human Centered
    • You’ll collaborate with tech teams to build comprehensive acceptance criteria, identifying and elevating any need for additional research to define future feature design
    • You'll breakdown business epics into features and further into user stories, driving your team towards lowest effort or Minimal Viable Product (MVP) for a valid feature test

  • Business Focused
    • Demonstrating a growth mindset, you’ll effectively use hypothesis-driven assessment of data to ensure your product or feature delivers on real business needs
    • You’ll own and prioritize feature development roadmaps, ensuring all necessary processes and procedures are followed to manage risk

  • Technology Driven
    • You’ll work autonomously in an agile environment, to conduct research and develop features that utilize new and evolving technology
    • You’ll collaborate with designers, technologists, data scientists and subject-matter experts to build cutting edge solutions to help customers
    • You’ll deliver well-managed product platforms for customers by seeking to understand technology trends and architecture strategy

  • Transformational Leadership
    • By actively participating in horizontal forums, you’ll harness a network of trusted relationships among tech teams, designers, key internal stakeholders and partner teams
    • You’ll articulate a succinct product roadmap to deliver business value and share with with stakeholders, elevating your team’s results and becoming a product matter expert

We want you if you are:

  • Intellectually Curious. You ask why, you explore, you're not afraid to blurt out your crazy idea or follow an email chain for weeks to find someone with an answer. Comfortable with ambiguity, a hunger to learn and a seeker of new challenges
  • Communicator & Influencer. You can communicate complex ideas clearly regardless of your audience. Our team knows their priorities and why they’re doing what they’re doing. You always can rally associates to work with you
  • Do-er. You’re biased toward action, you try things and sometimes you fail. You can get around roadblocks and stay focused on your goals. You’re well organized, able to multitask and able to prioritize your work
  • Passionate & Customer Focus. You care about growing others and bringing them together around what’s possible. You get a thrill from the journey of building and shipping products, and you have a desire and ability to connect with our external or internal customers to fully understand their needs
  • Learner. You have an appetite to learn new things or new technologies all while exhibiting humbleness when the time comes to ask for help
  • Team Player. You enjoy working with diverse people and driving the team toward a common goal. You have the ability to put the team before yourself and establish long-lasting relationships

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or military experience
  • At least 1 year of product management experience or at least 1 year of experience in product design, agile delivery, business analysis, data science, or software engineering

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or engineering
  • 1+ years translating business strategy or analysis into consumer facing digital products

  • 1+ years working with cross functional teams as a product owner in an agile development process

title: Data Engineer Intern
description:
About Hytech Hytech is a leading management consulting firm headquartered in Australia and Singapore, specialising in digital transformation for fintech and financial services organisations. We deliver end-to-end consulting services and provide robust middle- and back-office solutions that enable our clients to optimise operations, enhance efficiency, and stay ahead in a fast-evolving digital landscape. Our client portfolio includes top global trading platforms and leading crypto exchanges.

With more than 2,000 professionals worldwide, Hytech has a strong and growing international presence, with offices across Australia, Singapore, Malaysia, Taiwan, the Philippines, Thailand, Morocco, Cyprus, Dubai, and beyond.

About the Role We are looking for a motivated Data Engineering Intern to join our Data Platform team. In this role, you will help build automated data products end to end - from data ingestion and processing pipelines to calculation modules and internal platform features. You will work closely with engineers and business stakeholders across the group, turning business logic into reliable, production-grade data solutions.

Key Responsibilities Assist in integrating data from multiple business and transactional sources into the data platform. Develop and maintain data extraction, cleansing and aggregation pipelines. Implement business calculation logic on existing frameworks and maintain rule configurations. Perform data validation and reconciliation; trace, document and explain the root cause of discrepancies. Support the development and testing of internal platform features. Leverage the team's AI tooling to improve development and validation efficiency, and document reusable practices for the team. Write and maintain technical documentation covering pipelines, configurations and validation procedures. Collaborate with engineers and business teams to clarify requirements and verify output correctness. Participate in code reviews and follow team development standards. Support ad-hoc data requests and investigations from business teams.

Requirements Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Engineering or a related field. Proficiency in Python, with the ability to independently implement data processing and business logic. Strong SQL skills, comfortable writing multi-table joins and aggregation queries. Meticulous and detail-oriented, with the patience to trace data discrepancies to their source. Basic understanding of data modelling and ETL concepts. Working understanding of AI tools, with the ability to apply them effectively in development, data work and documentation, and willingness to share learnings with the team. Proficiency in English and Mandarin is required to communicate with Mandarin-speaking business stakeholders and clarify data requirements for relevant markets. Available to work full-time for a continuous 4-6 months. Exposure to Databricks, Spark or similar data platforms is a plus. Front-end development experience is an advantage. Prior internship or project experience with data products or business systems is preferred. Self-motivated, eager to learn, and able to work collaboratively in a team environment.

What You'll Gain Hands-on experience building production data products end to end, from ingestion through to delivery. Exposure to group-level data platform architecture and configuration-driven development practices. Practical experience applying AI tooling in a real engineering context (accounts and support provided by the team). Opportunity to work closely with experienced data engineers and business stakeholders. Practical experience in data validation, reconciliation and production-scale quality assurance.

title: 2027 Summer Intern PhD Student - Drug Product Development Material Characterization
description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.



Drug Product Development works with colleagues throughout the entire pharmaceutical development process, from discovery to commercial launch and beyond, to develop formulations and processes that support drug products at both clinical and commercial stages. We are looking for candidates who are proven team players; appreciate the challenge of pursuing unique scientific discovery in an emerging field; and who demonstrate solid operational, interpersonal, project management and collaborative skills. We believe this starts with our summer intern program.

Summer interns will work with mentors for ~10 weeks on a guided research project focused on exploring the feasibility of material characterization techniques, including vibrational spectroscopy (Raman, NIR, IR), X-ray diffraction, and imaging tools. Interns will develop methods for product characterization, troubleshoot and resolve issues related to characterization methodologies, and collaborate with multi-disciplinary teams, including formulation scientists, analytical chemists, process engineers, and process modelers, to enable drug product formulation development and manufacturing processes. The program is organized to ensure that interns gain valuable industry and functional experience, work on challenging assignments, learn about BMS and meet diverse company representatives.

The program will feature:

  • An orientation, including an overview of company structure, products and brands
  • An introduction to the GPS and PD organizations

  • Hands-on training and working experiences in pharmaceutical manufacturing process areas and testing laboratories

Identity & secrets:

Observability & IR:

  • Establish Azure Monitor / Log Analytics baselines, tracing, SLOs, and actionable alerts; integrate with Microsoft Sentinel; lead incident response and postmortems.

Cloud security posture:

  • Drive Defender for Cloud coverage, vulnerability management (containers, hosts, code), and automated remediation.

Networking & data protection:

  • Hub-and-spoke or vWAN, Private Link/Endpoints, Private DNS, Firewall/NAT Gateway egress control; encryption at rest & in transit, KMS integrations.

Resilience & DR:

  • Backups (RSV/Velero), multi-region patterns, chaos exercises, capacity planning; codify DR runbooks and perform tests.

FinOps & compliance:

  • Implement tagging/budgets, right-sizing, Reservations/Savings Plans; map controls to CIS/NIST/ISO and produce audit evidence from pipelines.

Coaching & enablement:

  • Pair with product teams, review designs/PRs, write reference modules/templates, and uplift platform literacy across the org.

Security Hardening:

  • Enable hardening for respective components, including but not limited to OS hardening, Application Hardening, Azure Services hardening.

Qualifications

  • 7+ years in DevOps/SRE/Platform Engineering with 3+ years on Azure and 2+ years operating Kubernetes in production.
  • Proven delivery of Azure Landing Zones or equivalent enterprise Azure foundations, expressed asTerraform or Bicep modules.
  • Strong with GitHub Actions/Azure DevOps, artifacts, environments, approvals, reusable workflows.
  • Hands-on with container runtime security & policy: OPA/Gatekeeper or Kyverno, Pod Security restricted, read-only root FS, capability drops, seccomp/AppArmor.
  • Network security in K8s: NetworkPolicy default-deny, ingress controllers (Nginx/AGIC), egress control, TLS everywhere, mTLS preferred.
  • Image lifecycle: private registries (ACR), pull-through caches, cosign signing & admission verification, Nessus scanning.
  • Observability: Azure Monitor/Logs, DCRs, dashboards, SLOs, alert routing to ITSM; experience integrating with Sentinel or enterprise SIEM.
  • Infra & config as code at scale; linting/testing/policy gates; change automation and drift detection (GitOps).
  • Solid Linux fundamentals, networking, PKI, and incident response.

Additional Information

We are driven by our AEIOU beliefs—Adventure, Excellence, Integrity, Ownership, and Unity—and we seek individuals who embody these values in both their professional and personal lives. We are committed to our Impact: Valuing our clients, Growing our people, and Creating our future.

title: Solutions Architect
description:
TL;DR Kharon is seeking a full-time New York City-based Solutions Architect. This role requires in-office attendance at least 3 days a week.

Kharon's sanctions and risk intelligence helps businesses screen out bad actors. That only matters if it lands inside the systems where decisions get made. You'll be our first Solutions Architect, part integration architect and part investigative builder, designing imaginative ways to embed Kharon's data into clients' screening tools, onboarding flows, and homegrown applications. You'll draw on the whole tool chest, from established playbooks and runbooks to AI-powered prototypes, and take clients from "we should do this" to "we did it."
  • Implementations from design to go-live. You'll own client integrations across flat file, API, and MCP, from the first solution design session to launch, working alongside our technical account managers.
  • Technical discovery with Sales. You'll be the technical voice in early client conversations, turning a messy workflow into a clear scope and a Solution Design Document people still reference a year later.
  • Proofs of concept that move decisions. You'll scope and build POCs, using tools like Claude Code when they help, so clients can see exactly how Kharon will work in their environment.
  • Integrations that stay healthy. After launch, you'll own technical support and troubleshooting so live clients keep running smoothly.
  • The client's voice in the product. You'll bring what you learn in discovery and delivery back to Product in a form that shapes what we build next.
  • RFPs and security reviews. You'll draft the technical, solution design, and security sections of RFPs and client security questionnaires.
  • You've sat with B2B clients, run technical discovery, and designed the integration that came out of it.
  • You build working things yourself: scripts, API calls, data checks, prototypes. AI coding tools are welcome; you know how to check their work.
  • You understand REST APIs (auth, pagination, error handling), flat file or batch exchange (SFTP, schemas, validation), and MCP, and you've worked hands-on with MCP servers or tools. You can explain when each pattern fits. You use SQL to sanity-check data and work in a scripting language, ideally Python.
  • You write technical documents people rely on after the meeting ends.
  • You've owned delivery on at least some engagements, keeping timelines and stakeholders on track.

About the team

The Implementations team is new, and you'll be the first Solutions Architect on it. You'll work closely with our Director of Implementations, technical account managers, Sales, Customer Success, and Product. That means you'll help write the playbook, not just follow it, and your work will shape how the team operates as it grows in 2027. We're still building process, so you'll need to be comfortable making good calls where there isn't a precedent yet.


Kharon is a highly disruptive and incredibly innovative organization that navigates risk at the intersection of global security threats + international commerce.
What does that mean? Great question.

Operating at the nexus of global security, Kharon is on a mission to revolutionize the current landscape. We take really complex data as it relates to global security and empower our clients to not only understand the risk associated with their potential business relationships but to operationalize that data so that they can make the best and most informed decisions possible. From financial crimes and sanctions to export controls and threat identifications, our tools optimize protection against the types of risks that could otherwise be incredibly dangerous and excessively costly to any business. Serving many of today’s leading global financial and multinational institutions, Kharon products are the most powerful in the space with a precision and depth that is absolutely unparalleled.

When you look at any major global crisis event, we’re providing intelligence that’s at the heart of those circumstances. We connect the dots in a way that’s meaningful. Now, we’re experiencing unprecedented growth. As the world continues to evolve in complexity, so too does the demand for our products. Given the significance of our work and the increasing global reliance on our insights, we are looking for a Solutions Architect to join us as we work to shape the way businesses perceive and navigate global risks.

To the right person, this will be the perfect kind of challenge. Our mission is compelling, our product is powerful, and we’re growing at a rate that makes us unstoppable. If you’re looking to be surrounded by people who will inspire you to think and challenge you to grow then look no further. Our team is made up of some of the most visionary and uncompromising individuals you will ever encounter. We don’t take ourselves seriously but we’re serious about the work we do and there is absolutely no slowing us down.

To keep that momentum going, we do our very best to make sure that each and every team member is completely taken care of. We’re nothing without our people and we strive to offer a package that reflects that. As a Kharon team member, you can expect:
  • Fully sponsored medical, dental, and vision insurances
  • FSA program for both medical and dependent care
  • Long term disability
  • 401k + Roth with matching and immediate vesting
  • Flexible paid time off + 11 paid holidays

The base salary range at Kharon is set between $130,000 to $160,000. Please note that this figure does not necessarily include potential bonuses, commissions, benefits, or equity that may be part of the overall compensation package.

If interested in pursuing this position, please visit to apply.

title: Global Trial Acceleration Associate
description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.


Key Responsibilities

  • The Global Trial Acceleration Associate is responsible for managing and executing on centralized activities in support of global trials with an emphasis on clinical documentation.
  • The Global Trial Acceleration Associate will interact with clinical study sites, CROs/vendors, Country Trial Managers (CTM)/Clinical Trial Monitor (CTMo.), the study team and other functional areas within BMS and will provide support to the Study Team throughout the study duration (start-up, maintenance, and close-out of clinical studies).
  • As the main point of contact for essential document management, ethical and regulatory submission-related activities, develops and maintains collaborative working relationships with relevant stakeholders.
  • Support outsourcing activities by interfacing with operational teams, support groups and service providers for successful selection, contracting and execution of outsourced studies while ensuring compliance with regulatory standards, ethical practices, BMS outsourcing and procurement policies and procedures.
  • Initiate and manage start-up documentation activities for global clinical trials.
  • Submission of potential investigators to CTSS for debarment review and tracking of decisions.
  • Responsible for country/Site Activation for clinical trials as applicable per region; this includes the final review of applicable documents, final sign-off of the country/site activation checklist. The incumbent may also be responsible for activating the site in accordance with all applicable global / local study procedures.
  • May provide a level of quality control of start-up activity.
  • Update and review of various study-related clinical systems to determine and report status of clinical trial documents for insourced studies (i.e., CTMS, eTMF, etc. or corresponding vendor systems)
  • May arrange certified translation of study level documentation from translators as requested (i.e., ICF, Protocol, IB)
  • May assist with the coordination or creation of other study specific materials such as pharmacy or Investigator site file to ensure that these are available on site for site initiation visits/prior to first patient visit.
  • May act as single point of contact for the study team for centralized activities during study start-up.
  • Ongoing maintenance and tracking of essential documentation and collection of updated/outstanding documentation and submission as required during all phases of clinical trial.
  • Ongoing communication with study teams regarding centralized study activities.
  • Maybe responsible for creation and management of standardized document templates.

  • Country and site level ICF adaptation.

  • Prior therapeutic area expertise (eg: Oncology, Cardiology, Hematology, Immunology etc) is preferred.

  • Hands-on experience preparing, reviewing, and submitting regulatory documentation to IRB/IECs and Regulatory Agencies; including formulating responses to queries.
  • Hands-on experience of preparing, reviewing, and submitting clinical study start-up / activation documentation, including responses to queries.
  • Knowledge of ICH / GCP and regulatory guidelines/directives, understanding of drug development process and Pharma, Strong organizational, time-management, analytical and decision-making skills to efficiently evaluate, plan and accomplish work goals.
  • Effective communication skills in English (written & oral), computer skills - MS office suite, SharePoint, etc. CTMS (Veeva Vault experience preferred, knowledge of portals, databases and other Clinical Trial enabling technologies
  • Proven experience in managing key internal and external stakeholders effectively by frequently soliciting input and gathering and incorporating feedback into processes as appropriate.
  • Effective management or support of cross-functional, multi-cultural teams and demonstrated ability to work and influence within a matrix structure.
  • Proven time management skills and ability to be flexible to meet job demands, manage multiple priorities, and take on new initiatives and improvement efforts.
  • Demonstrates a high level of adaptability in dealing with ambiguous and complex work environment and balances multiple demands on role in a responsive and professional manner.

title: Director- Solution Testing, Americas (Watertown, WI/Carrollton, TX)
description:
The Director- Solution Testing, Americas is responsible for leading the testing, validation, and certification of hardware, software, firmware, digital products, and third-party integrations for the North American market. This role serves as the critical link between global product development and North American deployment, ensuring all standard and non-standard solutions are thoroughly tested, verified, and approved prior to release. The Director partners closely with Product Management, Engineering, Sales, and global product teams to establish testing priorities, manage release readiness, drive quality standards, and prevent unvalidated solutions from reaching customers. Additionally, the role oversees testing processes, release communications, solution certification, and the delivery of North American business requirements to global development teams, ensuring product quality, operational excellence, and customer satisfaction.
  • Define and execute the NAST strategy, roadmap, priorities, and quality standards in alignment with business objectives and global release plans.


  • Lead and develop the NAST team through workforce planning, performance management, coaching, succession planning, and resource allocation.

  • Coordinate testing activities, associated costs, and North American release readiness for hardware, software, firmware, digital products, third-party interfaces, fixes, and enhancements.


  • Partner with Product Management, Sales, Engineering, Service, and global product teams to scope, prioritize, and govern North American solution requests.


  • Establish and improve testing governance, automation, environments, acceptance criteria, certification standards, documentation, and reporting across all validation types.


  • Serve as the final North American release authority by assessing quality, compliance, readiness, and risk, and approving, conditionally approving, or withholding release.


  • Define and report KPIs for test coverage, defect leakage, cycle time, release readiness, corrective actions, and post-release quality; escalate material risks and trends.


  • Manage budgets, laboratory capacity, vendors, tools, equipment, and assets supporting testing, demonstrations, proofs of concept, events, integrations, and partner or customer laboratories.


  • Ensure pilot, deployment, and support readiness through release communication, documentation, training, known-issue management, support handoff, rollback planning, and post-release monitoring.


  • Lead development requests and critical defect escalations with global product teams, establishing ownership and driving timely cross-functional resolution.


Education:
· Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Quality Management, Business, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.

Required Experience:

· 10+ years of progressive experience in solution testing, quality assurance, systems integration, engineering, or a related technical function.


· 5+ years leading technical teams, including people management, coaching, performance management, resource planning, and organizational development.


· Demonstrated leadership of testing strategy, release governance, acceptance criteria, certification, quality metrics, and continuous improvement.


· Experience managing budgets, vendors, laboratory capacity, tools, equipment, and resources across competing business priorities.


· Experience leading global, cross-functional initiatives involving integrated hardware, software, firmware, digital products, third-party interfaces, pilots, and production releases.


Preferred Qualifications:
· Master’s degree in a related technical, business, or quality discipline.
· Relevant certification in quality, testing, project management, Agile, Lean, or Six Sigma.
· Experience with test automation, test management, defect tracking, analytics, and continuous integration or delivery practices.
· Knowledge of cybersecurity, regulatory, safety, accessibility, audit, and quality standards for integrated solutions.
· Experience in retail, financial services, cash automation, payments, self-service, or other customer-facing technology environments.

REQUIRED SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES

· Strategic leadership and judgment that translate business objectives into priorities, decisions, and measurable outcomes.


· People leadership that builds accountability, collaboration, employee development, succession readiness, and high-performing teams.


· Decisive risk management, including evaluation of incomplete information, competing priorities, and corrective actions.

title: Senior Test Centre Associate - Newcastle
description:
Reed in Partnership has been delivering public services since 1998. We are a British, family-owned company, whose mission has always been to positively transform people and their communities. This is reflected in our services, which we deliver to help people from all backgrounds and circumstances to change their lives for the better.

Pay Range

£14.80 p/hr

Job Description

Do you possess great leadership skills and a passion for providing excellent customer service?

Would you like a role where you can meet and help new people everyday?

Then consider the position of Senior Test Centre Associate - Newcastle at Reed in Partnership!

Our DVSA (Driver and Vehicle Standards Agency) programme, provides secure assessment of prospective new drivers for the Department of Transport. Through more than 70 test centres, we provide 1.7 million + Driving Theory Tests a year across several regions of the UK.

Our delivery provides the infrastructure and processes required to test each candidates driving theory knowledge and hazard perception. We ensure the integrity and compliance of each individual test in accordance with the assessment standards set by the DVSA.

What is the role about?

You will be responsible for the invigilation of exams and the efficient delivery of tests to participants, ensuring that relevant procedures and guidelines are adhered to at all times. These responsibilities will be delivered both directly through your invigilation duties and via your management, during your shift, of the Test Centre. The Senior Test Centre Associate (STCA) will strictly adhere to the guidelines in accordance with the programme’s requirements and Reed in Partnership’s policies and procedures.

Your day-to-day responsibilities will include:


  • Checking candidates ID documents and booking them in on the system
  • Supervision and invigilation of tests
  • Delivery of site opening and/or closing procedures
  • Coaching and supporting Test Centre Associates
  • Review of test centre schedule to identify the number of candidates booked in and organising how any non-standard accommodations will be delivered.
  • Notifying the DVSA HR team of employee absences to allow alternative cover to be arranged
  • Providing management support to the Test Centre Manager as required
  • Handling and reporting incidents that could impact candidate testing in line with our incident management procedures.

Your Work Schedule

Our Senior Test Centre Associate roles offer a flexible working pattern (either part-time or occasional shifts) with the potential for additional hours to suit you.

Shifts could range from:


  • Mornings - 8.00am to 1pm/2pm
  • Afternoons - 12.30pm/1pm to 5.30pm/6.30pm
  • Full day - 8.00am to 5.30pm/6.30pm
  • Evenings - 4.30pm/5pm to 8.30pm/9.30pm
  • Afternoon & Evenings – 12pm/1pm to 8.30pm/9.30pm

The Newcastle Theory Test Centre usually opens six days per week, subject to demand. Main operating days are usually Monday through to Saturday. The ideal candidate will be fully flexible to pick up shifts across all evenings and Saturdays and to cover shifts as a TCA when required.

What’s in it for you?

The roles offer long term employment stability and the satisfaction of assisting people at a key moment in their lives.

To be successful in this role, we are looking for someone with:

  • Experience of leading or supervising a team
  • Applicants must hold a full UK driving licence due to the nature of the role (although driving will not be required for all locations)
  • Significant demonstrable experience in providing high-quality customer service.
  • Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Flexible in working hours and days, including evenings and Saturday.

Desirable Skills:


  • Able to remain calm and deal with confrontational candidates in a professional manner.
  • Excellent judgment and decision-making skills.
  • Experience in working with diverse customer groups.
  • Ability to work under pressure to short timescales and multi-tasking to complete a variety of competing activities.

Please note the closing date for internal applications is 13th October 2026

title: Solution Architect
description:
Your role & work environment

We are looking a Solution Architect with experience or a broad interest in the area of Know Your Customer (KYC). The focus of your architecture activities will be to establish resilient solution architectures for business and IT problems in line with the ING Belgium and Group strategy.

A day in the life of an IT Solution Architect

  • You are working in cooperation with IT and Business stakeholders recognizing the correlation / dependencies between their activities.
  • You create your designs in close collaboration with the engineers and Domain Architects, guiding them to the deployment of the design.
  • You drive to make complex changes or projects happen within and across Tribes. Your holistic view as well as your knowledge of both Business and IT are crucial in the translation of business requirements in a sequence that delivers customer value as early as possible.
  • You define and align the roadmaps between squads – from same or different Tribes – and other parts of the organization and thoroughly manage dependencies.
  • You are the connecting pin between colleagues having different expertise in self-steering teams (squads). Your colleagues will be IT Integrators, IT Solution Architects, Engineers, Domain Architects, Product Owners or Squad Masters, Developers, Customer Journey Experts, etc.
  • You are a driver of the solution approach (together with squads) using in-depth knowledge of Business and IT such as architecture, application landscapes, infrastructure, business operations and legislation.

How to succeed

We hire smart people like you for your potential. Our biggest expectation is that you’ll stay curious. Keep learning. Take on responsibility. In return, we’ll back you to develop into an even more awesome version of yourself.

As a Solution Architect, you will also need:

  • At least 3 to 5 years of relevant professional experience in solution architecture, software engineering, or IT delivery.
  • Affinity with architectural practices, solution design, and translating business requirements into sustainable technology solutions.
  • TOGAF, ArchiMate, and/or Public Cloud certifications are considered a plus.
  • Broad interest in banking technology, with knowledge of domains such Know Your Customer (KYC) being an asset.
  • Proficient in English (ING's corporate language) and Dutch or French.
  • Strong behavioural competencies: collaboration, communication, stakeholder management, innovation, and the ability to navigate complexity and drive pragmatic decision-making.
  • Strong technical competencies with attention to architecture principles, data, privacy, security, scalability, performance, resilience, cost and ethics. Able to work autonomously and act as a trusted advisor and sparring partner for engineers, product teams, and fellow architects.
  • Ability to design end-to-end solutions, balance functional and non-functional requirements, and document architectural decisions in a clear and structured manner.

As a Solution Architect, you will have the opportunity to:

  • Contribute actively in INGs strategic goals and objectives on a daily basis.
  • Work with likeminded colleagues from who you will learn a lot of their experience.
  • Have the opportunity to further increase your knowledge by attending both internal or external training opportunities.
  • Demonstrate your value and grow within the organisation.
  • Have the ability to work on a mix of change/project initiatives.

The team

You will be in a team of IT Solution Architects and Domain Architects. They are part of COE Architecture BE working together with numerous stakeholders being at the heart of the delivery of Features with the Tribes.

We are the go to team driving and bringing speed in the different changes & projects.

Would you like to get to know the department better? Book a coffee with the hiring manager, a team member, or the recruiter. In a second phase you could get to know the job content better via a My Job Your Job.

title: Senior Specialist, MES Platform Engineer
description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.


Position Summary


As part of the Digital Plant department Manufacturing IT Systems & MES for the Leiden Cell Therapy Facility (CTF), the Senior Specialist, MES Platform Engineer is responsible for the administration, maintenance, configuration, and continuous improvement of the Syncade MES (Manufacturing Execution System) environment. The role combines technical system administration responsibilities with recipe authoring expertise to ensure reliable MES operations, GMP compliance, optimal system performance, and efficient execution of manufacturing processes.

The position serves as a key bridge between manufacturing operations, quality, validation, and IT teams by supporting MES infrastructure, user administration, master data management, recipe development, system enhancements, and business process improvements.


Duties / Responsibilities


MES System Administration & Maintenance

  • Manage and maintain the MES application environment, including integrations and peripheral devices such as scanners and label printers.
  • Monitor MES application health, availability, performance, and underlying hardware components.
  • Support installation, configuration, upgrades, patches, and lifecycle management activities.
  • Perform routine system reviews and execute corrective and preventive measures to maintain system reliability.
  • Collaborate with Shared Services and infrastructure teams to define and manage application versus infrastructure responsibilities.

Recipe Design & Configuration

  • Design, configure, document, and maintain Master Recipes using standardized corporate objects and approved building blocks.
  • Analyse business requirements and translate operational processes into MES solutions.
  • Maintain and enhance existing recipes while ensuring consistency, usability, and compliance.
  • Evaluate and implement new objects, templates, and configuration components supporting recipe development and manufacturing improvements.

Master Data & User Administration

  • Execute master data management activities to ensure data integrity and consistency within MES.
  • Manage MES user access in compliance with approved procedures and regulatory requirements.
  • Support periodic access reviews and maintain appropriate segregation of duties.
  • Configure and maintain MES system settings supporting manufacturing operations.

Reporting, Labels & Configuration Management

  • Create and maintain MES reports, labels, label formats, and related configuration designs.
  • Support manufacturing operations through effective reporting and labelling solutions.
  • Maintain documentation and traceability related to MES configuration changes.

Testing, Validation & Compliance

  • Develop and execute testing activities supporting new recipes, system changes, and MES enhancements.
  • Support creation of User Acceptance Test (UAT) scripts and validation deliverables.
  • Participate in dry runs, qualification activities, and validation reviews.
  • Ensure MES solutions remain compliant with GMP, GxP, Data Integrity, and Computer System Validation requirements.
  • Support risk assessments, impact assessments, and change control activities.

System Upgrades & Continuous Improvement

  • Support MES upgrade projects, platform enhancements, and technology lifecycle initiatives.
  • Identify opportunities to optimize MES processes, improve user experience, and increase manufacturing efficiency.
  • Partner with local and global MES teams to implement best practices and standardized solutions.
  • Contribute to the long-term MES roadmap and system sustainability initiatives.

Incident & Operational Support

  • Provide second-line support for MES incidents, service requests, and operational issues.
  • Troubleshoot application, configuration, recipe, integration, and performance issues.
  • Restore MES availability in alignment with business continuity requirements, urgency, and severity classifications.
  • Participate in investigations and implementation of corrective actions related to MES events and deviations.

Collaboration & Leadership Support

  • Work closely with Manufacturing, QA, MSAT, CSV, and IT stakeholders to ensure MES solutions meet business needs.
  • Collaborate with peer MES administrators and recipe authors across CTF sites.
  • Assist the Senior Manager Manufacturing IT Systems & MES in responsibilities associated with Technical System Ownership, Configuration Item Ownership, governance, and continuous improvement initiatives when required.

Reporting Relationship

Reports to Senior Manager – Manufacturing IT Systems & MES Lead


Collaborates With

  • MES Recipe Authors
  • Manufacturing Support IT
  • IT Automation
  • Shared Services IT
  • Quality Assurance (QA)
  • Manufacturing Science & Technology (MSAT)
  • Computer System Validation (CSV)
  • Manufacturing Operations
  • Global MES Teams

Qualifications


Required Knowledge & Experience

  • Strong understanding of Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) and manufacturing processes.
  • Experience with MES recipe authoring, configuration management, and system administration.
  • Knowledge of GMP, GxP, Data Integrity, and Computer System Validation practices.
  • Experience managing master data, user access, and system configuration.
  • Proficiency in troubleshooting, root cause analysis, system monitoring, and performance optimization.
  • Experience supporting MES upgrades, change management, and validation activities.
  • Strong problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a highly regulated biopharmaceutical manufacturing environment.

Technical Skills

  • Emerson Syncade MES
  • SQL
  • ISA-95

title: Senior Associate, Product Management - Upmarket Referrals
description:
Senior Associate, Product Management - Upmarket Referrals

Product Management

Product Management at Capital One is a booming, vibrant craft that requires reimagining the status quo, finding value creation opportunities, and driving innovative and sustainable customer experiences through technology.


We believe our portfolio of businesses and investments in growth and transformation will result in a company with the scale, brand, capabilities, talent, and values to succeed as the digital revolution transforms our society and our industry.


Do you dream of well-designed and intuitive products and customer experiences? Do you want to be the one who introduces change to help tens of millions of customers make smarter financial choices? Do you want to change the way people manage their money? If you answered yes to all of these questions, then product management at Capital One may be a fit for you


About the team

The Upmarket Referrals Product team drives the platform strategy and customer experience for all referral programs across Capital One. The role focuses on referral growth initiatives and leads the development of new capabilities. In this role, you will define and execute the product vision to scale referral growth—partnering across platform and segment teams to onboard new use cases, expand product offerings, and deliver exceptional user experiences.

In this role, you’ll learn the essentials of being a product manager, and we’ll invest in you to grow in four key areas:

  • Human Centered
    • You’ll collaborate with tech teams to build comprehensive acceptance criteria, identifying and elevating any need for additional research to define future feature design
    • You'll breakdown business epics into features and further into user stories, driving your team towards lowest effort or Minimal Viable Product (MVP) for a valid feature test

  • Business Focused
    • Demonstrating a growth mindset, you’ll effectively use hypothesis-driven assessment of data to ensure your product or feature delivers on real business needs
    • You’ll own and prioritize feature development roadmaps, ensuring all necessary processes and procedures are followed to manage risk

  • Technology Driven
    • You’ll work autonomously in an agile environment, to conduct research and develop features that utilize new and evolving technology
    • You’ll collaborate with designers, technologists, data scientists and subject-matter experts to build cutting edge solutions to help customers
    • You’ll deliver well-managed product platforms for customers by seeking to understand technology trends and architecture strategy

  • Transformational Leadership
    • By actively participating in horizontal forums, you’ll harness a network of trusted relationships among tech teams, designers, key internal stakeholders and partner teams
    • You’ll articulate a succinct product roadmap to deliver business value and share with with stakeholders, elevating your team’s results and becoming a product matter expert

We want you if you are:

  • Intellectually Curious. You ask why, you explore, you're not afraid to blurt out your crazy idea or follow an email chain for weeks to find someone with an answer. Comfortable with ambiguity, a hunger to learn and a seeker of new challenges
  • Communicator & Influencer. You can communicate complex ideas clearly regardless of your audience. Our team knows their priorities and why they’re doing what they’re doing. You always can rally associates to work with you
  • Do-er. You’re biased toward action, you try things and sometimes you fail. You can get around roadblocks and stay focused on your goals. You’re well organized, able to multitask and able to prioritize your work
  • Passionate & Customer Focus. You care about growing others and bringing them together around what’s possible. You get a thrill from the journey of building and shipping products, and you have a desire and ability to connect with our external or internal customers to fully understand their needs
  • Learner. You have an appetite to learn new things or new technologies all while exhibiting humbleness when the time comes to ask for help
  • Team Player. You enjoy working with diverse people and driving the team toward a common goal. You have the ability to put the team before yourself and establish long-lasting relationships

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or military experience
  • At least 1 year of product management experience or at least 1 year of experience in product design, agile delivery, business analysis, data science, or software engineering

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or engineering
  • 1+ years translating business strategy or analysis into consumer facing digital products
  • 1+ years of experience working on core product platforms powering digital experiences
  • 1+ years working with cross functional teams as a product owner in an agile development process

title: Bancorp Security Operations Center Agent II 3pm-11:30pm
description:
Make banking a Fifth Third better®
We connect great people to great opportunities. Are you ready to take the next step? Discover a career in banking at Fifth Third Bank.

GENERAL FUNCTION: The Bancorp Security Operations Center (BSOC) is a 24/7 global crisis monitoring and reporting center that provides Time-critical indications, warning, command and control for weather-related emergencies, natural disasters, criminal activities, and geo-political crises affecting our colleagues across the global enterprise. The BSOC is Fifth Third Bancorp’s Central Alarm Monitoring Station and single point of contact for all emergency and non-emergency physical security and safety issues. The BSOC documents and reports all necessary information and coordinates communication and/or necessary actions to ensure a proper and timely response to all crisis/physical security incidents. It maintains situational awareness of local, regional, and national events that could impact Fifth Third Bank colleagues and locations. The BSOC operates 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, 365 days a year, ensuring the protection of our Colleagues, Customers, and Company through Best in Class Service. Our mission is to become the leading bank security and safety department whose capabilities, knowledge of our business and understanding of our customer allows us to ensure associate safety, mitigate losses and effectively respond to crisis situations.


The Bancorp Security Operations Center Analyst is an individual contributor position within the BSOC. This role is responsible for answering incoming calls regarding suspicious activity and/or security related events, and for monitoring complex alarm and surveillance systems and coordinating appropriate response to alerts. The Bancorp Security Operations Center Analyst creates reports and maintains detailed logs of all calls and activities, and contacts relevant security and non-security colleagues to coordinate response or for assistance resolving issues. This individual reports these events to our field, branch, and/or home office partners per policy and leadership guidance. The Bancorp Security Operations Center Analyst reports directly to the Security Operations Center Manager, but takes tactical direction from BSOC Supervisor and Director of CSI & BSOC Operations when directed.


Responsible and accountable for risk by openly exchanging ideas and opinions, elevating concerns, and personally following policies and procedures as defined. Accountable for always doing the right thing for customers and colleagues and ensures that actions and behaviors drive a positive customer experience. While operating within the Bank's risk appetite, achieves results by consistently identifying, assessing, managing, monitoring, and reporting risks of all types.

title: Sr. I&E Technician (2nd Shift)
description:
At DNOW, we believe our associates are the best in the business. We value and reward hardworking, creative, and dedicated employees that desire to be part of a team committed to outstanding customer service.

START YOUR CAREER NOW.

The Sr. I&E Technician will be responsible for installing, routing, and terminating instrumentation tubing systems, performing leak testing and system verification, and ensuring compliance with engineering specifications and industry standards. They will collaborate with project teams, maintain accurate documentation, and follow all safety protocols to support safe and reliable operations.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES


  • Install, route, and secure stainless steel and other tubing for instrumentation and electrical systems according to P&IDs, isometric drawings, and engineering specifications.

  • Terminate and connect tubing to transmitters, gauges, valves, and other field devices.

  • Collaborate with electricians, instrument fitters, and engineers to coordinate installation schedules and resolve field challenges.
  • Maintain accurate documentation of work performed, including redlining drawings and updating as-builts.
  • Follow all safety protocols, including lockout/tagout and confined space procedures.

JOB REQUIREMENTS


  • Proven experience in I&E tubing installation in industrial environments (oil & gas, petrochemical, power generation, or similar).
  • Strong ability to read and interpret P&IDs, loop diagrams, and isometric drawings.
  • Proficiency with tubing tools such as benders, cutters, flaring tools, and swaging equipment.
  • Knowledge of industry standards (ISA, API, ASTM) and best practices for tubing installation.
  • Commitment to safety, quality, and precision in every task.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team in fast-paced environments.
