With a vision to be the world’s most trusted financial group, it’s part of our culture to put people first, listen to new and diverse ideas and collaborate toward greater innovation, speed and agility. This means investing in talent, technologies, and tools that empower you to own your career.

Join MUFG, where being inspired is expected and making a meaningful impact is rewarded.

The selected colleague will work at an MUFG office or client sites four days per week and work remotely one day. A member of our recruitment team will provide more details.

The Global Talent, Learning & Culture team is responsible for a range of key HR areas and processes across the Global MUFG Bank and Securities business; including Learning & Development, Talent Management, Talent Acquisition & Mobility, and Culture & Engagement.

The role of Talent, Learning & Culture (TL&C) is to ensure that MUFG maintains a high performing workforce, and is an organization where people can join, accelerate, learn, develop and progress their careers alongside their personal goals. The team aims to provide sound expert advice and resources to both HR and business colleagues, and to deliver programs that support the development of highly performing and engaged teams.

The VP, AI Learning & Development Lead – Americas will shape and execute the Americas- wide AI workforce enablement roadmap, translating evolving AI capabilities and business needs into practical, role-based learning and adoption opportunities. The role will combine strong AI fluency and hands-on experience with enterprise generative AI tools and delivering AI Learning & Development programs to build workforce capability, enable practical use of AI, and help embed new ways of working across the region.

The role will lead cross-functional coordination across TL&C, Technology/IT, PMO, Corporate Communications, Risk, Legal, Compliance, Procurement, vendors, Business Unit AI Leads, HRBPs, and business stakeholders to align priorities, manage dependencies, and move the program from strategy through implementation.

Strategy, AI Enablement & Learning Design

  • Establish the AI capability framework and learning architecture for the Americas, aligned to global foundations and adapted for regional business, technology, and regulatory requirements.
  • Define target audiences, proficiency levels, and desired outcomes, including pathways for novice, intermediate, advanced/expert, senior leader, people manager, technical, and champion populations.
  • Translate AI capabilities, business needs, and SME input into role-based learning pathways, instructor-led opportunities, clear learning objectives, and practical guidance for technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Define the baseline proficiency approach and mandatory AI learning & development plan for all employees.
  • Leverage and adapt existing global capability frameworks, audience segmentation, supplier criteria, learning architecture, current state/gap analysis, and governance approaches.
  • Make recommendations to build, buy, reuse, or adapt learning solutions by evaluating internal and external offerings against capability and business requirements.
  • Assess business demand, capability gaps, and emerging AI use cases through partnership with Business Unit AI Leads, HRBPs, Technology, and business stakeholders.
  • Coordinate with Risk, Legal, and Compliance to incorporate requirements associated with new AI tools, capabilities, and use cases.
  • Maintain strong fluency in emerging AI capabilities, tools, use cases, and workforce trends, translating relevant developments into practical learning and enablement opportunities for the Americas.

Program Leadership & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Lead the cross-functional AI learning & development program across TL&C, PMO, Technology/IT, Procurement, Risk, Legal, Compliance, Corporate Communications, vendors, Business Unit AI Leads, HRBPs, and business stakeholders across MUFG’s bank, securities, trust bank, and investor services entities in the Americas region.
  • Translate evolving AI workforce priorities into a connected roadmap and implementation plan, leading the program structure, stakeholder alignment, decision points, and follow-through required to drive execution.
  • Manage dependencies across content and SME readiness, platform access, procurement, supplier decisions, regulatory input, communications timing, implementation capacity, and emerging business use cases.
  • Establish sustainable governance and intake processes to prioritize business-unit-specific workforce enablement requirements and AI use cases.
  • Partner with global and regional TL&C stakeholders, including the EMEA AI Workforce Enablement lead and APAC workstreams, to leverage existing frameworks, maintain global alignment, and adapt solutions for the Americas.
  • Act as a trusted partner to business and functional stakeholders, facilitating alignment and proactively managing priorities, timelines, dependencies, decisions, and implementation readiness.
  • Establish program reporting and adoption governance, including training completions, Copilot usage, champion engagement, and pulse results for senior stakeholders.

Execution & Adoption

  • Coordinate implementation and delivery of selected learning solutions, including self-paced content, assessments, curated pathways, instructor-led options, and measurement support.
  • Execute role-based learning pathways, instructor-led opportunities, employee self-learning engagement, and mandatory baseline learning & development plan.
  • Own, deploy, and sustain practical learning and enablement resources, including people leader toolkits, office hours, FAQs, playbooks, and workflow-based guidance that help employees apply AI effectively in their work.
  • Partner with relevant business owners on learning vendor engagement, including detailed vendor inquiries and evaluation inputs.
  • Create ongoing feedback loops across senior stakeholders, employee peer groups, and the broader employee base to inform learning priorities, use cases, and adoption.
  • Support peer-to-peer employee groups with onboarding, quarterly sessions, operating cadence, recognition, and toolkits.
  • Coordinate with responsible SMEs, platform owners, communications partners, and business stakeholders to enable new AI tools and capabilities based on business need.
  • Proactively develop PMO and stakeholder updates, governance materials, leadership-ready content, and implementation communications in partnership with Corporate Communications.


Experience

  • Proven track record leading large-scale, complex programs across multiple businesses, legal entities, and geographies.
  • Demonstrated experience across Learning & Development, digital adoption, program management, workforce transformation, or related roles.
  • Direct experience leading an enterprise AI or digital enablement program with Technology partners, from tool rollout through adoption.
  • Proven experience designing, implementing, or scaling learning and adoption programs that build capability, drive behavior change, and enable new ways of working.
  • Hands-on experience with enterprise generative AI tools (e.g., Microsoft 365 Copilot, agent builders).
  • Technology and learning and development vendor management experience.

Skills

  • AI fluency: Working knowledge of LLMs, prompting, agents, and responsible AI/model risk.
  • Confidence with advanced or niche AI tools and use cases, including agents, custom AI solutions, and workflow-based AI enablement.
  • Program leadership: Strong program leadership skills, including translating evolving or ambiguous priorities into a clear roadmap, coordinating multiple workstreams and cross-functional dependencies, and driving execution end-to-end with limited oversight.
  • Learning design: Strong learning design judgment and the ability to convert real workflow examples and expert input into practical, usable learning.
  • Simplifying complexity: Proven ability to translate technical concepts, business needs, and SME input into clear, actionable guidance and learning experiences for technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Consulting and influence: Strong consulting and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to advise, facilitate, and influence stakeholders from working teams through senior leadership across business and functional groups.
  • Executive communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Experience developing audience-specific messaging, leadership-ready materials, and clear communications that explain complex topics and why they matter.
  • Agility and collaboration: Excellent organizational skills, with a collaborative and proactive approach to problem-solving and the ability to operate effectively in a fast-evolving, ambiguous environment.

Education/Qualifications:

  • Preferred: A degree or equivalent professional qualification/experience in Human Resources, Change Management, or other relevant field.

title: Senior Model Validator / Financial Risk IRRBB
description:

title: Head of Hardware & Systems Engineering
description:
The Opportunity

We’re looking for a Head of Hardware & Systems Engineering to turn advanced technology into robust, reliable and manufacturable products that protect people and critical assets around the world.

Reporting directly to the CTO, you’ll lead a growing team of over 10 engineers across Mechanical, Electronics and Systems, shaping capability, standards and delivery from early concepts through to manufacture.

This is an opportunity for an experienced engineering leader who enjoys technical complexity, develops talented people and brings clarity to competing priorities. You’ll have the scope to strengthen how we work and make a visible impact as OpenWorks grows.

Who We Are

OpenWorks is a rapidly growing business operating globally with a passion for exceptional engineering and building on a legacy of defence innovation in the North East of England.

Our products provide ultra-high performance, real-time detection, tracking, identification and targeting of dynamic aerial threats. They have been deployed internationally to protect high profile military and civilian assets, and contribute towards the defeat of nuisance, misguided and maliciously deployed drones during operations.

We are very proud to have supported a wide range of law enforcement and military operators, protecting many of the most high profile sites and individuals around the world.

The amazing things we do are only possible because of a dedicated and passionate team.

Security Vetting Information

OpenWorks Engineering operates within the defence sector. As part of our recruitment and onboarding processes, we collect information that may be required to support future security vetting and clearance requirements, should these become necessary during employment.

Why You’ll Love Working With Us

Join a high-energy, collaborative team where great ideas thrive, challenges are embraced, and people genuinely love what they do.

Here’s what our benefits have to offer:

Rewarding Success - Competitive salary, starting from £90,000, plus a discretionary annual bonus of up to 25% of salary alongside a structured pay progression framework.

Enhanced Pension – Up to 8% employer-matched contributions to help you plan for the future.

More Time to Recharge – 25 days’ holiday plus public holidays, long-service rewards, and the option to buy up to 5 extra days.

Breakfast & Lunch on Us – Enjoy team breakfasts and freshly prepared lunches every day courtesy of Chef Mark and his team.

Health & Wellbeing – Private healthcare and life assurance for added peace of mind.

Sustainable Travel – Salary sacrifice schemes, including EV car and Cycle to Work options.

Team Socials – Regular events, from quiz nights and football to board games and more.

Learning & Growth – A culture that empowers you to challenge, grow and make an impact, plus a £250 annual learning budget to invest in the development that matters most to you.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Lead and develop the team: Build capability, ensuring a high performance across Mechanical, Electronics and Systems through clear expectations, coaching, recruitment and ownership.
  • Drive engineering delivery: Turn product and business priorities into achievable plans, managing capacity, resources and commitments across multiple projects.
  • Provide technical leadership: Set engineering standards, challenge designs and guide complex decisions, keeping risks, requirements and interfaces under control.
  • Take concepts into production: Lead development through prototyping, verification and new product introduction, embedding manufacturability, testability, compliance and supportability.
  • Bring disciplines together: Work closely with Software, Intelligence & Autonomy, Product and Operations to deliver reliable, integrated products.
  • Align teams and remove barriers: Clarify priorities, ownership and dependencies across functions, resolve blockers and escalate trade-offs that need wider business decisions.

What we’re looking for:

Essential

  • Proven engineering leadership: Significant experience leading and developing multidisciplinary teams in complex R&D and product development environments.
  • Technical credibility: A strong Systems, Mechanical or Electronics background, supported by a relevant engineering degree or equivalent, with the confidence to challenge experienced engineers.
  • Full lifecycle delivery: A track record of taking products combining mechanical, electronics and software from concept through verification, new product introduction and manufacture.
  • Systems thinking: Strong judgement around requirements, integration, technical risks and trade-offs, with an understanding of configuration control and engineering change.
  • People and delivery focus: Experience managing performance, priorities and resources across multiple projects, building collaboration and maintaining momentum as priorities change.

Desirable

  • Relevant technology experience: Experience in electro-optical, autonomous, radar, surveillance or counter-UAS systems.
  • Engineering assurance: Experience in regulated, safety-critical or quality-focused environments, or knowledge of defence engineering standards.
  • Professional development: A relevant master’s qualification or Chartered Engineer status through IET, IMechE or an equivalent body.

You must have the right to work in the UK; we are unable to offer visa sponsorship. Occasional travel may be required.

More about us:

Vision

Help protect the territory and airspace of NATO countries and their allies.

Mission

Be a world-leading provider of autonomous technology for Surveillance applications and Defence

Values

Be a Good Egg: Earn respect, have mutual trust and be honest

Do cool stuff: We develop cool tech with an awesome team, and we get stuff done

Be empowered: We are autonomous, reliable and take personal responsibility

We are one team: Look out for each other and the team

Things go wrong: Fail fast, learn and move on

Have fun: We’re doing amazing things with passionate people

We Get It Done: Focus on what matters and work with energy to bring ideas to life

title: Java Developer
description:
We’re looking for a Java Developer with 5+ years of strong hands-on experience in backend development, building REST APIs and microservices using Java, Spring Boot, and Dropwizard. The ideal candidate should also have working knowledge of React.js, database management, and end-to-end application development, with a focus on building scalable, secure, and reliable applications.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain backend applications using Java, Spring Boot, and Dropwizard.
  • Build and integrate RESTful APIs and microservices for seamless application communication.
  • Develop and maintain frontend components using React.js, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
  • Work with relational databases, write optimized SQL queries, and ensure data integrity.
  • Write unit and integration tests using JUnit and Mockito to maintain code quality.
  • Troubleshoot issues, debug applications, and optimize performance and reliability.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams in an Agile environment to deliver scalable and secure solutions.
  • Maintain code repositories, support CI/CD pipelines, and contribute to application deployment and maintenance.

Requirements


Backend Technologies

  • Java (Core Java, OOP, Collections, Exception Handling, Multithreading)
  • Dropwizard Framework – hands-on experience building and maintaining RESTful APIs
  • Spring Boot – development and integration of backend services and microservices
  • REST APIs, JSON, HTTP protocols, and API integrations
  • Maven/Gradle for build and dependency management

Frontend Technologies

  • React.js, JavaScript (ES6+)
  • HTML5, CSS3
  • React Hooks, component-based development, and state management
  • Frontend and backend API integration

Databases

  • Experience with relational databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, or Oracle
  • Strong SQL skills, including joins, subqueries, indexing, and query optimization
  • Understanding of database schema design, transactions, and data integrity

title: Sourcing Director

The Senior Analyst will support FTC hiring and vendor operations by managing candidate pipelines, coordinating interviews, tracking hiring progress, engaging with vendor partners, and overseeing invoice validation and processing. title: Privacy Counsel
description:
DT (NASDAQ: APPS) is unifying the full mobile experience. Our growth platform powers the mobile ecosystem by bringing together advertisers, app developers, and device partners, to create a unique and premium value exchange, that results in a personalized and seamless mobile device experience.


At DT, we move fast, think big, and build collaboratively. We believe great ideas can come from anywhere, and we trust our teams to take ownership, challenge convention, and make an impact from day one.


Here, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career while contributing to products and experiences used by millions around the world.

With us, you will enjoy competitive compensation, equity awards, and a comprehensive benefits package designed to invest in your total well-being, all within a hybrid and flexible work environment.

DT (Digital Turbine) sits at the intersection of mobile app distribution, device monetization, and the programmatic advertising ecosystem — a position that requires us to navigate one of the most dynamic privacy and data protection landscapes in the industry. The Privacy Counsel is the person who helps us do that with rigor and speed.


This Privacy Counsel role is a high-visibility, high-impact position within the Legal team. You will serve as a hands-on advisor on global privacy and data protection matters across DT's platform, product, and partner ecosystem — advising on everything from day-to-day compliance questions to the privacy implications of new product launches and commercial deals.


You will work closely with the Legal, Product, Engineering, Partnerships, and Ad Operations teams to embed privacy considerations into how DT builds and ships products. This is a hands-on role for an experienced attorney who can move fluidly between detailed legal analysis and practical, business-friendly guidance, and who is comfortable being the primary privacy point of contact for a fast-moving, technical organization.


About the Privacy Counsel role:


Privacy & Data Protection Advisory


Serve as day-to-day legal advisor on global privacy and data protection laws applicable to DT's business, including CCPA/CPRA and other U.S. state privacy laws, GDPR, UK GDPR, and the ePrivacy Directive. Knowledge of other countries privacy laws is an advantage.


Advise Product and Engineering teams on privacy-by-design considerations for new features, identifiers, and data flows, including data minimization, consent and opt-out signaling, pseudonymization and de-identification standards, retention, and purpose limitation.


Advise on the allocation of privacy roles and responsibilities (e.g., controller/processor, business/service provider) across DT's products and partnerships, and maintain the data-flow documentation that supports DT's positions in commercial negotiations.


Review, negotiate, and advise on data processing agreements, international data transfer mechanisms (e.g., SCCs and the UK IDTA), vendor contracts, and partner agreements from a privacy and data protection perspective, and maintain DT's DPA templates and negotiation positions.


Track and interpret evolving privacy laws and regulatory enforcement and guidance (e.g., FTC, CPPA, and EU/UK data protection authorities) globally, and translate them into practical guidance for internal stakeholders.


Compliance Programs & Risk Management


Support and help mature DT's privacy compliance program, including policies, data inventories and records of processing, data retention and de-identification standards, vendor and sub-processor management, privacy impact assessments, and training materials.


Own and maintain DT's privacy notices and external privacy disclosures.


Partner with Security and Engineering teams on data breach response protocols and incident management, including notification analysis under applicable laws and contractual commitments.


Monitor and respond to regulatory inquiries, audits, partner and customer privacy questionnaires and audits, and consumer and data subject rights requests (including opt-out and Global Privacy Control signals) in coordination with cross-functional teams.


Help build scalable processes and playbooks so that privacy review can keep pace with DT's product and commercial velocity.


Cross-Functional Partnership


Act as an internal consultant and thought partner for Product, Partnerships, Sales, and Ad Operations teams, helping them understand privacy risk and translate it into actionable product and deal decisions, and exercising sound judgment on when a matter requires escalation to the Head of Legal or outside counsel.


Prepare clear, business-friendly materials and guidance that can be used by non-legal stakeholders without extensive legal background.


Collaborate with outside counsel on complex or jurisdiction-specific matters as needed, with an eye to cost and to keeping institutional knowledge in-house.


About YOU as the Privacy Counsel:



4+ years of experience practicing privacy and data protection law, in-house or at a law firm, including hands-on experience negotiating data processing agreements and advising on controller/processor and business/service provider allocation, ideally with exposure to the technology, ad tech, online and mobile ecosystem.


Strong working knowledge of global privacy frameworks, including CCPA/CPRA and other U.S. state privacy laws, COPPA and children's privacy requirements, GDPR, ePrivacy Directive, and other applicable U.S. and international data protection laws.


Comfort working directly with engineers and product teams to understand how data is actually collected and used before advising.


Demonstrated ability to translate complex legal requirements into clear, practical, and actionable guidance for non-legal, technical, and business stakeholders.

Strong written and verbal communication skills, with close attention to detail and the ability to produce work that is sharp, clear, and immediately usable by busy stakeholders.


Comfort operating in a fast-paced, matrixed environment, managing multiple workstreams and shifting priorities independently.


J.D. and active bar membership in good standing in any U.S. state (or eligibility for registered in-house counsel status in the state of employment).

CIPP/E, CIPP/US, or comparable privacy certification.


Preferred experience/skills:


  • Familiarity with the mobile app ecosystem, and the ad-tech industry.
  • Familiarity with the ad-tech industry frameworks (e.g., IAB TCF and GPP) and platform policies is an advantage.
  • Experience building or scaling a privacy compliance program from the ground up.
  • Familiarity with emerging areas such as age assurance, AI governance (including the EU AI Act and U.S. state AI laws), and state-specific children's privacy laws.
  • Experience supporting large telecommunication companies
  • Experience supporting multi-party data supply chain.
  • Experience handling regulatory investigations or inquiries from data protection authorities (such as the FTC, the CPPA, ICO, CNIL.
  • Familiarity with privacy and data protection laws in other markets globally (e.g., Brazil, Japan, South Korea, India) is an advantage.

At DT, we are committed to pay transparency and equitable compensation. (For New York-based candidates). The salary range for this position is $165,000 - $192,000, and is based on experience, skills, and qualifications. In addition to competitive pay, we offer a comprehensive benefits package, including (stock options, unlimited PTO and performance-based bonus). We believe in fostering an environment where employees are valued and compensated fairly for their contributions.

DT (NASDAQ: APPS) is a mobile growth platform that powers superior experiences and outcomes for advertisers, app developers, carriers, OEMs, and publishers worldwide.


Our technology connects brands and apps with consumers across devices, apps, and mobile environments — helping partners drive awareness, acquisition, engagement, and monetization through intelligent, integrated experiences.


Headquartered in Austin, Texas, DT operates globally across North America, EMEA, APAC, and LATAM.


DT is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. We welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities, and perspectives, and believe teams with different points of view build better products, ideas, and experiences.

title: Environmental Project Manager (Phase II due diligence, retail petroleum subsurface investigation, and remediation)
description:

With a team of 3,500 employees and offices throughout the US, we combine local expertise and a network of relationships to deliver solutions to both public and private clients. Our services help improve the quality of life in the communities where we live and work. We always aim for smart, safe, and sustainable results. Job Description

Atlas is seeking an Environmental Project Manager to lead subsurface investigation, retail petroleum, due diligence, and remediation projects throughout Texas.

In this role, you will guide projects from proposal through completion, helping clients understand environmental conditions, meet regulatory requirements, and make informed decisions. You will combine technical expertise with practical project leadership, clear communication, and a strong commitment to safety and quality.

Core Responsibilities

  • Manage day-to-day operations for Phase II due diligence, retail petroleum subsurface investigation, and remediation projects throughout Texas, including all aspects of the project life cycle such as proposal generation, technical execution, reporting, and invoicing.
  • Work closely with local management to develop new clients and expand services provided to existing clients.
  • Actively participate in professional and technical organizations appropriate for core skill set and client needs.
  • Prepare or review reports by assisting with data compilation, reduction, interpretation, evaluation, and comparison to state and/or federal environmental regulatory standards.
  • Interact with internal and external clients, service partners, and contractors.
  • Promote a safety-first culture that values proactive measures and continuous improvement.
  • Collaborate with other team members toward a common goal of providing client-centric services with high-quality interactions and deliverables.
  • Prepare reports, including analysis of data and develop conclusions and recommendations.
  • Participate in client calls, discussing project findings and implications for a non-technical audience.
  • Work closely with local and national management teams to perform requested client/project tasks in both a field and office setting.

You’ll thrive here if you have

  • A bachelor’s or master’s degree in environmental science, geology, engineering, or another relevant applied science.
  • At least five years of environmental consulting experience, including project management, fieldwork, data evaluation, technical writing, and quality review. Seven or more years is preferred.
  • Working knowledge of Phase II subsurface investigations, retail petroleum release investigations, contaminant remediation, and Texas environmental requirements.
  • Experience managing clients, coordinating contractors, and contributing to business development or professional organizations.
  • Qualification as an Environmental Professional under ASTM E1527.
  • Current 40-hour HAZWOPER training and annual eight-hour refresher training.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, scientific judgment, organization, and attention to detail.
  • The ability to manage multiple priorities independently while remaining an active, reliable member of the team.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and Teams.
  • The ability to meet role-related physical and employment requirements, including lifting up to 50 pounds and successfully completing required motor vehicle and substance screening.
  • Staff location in Dallas, TX would be preferred but will consider staff in any Texas metro area.

What you can expect from us

The A-Team Experience is our employee program focused on helping our people thrive professionally, personally and as part of a community. We trust our people to do great work and live fulfilling lives, and we provide resources that care for our people, both at work and in life:

title: I&E Technician - Associate
description:

title: Software Engineer
description:

What You’ll Be Doing:

The Software Engineer designs, develops, tests, and maintains software applications using modern programming languages and frameworks. Working in an Agile, globally distributed team, this role partners with product managers, designers, and other engineers to translate requirements into technical specifications and deliver clean, maintainable, and reliable code.

This individual works with minimal supervision on assigned features, actively learning and adopting the development methods, frameworks, and patterns defined for the role and by the team, and contributes to the design and implementation of enhancements to the team’s systems. The role is expected to use approved AI-assisted tools to accelerate delivery and improve quality while remaining fully accountable for every delivered result.

AI-Assisted Engineering Expectations

Evolent engineers are expected to effectively leverage approved AI-assisted development and productivity tools (e.g., code assistants, copilots, automation agents, knowledge assistants, and analytics tools) to improve quality, efficiency, and innovation while maintaining accountability for all delivered work. These expectations span the full engineering lifecycle, not only code generation, including iterating with AI on solution design, evaluating alternatives, and producing design artifacts. Engineers remain responsible for validating outputs, ensuring solution quality, protecting sensitive information, and complying with security, privacy, regulatory, and Responsible AI standards.

Key Responsibilities

Design and Development

• Design, develop, test, and maintain software applications for assigned features using modern programming languages and frameworks.

• Collaborate with product managers, designers, and other engineers to understand requirements and translate them into technical specifications.

• Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code, following the team’s established best practices, patterns, and coding standards.

• Write unit, integration, and end-to-end tests to ensure code quality and reliability.

• Contribute to the design and implementation of enhancements to the team’s systems.

Quality and Continuous Improvement

• Participate in code reviews to ensure code quality, functionality, and maintainability, and seek feedback to continuously improve skills.

• Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve technical issues and bugs in a timely manner.

• Optimize applications for performance, scalability, and reliability.

• Follow and help reinforce the team’s development processes and standards, helping peers understand the benefits and risks of exceptions.

• Contribute to the continuous improvement of development processes, tools, and methodologies, and stay current with emerging technologies and industry trends.

AI-Enabled Delivery

• Utilize approved AI-assisted engineering tools to accelerate software development, testing, documentation, troubleshooting, and analysis activities.

• Apply AI-assisted development techniques throughout the software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, coding, testing, debugging, and documentation.

• Evaluate and validate AI-generated outputs for correctness, security, maintainability, compliance, and business appropriateness before use.

• Learn and adopt the prompts, skills, agents, and AI-assisted development patterns defined by the team, and share improvements that benefit the team.

• Identify opportunities to improve engineering productivity and quality through AI-enabled workflows and automation.

Governance and Compliance

• Follow enterprise policies governing AI usage, intellectual property protection, security, privacy, PHI handling, and Responsible AI practices.

• Ensure no confidential, regulated, or protected information is used with unapproved AI services or tooling.

• Participate in peer reviews and validation processes for AI-assisted solutions.

Required Qualifications

• 2+ years of professional software development experience using languages such as C#, Java, Python, or JavaScript.

• 2+ years of hands-on experience with Microsoft and .NET technologies, specifically .NET Core, C#, and T-SQL.

• Experience building RESTful APIs using ASP.NET.

• Working knowledge of relational database development, preferably using SQL Server.

• Familiarity with testing frameworks (e.g., xUnit, NUnit, MSTest), logging frameworks (e.g., NLog, log4net, Serilog), and ORM frameworks (e.g., Dapper, Entity Framework, NHibernate).

• Strong understanding of software design principles, algorithms, and data structures.

• Familiarity with Git-based version control (e.g., GitHub, Azure Git) and collaborative coding workflows, including pull requests.

• Familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g., Azure, AWS, Google Cloud) and containerization tools (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).

• Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently and as part of a globally distributed team.

• Strong communication skills, openness to feedback, and the ability to articulate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

• Exposure to AI-assisted development platforms such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, or similar tools.

• Familiarity with prompt engineering, AI-assisted testing, and AI-enabled software delivery practices.

• Experience with front-end frameworks (e.g., React, Angular, Vue), including developing Single Page Applications (SPA).

• Experience with additional back-end technologies (e.g., Node.js, Django, Spring).

• Familiarity with microservices architecture.

• Experience working with NoSQL data stores (e.g., Elasticsearch).

• Healthcare domain experience.

Education

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Electronically file shipment information with the U.S. Department of Homeland Security/Customs and Border Protection websites; communicate status of shipments to appropriate personnel as necessary.

title: Security Engineer  - Cloud Security Controls
description:
Position Overview

At PNC, our people are our greatest differentiator and competitive advantage in the markets we serve. We are all united in delivering the best experience for our customers. We work together each day to foster an inclusive workplace culture where all of our employees feel respected, valued and have an opportunity to contribute to the company’s success. As a Security Specialist within PNC's Technology organization, you may be based in a remote location. This position may not be available in all geographic locations.

As a Security Engineer on PNC's Cloud Security team, you will build and deploy innovative security controls that protect public cloud workloads that meet and often exceed regulatory standards. You will work on a highly innovative/collaborative team that works diligently to automate and bake security into Azure and AWS public cloud workloads. You will utilize the Cloud Provider’s and third party Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) tools to perform posture assessment PNC’s public cloud workloads. Familiarity and willingness to develop expertise in utilizing these CSPM tools as the source of truth for public cloud resource compliance is a must for this position.

You will work closely with Cloud Security's Security as Code (SAC) pipeline to test and deploy security controls that ensure PNC workloads are secure by default. You will interact and engage with PNC Cloud Architects and PNC’s SOC team to understand potential vulnerabilities and work to codify these controls. In addition, you will engage with our Cloud Product team and Infrastructure as Code (IAC) teams as we shift our security controls to the left into Cloud Infrastructure pipelines. Being able to effectively communicate verbally and in writing is critical to interacting and engaging our stakeholders and internal customers. You will be a vital part of the Cloud Security team’s mission to secure PNC’s cloud workloads.

As a Security Engineer, you will help mentor and guide the junior members of the team and participate in future roadmap planning. A strong ability to collaborate, problem solve, and actively build trust with our partners and stakeholders is critical.

Responsibilities
o Build and test security controls for Azure resources and AWS services
o Validate security control effectiveness and promote controls to production workloads
o Work within agile team and proactively participate in planning sessions
o Engineer and Configure utilizing CSPM tools to effectively analyze and assess cloud workloads for compliance in a CI/CD environment
o Continuous learning environment – Our team does not stand still, a growth mindset that is continuously seeking new and better ways to solve security challenges is a must.
o Assess, implement, automate, and document security solutions and processes for Microsoft Azure and AWS
o Provide analysis of workloads to ensure alignment with operational security requirements in order to go to production.
o Work closely with Cloud Security Product Owner to refine backlog tickets and define priority and sizing
o RCSA Control owner for Cloud Security - TEC072
o Automate and orchestrate the process of Cloud software deployment (CI/CD) to integrate enterprise security standards, policies, configurations, and architectures, for applications, platforms, and infrastructure
o Assist DevOps team members with the development and operationalization of security
o Ensure the security posture of applications seeking deployment into Production



Preferred Skills:
o Deep experience with AWS and/or Azure cloud services in an Enterprise environment
o Thorough understanding of Cloud security best practices.
o Experience performing security gap analysis on Cloud Services or Cloud Infrastructure
o Experience in implementing security controls for public cloud workloads in Azure and AWS.
o Experience creating innovative security solutions that balance security with all other corporate priorities
o Proficient in one or more scripting languages such as Python, Powershell, Bash, etc.
o Expertise with Git, including branching workflows.
o Experience with testing security controls to ensure the effectiveness of the control.
o Strong written and verbal communications skills.
o Process and detail oriented.
o Has demonstrated project leadership, helping guide the direction of large team initiatives.
o Ability to “think outside the box” when considering options to address security controls at scale and across multiple cloud service providers.
o Expertise in SQL or SQL-type query languages

title: Senior Risk Advisory Consultant
description:
Make banking a Fifth Third better®
We connect great people to great opportunities. Are you ready to take the next step? Discover a career in banking at Fifth Third Bank.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

The Senior Risk Advisory Consultant is a senior individual contributor who delivers advanced insurance and risk-management advice as part of the holistic wealth planning process. Aligned to designated regions, the role partners closely with Wealth Advisors and Wealth Strategists to identify client risks, evaluate existing coverage, design appropriate strategies and coordinate implementation. The Senior Consultant serves as a subject-matter expert for complex high-net-worth and ultra-high-net-worth client needs, leads client and advisor discussions, and helps strengthen consistent Risk Advisory practices across SCAS.


Please see below for specific responsibilities and requirements for this role.


YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES:

The responsibilities for this role are below; you may support projects of varying complexity based on skill and organizational priorities.

· Advanced Risk Assessment: Lead structured risk assessments for new and existing wealth strategies, identify protection and liquidity gaps, and document findings and recommended next steps.

· Holistic Solution Design: Develop insurance strategies that complement estate planning, wealth transfer, business succession, executive benefits, charitable objectives and broader client financial goals.

· Client Advisory: Explain complex insurance concepts, tradeoffs and implementation considerations to clients and their external advisors in a clear, balanced and understandable manner.

· Wealth Team Partnership: Work alongside Wealth Advisors, Wealth Strategists, fiduciary professionals and other SCAS specialists from discovery through recommendation and implementation.

· Case Leadership: Lead complex cases, including data gathering, financial and policy analysis, illustration review, carrier engagement, underwriting coordination, application strategy and policy delivery.

· Existing Policy Review: Evaluate existing life, disability, long-term care and annuity arrangements for alignment with current objectives, ownership structures, funding assumptions and service needs.

· Regional Engagement: Develop proactive relationships across assigned regions, participate in opportunity and planning discussions, and help advisors identify situations requiring Risk Advisory involvement.

· Quality and Risk Management: Maintain complete documentation, follow applicable policies and procedures, elevate exceptions and concerns, and support appropriate review of recommendations and transactions.

· Practice Development: Contribute to assessment questions, planning standards, advisor education, templates and process improvements that scale the Risk Advisory model.

· Mentorship: Provide technical guidance and case support to the Risk Advisory Associate and less-experienced partners while escalating the most complex matters to the Director.

· Other Duties: Performing other duties as assigned, adapting to new tasks or shifts in priorities as necessary to support your team's and the company's mission.


MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:

· Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and experience.

· Appropriate state insurance licenses for Life, Health and Long-Term Care, as required under Fifth Third licensing guidelines.

· Eight or more years of insurance planning, advanced case design, wealth planning or related financial-services experience.

· Demonstrated experience advising high-net-worth clients and collaborating with relationship managers, planners or external professional advisors.


REQUIRED SKILLS:

Qualified candidates will possess an advanced degree of proficiency, typically developed through eight or more years of relevant experience, in:

· Insurance and Risk Analysis: Assessing life, disability, long-term care and annuity needs and evaluating existing and proposed solutions.

· Complex Planning: Applying insurance concepts within estate, tax, liquidity, business-owner and wealth-transfer planning.

· Consultative Communication: Leading discovery and recommendation discussions and presenting complex concepts clearly.

· Case Design and Execution: Managing sophisticated cases from assessment through underwriting, implementation and delivery.

· Collaboration and Judgment: Working effectively across a multidisciplinary team and exercising sound judgment in ambiguous client situations.


Please refer to the “Skills for Success” section to learn how to stand out as an applicant.


SKILLS FOR SUCCESS:

Qualified candidates will possess an advanced degree of proficiency across a suite of skills including, but not limited to:

· Professional Designations: CLU, ChFC, CFP or progress toward a comparable advanced designation.

· Fiduciary Mindset: Approaching insurance as one element of a client’s overall plan and prioritizing documented client needs and outcomes.

· Advisor Enablement: Helping Wealth Advisors and Wealth Strategists identify needs and confidently position Risk Advisory.

· Regional Relationship Management: Building productive partnerships across multiple markets while managing competing case priorities.

· Coaching and Knowledge Sharing: Reviewing work, sharing expertise and supporting development of junior team members.


DOING THE RIGHT THING:

Our employees take pride in doing the right thing for customers and colleagues as well as being accountable for risk by openly exchanging ideas and opinions, elevating concerns, and following policies and procedures that protect all our valuable assets, including you.

Our team delivers innovative digital, social, video, and event solutions that turn brand ambition into measurable commercial success. In this New York role, you'll drive revenue expansion across a premier luxury account portfolio.

Description

Reporting to the Luxury Sales Lead, you'll manage and expand our luxury account portfolio across fashion, watches, and jewelry. Operating from our New York office, you'll partner with brand executives and agency leads to deliver integrated commercial campaigns. You'll sell multi-platform packages spanning digital, social, video, branded content, and live events across Who What Wear and Marie Claire. By using Salesforce for pipeline forecasting and partnering with internal creative teams, you'll turn client goals into high-performing commercial revenue.

What You'll Do

You will report into the Luxury Sales Lead

  • Manage and grow a portfolio of luxury accounts, delivering against revenue targets and strategic account plans.
  • Develop new commercial opportunities across fashion, watch, and jewelry categories through proactive client outreach.
  • Sell integrated media partnerships spanning digital, social, video, branded content, live events, and Future Optic solutions.

  • Partner with Creative Strategy and Client Services teams to build commercially viable proposals and ensure smooth campaign handoffs.

What You’ll Bring

  • Established network of relationships with luxury brands and agency partners across fashion, watches, and jewelry.

  • Commercial judgment and poise navigating multi-stakeholder sales cycles.
  • Strong organizational skills to manage competing priorities and account campaigns.
  • Familiarity using Salesforce or comparable CRM platforms for pipeline management and forecasting.

Minimum Requirements

  • Professional background in media sales, digital advertising, or commercial partnership management within premium media.
  • Experience managing client relationships, sales pipelines, and commercial negotiations.
  • Ability to work from our New York office under a hybrid model, working two days a week on-site.

What We Offer

title: Change Management Lead
description:
Position Details


  • Full-Time | Fixed term until April 2029
  • Higher Education Officer Level 9 | $133,860 - $143,239 p.a.
  • Location: Bedford Park / Kaurna Country
  • View Position Description


About the Flinders HealthCare Centre


The Flinders HealthCARE Centre (FHC) is a multidisciplinary education, research, and healthcare facility located at the heart of Flinders Village and co-funded by the Australian Government and Flinders University. Scheduled to open in 2029, FHC will support the delivery of approximately 1,300 additional health graduates and up to 10,000 additional episodes of health and community care annually, bringing together education, research, and health and community services to enable new models of care, innovative use of technology, and transformative learning.


About the Program


The Program supports the establishment and activation of the FHC, working across the Colleges of Health and Enablement (CHE), Medicine and Public Health (CMPH), and Human Sciences and Culture (CHSC). With support from central services, the Activation team is structured across four workstreams and five enabling streams to support the design of an innovative interprofessional curriculum, underpinned by a newly defined clinical services model and contemporary simulation practices. The Program will also focus on co-designing health services in partnership with government and industry partners.


About the Role


Join us as our Change Management Lead for the activation of the Flinders HealthCare Centre, offering an exciting opportunity to be a part of a high performing project team who are shaping the development of the iconic, state of the art Flinders HealthCare Centre.


Reporting to the Program Director, and working closely with the Associate Director, Change and Strategy, in the People and Culture portfolio, the Change Management Lead will ensure change strategies and plans align with the organisational objectives and the University's Change Management Framework. The incumbent will bring significant experience and sound knowledge in change management and communication, with the ability to foster cultural alignment during the transition into the new Flinders HealthCARE Centre building. The incumbent will lead change management programs and develop comprehensive plans to ensure the FHC Activation Program’s change initiatives are successfully implemented.


The role is also responsible for:


  • Overseeing, gathering and analysing data, assessing the impact of change, recommending interventions and mitigations, and providing insights to help informed decision-marking.
  • Creating and delivering tailored change management plans and required supporting plans such as Communications and Engagement Plans.
  • Building and maintaining trusted relationships with key stakeholders, which includes providing guidance, addressing their needs and concerns, and assisting leaders to be the ‘face of change’ through practical and strategic change management techniques.
  • Leading, delivering, and monitoring engagements to ensure regular, meaningful opportunities for stakeholders and impacted groups that enable buy-in, builds understanding, and support early adoption.

Please refer to the attached position description, for a comprehensive list of roles and responsibilities.

This position makes a significant contribution to the University’s strategic plan to changing 10 million lives, Every One Matters, by 2035 through the strategic drive of Students First. This enabling role will play a pivotal role in the successful development and launch of the Flinders HealthCare Centre; a centre designed to offer modern, simulation training facilities that enhance student workforce readiness and strengthen their impact when entering communities as practitioners.

About You


You have highly developed interpersonal, and relationship management skills, with experience building and maintaining effective relationships with stakeholders and supporting individuals and groups through diverse types and levels of change. You bring a proven ability to lead and facilitate stakeholder engagement at all levels, develop high-quality communications, and oversee and deliver learning, readiness and adoption activities. You have excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly and effectively with diverse audiences, and extensive experience fostering flexible ways of working to drive collaboration, adaptability and successful outcomes.


You will also be able to demonstrate:


  • Postgraduate qualifications and extensive relevant experience, or an equivalent combination of experience and/or education and/or training.
  • Experience in leading and delivering successful change management programs and services across entire project lifecycles.
  • Extensive experience in overseeing and undertaking change impact analysis and creating fit-for-purpose change management plans for impacted groups.
  • Experience in leading and overseeing project and change management resources to deliver change management activities.

Life at Flinders

They say know your place. We say you've found it right here.


Flinders University was founded on the belief that learning should open minds, celebrate individuality and give people the freedom to pursue their own point of view. That spirit lives on in our community of thinkers, doers and changemakers who challenge convention, and each other, to shape what comes next.


Rising to a challenge is nothing new for Flinders. During our first 60 years, we’ve navigated revolutionary changes in social and cultural norms, and have responded to transformative economic, environmental and technological developments. Through it all, we’ve continued to deliver for our students and community, innovating in learning and research to prepare graduates for the changing world they help create.


Reaching beyond the limits of buildings, borders, and backgrounds, ours is an inclusive culture that believes absolutely in equality and opportunity for all. We don't just accommodate differences; we embrace and celebrate them.


So, why work at Flinders?

  • 17% Superannuation + salary packaging options
  • Flexible working arrangements
  • Awarded the AHEIA Higher Education Award for Workplace Culture Excellence due to our commitment to wellbeing through our Thriving@Flinders staff wellbeing program
  • Wide range of professional development activities and services, including exclusive staff study offers
  • We embrace diversity and promote equity and inclusion for all students and staff, as shown through our three SAGE Cygnet Awards.
  • Vibrant campus life and amenities including on campus health care services, gym and childcare centre (Bedford Park, South Australia).
  • Recognised as a Veteran Employer of Choice

Our Commitment to Reconciliation and Indigenous Employment

Flinders University is proud to be an organisation that is committed to our Reconciliation Action Plan and Indigenous Workforce Strategy. Our vision is to be a preferred employer for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples. We are committed to progressing Indigenous advancement in education, research, employment, and wellbeing, and strongly encourage applications from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples for all Flinders vacancies.

  • Please see here for our Reconciliation Action Plan
  • Please see here for our Indigenous Workforce Strategy

Prescribed Conditions for Employment

Appointment to this role is conditional on the completion of required pre-employment checks and declarations, each of which must be satisfactory to the University.


These include:

  • Flinders University will require a current completed Nationally Coordinated Criminal History Check and Gender Based Violence Declaration which is satisfactory to the University. The contract of Employment is conditional upon the receipt of these completed compliance checks. A disclosable outcome will not automatically disqualify a candidate from consideration. Each case will be assessed on its individual merits and relevance to the inherent requirements of the role.
  • SA: Staff working in a health care setting are strongly recommended to be fully vaccinated against COVID-19 in line with the SA Health policy.

How to Apply and Information


  • You are required to submit a CV, along with a Suitability Statement as a separate document. This should be no more than 3 pages, and address the Key Position Capabilities of the Position Description
  • Flinders University is committed to providing an environment where staff with disability are valued, supported and encouraged to participate fully and independently in the life of the University. If you require any reasonable adjustments to assist you in the selection process, please advise the contact in the Recruitment Team so that we can make appropriate arrangements through recruitment@flinders.edu.au or call 08 8201 2383.
  • For more information regarding this position, please contact Dr Mailys Stirling

Certification

01 Nov 2026

The American Connection Corps (ACC), an AmeriCorps program of Lead For America (LFA), is a service fellowship program aimed at helping communities build the digital connectivity necessary to expand opportunity and economic mobility, ranging from healthcare access to quality employment.

ACC Members serve with locally-rooted organizations, helping address the digital divide and strengthen access to opportunity. Through their service, they gain hands-on experience, build in-demand skills, and explore career pathways while making a tangible impact in their communities.

About Through the Trees

Through the Trees bridges the digital divide- one signal, one device, one neighbor at time.

The member will assist staff with approved service activities, including device refurbishment, device distribution, and digital literacy sessions, while gaining experience with the organization’s service delivery efforts. Member will assist staff with community outreach projects to increase awareness, support efforts to identify and coordinate in-kind device donations, and educate the community on our mission through staff-approved information and materials

Key Responsibilities

  • Community Outreach: Assist with staff-led outreach efforts with regional communities to raise awareness about digital equity programs and resources.
    • Device Procurement: Support staff-led efforts to identify and coordinate in-kind device donations and assist with related community outreach under staff direction and supervision.
  • Device Refurbishment: Assist staff with the device refurbishment program and learn technical aspects of the process through hands-on service activities.
  • Digital Literacy: Assist staff with digital literacy training sessions, both one-on-one and group.
  • Data Collection and Reporting: Collect service-related data and compile summaries that highlight program progress, challenges, and successes for staff review.

All functions and activities performed by the AmeriCorps Member are completed under the guidance, supervision, and direction of program and host site staff.

Learning & Development Opportunities

As an ACC Member, you will receive structured training and support throughout your service year, including:

  • A week-long virtual orientation with the national cohort to kick off the service year.
  • A week-long, in-person national Winter Institute convening with your ACC cohort — travel, lodging, and a per diem stipend are fully covered.
  • Twice-monthly virtual training on skills for service, including project management, asset-based community development, grant writing, and serving vulnerable populations, plus self-paced curricula with opportunities to earn badges and credentials.
  • A structured community listening tour at the start of service to understand local needs, assets, and opportunities.
  • Dedicated 1:1 support from a Lead For America Program Coordinator and twice-monthly peer pod meetings for networking and professional development.
  • Access to a national network of ACC Members, alumni, and community partners.

Requirements

  • Passion for community service and connecting your neighbors to the digital tools, skills, and opportunities they need to thrive.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team.
  • Interest in gaining experience in community development or digital inclusion.

Eligibility:

  • Be a U.S. Citizen, National, or Lawful Permanent Resident.
  • Hold a high school diploma or GED equivalent.
  • Be 17 years of age or older by the start of service.
  • Have not already served four (4) or more AmeriCorps State/National terms.

Timeline:

We are currently recruiting Members to serve from December 7th, 2026 - August 13th, 2027. Members will serve full-time (approximately 40 hours per week), completing 1200 hours of service over the course of the term.

Application Process:

  1. Submit Your Application: Complete the application on the next page to join our general talent pool.
  2. Host Site Review: Our host site organization will review your application, and invite those moving forward to interview.
  3. Lead For America Interview: Finalist candidates will be invited to interview with the Lead For America team.

Benefits

Full-time ACC Members receive:

  • A $23,300 living stipend (dispersed bi-weekly over the course of the service term)
  • A $5,220 Segal Education Award through AmeriCorps, which can be applied to education-related expenses after the program concludes (including repayment of qualifying student loans).
  • Healthcare coverage (if applicable).
  • Access to childcare benefits.
  • Student loan forbearance during your year of service.
  • Fully-funded ACC Winter Institute druing the year.

Non-Discrimination

This institution operates in accordance with Federal and AmeriCorps civil rights and non-discrimination requirements. This program is available to all. All program documents, including compliance history information, may be made available in languages other than English. Persons with disabilities who require alternative means of communication to obtain program information (e.g. Braille, large print, audiotape, American Sign Language), should contact us at ACCinfo@leadforamerica.org

Note: The ACC program does not offer part-time or remote member positions at this time.

title: Regional Vice President of Commerce
description:
About the role

Stream Companies is seeking an experienced, proactive sales professional to help grow our business outside the automotive vertical. Reporting to the EVP of Growth, the Regional Vice President of Commerce will identify prospective clients, develop relationships, and sell Stream’s full-service marketing and advertising offering.

This is an individual contributor role with ownership of the sales process—from target identification and outreach through discovery, proposal development, formal presentations, follow-up, negotiation, and signed agreement.

Priority industries include HVAC and other home services, retail and point-of-sale businesses, funeral homes. Additional opportunities may include plumbing, electrical, roofing, specialty retail, franchise businesses, and other multi-location consumer services.

What you'll do

  • Partner with the EVP of Commerce to establish target accounts, prioritize industries, and execute a plan for new revenue growth.
  • Identify and research prospects based on their business needs, growth potential, and fit with Stream’s services.
  • Generate opportunities through direct outreach, networking, referrals, and collaboration with internal teams.
  • Lead discovery conversations to understand each prospect’s goals, challenges, current marketing approach, budget, and decision-making process.
  • Develop tailored proposals with support from Stream’s strategy, creative, media, and other subject matter experts.
  • Deliver at least six formal sales presentations to qualified prospects per quarter, connecting recommended services to clear business objectives.
  • Maintain consistent follow-up, address objections, negotiate terms, and move opportunities through to signed agreements.
  • Keep accurate CRM records, including prospect activity, opportunity stage, projected revenue, next steps, and expected close dates.
  • Provide pipeline updates and revenue forecasts to the EVP of Commerce.
  • Coordinate a clear handoff to account management and delivery teams, ensuring client expectations and commitments are documented.
  • Share market feedback to help refine Stream’s positioning and approach within non-automotive industries.

Qualifications

  • Five or more years of sales experience, with a demonstrated record of winning new business.
  • Experience managing the full sales process, including prospecting, discovery, proposals, presentations, negotiation, and closing.
  • Ability to translate business challenges into compelling marketing and advertising recommendations.
  • Strong presentation, communication, relationship-building, and follow-up skills.
  • A disciplined approach to pipeline management, forecasting, and CRM documentation.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment while collaborating across teams.

Preferred Experience

  • Sales experience within an advertising agency, marketing services company, or related business.
  • Familiarity with integrated offerings such as paid media, SEO, websites, creative, and marketing strategy.
  • Experience selling to home services, retail, funeral services, franchise organizations, or multi-location businesses.
  • An established network within one or more target industries.

What Success Looks Like

Success will be measured by new revenue generated, qualified pipeline development, opportunity progression, and consistent execution of six or more formal pitches per quarter. The ideal candidate will build strong prospect relationships, present thoughtful proposals, and convert opportunities into signed business.

Job Title

Mechatronics & Robotics Technician

Job Description Summary

Job Description

At C&W Services, we live by the belief that Better Never Settles. We're dedicated to creating a positive impact globally, and we're looking for talented individuals to join our team.

C&W Services provides compelling benefits, including:

  • Weekly Pay
  • Comprehensive Benefits that start on your first day
  • Training, Development, and Advancement Opportunities
  • A Clean and Cutting-Edge Facility
  • A Safety-First Culture

About the Role

As a Mechatronics & Robotics Technician, you will use your skills to support the Operations Maintenance Team repairing and maintaining material handling equipment and pneumatic systems throughout the building. You will have the opportunity to install, maintain and repair automated packaging and distribution equipment.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Safety: Promote a safe working environment by following all safety procedures.
  • Maintenance: Complete preventative maintenance routines with proper documentation. Troubleshoot electrical and mechanical problems related to all Material Handling Equipment (MHE) which includes belts, motors, photo-eyes, relays, and more.
  • Monitoring: Create, assign, and close out work order with data including labor hours, equipment maintenance, and parts used. Track and store department inventory.
  • Support: Mentor junior technicians to grow in their roles.
  • Communication: Maintain positive working relationships across all of the Operations facility.

Basic Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • 2+ years of experience in the repair of material handling equipment (MHE) or automated conveyor systems and controls.
  • 2+ years of experience conducting predictive and preventative maintenance procedures.
  • 1+ years of blueprint and electrical schematic reading.
  • 1+ years of knowledge with electrical and electronic principles.
  • Experience with a Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS).
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Project, with the ability to create and manage documents effectively.
  • Ability to work flexible schedules/shifts.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Associates or higher degree from a vocational school or college with a focus on Mechanical or Electrical field.
  • Experience with Material Handling Equipment (MHE) safety standards accordance with Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) and Safety standards.
  • Experience with robotic operation and maintenance.
  • Able to troubleshoot basic input and output functions.

Physical Demands:

  • Must have ability to reach overhead, kneel, squat, climb steps/ladders, use an aerial lift, and frequently lift a maximum of 50 lbs. of equipment.
  • Ability to perform tasks wearing appropriate or required Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), which may include but is not limited to hard hat, face mask, face shield, and composite toe shoes.
  • Regularly required to crouch or bend and reach to install/move equipment.
  • Involves movement between departments, floors, and properties to facilitate work, averaging 6 to 12 miles per day.
  • Work in a warehouse environment with fluctuating temperatures.
  • Regularly required to type on a computer for 1-2 hours per day.

Why C&W Services?

We're a global company with over 400 offices in 60 countries. We're proud of our diverse family of employees and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace. We're recognized by the Human Rights Foundation as a Best Place to Work for LGBTQI+ individuals and are dedicated to continuing to build a culture of inclusion and respect.

What’s Next?

Ready to take the next steps in your career? Apply today and be part of a team that is making a difference!

title: Construction Project Manager
description:
About Milan Laser Hair Removal

At Milan Laser Hair Removal, we're not just transforming skin—we're transforming confidence. As the nation's largest laser hair removal provider, we're built on a culture of excellence, innovation, and delivering a world-class experience for both our clients and our team.

We're looking for a Construction Project Manager who is highly organized, detail-oriented, and experienced in managing commercial construction projects from planning through completion. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys managing multiple projects, solving problems, and working with contractors and cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality results.

You'll play an important role in Milan's continued growth by overseeing new clinic construction and remodel projects across our nationwide network, ensuring each location is completed on schedule and meets our quality standards.

About the Role

The Construction Project Manager oversees the execution of new clinic construction and remodel projects from design development through clinic opening. You'll manage construction schedules, coordinate contractors and vendors, monitor project progress, and ensure each location is delivered according to established timelines, budgets, and quality expectations.

This role works closely with Milan's internal teams, general contractors, and external partners to keep projects moving forward. You'll be responsible for identifying potential delays, resolving construction challenges, and ensuring completed sites are ready for a successful transition to our New Clinic Opening team.

We're looking for someone who can balance multiple projects, communicate effectively with stakeholders, and take ownership of delivering results in a fast-paced, growing organization.

Status: Full-time | Salaried
Location: Omaha, NE | On-Site

Travel: Up to 50%, including out-of-state and overnight travel

What You'll Do

Construction Project Management & Execution

  • Manage new clinic construction and remodel projects from design development through completion and clinic opening.
  • Oversee project schedules, milestones, and deliverables to ensure projects remain on track.
  • Coordinate with general contractors, vendors, and internal teams to resolve challenges and maintain project progress.
  • Manage the transition of completed construction projects to the New Clinic Opening team, ensuring outstanding contractor work is completed before setup begins.

Scheduling & Project Coordination

  • Develop and maintain master construction schedules for assigned projects.
  • Monitor construction progress, identify potential delays, and work with contractors to implement recovery plans when needed.
  • Track procurement and delivery timelines for materials and equipment to prevent project delays.
  • Maintain accurate project tracking tools and provide regular updates on construction milestones.

Design & Construction Planning

  • Partner with internal design teams and external consultants on clinic layouts, scopes of work, and material selections.
  • Review construction plans to ensure projects align with Milan's design standards and operational needs.
  • Provide construction and field expertise to identify potential challenges and ensure designs can be executed within project timelines.

Budget & Contract Management

  • Support the development of project cost estimates, budgets, and financial forecasts.
  • Participate in contractor bidding and selection processes, providing recommendations on vendors and general contractors.
  • Review construction contracts, change orders, and payment applications, coordinating approvals as needed.
  • Monitor project costs and communicate budget risks or concerns to leadership.

Field Oversight & Quality Assurance

  • Visit construction sites to monitor progress, inspect workmanship, and ensure projects meet Milan's construction and quality standards.
  • Coordinate required inspections and verify compliance with applicable building codes, permits, and safety regulations.
  • Partner with general contractors to resolve construction issues, address deficiencies, and complete outstanding punch list items.
  • Ensure each completed project meets established quality expectations before clinic turnover.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Reporting

  • Work closely with internal departments to align construction milestones with clinic opening timelines and operational needs.
  • Maintain clear communication with contractors, vendors, and internal stakeholders throughout each project.
  • Provide regular updates to leadership on project progress, schedules, budgets, risks, and key performance indicators.
  • Identify opportunities to improve construction processes, project coordination, and overall execution.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of construction project management experience.
  • Experience managing multi-site commercial, retail, or healthcare construction and build-out projects.
  • Demonstrated experience managing construction schedules, project milestones, and long-lead procurement timelines.
  • Experience contributing to construction cost estimates, project budgets, and financial forecasting.
  • Experience negotiating and administering construction contracts, including change orders.
  • Ability to read and interpret construction drawings, specifications, and submittals.
  • Working knowledge of mechanical, electrical, and plumbing (MEP) systems.
  • Understanding of building codes, permitting processes, and construction safety regulations.
  • Experience presenting project status, budget updates, and potential risks to executive leadership.
  • Proficiency with project management software, spreadsheets, and collaboration tools.
  • Strong organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and priorities.
  • Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Architecture, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Ability to travel up to 50% of the time, including overnight and out-of-state travel.
  • Valid driver's license.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's degree in Construction Management, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Project Management Professional (PMP) or Certified Construction Manager (CCM) certification.
  • Experience working in an environment where project performance is measured through established KPIs.

What Sets You Apart

  • You're highly organized and can confidently manage multiple construction projects, timelines, and stakeholders at once.

  • You take ownership of your projects and proactively identify challenges before they impact schedules or budgets.
  • You're comfortable working directly with contractors, vendors, and leadership to keep projects moving forward.
  • You have a strong eye for detail and take pride in delivering high-quality construction projects.
  • You're a natural problem-solver who can navigate unexpected challenges and find practical solutions.
  • You communicate clearly, build strong working relationships, and know how to hold partners accountable.
  • You enjoy a mix of hands-on fieldwork and project planning and thrive in a fast-paced, growing organization.

Why You'll Love Working Here

  • Be part of a fast-growing, nationally recognized brand.
  • Play a direct role in Milan's continued expansion by bringing new clinic locations to life.
  • Manage a variety of construction and remodel projects across our nationwide clinic network.
  • Work closely with leadership, internal teams, and external construction partners.
  • Have a meaningful impact on project quality, efficiency, and successful clinic openings.
  • Join a collaborative culture that values ownership, continuous improvement, and new ideas.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and career development.

Benefits

  • Medical, dental, vision, disability and life insurance within 30 days
  • Unlimited PTO - work with your manager and take time as needed
  • 6 Paid holidays
  • $50 cellphone stipend paid out monthly
  • 401k retirement plan with vested 4% employer match after 90 days
  • Career advancement opportunities

The requirements listed are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Other duties may be assigned.
