title: Front-End Engineer
description:
Gumball builds consumer web experiences and the internal tools used to manage them. Our products include mobile-first acquisition funnels, dynamic forms and surveys, administrative tools, and reporting interfaces used across multiple brands.


We are hiring a Front-End Engineer to turn product requirements into clear, responsive, and reliable interfaces. You will work across customer-facing sites and internal tools, make practical design decisions, and collaborate with a senior engineer who provides the backend services your work requires.


Our current front-end stack is TypeScript, React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Radix UI, and Material UI. It is a starting point, not a fixed requirement for every future problem. You should be comfortable working in this stack while remaining flexible enough to evaluate and adopt different tools when the product’s needs justify them. Most customer traffic is mobile, so mobile behavior is a core engineering requirement.

What you will do

  • Build and maintain responsive customer-facing experiences and internal web applications.
  • Create forms, surveys, editors, dashboards, and reusable interface components that are clear to first-time users.
  • Translate written requirements, brand direction, and stakeholder feedback into finished interfaces.
  • Make thoughtful decisions about layout, typography, interaction, and responsive behavior. Collaborate with the senior engineer and stakeholders when a decision affects product behavior, shared systems, or more than one brand.
  • Work with the senior engineer to define the solution. They provide the backend services and data contracts; you integrate them into the interface and identify what the front end still needs.
  • Handle loading, success, empty, validation, and failure states instead of treating the first render as complete.
  • Build for mobile use, accessibility, browser compatibility, and maintainability.
  • Test your work as a user, document the results, and respond to feedback from quality assurance and code review.
  • Keep tickets and pull requests aligned when requirements change.
  • Support production incidents when assigned by the Engineering Lead.

What we are looking for

  • Professional experience building and shipping front-end web applications, regardless of framework.
  • Experience building responsive, mobile-first web applications.
  • Strong command of HTML, CSS, component design, forms, validation, and browser behavior.
  • The ability to make sound interface decisions without requiring a finished design for every screen.
  • Experience integrating front-end applications with APIs or database-backed services.
  • A record of owning work through implementation, testing, pull-request review, and follow-up.
  • Clear written communication and the judgment to ask for input before assumptions become rework.
  • Availability during the team’s Eastern Time workday.

Helpful, not required

  • React, TypeScript, Next.js App Router, Tailwind CSS, Radix UI, or Material UI.
  • Consumer acquisition funnels, multi-step forms, survey builders, or administrative tools.
  • Complex forms, validation, data tables, drag-and-drop editors, rich text, data visualization, or conditional interfaces.
  • Front-end performance, automated testing, or accessibility work.

How the team works

You report to the Engineering Lead, who is also the senior engineer, and work closely with the Technical Project Manager and business stakeholders. The Engineering Lead partners with you on the solution and provides the backend your interface needs. You own the quality, usability, and implementation of the front end.


Salary

The pay range for this role is:

$80,000.00 - $100,000.00 USD per year (Remote (United States))

PROGRAM MANAGEMENT CAREER STREAM: Program Managers and Directors focus on tactical, operational activities for a major program with broad or ongoing impact. Levels within the program management career stream typically accomplish program objectives through matrixed employee teams and / or vendors who are not direct reports but for which the incumbent has direct accountability to lead. The majority of time is spent overseeing their area of responsibility, managing program/team performance, communicating project and operational developments, planning, prioritizing and / or directing the responsibilities of program team members. Goal achievement is typically accomplished through performance of program team members.

DIFFERENTIATING FACTORS

Autonomy: Manages one or more medium-scale, established programs with generally-defined program plans and delivery methodologies. Is accountable for overall program process, performance, and customer satisfaction.

Organizational Impact: Participates in establishing program objectives, timelines, milestones, and budgets . Develops new policies and procedures that affect program management. Typically has budget accountability for one or more programs. Program decisions are generally recommended to higher level management.

Innovation and Complexity: Problems and issues faced are difficult and undefined, and require detailed information gathering, analysis and investigation to understand the problem. Problems typically impact multiple workstreams, departments or specialties . Enhances programs management processes to improve program.

Communication and Influence: Communicates and leads meetings with internal and external customers and vendors, conducts briefings to higher level management team. title: Senior Tax Reporting Specialist for Global Tax Reporting
description:
Where expertise meets impact: join us and help shape Saxo’s global CRS and FATCA tax reporting.


About the Job

Saxo is seeking a Senior Tax Reporting Specialist to join our Global Tax Reporting team with a specific focus on CRS and FATCA reporting. In this role, you will play a crucial part in navigating the complex tax landscape, ensuring Saxo's compliance with CRS and FATCA regulations. You will drive activities across jurisdictions to ensure Saxo's compliance with relevant legislation, market practices, and internal rules.

At Saxo, we pride ourselves on fostering a growth-embracing culture. You thrive in a dynamic, ambitious, yet informal and welcoming work environment. We are committed to your personal and professional development, offering ample opportunities for career advancement. Work alongside the best in the industry and make a real impact.


Responsibilities

As our new Senior Tax Reporting Specialist, you will play a key role in ensuring accurate and compliant CRS and FATCA reporting, with a strong focus on data analysis, due diligence and reporting controls. You will work hands-on with large and complex data sets throughout the end-to-end reporting process and help ensure that reporting data is complete, accurate and ready for submission.

In addition, you will contribute to defining and maintaining reporting requirements and ensuring that reportable amounts and personally identifiable information (PII) data fields are correctly specified and delivered in the required formats.


Other responsibilities include:

  • Preparing, analysing and validating large data sets used for CRS and FATCA due diligence and reporting.
  • Performing due diligence activities, including generating, testing and validating data to identify inconsistencies, exceptions and potential reporting issues.
  • Designing, implementing and maintaining data-driven controls and reconciliations to ensure completeness and accuracy throughout the reporting process.
  • Investigating data discrepancies and reporting errors, identifying root causes and supporting their resolution.
  • Developing and maintaining efficient Excel-based analyses, validation models and other tools supporting the reporting process.
  • Acting as a frontrunner in identifying and implementing AI and automation opportunities across tax reporting processes, data analysis and controls, with the aim of reducing manual activities and improving efficiency, scalability and quality.
  • Maintaining a comprehensive log of reporting errors and supporting mitigation and remediation activities.
  • Working closely with technology and other stakeholders to translate reporting requirements into clear data and system requirements.
  • Monitoring changes to reporting requirements and XML schemas and assessing their impact on data, controls and reporting processes.
  • Delivering CRS and FATCA reports globally to high standards of completeness, accuracy and timeliness.

Your profile

We are looking for someone who enjoys working hands-on with data and investigating why numbers or data do not look as expected. You have a strong analytical mindset and are comfortable working with large and complex data sets, identifying patterns, exceptions and inconsistencies.

You are structured and detail-oriented, but also able to understand the bigger picture and translate regulatory requirements into practical data checks and controls. You take ownership of your work, enjoy solving complex problems and are motivated by continuously improving and automating processes.

You are also curious about how AI, automation and emerging technologies can improve the way tax reporting is performed, and you are motivated to take a leading role in identifying and implementing new solutions within the team.


Further:

  • Relevant degree in accounting, finance, economics, data analytics, business administration or a related field, combined with strong practical experience in data analysis and reporting.
  • Strong experience working with large and complex data sets and performing data analysis and validation.
  • Experience designing or operating data controls, reconciliations and exception-based reviews.
  • Advanced Excel skills, including experience building structured models using complex formulas, data validation and data transformation.
  • Experience with Power BI, SQL or similar data analysis tools is a strong advantage.
  • Strong interest in AI and automation and the ability to identify practical opportunities for applying new technologies to reporting processes and controls.
  • Experience with financial, regulatory or tax reporting is an advantage.
  • Experience with CRS and FATCA is a plus, but not a prerequisite if you have a strong data and reporting background.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and an ability to investigate data issues systematically from identification through to root cause.
  • Ability to communicate clearly and confidently in English, both verbally and in writing.

We get curious people invested in the world

When you work at Saxo, you become a Saxonian and part of a purpose-driven organisation, where good ideas are always taken seriously, and where you can make a true impact. We are invested in your development, and you can expect a robust career from day one when you join Saxo – no matter which role you take on.

You will join 2,500 other ambitious colleagues across 11 countries and become part of an international organisation. Working in Saxo, you will get to meet colleagues from many different cultures and backgrounds, and you should know that we value diversity and inclusion and see it as a genuine source of strength to drive growth, foster innovation and position us for long-term success.

We encourage an open feedback culture and supportive team environments enabling employees to grow and fulfil their career aspirations.

When you bring passion, curiosity, drive and team spirit, your learning journey will be dynamic and your career opportunities in Saxo will be immense.

At Saxo we don’t just offer a job – we offer an opportunity to invest in your future!


How to apply :

Click here to create an account and upload your resume and a short motivation. We look forward to getting to know you better!

  • Experience or a keen interest in internal Risk & Quality within a professional services firm or law practice.
  • Strong analytical and research skills and appetite for problem solving in a dynamic environment.
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills and strong leadership and coaching experience.

  • Ability to build strong, trust based relationships and influence with impact.
  • Confidence to work and communicate with people at all levels of seniority as well as external stakeholders.
  • Capability to deliver tangible commercial outcomes in a fast paced environment.
  • Confidence to learn and utilise internal systems and are competent in the use of AI tools.

  • Familiarity with legal services in the context of Corporate & Commercial law, Employment Law or Tax Law.
  • Experience in a multidisciplinary professional firm would be highly valued.

Responsibilities:

Performs functions associated with patient information processing for ambulatory care visits. Completes the tasks of reception, registration, charge reconciliation process, appointment scheduling, eRecord task management, In Basket management and Telephone encounter management using the electronic medical record and patient access and revenue cycle systems. Ensures patient satisfaction with information processing and reception service. Requires accuracy in order to generate a billable service for the provider. Responsible for functions being completed in an accurate, efficient, and customer friendly manner. May act as a resource to new staff.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

  • Greets patients to initiate positive ambulatory experience, requests patient identification, ensures use of two identifiers to verify the correct patient, identifies healthcare provider to be seen, identifies referring provider and primary care physician, directs patients to next destination, obtains signatures as needed, identifies and assesses patients’ special needs, and monitors reception area to ensure patient needs are met. Provides interaction of warm hand-off to registration and insurance management (RIM). Updates patients regarding waiting time for the provider every 15 minutes. Protects Personal Health Information (PHI) for patients as indicated by HIPAA regulations. Ensures cleanliness and order in the waiting room/lobby.
  • Collects patient demographic and financial information in an efficient, customer-oriented manner. Asks specific questions of patient to verify information accuracy to establish a billable account. Enters information into electronic medical record (EMR) and patient access and revenue cycle system. Requests patient e-mail address for confirmation purposes. Ensures completion of all appropriate forms by patients, such as Medicare Secondary Payer assurance, provision of HIPAA information for new patients, requesting patient identification to verify identity, provision of Financial Assistance Program, etc.
  • Schedules new and return visits to ambulatory care using the electronic medical record and patient access and revenue cycle system, monitors schedules and reports problems to Supervisor, pre-registers patients for next visit, coordinates appointments for ancillary testing or referrals to other clinic sites, follows-up missed appointments and cancellations, completes any correspondence or forms involved with appointment scheduling, schedules interpreters, schedules outside services to meet patient’s needs, and ensures patient satisfaction with visit prior to discharge from the area. Prints After Visit Summary (AVS) at check-out when appropriate, uses two patient identifiers to ensure provision of the summary to the correct patient. May assist with provider template changes. Collects patient co-pays, prepares end of day deposits and reconciles any discrepancies.
  • Answers phone in a timely and courteous manner. Manages incoming clinic calls and sorts calls to various providers. Opens telephone encounter in EMR when speaking with patients. Ensures routing of encounter in EMR to the appropriate staff/provider. Coordinates outgoing calls related to major functions above. Provides information to patients to minimize the need to distribute the telephone call, forwards calls, pages providers, and takes messages.
  • Edits and corrects registration errors and completes missing registration data. Assists in charge reconciliation process. Ensures accuracy of patient schedules. Identifies ways to reduce follow-up, repetitive, or corrective work. Manages multiple processes in EMR, including messaging in In Basket and referral work queue processing, which is part of the patient legal medical record, therefore, ensures accurate and concise information is entered.
  • Assesses the urgency of a situation and determines appropriate routing for the patient, serves as a resource for handling complaints, utilizes service recovery concepts, serves as front-line problem solver.
  • May escort patient into the treatment corridor, collects height and weight information, records list of current medication, records basic visit documentation, obtains vital signs, etc. Competencies must be verified by clinical staff before performance of any of these duties.
  • Other duties as assigned.

  • High School diploma and 1 year related experience in an administrative office or customer service field required or
  • Completion of Vision Care 1,2,3 courses required
  • Or equivalent combination of education and experience

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES

To ensure that our testing tools and information systems remain future-proof, you will take the lead in modernizing and developing our software solutions. In addition, you will advise stakeholders across the value chain on quantitative issues.

In this role, you will:

  • Future-proof actuarial models by translating them into Python code
  • Provide subject-matter expertise to strategic projects and migration programs
  • Develop testing software to safeguard the actuarial accuracy of calculation engines and IT systems

What we offer you
NN invests in an inclusive, inspiring work environment and in skills and competences for the future. We match this with employee benefits that are in line with what is needed today and in the future. This way, we offer our employees the opportunity to get the best out of themselves. We offer you:

  • Salary between €3,891 and €5,188 based on a 36-hour work week, depending on your knowledge and experience
  • 13th month and holiday allowance are paid with your monthly salary
  • 27 vacation days for a 5-day working week and three Diversity Days
  • A modern pension administered by BeFrank
  • Plenty of training and learning opportunities
  • NS Business Card 2nd class, which gives you unlimited travel, also privately
    Do you prefer to travel with your own transport? Then you can declare the kilometers travelled
  • Allowances for setting up your home office and for internet use

Who you are

You have a strong quantitative background, enjoy intellectual challenges, and have an affinity for IT. You can quickly find your way through mathematical models and are able to translate complex code into clear and understandable language. You are positive, enjoy sharing ideas, and are open to different perspectives, making you a valued and collaborative colleague.

In addition, you have:

  • A Master's degree or equivalent academic working and thinking level
  • Experience programming in Python; knowledge of VBA and/or object-oriented languages such as C# or Java is a plus
  • Knowledge of statistical methods and the ability to explain complex analyses clearly to stakeholders
  • A curious, pragmatic mindset and a strong drive to get things done
  • C2-level proficiency in Dutch

Who you will work with

The Insurance Technology team is part of the Expert Center Services within NN Life & Pensions. Together with 13 experienced Modelers, Analysts, Actuaries, and Testing Experts, we serve as the actuarial center of expertise within the Services domain.

Working in multidisciplinary teams, we collaborate closely with colleagues from IT, Legal, Finance, and Risk Management.

We work in a hybrid environment with flexible working hours. Dedicated office days enable us to meet and collaborate in person, while the right tools and facilities allow us to stay connected and work effectively from home.

title: QA Specialist III
description:
Quality Assurance Specialist III

Location: Houston, Texas – Onsite

Shift: Sunday through Thursday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM


As a Quality Assurance Specialist III, you will serve as a key representative of the Quality Assurance organization, ensuring quality and compliance standards are maintained across aseptic manufacturing operations. This role provides the opportunity to partner closely with Manufacturing, Quality Control, Engineering, and support teams to support production activities, provide quality oversight, maintain cGMP compliance, and help deliver life-changing therapies to patients. The successful candidate will be responsible for quality decision-making, investigation support, batch record review, and driving compliance initiatives within a regulated GMP manufacturing environment.


What you will get:


A competitive compensation package. In addition, below you will find a comprehensive summary of the benefits package we offer:


  • Performance-related bonus
  • Medical, dental and vision insurance
  • 401(k) matching plan
  • Life insurance, as well as short-term and long-term disability insurance
  • Employee assistance programs
  • Paid time off (PTO)

Compensation for this role will be determined by the candidate’s qualifications, skills, experience, and relevant knowledge.


What you will do:


  • Verify compliance with ISO, cGMP quality system requirements, FDA regulations, and other applicable regulatory guidance.
  • Perform QA walkthroughs and work closely with Manufacturing and support groups to identify, investigate, and resolve quality and compliance issues.
  • Provide independent quality oversight and make quality-related decisions based on regulatory and compliance knowledge.
  • Review and approve Master Batch Records (MBRs), executed batch records, and supporting GMP documentation to support manufacturing operations and product release activities.
  • Support and oversee investigations, deviations, environmental monitoring events, laboratory investigations, and root cause analysis activities.
  • Provide quality support for aseptic manufacturing operations, including real-time decision making during production activities.
  • Become gown-qualified and provide on-floor QA support within classified manufacturing environments.
  • Manage multiple priorities and projects simultaneously while supporting quality system initiatives and continuous improvement efforts.
  • Lead or support special projects and additional QA compliance activities as assigned by QA leadership.

What we are looking for:


  • Bachelor’s degree in a scientific, technical, engineering, or related discipline required.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in a cGMP-regulated manufacturing environment and related Quality Assurance field.
  • Previous Quality Assurance and/or Quality Control experience within pharmaceutical, biologics, cell therapy, or GMP manufacturing operations.
  • Experience supporting investigations, deviations, root cause analysis, and quality system processes.
  • Knowledge of GMP regulations, including 21 CFR Parts 210, 211, and 820, as well as ISO quality standards and data integrity requirements preferred.
  • Familiarity with aseptic manufacturing environments and cleanroom operations.
  • Experience reviewing GMP documentation, batch records, and deviation records with strong attention to detail.
  • Strong critical-thinking skills with the ability to make independent quality decisions in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications; experience with TrackWise, DMS, SAP, and LIMS systems preferred.
  • Strong communication, technical writing, time management, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects concurrently while maintaining a high level of quality and compliance.

About Lonza


At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

title: Lifestart Director
description:
Lead the scale-up of Lifestart from a fragmented and entrepreneurial set-up into a scalable, globally coordinated and commercially sustainable growth platform.

The Lifestart Director owns the Hatchery business, including its functional P&L, commercial performance, production, warehousing and operational delivery across the relevant countries and operating units.

For Nursery, ownership and P&L accountability remain with the Business Units; the Director provides global direction, coordination, alignment with innovation, and constructive performance challenge.

The Director also guides the business priorities for Lifestart R&D, while formal ownership of R&D development remains with Skretting Innovation.

Job Description:

Get ready to Own the future of Lifestart as a Lifestart Director at Skretting, a Nutreco company. As global leaders in animal nutrition and aquafeed, our shared purpose of Feeding the Future is making a positive global impact for generations to come. Step into this transformational leadership role and Own the future of Lifestart—through vision, innovation and impact.

What you’ll do

Lifestart has been established as one of Skretting's strategic growth priorities within the North Star strategy. As Lifestart Director, you will lead the development of this business platform and play a key role in delivering the ambition to significantly accelerate growth, value creation and market leadership.

You will own the global Hatchery business and functional P&L while providing strategic leadership and coordination for Nursery activities across the Business Units. Working across commercial, operations, technical, innovation and leadership teams, you will align priorities, build capabilities and create the operating model required to scale Lifestart into a globally coordinated business.


Key areas of focus include:

  • Leading the global Hatchery business, including commercial performance, operations, production, supply network and profitability.
  • Translating the Lifestart strategy into a scalable business model, governance framework and execution roadmap.
  • Partnering with Business Unit leaders to drive alignment, performance improvement and capability development across Nursery.
  • Shaping portfolio priorities and guiding the commercial direction of the Lifestart innovation agenda in partnership with Skretting Innovation.
  • Contributing as a member of the Skretting Leadership Team and supporting delivery of the broader North Star strategy.
  • Driving customer-led commercial growth through segmentation, value-based selling, key-account development and strategic partnerships.
  • Building the specialist commercial, technical and operational capabilities required to scale Lifestart globally.


Who we’re looking for

  • Proven senior leadership experience with direct business ownership and P&L accountability in an international and complex environment.
  • Strong commercial, strategic and financial acumen, with experience scaling businesses and delivering sustainable growth.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead through influence, navigate matrix organizations and align diverse stakeholder groups around a common objective.
  • Experience driving transformation, organizational development and capability building across multiple functions and geographies.
  • A collaborative and entrepreneurial leader who combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution and a strong ownership mindset.
  • Excellent communication and negotiation skills, with the willingness to travel frequently. Experience in aquaculture, animal nutrition or Lifestart is an advantage, but not essential.


What you’ll receive

This role offers a unique opportunity to lead one of Skretting's most important strategic growth platforms and shape the future direction of the Lifestart business globally.

You will gain:

  • Significant visibility across Skretting's global leadership team.
  • The opportunity to influence strategy, innovation, commercial performance and organizational design.
  • Exposure to complex international business challenges and growth opportunities.
  • A platform to build cross-functional leadership experience across commercial, operational and innovation disciplines.
  • The chance to play a pivotal role in establishing Skretting as the global leader in Lifestart nutrition.

This position represents an opportunity to make a lasting impact on one of Skretting's most important strategic priorities. Combining business ownership, strategy execution, innovation leadership and organizational development, the role offers the scope to shape both the future of Lifestart and the future of Skretting's growth agenda.

Further details about the role and broader business context will be shared as part of the interview process.






Our organisation:

Skretting is a global leader in providing innovative and sustainable nutritional solutions and services for the aquaculture industry. Skretting has production facilities in 18 countries on five continents to manufacture and deliver high quality feeds from hatching to harvest for more than 60 species. The total annual production volume of feed is close to 2.5 million tonnes. Our mission is Feeding the Future.

title: Design and Change Control Engineer
description:
KX Technologies LLC

As a part of the global industrial organization Marmon Holdings—which is backed by Berkshire Hathaway—you’ll be doing things that matter, leading at every level, and winning a better way. We’re committed to making a positive impact on the world, providing you with diverse learning and working opportunities, and fostering a culture where everyone’s empowered to be their best.

The Design and Change Control Engineer supports product design and owns the engineering change (EC) process. This role splits time between design work on new and existing products and managing engineering changes from request through release. The role works with engineering, manufacturing, quality, and supply chain to make sure designs and changes are accurate, on time, and meet company and industry requirements. The role will also be part of our centralized Design team, where they will support the design of global water filtration products.


Design Responsibilities

  • Create and update 3D models and detailed drawings in SolidWorks for new product development and existing products.
  • Design filtration components, housings, and test fixtures under the direction of senior engineers.
  • Apply dimensioning and tolerancing standards (GD&T) and perform basic tolerance checks.
  • Support prototype builds, 3D printing, and design verification testing.
  • Work with suppliers on part manufacturability, including injection molded parts.
  • Support cost reduction and sustaining engineering projects.

Change Control Responsibilities

  • Own the EC process, including ECR, ECO, and ECN. Receive requests and align with stakeholders on priority and ownership.
  • Facilitate impact reviews and approvals. Participate on the EC Board.
  • Implement changes in Epicor and maintain drawings, specifications, and bills of materials.
  • Check work for accuracy and completeness, and maintain EC records.
  • Maintain and improve change control tools and workflows.
  • Provide training and support to other teams, and support internal and external audits.

General Responsibilities

  • Lead engineering and cross-functional projects of low to moderate complexity from planning through completion.
  • Develop project plans, coordinate activities, track progress, and communicate status, risks, and decisions.
  • Work across engineering, manufacturing, quality, supply chain, and other functions to resolve issues and meet project objectives.
  • Manage multiple priorities and complete work accurately and on schedule.
  • Identify and implement practical improvements to products, processes, tools, and documentation.
  • Follow company quality, safety, regulatory, and documentation requirements.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field.
  • 2+ years’ experience in design engineering, engineering change control, or both, in a manufacturing environment.
  • Proficiency with SolidWorks, including detailed drawings.
  • Working knowledge of GD&T.
  • Experience with an engineering change process.
  • Experience entering and updating item and bill of materials records in an ERP system. Epicor preferred.
  • Strong attention to detail and clear written and verbal communication.

Nice to Have

  • Plastic part design and injection molding experience.
  • Knowledge of water filtration products and regulatory requirements, such as NSF/ANSI standards.
  • Experience with ISO-based quality systems.
  • Experience with Monday.com or similar workflow tools.

$75,000 - $80,000


Location:

West Haven, CT (On-site)

title: Data Engineer (Snowflake / DevOps & CI/CD) (1 Year Contract)
description:
We are looking for an experienced Data Engineer with a strong specialisation in DevOps and CI/CD to support the development, automation, and deployment of a Snowflake-based data platform.

In this role, you will design, implement, and maintain automated deployment pipelines to ensure that changes to Snowflake database objects, data pipelines, and platform configurations are consistently tested, version-controlled, and securely deployed across development, UAT, and production environments.

You will work closely with data engineers, solution architects, infrastructure, and security teams to establish reliable CI/CD processes, streamline deployments, and maintain a secure and scalable data platform.

This is a hands-on technical role suited to someone with strong experience in GitLab CI/CD, Snowflake, scripting, and deployment automation within enterprise environments. Responsibilities

CI/CD Pipeline Development & Automation Design, develop, and maintain GitLab CI/CD pipelines to automate the deployment of Snowflake database objects, data pipelines, and configuration changes. Implement version control, automated testing, approval workflows, and deployment controls across development, UAT, and production environments. Develop reusable deployment templates, scripts, and automation frameworks to standardise deployment processes. Automate environment configurations and ensure the controlled promotion of changes between environments. Support the provisioning, configuration, and maintenance of private CI/CD runners within secure network environments.

Snowflake Platform & Deployment Management Automate the deployment and management of Snowflake objects, including databases, schemas, roles, policies, views, Dynamic Tables, Streams, and Tasks. Implement deployment logging, monitoring, rollback, and recovery procedures to ensure platform reliability. Support the management of Snowflake role-based access controls (RBAC), permissions, and environment configurations. Troubleshoot deployment failures, pipeline issues, and configuration inconsistencies across environments. Collaborate with data engineering teams to ensure deployment processes align with platform architecture and engineering standards.

Security, Infrastructure & Platform Operations Work closely with infrastructure, security, and network teams to implement secure CI/CD processes and platform connectivity. Support secure network configurations, including PrivateLink, network policies, secrets management, and access controls. Implement and maintain deployment security standards, ensuring compliance with enterprise security requirements. Monitor Snowflake jobs, data pipelines, and platform health to identify and resolve operational issues. Identify opportunities to improve deployment efficiency, platform stability, and operational reliability.

Documentation & Collaboration Develop and maintain technical documentation, deployment procedures, CI/CD standards, and operational runbooks. Collaborate with solution architects, data engineers, and DevOps teams to improve engineering practices and deployment workflows. Provide technical guidance and knowledge transfer to engineering and operational teams. Support continuous improvement initiatives to enhance automation, deployment reliability, and platform maintainability.

Requirements

At least 4 years of experience in Data Engineering, DevOps, Platform Engineering, or related technical roles. Strong hands-on experience with GitLab CI/CD, Git, and automated deployment pipelines. Practical experience with Snowflake, including deploying and managing database objects through automated CI/CD pipelines. Strong proficiency in SQL and scripting languages such as Python and Shell scripting. Experience implementing automated testing, release management, deployment approval workflows, and rollback procedures. Good understanding of Snowflake security concepts, including RBAC, role grants, environment configurations, and secrets management. Experience working with cloud infrastructure, networking, and secure enterprise environments. Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, with the ability to diagnose deployment and platform issues. Good communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering, infrastructure, and security teams.

Good to Have

Experience with Terraform, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), or database change-management tools. Familiarity with enterprise CI/CD platforms and deployment automation frameworks. Experience working with Microsoft Azure or other cloud platforms. Relevant certifications in Snowflake, Azure, or DevOps.

title: #EG DevOps & Automation Engineer
description:
NCS is a leading technology services firm that operates across the Asia Pacific region in over 20 cities, providing consulting, digital services, technology solutions, and more. We believe in harnessing the power of technology to achieve extraordinary things, creating lasting value and impact for our communities, partners, and people. Our diverse workforce of 14,000 has delivered large-scale, mission-critical, and multi-platform projects for governments and enterprises in Singapore and the APAC region.

Job Description

As aDevOps & Automation Engineer, you will develop automation playbooks, runbooks, and cookbooks to streamline tasks related to service delivery and operations. This role involves implementing automation use cases in production environments, including support for modifications and troubleshooting. You will also manage the automation platform to ensure high availability and seamless operational performance, execute and oversee automation playbooks as part of day-to-day operational activities and handle operational tasks related to both the automation processes and the underlying automation platform.

Additionally, the role requires hands-on expertise in scripting languages such as Ansible, Python, Terraform, Chef, Groovy, and PowerShell, as well as experience in CI/CD pipelines, DevOps platform management, and cloud-based automation. You should be proactive, possess strong problem-solving skills, and have a passion for automation and process optimization.

What will you do?

Automation Development & Implementation

  • Understand automation concepts and their application in day-to-day service delivery and operations within IT Managed Services.
  • Operationalise and manage automation development initiatives to enhance productivity.
  • Develop automated scripts to test automation playbooks before deployment to production environments.
  • Possess strong knowledge of Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC), including code control and versioning best practices.

Platform & Infrastructure Management

  • Familiarity with integration of automation solutions with external tools such as ITSM platforms.
  • Ensure compliance with ITSM integration and other relevant system tools.

Service Delivery & Operational Efficiency

  • Understand automation concepts and their application in day-to-day service delivery and operations within IT Managed Services.
  • Ensure process efficiency, automation stability, and system reliability.
  • Drive continuous improvements through proactive automation development.

Qualifications

The ideal candidate should possess:

Experience

  • Ansible, Terraform, and Chefplatform setup, configuration, and management.
  • Code versioning, CI/CD, and automated testing.
  • DevOps platform setup and CI/CD pipeline deployment.
  • End-to-end implementation of IaC in managed services projects.

Technical & Professional Skills

  • Strong knowledge of Linux/Unix/Windows Administration.
  • Experience with automation/configuration management using Puppet, Chef, or Ansible.
  • Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL, MS SQL, and MySQL.
  • Proficiency in source code control, versioning, and automation tool integration.
  • Some knowledge in developing playbooks using RPA tools.
  • Certifications in DevOps or automation tools(preferred).

Non-Technical / Soft Skills

  • Strong problem-solving skillsand attention to detail.
  • Passion for programming and automation, with a proactive approach to process improvements.
  • Good understanding of systems, networking, and software development lifecycle.
  • Self-motivated, team player, and able to work independently.

Qualifications

  • Degree/Diplomain Computer Science, IT, or a related field.
  • Hands-on experience in developing Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC)using scripting languages such as Ansible, Python, Chef (Ruby), Terraform (HCL), Groovy, PowerShell, or Bash.

Additional Information

We are driven by our AEIOU beliefs—Adventure, Excellence, Integrity, Ownership, and Unity—and we seek individuals who embody these values in both their professional and personal lives. We are committed to our Impact: Valuing our clients, Growing our people, and Creating our future.

Together, we make the extraordinary happen.

title: Appraisal Junior Analyst
description:
Why Anchor Loans?


Anchor Loans is one of several operating companies owned by Pretium Partners (+$70B AUM Financial Services Entity) and is working diligently to expand and grow its lending footprint.


Anchor Loans, established in 1998, is the nation’s leading private, direct lender to experienced residential real estate investors and builders, and the first to surpass $10 billion in total fundings. Renowned for expediting financing for developers and investors, we specialize in bridge loans, ground-up construction, and single-family rental solutions for non-owner-occupied projects. Headquartered in beautiful Thousand Oaks, California, Anchor Loans currently lends in 48 states and is expanding into new markets and service lines to better serve our current and future borrowers.


Responsibilities

The work falls into seven areas. The first three follow the valuation order SOP; the last four keep cost, vendors and systems in order.


Document prep

  • Review ready orders in the Document Management System and send gaps back to the LAC as custom conditions.
  • Write the Value As statement, click Valuation Complete, and complete Confirm Documentation to run the Router.

Appraisal place and chase

  • Check the Router result, build the LOE, and source an appraiser within 48 hours inside approved fees.
  • Track to delivery, apply the missed delivery rule, and confirm the report has both AIV and ARV before review.

Hybrid inspections

  • Order in the Inspectify portal, track to delivery, and act on access alerts.
  • Upload the report to AGG and send it to the appraiser.

Commercial appraisal ordering and prep

  • Order commercial appraisals and environmental studies, and assemble the appraiser's package before engagement.
  • Check each report against the engagement before review.

Invoicing

  • Reconcile invoices against orders and approved fees, and resolve vendor disputes.
  • Close each month with every completed order matched to an invoice.

Cost analysis

  • Report cost and turn time by product path.
  • Track fees by market and vendor, and maintain vendor scorecards.

Appraisal portal optimization

  • Maintain the appraisal platforms and Inspectify portal, and support the move to ValueLink.
  • Replace manual steps with system events, and keep SOPs current.

Required

  • One internship preferred but not mandatory. Full-time availability.
  • Ability to read a purchase contract, rehab budget and construction plans and summarize what they say about the property.
  • Strong Excel: lookups, pivot tables, and reconciling two lists.
  • Professional written and spoken English for daily contact with US appraisers, vendors and loan staff.
  • Disciplined follow-up across many open orders, with every action recorded in the system as it happens.

Benefits:

The values of our employees reflect those of the company as a whole. If you embrace teamwork, innovation, and accountability you'll feel right at home. Our mission is to create opportunities for success by improving homes and communities. We set up our team members for success by offering a competitive benefits package that includes:

  • Colombian law benefits
  • Highly competitive performance bonus
  • 15 legal vacation paid days
  • Paid Colombian Holidays annually

All qualified candidates are welcome and will receive consideration for employment regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, sexual orientation, natural origin, disability, age, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

title: Shift Supervisor
description:
At Blue Bottle, our mission is to connect the world to delicious coffee. From seed to cup, we elevate the craft of coffee in everything we do. We strive to build a better tomorrow by investing in what matters: a sustainable future for our people, the company, and our planet.
About the Job
A Shift Supervisor serves as an integral member of leadership, spearheading efforts to consistently deliver exceptional hospitality and elevate the coffee experience, all while upholding stringent Cafe standards and driving toward established business objectives. Shift Supervisor fosters a culture of continuous learning within the Cafe, serving as a catalyst for inspiration and motivation among team members to continuously refine their skills and enhance performance.
While occupying a position of influence within the team, a Shift Supervisor operates without direct reports, leveraging their leadership to orchestrate collaborative efforts and drive collective success

You Will:

  • Possess comprehensive knowledge of Cafe expenditures and actively contribute to sales growth initiatives
  • Support ongoing operations and continuous improvement within the cafe, through the assigned operational area of focus, taking a proactive role in ensuring the right routines, processes, and tools are in place to enable the team’s success
  • Oversee service flow to uphold optimal levels of safety, cleanliness, quality, and efficiency
  • Execute essential operational support duties such as ordering, receiving, and managing inventory
  • Follow the Leader on Duty process and checklists by strategically deploying staff, overseeing breaks, and ensuring exceptional hospitality and adherence to Blue Bottle's standards for beverage and food preparation
  • Facilitate the onboarding and training of new team members, ensuring seamless integration into the team
  • Assume responsibility for cash handling and daily deposits
  • Promptly address guest concerns within the Cafe
  • Report incidents of illness and injury as per protocol
  • Provide guidance to team members on new menu offerings and operational procedures
  • Lead efforts to achieve company-wide sustainability objectives, actively engaging your team in these initiatives
  • Consistently prepare and serve beverages and food items to the highest quality standards
  • Take charge of supervising high-performing team members
  • Demonstrate exemplary behavior as a role model for your team members, consistently setting high standards and continuously striving for improvement, and lead with Omotenashi in mind
  • Foster a culture of curiosity and ongoing learning, participating in tastings, cuppings, and training sessions to deepen your understanding of coffee
  • Ensure compliance with company standards and safety protocols, fostering a culture of continuous improvement through constructive feedback and support to promote a safe and respectful workplace environment for all team members

You Are:

  • A leader who is passionate about training and helping to develop a team
  • Aware of your impact on others, and seek regular feedback to continually improve
  • A strong communicator who can provide impactful and motivating feedback to improve the team’s beverage, food, and hospitality delivery
  • Always curious, you are excited about finding new ways to delight our guests
  • Savvy with your resources, with the ability to make decisions and problem-solve
  • Dedicated to your team and your guests, you understand and value empathy and use it to guide interactions on and off the job
  • Passionate about the planet and creating a sustainable future for our people, the company, and our planet
  • Eligible to work in the United States and 18 years of age or older

You Have:

  • 6 months to 1 year of supervisory experience or experience in team leadership
  • Completed Blue Bottle Academy’s Barista training and validation program or will complete it within 90 days post-hire
  • Existing Food Safety Certification required for the state you will be working in and for your specific role, or will obtain it within 30 days post-hire
  • Basic math and computer skills
  • A flexible schedule and are available to work mornings, evenings, weekends, and holidays

A few benefits we offer:

  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage for eligible employees starting on your first day
  • Best-in-class coffee training and continuing education
  • Free membership into the Specialty Coffee Association of America and discounts on events (including Expos and Championships)
  • 401(k) plan
  • Paid time off & paid volunteer hours
  • 50% discount on all products, both online and in-cafe; this includes food, beverages, whole-bean coffee, and merchandise
  • 2 free drinks during shifts for cafe team members
  • Flexible spending account & commuter benefits
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Additional benefits information

Our Shift Supervisor position is a dynamic one! Below, we’ve mapped out the physical demands that are essential to the role:

  • Ability to stand and walk for long periods of time; you’re on your feet the majority of the day, whether you are standing behind bar pulling shots or walking the cafe floor
  • Use of hands to reach, grip, turn, and perform precision work; you’re using your hands to operate beautiful espresso machines, pour delicious pour overs, and operate the register (among other responsibilities)
  • As needed, squat, bend, twist, and reach for items below waist level or above shoulders; for example, you may have to bend down or reach up to grab cups, lids, and towels
  • Ability to lift, push/pull, carry, and/or move up to 50 pounds; for example, you’ll be handling bags of coffee beans, coffee kegs, crates of milk, tubs of dishes, and trash bins
  • As needed, climb ladders, stairs, ramps, and uneven floors and/or surfaces; for example, climb on a step stool to change menu slats or go up and down stairs and ramps to storage areas
  • Ability to smell and taste; you’re tasting and smelling coffee and food, helping ensure quality control for each cup and plate
  • Ability to listen and speak; you’re listening and speaking with our guests to take and fill orders, and guide and create experiences
  • The role is performed in an environment that may involve exposure to environmental conditions, including elevated temperatures from food and beverage preparation equipment, and cooler temperatures in refrigerated spaces

Compensation:

  • $20.20 per hour + tips averaging approximately $6-$9 dollars per shift hour

We comply with the ADA and provide reasonable accommodations that allow qualified applicants/employees to perform the essential functions of the job. title: Sr. Principal Clinical Data and Solutions Architect
location: Minneapolis, Minnesota, United States of America
description:
We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on - 30 Oct 2026


Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

A Day in the Life

The Clinical Business Intelligence team supports clinical trial execution, operational oversight, and portfolio decision-making through scalable data and analytics capabilities. The team partners with Clinical Operations, Safety, Monitoring, Data Management, Biostatistics, IT, and enterprise architecture teams to deliver governed data platforms, reporting solutions, and analytics products that improve visibility into clinical performance and enable data-driven decision-making.

As a Senior Principal Clinical Data and Solutions Architect, you will provide strategic leadership for clinical data, analytics, and reporting capabilities across the clinical research ecosystem. You will partner with business and technology stakeholders to define data products, modernize platforms, establish governance standards, and deliver scalable solutions that transform clinical data into actionable insights.


At Medtronic, we bring bold ideas forward with speed and decisiveness to put patients first in everything we do. This position is remote to enhance our competitive edge and expand our cross-functional collaboration efforts. This role will require 10% travel to enhance collaboration and ensure successful completion of projects.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Define and lead the evolution of clinical data, analytics, and reporting platforms supporting clinical trial execution and portfolio management.
  • Develop scalable data products, semantic models, reporting frameworks, and self-service analytics capabilities.
  • Apply Clinical Data Interchange Standards Consortium (CDISC) standards, including Study Data Tabulation Model (SDTM), Analysis Data Model (ADaM), and Unified Study Definitions Model (USDM), within data, analytics, and reporting solutions.
  • Partner with Information Technology and enterprise architecture teams to design and support cloud-based clinical data platforms, including Amazon Web Services (AWS) environments.
  • Lead modernization initiatives involving legacy system transformation, data migration, integration, and interoperability.
  • Establish standards for data governance, quality, traceability, validation, metric consistency, and regulatory compliance.
  • Oversee the development and adoption of clinical dashboards, analytics solutions, and operational reporting capabilities.
  • Support platform strategy, vendor evaluations, solution oversight, validation activities, and investment planning.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree.
  • Experience applying CDISC standards, including SDTM, ADaM, and USDM, within clinical data, analytics, or reporting environments.
  • Experience with cloud-based data platforms in regulated environments, including AWS technologies.
  • Experience supporting clinical trial execution, operational reporting, analytics, or clinical portfolio decision-making.
  • Experience partnering with business stakeholders, Information Technology, and architecture teams to deliver data and analytics solutions.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Biostatistics, Statistics, Data Science, Computer Science, or quantitative discipline and significant experience in clinical research data and analytics.
  • Experience modernizing clinical data platforms, reporting environments, or enterprise analytics solutions.
  • Experience with Structured Query Language (SQL), SQL Server, Power BI, or similar business intelligence and analytics platforms.
  • Knowledge of International Council for Harmonisation (ICH), Good Clinical Practice (GCP), Food and Drug Administration (FDA), and 21 CFR Part 11 requirements.
  • Experience leading large-scale platform transformation, technology enablement, or data governance initiatives.
  • Experience within medical device, pharmaceutical, contract research organization (CRO), or other regulated clinical research environments.

For Baccalaureate degrees earned outside of the United States, a degree that satisfies the requirements of 8 C.F.R. § 214.2(h)(4)(iii)(A) is required.

title: Senior Associate, Product Manager - Account Opening
description:
Senior Associate, Product Manager - Account Opening

Job Description

At Capital One, we believe great products begin with a deep understanding of our customers. From our earliest days, we pioneered the use of predictive modeling to individually personalize credit card offers, turning the entire industry on its head. As we’ve grown bigger, we’ve found more and more ways to use technology and face-to-face conversations to understand the human problems associated with money and finances.


About the Team

In the Retail Bank, we’ve combined this human-centered approach with our heritage of data-driven decision making to design, build, and test our way to truly enabling financial experiences. We’ve challenged ourselves to spend less time planning, more time doing, and, above all else, to see the world through the eyes of our customers as they work to understand and manage their money.


Are you passionate about improving the way people interact with their money? Are you driven by the delight you bring to customers? Do you keep asking “why” until you hit the root? It’s common to fall in love with solutions, but have you ever fallen in love with the problem? Do you have an opinion on whether shipping is more important than perfection? Do you have a healthy dose of skepticism for the impossible? If you’re nodding your head, then we want you!


As a Product Manager focusing on our Account Opening products, you’ll be joining a passionate team of product managers, designers, engineers, data scientists, and analysts working to redefine how millions of customers interact with their money. You might work on developing the next generation of our UI. You might solve the gnarly problems presented by the introduction of AI in finance management. You might reimagine the digital tools in comparing or bundling our financial products in the application. You might protect our customers from the bad guys. You might build solutions to solve problems we haven’t even discovered yet. One thing is for sure: you will dream and you will ship.


On any given day in the Bank you’ll be:

  • Empowered. Part of a team responsible for defining the central data strategy for Retail Bank. Delivering data platforms that will drive how we embrace emerging technologies and power our business agenda by enabling real-time, intelligent decisions and creating a competitive advantage for the Bank and Capital One
  • Learning constantly. Work deeply with customers, associates, designers, technologists and data scientists to build cutting edge solutions
  • Innovating relentlessly. Pushing big change by asking bold questions; starting small, testing, and learning your way to something dramatically better
  • Sharing openly. Telling stories that change the way people think about building products and solving problems, and that illustrate the power of what software can do to make them even better
  • Connecting creatively. Jumpstarting a self-supporting community by sowing the right seeds, building the right tools, integrating the right off-the-shelf products and just plain elbow grease
  • Succeeding strategically. Solving the right problem and holding on the wrong one.

In this role, you’ll learn the essentials of being a product manager, and we’ll invest in you to grow in four key areas:

  • Human Centered
    • You’ll collaborate with tech teams to build comprehensive acceptance criteria, identifying and elevating any need for additional research to define future feature design
    • You'll breakdown business epics into features and further into user stories, driving your team towards lowest effort or Minimal Viable Product (MVP) for a valid feature test
  • Business Focused
    • Demonstrating a growth mindset, you’ll effectively use hypothesis-driven assessment of data to ensure your product or feature delivers on real business needs
    • You’ll own and prioritize feature development roadmaps, ensuring all necessary processes and procedures are followed to manage risk
  • Technology Driven
    • You’ll work autonomously in an agile environment, to conduct research and develop features that utilize new and evolving technology
    • You’ll collaborate with designers, technologists, data scientists and subject-matter experts to build cutting edge solutions to help customers
    • You’ll deliver well-managed product platforms for customers by seeking to understand technology trends and architecture strategy
  • Transformational Leadership
    • By actively participating in horizontal forums, you’ll harness a network of trusted relationships among tech teams, designers, key internal stakeholders and partner teams
    • You’ll articulate a succinct product roadmap to deliver business value and share with with stakeholders, elevating your team’s results and becoming a product matter expert

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or military experience
  • At least 2 years of experience working in Product Management

description:

The Production Controller will manage the flow of direct materials through the assigned production factory. They will also ensure that all required materials to execute the production schedule are available and that all transactions are properly executed in the system (ERP). There will also be a significant focus on continuous improvement through lean principles and ensuring that all transactions are properly executed in the ERP.   • Identify all critical material shortages, monitor the implementation of corrective action plans, control inventory levels of components, and coordinate the disposition of obsolete, non-conforming, and excess material.
  • Monitor performance to the production plan and take proactive action to solve problems and mitigate risk in the plan.
  • Responsible for ERP system cleanliness through date management and exception message analysis and action.
  • Monitor schedule adherence, on time release, actual vs. system lead times and on time completion of work orders.
  • Interface with Operations Team, Quality, Planning, Ops Engineering, and other organizations as needed.

  • Excellent verbal / written communications and interpersonal skills
  • Understanding of Manufacturing Resource Planning (MRP) with proficiency in AX-2012
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications

  • Experience with Inventory Management; cycle counts, gross vs net, turns vs DOH, optimization approach

  • Bachelor’s Degree from an accredited university or college with a minimum of 2 years of experience in manufacturing or supply chain.

title: #EG Full Stack Developer (AI-Enabled)
description:
NCS is a leading AI Tech Services company. With a 15,000-strong team across the Asia Pacific, NCS scales its platforms and capabilities to provide clients with greater agility and AI expertise across a range of Industries. Embracing a strong ecosystem of global partners, NCS transforms technology services delivery combining AI with digital resilience to drive real business impact. NCS is a subsidiary of the Singtel Group.

Job Description

We are seeking a talented Full Stack Developer (AI-Enabled) to join us. This role combines strong full stack engineering expertise with hands‑on fluency in AI-assisted development tools to design, build, and deliver modern digital solutions at speed and scale. You'll work across the entire application stack - from intuitive user interfaces to robust APIs and data services - while leveraging AI coding assistants and, where appropriate, integrating AI capabilities into the products you build. You will help the team raise engineering productivity and quality through smart, responsible use of AI, and contribute to shaping how NCS delivers AI-enabled software to our clients.

Key Responsibilities

Full Stack Application Development

  • Design, develop, test, and deploy end-to-end web applications spanning frontend, backend services, APIs, and data layers
  • Translate functional and non-functional requirements into well-architected, maintainable software components using established design patterns
  • Build and maintain microservices and RESTful / GraphQL APIs using modern stacks such as Java/Spring Boot, .NET, Python, or Node.js
  • Model data and work with both SQL and NoSQL databases; design efficient queries, schemas, and integration patterns
  • Contribute to architecture discussions and trade‑off analyses for performance, scalability, security, and cost

AI-Assisted Software Engineering

  • Use AI-assisted coding tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, Amazon Q Developer, Gemini Code Assist, JetBrains AI Assistant, or equivalent) as a daily part of the development workflow
  • Leverage AI tools to accelerate coding, refactoring, code review, unit test generation, test data creation, and documentation
  • Apply prompt engineering and context-design techniques to get high-quality, trustworthy outputs from AI coding assistants
  • Critically review AI-generated code for correctness, security, performance, licensing, and alignment with project and NCS coding standards before committing
  • Measure and communicate the productivity and quality impact of AI-assisted workflows on project delivery

AI Solution Integration & Delivery

  • Integrate AI and Generative AI capabilities into enterprise applications - including LLM-powered features, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), chatbots and virtual assistants, intelligent document processing, recommendations, and agentic workflows
  • Build against foundation model APIs and managed AI services such as Azure OpenAI, Amazon Bedrock, Google Vertex AI / Gemini, Anthropic Claude, and OpenAI
  • Work with vector databases and AI application frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel; pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS) to deliver context-aware experiences
  • Design AI features with clear evaluation criteria, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints
  • Partner with data scientists, AI/ML engineers, and solution architects to take AI capabilities from prototype to production
  • Contribute to pre-sales and client engagements by prototyping AI-enabled features and shaping practical, value-driven solution designs

Quality Engineering & Secure Coding

  • Follow secure coding principles and NCS security guidelines to prevent common vulnerabilities across frontend, backend, and AI integrations
  • Write and maintain unit, integration, and end-to-end tests; meet project and organisation test coverage targets
  • Perform static code analysis, code reviews, and threat-aware reviews of AI-generated code and AI-integrated features
  • Address defects, performance issues, and production incidents through disciplined root‑cause analysis
  • Adopt Agile, DevOps, and CI/CD practices to deliver software iteratively and reliably
  • Build and maintain pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI) for automated build, test, and deployment
  • Containerise applications and deploy to container platforms (Docker, Kubernetes) and cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Instrument applications for observability - logs, metrics, traces, and, where applicable, AI-feature evaluation telemetry
  • Partner with business analysts, designers, data scientists, and product owners to translate user needs into working software
  • Participate in and lead peer reviews, design reviews, and knowledge-sharing sessions
  • Mentor junior developers on full stack engineering fundamentals and effective, responsible use of AI tools
  • Document designs, APIs, and AI‑integration patterns in a clear and reusable way
  • Champion responsible use of AI tools, including IP protection, client data handling, confidentiality, and licence‑compliance considerations
  • Help define and uphold team guardrails and standards for AI-assisted development and AI-integrated products
  • Stay current with the rapidly evolving AI tooling, model, and framework landscape, and bring relevant advances back to the team
  • Contribute to NCS assets, reusable components, and reference implementations that accelerate future AI-enabled delivery

Qualifications

  • Diploma, Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field; relevant coding certifications are also welcome
  • 3 to 8 years of professional experience building and delivering production web applications as a full stack developer
  • Strong hands‑on proficiency in at least one backend stack: Node.js (Express, NestJS), Golang, Python.
  • Solid understanding of API design (REST, JSON; GraphQL a plus), microservices, event-driven patterns, and integration with third‑party systems
  • Experience with SQL and NoSQL databases (e.g., Oracle, MS SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis)
  • Experience with Git‑based source control, Agile delivery, test‑driven development, and CI/CD toolchains
  • Working experience with containers and cloud platforms (Docker, Kubernetes; AWS, Azure, or GCP)
  • Demonstrated day‑to‑day use of AI‑assisted coding tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, Amazon Q Developer, Gemini Code Assist, JetBrains AI Assistant, Tabnine, Windsurf, or equivalent) and ability to articulate how these tools have improved your delivery quality and speed
  • Working knowledge of prompt engineering and how to structure effective context and instructions for AI coding assistants
  • Familiarity with Large Language Models and Generative AI concepts - tokens, context windows, embeddings, vector search, and Retrieval‑Augmented Generation (RAG)
  • Exposure to at least one LLM / GenAI platform or SDK (OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Amazon Bedrock, Google Vertex AI / Gemini, Hugging Face)
  • Involvement in at least one project that delivered an AI solution capability - such as a GenAI / LLM‑powered application, RAG system, chatbot or virtual assistant, intelligent document processing, ML‑powered feature, or AI agent - is a strong plus
  • Exposure to AI application frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel), vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector, FAISS), agentic patterns, tool/function calling, Model Context Protocol (MCP), and AI evaluation or guardrail practices is a plus
  • Awareness of responsible AI principles, data privacy, IP considerations, and security implications of using AI tools on client engagements
  • Strong problem‑solving, analytical thinking, and sound judgement in when - and when not - to rely on AI-generated output
  • Excellent written and spoken English, with strong communication and collaboration skills in a team environment
  • Self‑motivated, customer‑focused, and committed to high engineering and delivery standards

Additional Information

Lead high-impact AImanagement consultingprograms for major enterprises and public sector clients.

Work with a talented, multidisciplinary team in a collaborative environment.

Competitive compensation and strong professional development support.

We are driven by our AEIOU beliefs—Adventure, Excellence, Integrity, Ownership, and Unity—and we seek individuals who embody these values in both their professional and personal lives. We are committed to our Impact: Valuing our clients, Growing our people, and Creating our future.

Together, we make the extraordinary happen.
