title: Senior QA Engineer, AI & Automation
description:
Adventure is our Culture. Join a team that celebrates a lifestyle as bold as the terrain we love. At Backcountry, we are rooted in adventure, recognition, and wellbeing on and off the mountain. We spotlight employee stories, celebrate milestones, and offer exclusive outdoor perks. Whether you are at HQ, in a retail store, or remote, you will be part of a team that thrives on energy, exploration, and connection.

Reports to: Senior Retail Technology Architect

Location: Remote (US, Canada, or Costa Rica)

What You'll Do

Build AI-Accelerated Test Automation
  • Build and maintain scalable automation suites using Playwright across web, API, and mobile, contributing to broader QA frameworks and release validation standards.
  • Use AI coding assistants and agents (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Playwright's planner/generator/healer agents) to generate test plans, test cases, page objects, and test data from requirements, Jira stories, and PR diffs.
  • Review, validate, and harden every AI-generated test before it merges — you own the correctness of the suite regardless of what wrote the code.
  • Drive down flaky tests and maintenance cost through resilient locator strategies, AI-assisted self-healing, and automated failure triage.
  • Integrate automated quality gates into GitHub Actions CI/CD so every deploy is validated by the pipeline rather than by manual sign-off.
  • Build and maintain functional, regression, API, and performance/load testing coverage using tools like Postman, JMeter, or k6.
Apply Testing Judgment Where It Matters
  • Determine what should be automated, what can be delegated to AI, and what requires human testing — balancing coverage, risk, and release timelines.
  • Perform focused exploratory testing on new features, UI/UX changes, and complex user flows to catch edge cases and usability issues that automation and AI miss.
  • Turn every escaped defect into an automated regression check so the suite strengthens with each release.
  • Partner with engineers to embed tests, API contract checks, and AI-assisted code review early in the SDLC to reduce downstream defect costs.
  • Help define how to test AI-powered customer experiences (search, recommendations) where outputs are non-deterministic and need evaluation rubrics rather than exact assertions.
  • Track and report quality metrics (automation coverage, defect escape rate, flake rate, test cycle time) to show where automation is paying off.
Contribute to a High-Performing Team
  • Collaborate with QA peers and engineering teams, sharing knowledge, best practices, and the AI prompts and workflows that work.
  • Provide input on quality practices and process improvements across the engineering org, focusing on reducing manual regression and UAT effort.
  • Support and mentor QA engineers on automation and responsible AI-assisted testing, fostering a culture of quality ownership.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Quality Assurance and Testing, including 3+ years building and maintaining test automation that runs in CI/CD.
  • Proven, hands-on experience with Playwright for web and API E2E automation; Cypress or Selenium experience is a plus.
  • Strong automation fundamentals: ability to design, build, and maintain scalable, reliable test suites and frameworks, and to diagnose and eliminate flaky tests.
  • Strong proficiency in TypeScript/JavaScript or Python (Java a plus); you write test code to the same standard as production code.
  • Hands-on, day-to-day use of AI coding tools (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or Cursor) to write, refactor, and debug test code, with the discipline to validate and correct AI-generated output.
  • Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions preferred), including parallel execution, reporting, and quality gates.
  • Solid experience with functional, regression, API, and performance/load testing (Postman, JMeter, k6, or equivalent).
  • Strong exploratory testing skills and the judgment to build risk-based test strategies across automated, AI-assisted, and manual coverage.
  • Demonstrated SDLC and Agile experience with defect lifecycle management using Jira and TestRail.
  • Ability to operate effectively under a steady release cadence and manage competing priorities with minimal supervision.

Preferred Qualifications

  • E-commerce QA automation experience, particularly in environments shipping frequently with CI/CD integration.
  • Experience building or adopting agentic testing workflows (AI test generation, self-healing tests, MCP-connected tools, or LLM-based failure triage).
  • Experience testing AI/ML-powered features such as search, recommendations, or LLM-generated content, including evaluation of non-deterministic output.
  • Familiarity with BrowserStack or similar cloud device and browser grids.
  • Experience with observability tooling like Grafana or GCP-based infrastructure, including using production signals to prioritize test coverage.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally.

Why Join

The people who do best here are builders. They take ownership, move fast, and want to see the direct impact of their work.

  • Cross-Functional Impact: Your work touches every engineering team and every release — automation coverage and quality gates you build directly shape what ships to customers across web, mobile, and API.
  • AI-First Skill Building: You will work at the frontier of AI-assisted testing, using and evaluating emerging tools daily and building expertise that is defining the next generation of quality engineering.
  • End-to-End Ownership: You own the automation framework, the CI/CD quality gates, and the testing strategy — from choosing what to automate to deciding how to evaluate non-deterministic AI features.
  • Competitive Benefits (US): Paid time off policies, 401(k) match, medical/dental/vision and a variety of supplemental policies, and employee discounts across our portfolio of brands.
  • Competitive Benefits (Canada): Paid time off policies, RRSP match, medical, dental, and vision coverage, a variety of supplemental benefit options, and employee discounts across our portfolio of brands.
  • Competitive Benefits (Costa Rica): We offer an attractive benefits package including primarily remote work, private medical and life insurance, additional paid time off, monthly allowances and reimbursements, employee discounts, and opportunities for professional growth.

Interview Process

  1. Recruiter Screen - A 30-minute conversation with our recruiting team to align on the role, your background, and what you are looking for.
  2. Hiring Manager Interview - A deeper conversation focused on your automation experience, AI-assisted testing approach, and how you balance coverage with release velocity.
  3. Technical / Case Discussion - A hands-on session covering Playwright automation design, CI/CD integration, and your approach to evaluating and hardening AI-generated tests.
  4. In-Person Interview - We'd like to meet you at our Salt Lake City office. Details and logistics will be arranged with your recruiter.
  5. Reference Checks - Conducted in parallel with the final stages where possible.
  6. Offer - We move quickly for the right candidate.

Interview process is subject to change. Any updates will be communicated promptly and clearly.

Please Note

  • Part of our interview process is a mandatory in-person interview with someone on our team prior to an offer. Candidates that are unwilling or unable to meet for an in-person interview will be removed from consideration immediately.

If you do not have a LinkedIn profile, you must provide a credible reason in that field and supply alternative evidence of your professional background to verify your identity.

ING offers many opportunities to build a diverse and rewarding career. title: Expression of Interest for Board Directors
description:
The Opportunity

As part of its ongoing Board succession and renewal process, GrandBridge is seeking EOIs from candidates who will complement and add to the experience and capabilities of the current Board and contribute to the organization's future strategic direction. The Boards provide stewardship and oversight of GrandBridge, working with management to support the organization's long-term success while ensuring strong governance, accountability and responsible decision-making. Directors contribute strategic insight and independent judgment across matters including:

  • Enterprise strategy and long-term value creation
  • Financial performance, capital allocation and investment
  • Growth, partnerships, investments and business development
  • Corporate governance and enterprise risk
  • Regulatory and public-policy considerations
  • Organizational performance, executive leadership and succession
  • Technology, cybersecurity and enterprise transformation
  • Sustainability and the evolving energy landscape
  • Shareholder, customer and community interests

Our Directors bring an enterprise perspective to the Board table. They ask thoughtful questions, constructively challenge assumptions, consider both opportunities and risks, and contribute to a collaborative and effective governance environment.


Who We're Looking For

GrandBridge values a Board with complementary skills, experiences and perspectives. Candidates are not expected to bring expertise across every area. As we consider the future composition of the Board, we are particularly interested in candidates with senior leadership or governance experience in one or more of the following areas:

  • Energy, Utilities & Infrastructure
  • Finance, Investment & M&A
  • Strategy, Growth & Transformation
  • Technology, Digital & Cybersecurity
  • Governance, Risk & Regulatory
  • People, Culture & Executive Leadership

When reviewing EOIs, GrandBridge will consider the overall composition of its Boards and the combination of capabilities and perspectives required to support our strategic direction. In addition to relevant executive, sector or governance experience, successful candidates will demonstrate strong judgement, knowledge of corporate governance practices, independent thinking, integrity and an appreciation for the organization's accountability to its municipal shareholders, customers and communities.


Previous corporate Board experience, particularly as a Board Chair or Vice-Chair, and/or a recognized director designation is considered an asset; however, it is not required where a candidate brings significant executive, sector or governance expertise. GrandBridge encourages education and training for its Directors, particularly as it applies to Board leadership development.


Term & Commitment

Directors are appointed for a three-year term, with eligibility for reappointment in accordance with GrandBridge's governing documents and Board policies. The Board typically meets quarterly, with additional committee meetings, strategic planning sessions, AGM/Shareholder meetings, education and other governance activities scheduled throughout the year. Directors are expected to:

  • Be a member of at least one Board committee
  • Prepare for and actively participate in Board and assigned committee meetings
  • Participate in strategic planning, Board development activities, required governance, regulatory and organizational education
  • Develop and maintain an informed understanding of GrandBridge's businesses, operating environment and strategic priorities
  • Be available for additional meetings when significant strategic or governance matters arise
  • Candidates should have the capacity and flexibility to dedicate the time required to fully participate in the work of the Board and its committees.


Director Compensation

Directors are compensated in accordance with GrandBridge Corporation's Board remuneration framework.


Eligibility & Independence

Candidates must satisfy applicable director eligibility, independence and conflict-of-interest requirements established through GrandBridge's governing documents, shareholder requirements and applicable legislation and regulation. As part of the selection process, candidates will be asked to disclose business, professional, municipal or other relationships that could reasonably create an actual, potential or perceived conflict of interest.


Different Perspectives Make Us Stronger

Strong governance benefits from different experiences, backgrounds, perspectives and ways of thinking. GrandBridge is committed to an inclusive Board recruitment and succession process. We welcome EOIs from qualified candidates whose experiences and perspectives will broaden the collective capabilities of the Board and contribute to thoughtful, informed and balanced decision-making.


Interested?

If you are an experienced leader who brings strategic perspective, sound judgment and a commitment to effective governance, we invite you to submit and EOI. Please submit your resume and a brief letter of interest describing the experience, expertise and perspective you would bring to our Boards of Directors through our online careers’ portal at EOIs will be considered within the context of the Boards’ current and future mix of skills, experience, diversity and succession requirements.


Deadline for EOI’s: November 11, 2026

Candidates selected to advance will be contacted regarding the next stage of the Board recruitment process.

GrandBridge Corporation

39 Glebe Street, P. O. Box 1060

Cambridge, Ontario N1R 5X6

Check us out at

Kindly note, we do not entertain unsolicited referrals or resumes from third-party agencies or recruiters for our job postings.

We appreciate the opportunity to review all resumes, however due to volume, only those under consideration will be contacted. Any personal information submitted will be managed in accordance with the requirements of the Municipal Freedom of Information and Protection of Privacy Act and will be used only to determine eligibility for employment.

GrandBridge Corporation is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is AODA compliant.

  • Demonstrated ability to implement quality control methods to check data for errors, inconsistencies and missing information/codes.

title: Staff Security Engineer (Detection)
description:
• We’re taking an engineering-led approach to security operations, building internal capability and technical depth. You’ll provide technical accountability for REA’s detection-engineering capability and help shape how we evolve detection and automation
  • Permanent role based either onsite in Melbourne or Sydney as well as open to remote in other locations

We're REA

With bold and ambitious goals, REA Group is changing the way the world experiences property. No matter where you're at on your property journey, we're here to help with every step - whether that's finding or financing your next home.

Our people are the key to our success. At the heart of everything we do, is a thriving culture centred around high performance and care. We are purpose driven and collaborative, which drives innovation and our ability to make a real impact. As such, we’re proud to have been named one of Australia’s Best Workplaces four times since 2021 — including third place in 2025 — plus Best Workplace for Women in 2023 and Best Workplace in Technology in 2024 and 2025. These listings are testament to every person who helps make REA a great place to work.


Where the team fits in

The Detection & Response team helps REA identify, investigate and respond to cyber threats across our environment. The team monitors security signals, validates alerts, investigates suspicious activity and leads or supports coordinated incident response, including technical investigation and containment in partnership with engineering teams. With an increasing focus on detection and response engineering, the team continually strengthens REA’s ability to spot threats earlier, reduce the impact of incidents and learn from events to improve our security posture.


What the role is all about

The Staff Security Engineer is a key role in the Detections & Response team that will provide technical accountability for REA’s detection engineering capability within our purpose-built detection platform. You’ll shape standards, technical direction and the capability model across data flows, detection requirements, testing and response automation. Working within our strategic goals, you'll partner with the team to prioritise and sequence the work that delivers them, bringing deep technical expertise to guide how we get there.


Day to day of the job

  • Identify, initiate and lead long-term, cross-team initiatives that strengthen REA's detection and response capability, aligning stakeholders and driving delivery in partnership with Product, Platform and Engineering teams.
  • Configure and operate the detection platform and its data flows, including log ingestion, transformation, alert enrichment and response automation, while shaping the technical standards and patterns used to define and validate detections.
  • Define detection patterns and technical approaches to identify malicious activity across our environment, and lead the review, tuning and validation of high-fidelity detections and correlation logic that improve coverage, reduce false positives and enable the team to scale detection engineering capabilities.
  • Build and maintain automated pipelines, infrastructure, tests and quality gates that validate detections and protect against configuration drift, regressions and coverage gaps.
  • Analyse security events and logs to identify malicious activity, patterns and emerging attack techniques during investigations and proactive threat hunting
  • Assess threat intelligence, attacker techniques and relevant industry frameworks in the context of REA’s environment, using them to set detection priorities and guide refined detection patterns that continuously improve coverage and signal quality.
  • Investigate security alerts and incidents, independently determine whether containment is required, coordinate technical response activities and communicate effectively with the wider incident response team, senior management and business stakeholders as needed
  • Produce and automate response playbooks to ensure rapid and effective containment and response
  • Contribute to purple-team exercises and security testing to validate effectiveness of detections and identify gaps
  • Partner with Product, Platform and Engineering teams to ensure new systems and changes have appropriate logging, monitoring and detection coverage
  • Evaluate and use AI-assisted and other emerging tooling to improve detection, support investigations and response automation, applying sound security judgement and attacker-technique knowledge to guide investigative tasks and validate outputs.
  • Mentor and share knowledge with other Security and Engineering team members through reviews, pairing and internal forums

Who we’re looking for

  • Ability to define detection engineering architectures, patterns and standards across multiple platforms, balancing detection coverage, signal quality, cost, performance, and operational impact
  • Strong understanding of cloud and application architectures, including logging, monitoring, native security controls and common failure modes, with ability to translate these into detection and response requirements
  • Proficiency in log analysis, scripting and query languages to investigate security events and evaluate detection behaviour, with the ability to define requirements for, review and validate complex detection logic, including edge cases and performance considerations.
  • Capability to configure and manage data pipelines, including log forwarding, transformation, cost-conscious ingestion strategies, and observability pipeline tools
  • Deep understanding of security observability tooling including EDR, SIEM, CNAPP, SOAR, and identity platforms, with ability to leverage their telemetry for high-fidelity detections
  • Strong knowledge of attacker techniques and kill-chain concepts (e.g. MITRE ATT&CK) and how to map them into effective detections and coverage assessments
  • Strong understanding of modern DevOps and systems-engineering practices, including detection-as-code, source-control workflows, infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD pipelines, with the ability to define standards and quality controls for building, testing, deploying and operating security tooling.
  • Ability to build automation workflows for security operations, including SOAR platforms and response orchestration, and document operational procedures through playbooks, runbooks and detection test cases

The REA experience

The physical, mental, emotional and financial health of our people is something we’ll never stop caring about. This is a place to learn and grow.


Some of our Perks & Benefits include:

  • A hybrid and flexible approach to working
  • Flexible leave options including, birthday leave and purchase additional leave
  • Flexible parental leave offering for primary and secondary carers
  • Our Because We Care program offers employees volunteering leave, community grants, matched payroll giving and our Community Café donates 100% of revenue to charity
  • Hackdays so you can bring your big ideas to life

Our commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

We are committed to providing a working environment that embraces and values diversity, equity and inclusion. We believe teams with diverse ideas and experiences are more creative, more eﬀective and fuel disruptive thinking. If you've got the skills, dedication and enthusiasm to learn but don't necessarily meet every single point on the job description, please still get in touch.


Join our Talent Neighbourhood

title: #EG Senior Data Engineer
description:
Company Description

NCS is a leading AI Tech Services company. With a 15,000-strong team across the Asia Pacific, NCS scales its platforms and capabilities to provide clients with greater agility and AI expertise across a range of Industries. Embracing a strong ecosystem of global partners, NCS transforms technology services delivery combining AI with digital resilience to drive real business impact. NCS is a subsidiary of the Singtel Group.

Job Description

This is a Senior Data Engineer role within NCS AI Central’s Forward Deployed Engineering model, focused on preparing client data for production-grade AI, ML, and RAG systems.

The role owns the design and delivery of AI-ready data pipelines, including ingestion, cleaning, transformation, data quality checks, batch and streaming workflows, and production-scale operations. A key focus is building reliable data foundations for RAG and vector search, covering document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, hybrid search, and vector databases such as pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate, OpenSearch, or Azure AI Search.

You will also handle data governance and compliance, including PII redaction, access controls, data residency, metadata, and lineage, especially for regulated sectors such as Healthcare, Government, and Transport. They will work closely with AI Engineers and AI Architects to define what “AI-ready” data means for each engagement, from fast POC/POV work through to hardened production systems.

What will you do?

1. Data Pipeline Engineering & AI-Readiness

  • Design and build ingestion, cleaning, and transformation pipelines that turn messy, real-world client data into AI-ready datasets.
  • Build batch and streaming pipelines (Airflow/Prefect/Kafka) that keep data flowing reliably into AI systems without manual intervention.
  • Own data quality — deduplication, schema validation, completeness checks — upstream of any model or RAG pipeline.
  • Proactively flag data gaps or quality issues that would degrade model/RAG performance downstream, before they surface as an AI Engineer’s problem in testing.

2. RAG & Vector Store Architecture

  • Architect document/data ingestion and indexing pipelines for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems — chunking strategy, embeddings, hybrid/vector search.
  • Design and operate vector database and search infrastructure (pgvector/Pinecone/OpenSearch) at production scale and query volume.

3. Data Governance & Compliance

  • Implement PII redaction, data residency, and access-control patterns aligned to PDPA and sector-specific requirements (Healthcare, Government, Transport).
  • Maintain clear data lineage and metadata governance so engagement teams and auditors can trace how client data flows into AI outputs.

4. FDE & Development/Maintenance Coverage

  • During FDE engagements: rapidly assess and prepare a client's data landscape during Discover/POC, identifying data-readiness gaps early.
  • During system development & maintenance engagements: build and operate production-scale data pipelines handling the full volume and complexity of live client systems (e.g., Healthcare or Transport data at scale).
  • Contribute reusable ingestion/indexing patterns back into the shared internal asset library to accelerate future engagements.

5. Collaboration & Leadership

  • Partner closely and continuously with AI Engineers and AI Architects — understanding what a given model, RAG pipeline, or agent actually needs from the data layer, and translating that into concrete pipeline and schema design decisions.
  • Own the definition of “AI-ready” data for each engagement jointly with AI Engineers — agreeing on chunking strategy, metadata, freshness, and quality thresholds before pipelines are built, not after retrieval quality suffers.
  • Sit in solution design conversations alongside AI Engineers and AI Architects, so data architecture and model/RAG architecture are designed together rather than data being treated as a downstream dependency.
  • Mentor junior data engineers and set data engineering standards across engagements.

Qualifications

The ideal candidate should possess:

  • 5+ years in data engineering, including production-scale pipeline design (not just analytics/reporting pipelines).
  • Strong SQL and at least one systems language (Python/Scala/Java); hands-on with batch and streaming frameworks (Airflow, Spark, Kafka).
  • Experience building data pipelines for AI/ML or RAG use cases — embeddings, vector indexing, hybrid search.
  • Solid understanding of data governance, PII handling, and access-control patterns in regulated environments.
  • Comfortable moving between fast, exploratory data assessment (FDE/POC) and disciplined, high-volume production pipeline engineering (system development & maintenance).
  • Working understanding of core AI/LLM concepts — tokenization, embeddings, chunking strategy, context windows, RAG, and agentic workflows — sufficient to hold a real technical conversation with AI Engineers and AI Architects about what “AI-ready” data means for a given use case, not just how to move and clean it.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with vector databases (pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate) and search platforms (OpenSearch/Azure AI Search).
  • Exposure to Singapore Government data environments (GCC/HCC) and compliance regimes (IM8, PDPA).
  • Experience with sector-specific data complexity — Healthcare (clinical data governance) or Transport/Aviation systems.
  • Familiarity with data cataloguing and lineage tooling.
  • Prior experience embedded within an AI/ML delivery team (not just a data platform team) — i.e., has sat alongside AI Engineers day-to-day and adjusted pipeline/schema design based on model or RAG performance feedback.

Tech Stack (Illustrative)

  • Languages: Python, SQL (Scala/Java a plus)
  • Pipelines: Airflow/Prefect, Spark, Kafka/Debezium
  • Storage/Search: Postgres, S3/Blob, pgvector/Pinecone/Weaviate, OpenSearch/Azure AI Search
  • Governance: Presidio (PII redaction), data catalogue/lineage tooling
  • Cloud: AWS/Azure/GCP; GCC/HCC exposure a plus

Additional Information

Why Join NCS?

Grow with Us

  • Work on cutting-edge AI products that shape the future of technology
  • Collaborate with talented, passionate teams across research, engineering, and design
  • Access continuous learning opportunities and career development pathways

Make an Impact

  • Transform AI research into products that solve real problems for clients and users
  • Drive innovation in a leading Technology Services Firm with regional presence
  • Contribute to building a better future through responsible, human-centred AI

Thrive in Our Culture

  • Experience ahuman-to-humanapproach where relationships and collaboration matter
  • Be part ofTeam NCS, where bold ideas meet practical execution
  • Enjoy a supportive environment that values diversity, inclusion, and respect

We are driven by our AEIOU beliefs—Adventure, Excellence, Integrity, Ownership, and Unity—and we seek individuals who embody these values in both their professional and personal lives. We are committed to our Impact: Valuing our clients, Growing our people, and Creating our future.

Together, we make the extraordinary happen.

Learn more about us at ncs.co and visit our LinkedIn career site.

title: Senior Software Developer III  *
description:
Caseware is one of Canada's original Fintech companies, having led the global audit and accounting software industry for over 30 years, with more than 500,000 users across 130 countries and available in 16 different languages. While you might not have heard of us (yet) over 36,000 accounting and audit professionals list Caseware as a skill on their LinkedIn profiles!

As a Senior Software Developer III, you operate as a technical leader within your team and across the broader engineering organization. You shape architecture and design, raise the bar on engineering quality, mentor other developers, and partner closely with cross-functional stakeholders to translate technical decisions into business value. You are equally comfortable guiding agentic-AI tools to deliver code, reviewing designs, and influencing how the platform evolves.

📍 Location: This is a fully remote position located in Colombia.

Contact

Maira Russo - Senior Talent Acquisition Partner

Core Responsibilities

  • Create architecture, prototypes, and design proposals that deliver near-term business value while aligning with the future-state product and platform vision.

  • Influence technical direction through architecture reviews, RFCs, design discussions, and hands-on collaboration.

  • Partner with senior developers, architects, and tech leads to define and execute the product/platform architecture roadmap.

  • Balance delivery speed, quality, maintainability, and long-term platform health when making technical decisions.

  • Break down large initiatives into parallelizable chunks of work that deliver incremental business value.

  • Champion proposals through all phases of the SDLC, from design through production implementation.

  • Contribute to improving the core product build, CI/CD pipelines, and overall SDLC.

  • Troubleshoot and eliminate root causes of persistent production issues; drive reliability, observability, monitoring, and incident response.

  • Keep technical documentation current and create new artifacts as needed.

  • Facilitate design discussions within and across teams.

  • Represent the team in technical discussions with Tech Leads, Operations, Product/UX, Security, Domain SMEs, and external stakeholders.

  • Act as a trusted technical leader, helping teams succeed through collaboration, influence, and shared ownership.

  • Mentor other developers through design reviews, joint agentic-AI sessions, and feedback on skills, prompts, and other agent inputs; contribute to raising overall engineering maturity.

  • Share knowledge of new technologies and industry best practices.

  • Evaluate emerging technologies, frameworks, and cloud capabilities that could benefit the platform.

AI-Augmented Development Expectations

  • Use AI-assisted development tools — inline completion, conversational assistants, and agentic workflows — as a standard part of your daily workflow.

  • Critically evaluate and take ownership of all AI-generated output before it ships — verify correctness, security, and alignment with architecture and team standards.

  • Identify opportunities for agentic automation within your team, and lead the rollout of new AI-assisted workflows and tooling.

  • Mentor other developers on effective, responsible use of AI-assisted development tools.

  • Help establish team-level practices and guardrails for using AI tools safely and effectively.

  • Build and refine feedback loops that improve the team's collective use of AI tooling over time.

Core Qualifications

  • Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience; 8+ years of professional software development experience with demonstrated impact beyond a single team.

  • Proven experience designing and operating distributed, cloud-native, SaaS/multi-tenant platforms at scale, ideally on AWS.

  • Strong software fundamentals: OOP, design patterns, SOLID principles, and a track record of advocating for code quality.

  • Experience with agentic-AI software development practices.

  • Experience designing and consuming well-designed HTTP APIs (REST, GraphQL, or similar).

  • Experience mentoring developers and influencing architectural decisions across teams.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; comfortable operating in fast-moving environments with ambiguity and evolving requirements. English high B2.

  • Strong initiative to improve processes, tools, methodologies, and product quality.

Department-Specific Responsibilities

  • Build and operate the AWS AgentCore Gateway layer and the capabilities it hosts — MCP tool targets today, extending to inbound access, agent-to-agent (HTTP) targets, and inference/model-routing targets as those capabilities come online.

  • Develop and maintain the target registry and configuration model that lets customer firms register their own MCP servers for their agents to call, covering tenant isolation, credential handling, allowlisting and egress control, and containment when a third-party endpoint fails or misbehaves.

  • Build the inbound surface that exposes Caseware capability to external agents and clients over MCP and adjacent protocols, including authentication, scope enforcement, and rate limiting.

  • Build and operate the on-premise connectivity path, including session lifecycle, request correlation, and recovery for long-lived sessions between cloud-hosted agents and on-premise desktop clients.

  • Implement session and scope propagation from agent to gateway to target to backend, so authorization is correct and auditable at every hop.

  • Design and evolve OpenAPI contracts for gateway targets, and the target runtimes that implement them, keeping conventions consistent regardless of what a target fronts.

  • Implement outbound authorization for gateway targets (IAM/SigV4, OAuth, credential providers) so access to each target type is securely and consistently controlled.

  • Maintain versioning of target contracts as they evolve, so consuming teams and customers are not broken by change.

  • Contribute to end-to-end tracing and SLOs for gateway traffic, and build the observability that lets you and other teams detect and debug failures anywhere in the pipeline.

  • Mentor other developers joining the team, and contribute to technical direction for the integration layer through RFCs and design reviews.

Department-Specific Qualifications

  • Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) for LLM agents.

  • Experience building or operating a multi-tenant gateway or API platform: several traffic patterns behind one access point, tenant isolation, per-tenant credentials and secrets, quotas, and abuse protection.

  • Experience integrating with third-party or untrusted endpoints, with a clear point of view on failure containment and limiting blast radius.

  • Experience with authorization and scope propagation across multi-hop service boundaries — carrying and checking identity and permissions through the full pipeline, not just authenticating once.

  • Experience designing and operating persistent-connection or streaming architectures, including session management, recovery, and message correlation, along with related protocol-level concerns (timeout/retry semantics, backpressure, idempotency, graceful degradation).

Nice to Have

  • Experience with AWS Bedrock, AgentCore, or other managed agent/LLM orchestration platforms.

  • Experience with LLM provider routing and gateway patterns (multi-provider endpoints, model-based routing) or agent-to-agent (A2A) communication protocols.

  • Experience building developer- or partner-facing platform surfaces that external parties integrate against.

  • Experience integrating cloud services with on-premise or embedded clients (webviews, desktop apps).

  • Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (CDK, CloudFormation, or Terraform).

  • Experience operating systems in regulated or compliance-heavy domains.

Tech Stack

  • Backend & Platform: Node.js/TypeScript

  • Cloud & Infrastructure: AWS Lambda, AWS Bedrock, AWS AgentCore Gateway (or similar third-party platforms/tools)

  • Connectivity: Persistent-connection relay architecture for on-premise integrations

  • Contracts & Protocols: OpenAPI, Model Context Protocol (MCP), A2UI

  • Developer Tooling: GitHub, GitHub Actions

Perks & Benefits

  • ¨Contrato a termino Indefinido¨ with all the legal benefits
  • Prepaid Medicine
  • Life insurance and funeral assistance
  • Internet allowance
  • Home office stipend
  • Competitive compensation — above the market average

What's in it for you:
▪️Innovation is at our core. We work with cutting-edge technology in accounting and financial reporting, constantly pushing the boundaries to create impactful software solutions.

title: Logistics Planner

  • The ability to make an impact and shape your career with a company that is passionate about growth

title: Mechanical Seal Salesperson
description:
At DNOW, we believe our associates are the best in the business. We value and reward hardworking, creative, and dedicated employees that desire to be part of a team committed to outstanding customer service.

START YOUR CAREER NOW.

We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Mechanical Seal Sales Specialist to grow our mechanical seal business across industrial and energy markets.

We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Mechanical Seal Sales Specialist to grow our mechanical seal business across industrial and energy markets. This position will be responsible for developing new customers, expanding existing accounts, identifying competitor seal conversion opportunities, and increasing mechanical seal repair and replacement business.


The ideal candidate combines strong technical knowledge of mechanical seals and rotating equipment with the ability to prospect, build relationships, troubleshoot applications, and close business. This is a customer-facing sales role requiring significant time in the field working directly with maintenance, reliability, engineering, operations, and purchasing personnel.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute a territory growth strategy for mechanical seals, seal systems, repairs, and related rotating-equipment products.
  • Prospect and develop new mechanical seal customers while expanding penetration within existing accounts.
  • Identify installed competitor seals and develop conversion/change-out opportunities.
  • Conduct field surveys to document installed seal populations, applications, equipment, and recurring reliability issues.
  • Work with customers to troubleshoot premature seal failures and recommend appropriate solutions.
  • Develop opportunities for mechanical seal repair, refurbishment, and replacement.
  • Promote the company's in-house and partner seal repair capabilities.
  • Work closely with pump sales representatives and service personnel to identify seal opportunities associated with pump repairs, equipment upgrades, and new equipment.
  • Recommend appropriate seal designs, materials, elastomers, metallurgy, and seal support systems based on operating conditions.
  • Support applications involving single and dual mechanical seals, cartridge seals, component seals, and engineered sealing solutions.
  • Understand and discuss common API seal support systems, including Plans 11, 21, 23, 32, 52, 53, 54, and related configurations.
  • Perform customer site visits, equipment walkdowns, lunch-and-learns, technical presentations, and product demonstrations.
  • Develop relationships with maintenance, reliability, rotating-equipment, engineering, operations, and procurement personnel.
  • Prepare quotations and coordinate with internal engineering, operations, repair, and manufacturing teams.
  • Maintain accurate opportunities, customer activity, forecasts, and pipeline information in the CRM.
  • Follow up on quotations and opportunities through order placement.
  • Track sales activity, bookings, gross profit, new accounts, conversions, repair opportunities, and other defined KPIs.
  • Support outage, turnaround, and planned-maintenance opportunities.
  • Serve as the internal technical resource for mechanical seal applications within the assigned territory.

Primary Markets

The position will focus on industrial customers including:

  • Oil & gas – upstream, midstream, and downstream
  • Refining and terminals
  • Power generation
  • Mining and minerals
  • Water and wastewater
  • Chemical and petrochemical
  • Food and beverage
  • Pharmaceutical and biotechnology
  • General industrial manufacturing
  • EPC and engineering firms

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in mechanical seals, pumps, rotating equipment, or industrial technical sales preferred.
  • Strong understanding of mechanical seal applications and failure modes.
  • Experience with centrifugal pumps and other rotating equipment strongly preferred.
  • Familiarity with API 682, API 610, and ANSI/ASME B73.1 equipment and applications is beneficial.
  • Ability to understand operating conditions including pressure, temperature, speed, fluid properties, solids, vapor pressure, and equipment configuration.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop new business and grow existing accounts.
  • Experience selling against established competitors and converting installed equipment is highly desirable.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to communicate technical concepts effectively with both plant personnel and engineering organizations.
  • Strong organizational, follow-up, and CRM discipline.
  • Ability and willingness to spend significant time visiting customers throughout the territory.
  • Valid driver's license and ability to travel as required.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this position will be measured by both revenue growth and leading sales activity, including:

  • Mechanical seal bookings and gross profit
  • Year-over-year seal revenue growth
  • New customers developed
  • New applications identified
  • Competitive seal conversions
  • Seal repair opportunities generated
  • Installed-base surveys completed
  • Customer site visits
  • Qualified opportunities added to the pipeline
  • Quote-to-order conversion
  • Growth of mechanical seal business within existing pump accounts

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is not simply an order taker. We are looking for someone who enjoys being in plants, examining equipment, asking questions, solving reliability problems, and finding opportunities.

This individual should be comfortable walking through a facility, identifying pumps and mechanical seals, discussing recurring failures with maintenance personnel, and developing a technical and commercial solution that earns the customer's business.

The successful candidate will combine technical credibility, persistence, relationship building, and a strong new-business-development mentality to establish our organization as a trusted mechanical seal and rotating-equipment partner.

title: Data Analyst
description:
About Us
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Job Description

Functional Summary

The CS Business Intelligence and Analytics (BI&A) team has a simple mission: we turn massive amounts of data into robust tools and actionable insights that drive business value and provide best in class experience to our clients, internally and externally. Our team works to support Go to Market Services (GTMS) teams by building consolidated, strategic and scalable operational and analytics infrastructure for Visa core products, value added services, and internal processes.

Responsibilities

The Analyst will be responsible for owning the analytic function for GTMS business and performance metrics, both periodic and ad hoc. Specific activities may include:


  • Become the subject expert on all things related to GTMS business reporting
  • Own data and processes for daily, monthly, and quarterly executive reporting suites, ensuring timely and accurate delivery
  • Coordinate across product and metric owners to define key metrics and follow-up on any outliers or deviations
  • Create and maintain performance and monitoring dashboards around internal GTMS business metrics, including sales data, client care case performance, and CRM metrics
  • Identify and resolve inconsistencies and data quality issues
  • Serve as a liaison to strategic business partners to understand their needs and propose and build fit for purpose solutions
  • Perform periodic and ad hoc end-to-end analyses to identify operational and business opportunities to drive Best in Class performance
  • Work with stakeholders to understand the root problems, define analytical objectives and formalize data requirements for various types of dashboards and analyses
  • Design and launch robust and intuitive Tableau and Power BI dashboards supporting best in class money movement client experience
  • Create and present analytic deliverables to colleagues in the analytics team, other internal stakeholders with varying degrees of analytical and technical expertise
  • Distill massive amounts of data across disparate data sources into efficient functional data repositories in a Big Data environment
  • Independently perform analysis to derive insights and render robust, thoughtful results
  • Develop presentations of complex data and content for clients and stakeholders in an accurate, understandable, and engaging manner

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:

  • 3 or more years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or at least 1 year of work experience with an Advanced degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 0 years of work experience with a PhD

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 6 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or 4 or more years of relevant experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or up to 2 years of relevant experience with a PhD
  • Understanding of payments and operational client care functions
  • Able to utilize AI tools without losing the “human touch” and domain expertise
  • Expert proficiency in data visualization including Tableau, Power BI, and PowerPoint
  • Big Data skills including SQL and ETL experience
  • Functional knowledge of programming languages such as Python, Java, and/or Shell Scripting to support automation and data cleansing
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Dynamics or other ERP/CRM tools
  • Proficiency manipulating data from a variety of sources - Big data skills (Hadoop, Hive, Spark) and/or SQL skills required. Able to ‘talk data’ with technology partners
  • Strong verbal, written, and interpersonal skills with the ability to summarize complex topics into easy to understand pieces
  • Proficient in all MS Office applications
  • Strong strategic thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities, with the ability to translate complex data into actionable insights
  • Ability to interact and manage stakeholders globally and across time-zones
  • Visa experience or knowledge of the payments industry

Visa is an EEO Employer

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

Medtronic Neuroscience is focused on transforming care for patients with neurological, spinal, and chronic pain conditions. Through meaningful innovation and strong clinical partnerships, we help clinicians deliver therapies that improve lives and expand what is possible in-patient care.

This remote role supports Medtronic’s patient-first mission through cross-functional collaboration and requires up to 50% travel.

Primary responsibilities:

  • Lead and execute New Hire, Launch and Selling Skills training courses for Interventional Pain Therapies
  • Strongly influence the design of new product launch training plans based on business strategy with a significant focus on clinical and technical competency.
  • Design and execute creative and engaging, sales-focused training programs that are targeted, purposeful, and increase knowledge, selling skills and clinical competency.

  • Drive innovative training and education methods across digital and virtual platforms.

High School Diploma or equivalent with 11+ years of relevant experience in a clinical lab setting, clinical training, field sales/support in medical device, healthcare industry or equivalent experience (OR Associate's Degree with 9+ years experience OR Baccalaureate Degree with 7+ years experience).

title: MSL I  - Doenças Raras (Nordeste, Centro-oeste ou São Paulo)
description:
PTC Therapeutics is a global commercial biopharmaceutical company. For over 25 years our team has been deeply committed to a unified purpose: Extending life’s moments for children and adults living with a rare disease.

At PTC, we cultivate an inclusive culture where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds to join our team, fostering a strong sense of belonging.

Visit our website to learn more about our company and culture!
Site:

Job Description Summary:

Job Description:


Location: Candidates must be based in Brazil’s Northeast (state capitals preferred), the Central-West, or São Paulo.


The Medical Science Liaison I (MSL I) is a field base position of Medical Affairs that supports and represents PTC and its products with, and to, key opinion leaders (KOLs), clinicians, academic institutions, and professional organizations. The incumbent addresses the specific needs of these clients by responding to unsolicited requests for information about PTC marketed and developing products.

As the clinical and medical expert on the company’s products, he/she builds long-term relationships and establishes rapport with clinicians and doctors, clinics and academic centers through highly scientific product and disease state discussions that support or expand current therapeutic concepts and ensures safe and effective utilization of products. The incumbent is also a resource to company management regarding market dynamics, business development and client feedback.

The MSL I supports adherence to relevant regulatory requirements and company Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) as appropriate.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS


  • Attends international, national and regional medical meetings and symposia as a representative of PTC and engages in discussions with attendees as appropriate; attends scientific sessions and poster presentations, gathers information, and summarizes findings; as possible, and when appropriate, cultivates professional relationships from these contacts.
  • Delivers, and may develop/design, fair-balanced and objective clinical and scientific presentations to healthcare professionals (HCPs), payors, patients organizations in response to unsolicited requests for information on the use of company products.
  • Identifies and trains speakers for advisory boards symposia, and educational programs with regulatory approved materials, slides sets, abstracts, posters, etc.
  • Identifies, organizes and carry outs regional medical initiatives e.g. advisory board as need.
  • Provides input to management regarding alternative therapies, business development opportunities/risks, and client feedback.
  • Establishes, manages and maintains successful relations with relevant health authorities, including but not limited to: KOLs, HCPs, academic institutions, payors, patient organizations, etc.
  • Facilitates the accurate and timely submissions of applications for unrestricted educational grants or research initiatives and requests for support of studies, per company policy.
  • Maintains a thorough awareness of medical/clinical, regulator, compliance and quality issues and processes as they apply to the PTC therapeutic areas and adheres to, and supports, the standards established by the company.
  • Maintains competitors information relevant to company’s therapeutic areas, goals/objectives, project activities and/product team priorities and stays current on therapeutic advances and competing therapies or products; analyses and applies relevant intelligence findings and communicates and presents insightful data/impact in an efficient format to appropriate internal stake holders.
  • Work closely with key HCPs, such as a field medical team, to identify new opportunities and contribute to the design of the strategic medical plan aligned with the company's objectives to meet stakeholder needs. Evaluate the results and consolidate them as best practices.
  • Work in partnership with the marketing department to contribute to the conception of innovative medical/marketing projects and, consequently, execute them in their own territory.
  • Participate in regular internal meetings with the brand teams, providing insight from the medical field to collaborate on the brand strategy and propose solutions whenever appropriate.
  • Budget planning required to conduct Medical Affairs projects.
  • Provide cross-functional technical support to different departments. Conduct and/or assist with training for PTC's internal clients to better understand the scientific understanding of the molecule.
  • Be able to conduct medical-scientific classes for payers and healthcare providers in other areas to support Market Access, Patient Organization, and Government Affairs strategies.
  • Support in developing the field medical-scientific communication plan.

REQUIREMENTS:

  • Degree in health sciences or related scientific discipline
  • Be based in Brazil’s Northeast (state capitals preferred), the Central-West, or São Paulo.
  • Previous experience in similar positions in a pharmaceutical, biotechnology or related environment
  • Rare disease experience within a pharmaceutical company is required.
  • Advanced English is required (oral and written).
  • Experience in clinical research is an asset.
  • Knowledge in project management and excellent understanding of the pharmaceutical delivery process.
  • Hands-on experience working with KOLs, clinicians, HCPs, payors and/or academic institutions
  • Must posses a valid driver’s license
  • Excellent verbal and written communication and skills, including scientific/technical writing and presentations
  • Field-based role with frequent travel (approx. 70%)

title: Senior Security Engineer (Detection Engineer)
description:
• We're taking an engineering-led approach to detection and response, building internal capability and technical depth alongside AI-assisted tooling. You’ll work as an individual contributor, driving workstreams from problem definition through delivery, breaking complex problems into actionable work, and executing independently within agreed architecture and practices
  • Permanent role based in Melbourne or Sydney as well as open to remote in other Australian locations

We're REA

With bold and ambitious goals, REA Group is changing the way the world experiences property. No matter where you're at on your property journey, we're here to help with every step - whether that's finding or financing your next home.

Our people are the key to our success. At the heart of everything we do, is a thriving culture centred around high performance and care. We are purpose driven and collaborative, which drives innovation and our ability to make a real impact. As such, we’re proud to have been named one of Australia’s Best Workplaces four times since 2021 — including third place in 2025 — plus Best Workplace for Women in 2023 and Best Workplace in Technology in 2024 and 2025. These listings are testament to every person who helps make REA a great place to work.


Where the team fits in

The Detection & Response team helps REA identify, investigate and respond to cyber threats across our environment. The team monitors security signals, validates alerts, investigates suspicious activity and leads or supports coordinated incident response including technical investigation and containment in partnership with engineering teams. With an increasing focus on detection and response engineering, the team continually strengthens REA’s ability to spot threats earlier, reduce the impact of incidents and learn from events to improve our security posture.


What the role is all about

As a Senior Security Engineer in Detection & Response, you’ll help modernise REA’s detection capability by operating and improving the data flows, telemetry integrations and detection workflows that power the detection platform. You’ll use AI-assisted tooling to develop, review and validate high-fidelity detections and response automations, applying sound security judgement and detection-as-code practices to improve coverage and alert quality. You’ll evaluate threat intelligence in the context of REA’s environment to focus detection coverage on relevant adversaries, investigate suspicious activity, and independently coordinate technical containment and response. You’ll work with and be supported by a diverse, dynamic, and well-rounded Detection & Response team. Working with wider Security and Engineering teams, you’ll improve detection quality and resilience over time.


Day to day of the job

  • Configure and operate the data flows that support our detection platform, including log forwarding, transformation and cost optimisation, working with Platform and Cloud teams where changes to existing integrations are needed.
  • Define the threats and behaviours to detect, then review, tune and validate the high-fidelity detections and correlation logic that identify malicious activity across our environment, delivering measurable improvements in detection coverage and alert quality.
  • Develop and maintain automated detection testing and validation processes to identify configuration drift, regressions and coverage gaps.
  • Analyse security events and logs to identify malicious activity, patterns and emerging attack techniques during investigations and proactive threat hunting.
  • Assess relevant threat intelligence and emerging attack techniques in the context of REA’s environment, translating the findings into improved detection coverage and signal quality.
  • Investigate security alerts and incidents, independently determine whether containment is required, coordinate technical response activities, and communicate findings, actions and risks to the wider incident response team and business stakeholders as needed.
  • Develop response playbooks and automation workflows to support rapid and effective incident containment and response.
  • Partner with product, platform and engineering teams to ensure new systems and changes have appropriate logging, monitoring and detection coverage.
  • Share knowledge with other Security and engineering teams, contributing to documentation, operational practices and continuous improvement.

Who we’re looking for

  • Hands-on experience configuring and operating data flows, including log forwarding, data transformation, API integrations, cost-optimised ingestion and observability pipeline tools, with the ability to work with Platform and Cloud teams when existing integrations need changes.
  • Practical experience working in cloud environments (AWS, GCP or Azure), with an understanding of cloud and application architectures, logging, monitoring, native security controls and common failure modes, and how to translate these into detection and response requirements.
  • Practical experience defining the threats and behaviours to detect, and reviewing, tuning and validating high-fidelity detections through established detection-engineering practices and repository workflows.
  • Strong log analysis skills, with the ability to parse, correlate and investigate security events across diverse log sources, and a working knowledge of scripting to understand and work effectively with security automation and SOAR workflows.
  • Experience with security observability tooling including EDR, SIEM, CNAPP, SOAR, and identity platforms, understanding their telemetry and how to leverage it for high-fidelity detections
  • Solid understanding of attacker techniques and frameworks (e.g. MITRE ATT&CK) and how to translate threat intelligence into effective detections and coverage assessments
  • Familiarity with modern DevOps practices including CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment for security tooling
  • Ability to build automation workflows for security operations and document operational procedures through playbooks, runbooks and detection test cases

The REA experience

The physical, mental, emotional and financial health of our people is something we’ll never stop caring about. This is a place to learn and grow.


Some of our Perks & Benefits include:

  • A hybrid and flexible approach to working
  • Flexible leave options including, birthday leave and purchase additional leave
  • Flexible parental leave offering for primary and secondary carers
  • Our Because We Care program offers employees volunteering leave, community grants, matched payroll giving and our Community Café donates 100% of revenue to charity
  • Hackdays so you can bring your big ideas to life

Our commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

We are committed to providing a working environment that embraces and values diversity, equity and inclusion. We believe teams with diverse ideas and experiences are more creative, more eﬀective and fuel disruptive thinking. If you've got the skills, dedication and enthusiasm to learn but don't necessarily meet every single point on the job description, please still get in touch.

title: Learning Systems & Development Specialist
description:
Position Summary

The Learning Systems & Development Specialist is responsible for designing, developing, implementing, and maintaining learning programs, training content, and technology solutions that support employee development across LAGOS. This role administers the Learning Management System (LMS), manages learning records and reporting, supports certification programs, and coordinates learning initiatives spanning onboarding, product education, sales enablement, leadership development, and compliance training. Serving as a key resource for learning technology, curriculum development, and learning effectiveness measurement, this role partners with subject matter experts and business leaders to deliver engaging, accurate, and scalable learning experiences aligned with organizational needs.


Key Responsibilities

Learning Management System Administration

  • Administer the LMS, including learner profiles, user permissions, organizational structures, and learning groups, ensuring data integrity and system reliability.
  • Publish and maintain learning content, curricula, and assignments across Retail, Wholesale, Ecommerce, Customer Experience, Corporate Functions, and external audiences.
  • Serve as the primary LMS resource for learners, managers, and trainers; troubleshoot issues, coordinate vendor support, and support system upgrades and integrations.


Learning Program Design & Development

  • Design and develop training content, including eLearning modules, job aids, facilitator guides, assessments, and microlearning, applying instructional design best practices and adult learning principles.
  • Partner with subject matter experts and business stakeholders to identify learning needs and build curricula and learning paths for onboarding, product education, sales enablement, leadership development, and compliance training.


Certification Programs & Learning Records

  • Administer certification programs, including assessments, tracking, renewals, and recertification cycles.
  • Maintain accurate, audit-ready learner records and monitor compliance training requirements. 2


Reporting & Learning Effectiveness

  • Develop dashboards and reports on training completion, compliance, certifications, learner engagement, and LMS utilization.
  • Measure learning effectiveness through assessment results, learner feedback, and performance indicators, and recommend improvements to HR and business leaders.


Learner Engagement & Enterprise Learning Support

  • Provide operational support for enterprise learning initiatives, including program launches, scheduling, logistics, and communications that drive participation and engagement.
  • Develop user guides and FAQs, and support the delivery of virtual and in-person training as needed.


Key Performance Indicators

  • Training Completion Rate
  • LMS Adoption & Learner Engagement Rate
  • Certification Compliance Rate
  • On-Time Delivery of New & Updated Learning Content
  • LMS Support Resolution Time

title: Director, Risk Advisory
description:
Make banking a Fifth Third better®
We connect great people to great opportunities. Are you ready to take the next step? Discover a career in banking at Fifth Third Bank.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

The Director, Risk Advisory leads the Risk Advisory capability within Strategic Client Advisory Solutions. The role establishes a consistent approach for incorporating insurance and risk-management considerations into the wealth strategy process, leads and develops the Risk Advisory team, and personally advises on complex client situations. The Director partners with Wealth Advisors, Wealth Strategists and other specialists to identify protection, liquidity, estate, business succession and wealth-transfer needs and to coordinate appropriate insurance solutions. The role oversees case quality, regional alignment, operating discipline and risk governance while maintaining direct accountability for client and advisor engagement.

Please see below for specific responsibilities and requirements for this role.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES:

The responsibilities for this role are below; you may support projects of varying complexity based on skill and organizational priorities.

· Player/Coach Leadership: Lead, coach and develop Risk Advisory consultants while maintaining an active portfolio of complex client engagements and serving as the senior escalation point for advanced insurance planning matters.

· Risk Advisory Strategy: Translate the SCAS strategy into a practical Risk Advisory operating model, priorities, standards and performance expectations aligned to client value and holistic wealth planning.

· Wealth Strategy Integration: Own the core risk-assessment questions, decision pathways and documentation standards incorporated into new wealth strategies; ensure identified needs and outcomes are routed to Risk Advisory.

· Complex Client Advice: Partner with Wealth Advisors, Wealth Strategists, fiduciary professionals and external advisors to assess sophisticated life, disability, long-term care, annuity, liquidity and wealth-transfer considerations.

· Solution Governance: Provide oversight of case design, insurance recommendations, policy exceptions, carrier and product considerations, documentation and implementation quality within established policies and risk appetite.

· Regional Coverage: Align consultant coverage by region, monitor demand and capacity, and promote consistent access to Risk Advisory expertise across the Private Bank footprint.

· Advisor Enablement: Develop education, tools and consultation routines that help advisors recognize risk-management needs and integrate Risk Advisory earlier in the client planning process.

· Operating Discipline: Establish workflow, service standards, pipeline visibility, client-outcome measures and management reporting; improve processes that reduce administrative burden on senior advisory talent.

· Cross-Functional Partnership: Collaborate with SCAS, Private Bank, Insurance Operations, Legal, Compliance, Risk and third-party providers to execute solutions and resolve complex matters.

· Business and Client Outcomes: Support relationship acquisition, retention and deepening by delivering advice-led solutions and measuring success through client value, quality, adoption and execution rather than individual product production alone.

· Other Duties: Performing other duties as assigned, adapting to new tasks or shifts in priorities as necessary to support your team's and the company's mission.

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:

· Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and experience.

· Appropriate state insurance licenses for Life, Health and Long-Term Care, as required under Fifth Third licensing guidelines.

· 10+ years of insurance, wealth planning or related financial-services experience, including significant experience with high-net-worth clients.

· Demonstrated experience leading or coaching professionals and managing complex client engagements in a regulated environment.



REQUIRED SKILLS:

Qualified candidates will possess an advanced degree of proficiency, typically developed through 10 or more years of relevant experience, in:

· Advanced Insurance Planning: Evaluating and explaining sophisticated insurance structures within estate, liquidity, business succession and wealth-transfer planning.

· Advisory Leadership: Leading a client-focused advisory function while personally delivering complex work.

· Holistic Wealth Integration: Connecting risk-management recommendations to broader wealth plans and coordinating across multiple specialists.

· Risk and Regulatory Judgment: Applying licensing, suitability, fiduciary, documentation and escalation requirements in a regulated financial-services environment.

· Executive Communication: Translating complex concepts into clear recommendations for clients, advisors and senior stakeholders.

Please refer to the “Skills for Success” section to learn how to stand out as an applicant.

SKILLS FOR SUCCESS:

Qualified candidates will possess an advanced degree of proficiency across a suite of skills including, but not limited to:

· Professional Designations: CLU, ChFC, CFP or comparable advanced insurance or wealth-planning designation.

· Matrix Influence: Building credibility and driving consistent execution across regions and teams without relying solely on direct authority.

· Talent Development: Coaching consultants, reviewing work quality and building technical and advisory capability.

· Process Design: Creating practical assessment tools, workflows, service standards and metrics that scale an advisory capability.

· Change Leadership: Repositioning a production-oriented activity into an integrated, advice-led client capability.

DOING THE RIGHT THING:

Our employees take pride in doing the right thing for customers and colleagues as well as being accountable for risk by openly exchanging ideas and opinions, elevating concerns, and following policies and procedures that protect all our valuable assets, including you.

title: PeopleSoft Technical Leader
description:
About the Role

We are looking for an experienced PeopleSoft Technical Leader to lead the technical evolution, stability, and continuous improvement of our PeopleSoft Finance & Procurement platform. This role combines deep technical expertise, solution leadership, architecture oversight, coaching, and stakeholder engagement.

As the technical authority for the platform, you will guide engineering teams in delivering scalable, secure, and sustainable solutions while promoting a "standard first" mindset. You will drive lifecycle management initiatives, reduce technical debt, enable adoption of new PeopleSoft capabilities, and ensure the platform remains fit for the future.


Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership

  • Act as the technical reference for PeopleSoft FSCM, PeopleTools, Oracle technologies, integrations, and development frameworks.
  • Define and enforce engineering standards, coding guidelines, and solution design principles.
  • Review and challenge technical designs to ensure maintainability, scalability, and alignment with enterprise architecture.

Solution Design & Delivery

  • Lead the design and implementation of complex PeopleSoft solutions across Finance and Procurement domains.
  • Ensure business requirements are fulfilled through delivered functionality whenever possible before considering customization.
  • Provide architectural guidance for integrations, workflow automation, reporting, and data exchange solutions.
  • Support critical project deliveries and production issue resolution.

Continuous Improvement & Innovation

  • Promote simplification, automation, and standardization across the PeopleSoft landscape.
  • Identify opportunities to replace custom developments with delivered functionality.
  • Drive adoption of new PeopleTools features, PUM images, and Oracle technologies.

Lifecycle Management

  • Lead PeopleTools upgrades, PUM implementations, security patching, and platform modernization activities.
  • Ensure solutions remain aligned with Oracle best practices and vendor roadmaps.
  • Drive technical debt reduction and improve upgrade readiness.
  • Support environment standardization and deployment automation.

Platform Stability & Operational Excellence

  • Ensure platform availability, performance, security, and resilience.
  • Guide incident investigation, root cause analysis, and problem management activities.
  • Collaborate with platform engineers to improve monitoring, observability, and operational processes.
  • Maintain compliance with security, audit, and regulatory requirements.

Coaching & Team Development

  • Mentor developers, technical analysts, and platform engineers.
  • Foster a culture of engineering excellence, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning.
  • Support onboarding and professional development of team members.

Required Experience

  • 8+ years of PeopleSoft technical experience.
  • Strong expertise in PeopleSoft FSCM 9.2 and PeopleTools 8.61.
  • Extensive experience with:
    • PeopleCode
    • Application Engine
    • Component Interface
  • Strong Oracle SQL and PL/SQL skills.
  • Experience with PeopleSoft upgrades, PUM adoption, and lifecycle management.
  • Proven experience leading technical teams and complex delivery initiatives.
  • Experience working in Agile and DevOps environments.

Preferred Experience

  • Banking or Financial Services industry experience.
  • Knowledge of Procure-to-Pay (P2P), Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, General Ledger, Asset Management, Expense Management, and Billing processes.
  • Experience with cloud and CI/CD technologies.

What Makes You Successful

  • Have a strong ownership mindset and lead by example.
  • Challenge complexity and promote sustainable solutions.
  • Balance business value with technical excellence.
  • Communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Continuously learn and stay abreast of PeopleSoft, Oracle, and ERP innovations.
  • Inspire teams to deliver high-quality solutions while maintaining operational stability.
  • Foster collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.
