title: Principal Propulsion Engineer (Liquid Rocket Engine Assembly RE)
description:
Who We Are:

Venus Aerospace is revolutionizing rocket engine propulsion. With the first generational leap in rocket engine technology since Apollo, our proprietary Rotating Detonation Rocket Engine delivers historic efficiency and performance across aerospace applications. We are building the next generation of propulsion platforms that enable breakthrough capabilities in space, defense, and commercial high-speed flight. Our team thrives on solving the toughest engineering challenges and pushing the boundaries of what’s possible in aerospace. At Venus, we’re looking for bold engineers and innovators who want to make history and redefine the future of propulsion.

The Role: Principal Propulsion Engineer

As a Principal Propulsion Engineer, you will be involved in the design, analysis, and development of propulsion hardware from piece parts to engine assemblies. You will be responsible for taking designs from concepts to flight maturity hardware. The ideal candidate will be a self-starter and self-motivated individual who is comfortable working in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

What You'll Get To Do

  • Support design, analysis, manufacturing, and testing of propulsion piece parts and assemblies
  • Generate CAD models of components and engine systems
  • Fluid network modeling, analysis and design: design and analysis engine fluid systems, identify COTS components for fluid systems, work with suppliers to source components.
  • Generate P&ID’s of engine systems
  • Develop and execute test plans; analyze test results
  • Systems engineering experience focusing on generating engine balances, engine sizing and requirements, technical understanding of various engine cycles, and trading cycle efficiencies of various engine cycles
  • Use engine P&IDs to generate fully detailed CAD models of engine assemblies
  • Use agile methodology to break down complex projects into daily and weekly actionable tasks
  • Own the entire lifecycle of an engine assembly: combustor, thrust take-out structure, gimbal system, possibly pump and possibly hot gas turbine, flow control devices, etc.
  • Mentoring younger team members to increase their experience of the team in headquarters

What You Have

  • 10+ years of aerospace vehicle and engine systems engineering/design experience
  • Bachelor’s degree in aerospace or mechanical engineering
  • Systems engineering and operational experience
  • Experience working on multidisciplinary project teams
  • Knowledge of standard aerospace materials used in designs of propulsion systems for high mechanical and thermal loads
  • Knowledge of aerospace fluid systems component and fluid connections specifications
  • The ideal candidate will be a multi-disciplinary engineer with a diverse set of skills and experience in some or most of these fields of expertise: mechanical and fluid systems designs, structural/thermal design and analysis, engine testing and hot-fire data analysis, hands-on experience with assembling and testing propulsion systems, generating complex CAD models and designing for manufacturing (DFM), including excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • 5+ years of CAD experience, particularly working with large assemblies
  • Experience in some of the design and analysis tools such as NX / SolidWorks, ANSYS mechanical, CFX / StarCCM+, Matlab / Python, GFSSP, Microsoft Visio
  • Strong communication skills to effectively work in a hybrid in-person/remote work environment

What Will Set You Apart

  • Master’s, PhD degree in aerospace or mechanical engineering
  • Experience with RDREs or RDEs
  • Project management/leadership
  • Familiarity with Agile methods
  • Strong background in systems engineering for engine or PPMS systems
  • Engine and/or engine component testing
  • Familiarity with standards such as SMC-S-016, NASA STD-5012, AIAA S-080A-2018
  • Experience developing and standardizing processes for design, analysis, and testing
  • Responsible engineer experience in hotfire testing of liquid rocket engine assemblies, especially those that have gone wrong.

Benefits:

Venus Aerospace employee benefits include a 401(k) plan, stock options, and medical benefits, including dental and vision. We have a flex-Friday flexible schedule, unlimited PTO, and receive professional development opportunities.

The role involves applying knowledge of software systems, data structures, database management, cloud infrastructure, software architecture, and Agile delivery practices to support technology initiatives.

The successful candidate will lead and manage cross-functional technology teams, translate business requirements into technology solutions, guide technical implementation, evaluate emerging technologies, and support the delivery of scalable and maintainable data-oriented solutions. The role contributes to business objectives by improving technology delivery, supporting informed technical decisions, increasing operational efficiency, and aligning technology initiatives with organizational strategy.



Software Requirements


Required Software Skills


  • Ab Initio: Experience developing, maintaining, supporting, or enhancing Ab Initio-based data and software solutions relevant to the assigned Synechron project.
  • Software systems: In-depth understanding of various technologies, software systems, integrations, dependencies, and development practices.
  • Project-management tools: Familiarity with tools used for project planning, task management, reporting, collaboration, risk tracking, and delivery governance.
  • Agile methodologies: Knowledge of Agile development methodologies and iterative software delivery practices.
  • Software architecture: Understanding of software architecture principles, system design, integration patterns, reusable components, and design patterns.
  • Cloud computing: Knowledge of cloud computing platforms and infrastructure, including deployment, scalability, availability, security, and operational considerations.
  • Database management: Knowledge of database management systems, data structures, data processing, data quality, and data integration.
  • Technical documentation: Ability to prepare technical specifications, architecture documentation, roadmaps, implementation plans, and operational procedures.
  • Software versions: Experience working with the Ab Initio, database, cloud, project-management, source-control, and development tool versions used by the assigned Synechron project.

Preferred Software Skills


  • Experience with additional programming languages used in software development, data processing, automation, or integration.
  • Familiarity with source-control, build, deployment, continuous integration, and continuous delivery tools.
  • Experience with data integration, data warehousing, data quality, metadata, data lineage, or data governance tools.
  • Familiarity with cloud-native architectures, infrastructure automation, containers, or distributed systems.
  • Experience with reporting, dashboarding, monitoring, and operational support tools.
  • Experience evaluating technology platforms and preparing adoption recommendations.

Equivalent tools and technologies may be considered where they provide comparable capabilities.


Overall Responsibilities


  • Lead and manage cross-functional technology teams involved in software development, data solutions, and technology initiatives.
  • Provide technical guidance, mentorship, delivery support, and implementation direction to team members.
  • Drive technology initiatives and ensure successful delivery of projects within agreed scope, quality, timeline, and resource expectations.
  • Develop, maintain, support, and enhance Ab Initio-based solutions where applicable to project requirements.
  • Apply knowledge of software architecture, data structures, database systems, cloud infrastructure, and design patterns to technology solutions.
  • Identify areas for improvement and implement process changes to increase efficiency, quality, reliability, and delivery transparency.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to understand business requirements and translate them into practical technology solutions.
  • Develop technical specifications, implementation plans, solution documentation, technical roadmaps, and delivery recommendations.
  • Evaluate new technologies and make recommendations for adoption based on business value, technical suitability, security, maintainability, sustainability, and operational impact.
  • Develop and maintain technology roadmaps and ensure alignment with overall business strategy.
  • Work with delivery teams to manage project milestones, dependencies, risks, issues, quality expectations, and technical decisions.
  • Manage vendor relationships and support contract, service, delivery, and performance discussions.
  • Collaborate with development, data, architecture, cloud, security, testing, operations, and business teams.
  • Support technical issue resolution, root-cause analysis, process improvement, and operational readiness.
  • Promote sustainable technology practices by encouraging reusable components, efficient processing, maintainable solutions, and responsible use of cloud and infrastructure resources.
  • Measure performance through delivery outcomes, solution quality, operational stability, efficiency improvements, stakeholder alignment, and progress against technology roadmap objectives.


Technical Skills (By Category)


Programming Languages


Essential


  • Experience with Ab Initio development and data-processing solutions.
  • Strong understanding of software development principles, modular design, reusable components, testing, debugging, and maintainability.
  • Ability to understand and contribute to technical implementation using one or more programming or scripting languages.
  • Ability to interpret business and technical requirements and translate them into implementation activities.

Preferred


  • Proficiency in one or more programming languages used in software development, such as Java, Python, or Node.js.
  • Experience with scripting for automation, data processing, testing, deployment, or operational support.
  • Familiarity with programming practices that support scalable and maintainable data solutions.

Databases/Data Management


Essential


  • Knowledge of database management systems and data structures.
  • Understanding of data storage, retrieval, transformation, integration, validation, and quality considerations.
  • Ability to assess how data requirements affect solution design, software architecture, and implementation.
  • Experience collaborating with technical teams on data-related requirements and delivery activities.

Preferred


  • Experience with relational or non-relational databases.
  • Familiarity with data warehousing, data integration, data quality, metadata, data lineage, or data governance.
  • Experience supporting enterprise data platforms, reporting systems, or business data solutions.
  • Exposure to data migration, data reconciliation, or large-scale data-processing initiatives.

Cloud Technologies


Essential


  • Knowledge of cloud computing platforms and infrastructure.
  • Understanding of cloud deployment models, compute, storage, networking, scalability, availability, security, monitoring, and support.
  • Ability to evaluate cloud-related technical options and their impact on delivery, cost, performance, and operational support.
  • Experience collaborating with cloud and infrastructure teams on technology initiatives.

Preferred


  • Experience developing, deploying, or supporting data and software solutions in cloud environments.
  • Familiarity with cloud-native architectures, containers, automation, infrastructure as code, and distributed systems.
  • Experience assessing cloud resource efficiency, operational resilience, and sustainable technology practices.

Frameworks and Libraries


Essential


  • Experience working with Ab Initio components, workflows, data-processing processes, and relevant project technologies.
  • Understanding of software frameworks, libraries, integrations, dependencies, and compatibility considerations.
  • Ability to evaluate technology components based on maintainability, scalability, performance, security, and business requirements.

Preferred


  • Experience with frameworks and libraries used for Java, Python, Node.js, cloud, data processing, or systems integration.
  • Familiarity with API frameworks, integration libraries, testing tools, or deployment components.
  • Exposure to reusable data-processing frameworks and configuration-driven solutions.

Development Tools and Methodologies


Essential


  • Knowledge of Agile development methodologies.
  • Familiarity with project-management tools and delivery-governance practices.
  • Experience with software development lifecycle activities, including requirements analysis, design, development, testing, deployment, support, and documentation.
  • Experience leading or supporting cross-functional technology teams and managing projects.
  • Ability to prepare and maintain technical specifications, roadmaps, implementation plans, status reports, and delivery documentation.
  • Experience with code reviews, defect resolution, technical support, risk management, and process improvement.

Preferred


  • Familiarity with Scrum, Kanban, hybrid delivery, or other iterative development approaches.
  • Experience with source control, continuous integration, continuous delivery, build, release, and deployment tools.
  • Exposure to technology governance, architecture reviews, portfolio planning, or enterprise transformation initiatives.
  • Experience with delivery metrics, operational dashboards, issue tracking, and technology performance reporting.

Security Protocols


Essential


  • Awareness of secure software development, data protection, access control, authentication, authorization, and infrastructure security.
  • Ability to consider security, privacy, compliance, and operational risks when designing or evaluating technology solutions.
  • Understanding of secure handling of application code, configuration, credentials, data, and cloud resources.
  • Ability to collaborate with security and governance teams to address technical risks and controls.

Preferred


  • Familiarity with encryption, secrets management, vulnerability management, secure APIs, security testing, auditability, and compliance controls.
  • Experience supporting security requirements for cloud, data, software, or enterprise technology platforms.
  • Knowledge of security considerations related to data integration and data-processing solutions.


Experience Requirements


  • 8–10 years of experience in technology leadership, software development, data development, technology delivery, or a related field.
  • Experience with Ab Initio development, implementation, support, enhancement, or data-processing solutions.
  • Strong technical expertise across multiple areas of software development and technology.
  • Experience leading cross-functional teams and managing technology projects.
  • Experience translating business requirements into technical solutions and implementation plans.
  • Experience with cloud computing platforms and infrastructure.
  • Knowledge of Agile development methodologies and project-management tools.
  • Experience developing and maintaining technical roadmaps aligned with business strategy.
  • Experience evaluating technologies and making recommendations for adoption.
  • Experience managing vendor relationships and participating in contract, service, or delivery discussions.
  • Industry experience in technology, data platforms, software development, financial services, or enterprise technology environments is preferred.
  • Candidates may also qualify through equivalent combinations of Ab Initio development, data engineering, technical leadership, solution design, technology delivery, architecture, or platform implementation experience that demonstrate the required capabilities and outcomes.


Day-to-Day Activities


  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to understand business requirements, clarify priorities, and translate needs into Ab Initio and broader technology solutions.
  • Lead cross-functional technology teams, provide technical guidance, review progress, resolve dependencies, and support team members through mentoring and knowledge sharing.
  • Evaluate technologies, maintain technology roadmaps, prepare technical specifications, manage project deliverables and vendors, and provide progress and risk updates.

Qualifications

  • A minimum of 8–10 years of experience in technology leadership and software development is required as specified.
  • Certification in Ab Initio, cloud computing, Agile delivery, project management, software architecture, or a related discipline is preferred but not mandatory.
  • Relevant training in Ab Initio, software architecture, cloud infrastructure, data management, Agile methodologies, project management, security, or vendor management is preferred.
  • Commitment to continuous professional development through technical learning, leadership development, knowledge sharing, relevant certification, and awareness of evolving technology practices.


Professional Competencies


  • Apply analytical reasoning and structured problem-solving to evaluate complex technology challenges, identify root causes, and recommend practical solutions.
  • Lead cross-functional teams by providing clear technical direction, mentoring team members, supporting collaboration, and promoting shared delivery accountability.
  • Communicate business requirements, technical options, roadmaps, risks, recommendations, and delivery information clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

title: Software Engineer
description:
Your Future Evolves Here

Evolent partners with health plans and providers to achieve better outcomes for people with most complex and costly health conditions. Working across specialties and primary care, we seek to connect the pieces of fragmented health care system and ensure people get the same level of care and compassion we would want for our loved ones.

Evolent employees enjoy work/life balance, the flexibility to suit their work to their lives, and autonomy they need to get things done. We believe that people do their best work when they're supported to live their best lives, and when they feel welcome to bring their whole selves to work. That's one reason why diversity and inclusion are core to our business.

Join Evolent for the mission. Stay for the culture.

What You’ll Be Doing:

Position Summary

The Software Engineer designs, develops, tests, and maintains features in the web user experience for the Evolent Platform. Working in an Agile, globally distributed team, this role builds React and Next.js (TypeScript) features and partners with product managers, designers, and other engineers to deliver clean, accessible, and reliable code.

This individual works with minimal supervision on assigned features, actively learning and adopting the development methods, frameworks, and patterns defined for the role and by the team, and contributes to the design and implementation of enhancements to the team’s systems. The role is expected to use approved AI-assisted tools to accelerate delivery and improve quality while remaining fully accountable for every result delivered.

AI-Assisted Engineering Expectations

Evolent engineers are expected to effectively leverage approved AI-assisted development and productivity tools (e.g., code assistants, copilots, automation agents, knowledge assistants, and analytics tools) to improve quality, efficiency, and innovation while maintaining accountability for all delivered work. These expectations span the full engineering lifecycle, not only code generation, including iterating with AI on solution design, evaluating alternatives, and producing design artifacts. Engineers remain responsible for validating outputs, ensuring solution quality, protecting sensitive information, and complying with security, privacy, regulatory, and Responsible AI standards.

Key Responsibilities

Design and Development

• Design, develop, test, and maintain React and Next.js features for assigned areas of the application, following the team’s established patterns and coding standards.

• Build Server and Client Components, forms, and data-heavy screens, such as grids and document viewers, using the team’s component library.

• Integrate features with backend-for-frontend endpoints and platform APIs.

• Write component and end-to-end tests using Vitest, React Testing Library, and Playwright.

• Collaborate with product managers, designers, and other engineers to understand requirements and translate them into technical specifications.

• Contribute to the design and implementation of enhancements to the team’s systems.

Quality and Continuous Improvement

• Build accessible components that meet WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA and Section 508, and fix accessibility defects.

• Participate in code reviews to ensure code quality, functionality, and maintainability, and seek feedback to continuously improve skills.

• Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve technical issues and bugs in a timely manner.

• Follow and help reinforce the team’s development processes and standards, helping peers understand the benefits and risks of exceptions.

• Contribute to the continuous improvement of development processes and tools and stay current with emerging front-end and agentic UI technologies.

AI-Enabled Delivery

• Utilize approved AI-assisted engineering tools, such as GitHub Copilot, to accelerate software development, testing, documentation, and troubleshooting.

• Evaluate and validate AI-generated outputs for correctness, security, maintainability, compliance, and business appropriateness before use.

• Learn and adopt the prompts, skills, agents, and AI-assisted development patterns defined by the team and share improvements that benefit the team.

• Identify opportunities to improve engineering productivity and quality through AI-enabled workflows and automation.

Governance and Compliance

• Follow enterprise policies governing AI usage, intellectual property protection, security, privacy, PHI handling, and Responsible AI practices.

• Handle patient data safely under HIPAA, following the team’s standards for keeping PHI out of browser storage, logs, and telemetry.

• Ensure no confidential, regulated, or protected information is used with unapproved AI services or tooling.

• Participate in peer reviews and validation processes for AI-assisted solutions.

Required Qualifications

• 2+ years of professional software development experience building web applications with React and TypeScript.

• Working knowledge of Next.js or another server rendered React framework.

• Solid understanding of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and modern React patterns, such as hooks, state management, and component composition.

• Familiarity with REST APIs and asynchronous data fetching, including streaming responses.

• Working knowledge of web accessibility (WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA) and semantic HTML.

• Familiarity with Vitest or Jest, React Testing Library, and Playwright.

• Familiarity with Git-based version control (e.g., GitHub) and pull requests, and CI/CD using GitHub Actions.

• Regular use of AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot.

• Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently and as part of a globally distributed team.

• Strong communication skills, openness to feedback, and the ability to articulate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with enterprise component libraries such as KendoReact (Telerik) or MUI.

• Familiarity with Entra ID (Azure AD) and OpenID Connect.

• Familiarity with Python or C# and .NET.

• Familiarity with Docker and Kubernetes.

• Familiarity with FHIR R4.

• Healthcare domain experience.

Education

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

To ensure a secure hiring process we have implemented several identity verification steps, including submission of a government issued photo ID. We conduct identity verification during interviews, and final interviews may require onsite attendance. All candidates must complete a comprehensive background check, in-person I-9 verification, and may be subject to drug screening prior to employment. The use of artificial intelligence tools during interviews is prohibited and monitored. Misrepresentation will result in immediate disqualification from consideration.

Technical Requirements:

We require that all employees have the following technical capability at their home: High speed internet over 10 Mbps and, specifically for all call center employees, the ability to plug in directly to the home internet router.

Evolent is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants equally without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability status. If you need reasonable accommodation to access the information provided on this website, please contact recruitingteam@evolent.com for further assistance.

The expected base salary/wage range for this position is $112,000-123,000. As part of our total compensation package, Evolent is proud to offer comprehensive benefits (including health insurance benefits) to qualifying employees. All compensation determinations are based on the skills and experience required for the position and commensurate with experience of selected individuals, which may vary above and below the stated amounts.

title: Recruiting Coordinator
description:
Who We Are:
FitzMark is a third-party logistics provider specializing in all modes of transportation. We deliver best-in-class services for both our customers and carriers by leveraging our proprietary technology, DASH, and maintaining a proactive operational approach to ensure all logistics needs are guaranteed. With offices strategically located in Indianapolis (HQ), Atlanta, Birmingham, Buffalo, Chattanooga, Denver, Fort Worth, Gainesville, Jackson, Kansas City, Nashville, Omaha and Scottsdale, FitzMark has been able to sustain growth in a complex industry and market.
At FitzMark, success is driven by emphasizing our employees’ accomplishments in a collaborative and dynamic environment. We provide the tools and resources necessary to promote a culture of ownership and accountability to guide your career path and financial freedom.
Are you ready to make your mark?

FitzMark is looking for a Recruiting Coordinator to join our team and provide skillsets vital to a streamlined candidate and new hire experience. This position will be responsible for providing support to the recruiting process, assisting in growing a strong talent pipeline, building effective internal relationships with recruiters, hiring managers, and Universities, maintaining our applicant tracking system, and working along HR in the pre-employment processing for new hires across multiple locations.
The ideal candidate holds an HR background combined with work experience in coordinating recruitment processes and a passion for people.

  • Utilize an active approach to source candidates using a variety of methods to build a robust candidate pipeline
  • Track status of offer letters, referral bonuses, and other recruiting correspondence

  • Coordinate travel arrangements for new hires and recruiting team as necessary
  • Assist branch leadership and trainers in executing New Hire Day 1
  • Manage registration, coordination, travel, follow up, and campus relations for all University Career Fairs
  • Prepare recruitment materials for various events and platforms
  • Support recruiting projects and assist with process optimization
  • Maintain a positive candidate experience through offer and onboarding process, creating a seamless transition for a new FitzMark employee

Experience and Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field preferred
  • One (1) year Talent Acquisition or Recruiting experience preferred
  • One (1) to two (2) years professional and administrative experience preferred
  • Excellent communication skills both verbal and written
  • Strong administrative skills which include organization and attention to detail

Hours: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM
Location: On-Site Downtown Indianapolis Office

FitzMark provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

title: Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer (AWS) (copy)
description:
Verisys is looking for a hands-on Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer with deep AWS expertise to help build, secure, and scale the infrastructure behind our healthcare credentialing platform. Our environment is primarily Windows-based, and you will be our subject matter expert for Linux, our on-premises Nutanix environment, container platforms (Rancher and Amazon ECS Anywhere), SMTP relay, and SSL/TLS certificates. This is a remote role with high ownership, focused mainly on DevOps and cloud engineering with a meaningful systems administration component. This is a generalist role on a small team: you will move between cloud engineering, systems administration, and whatever the business needs next, so comfort with shifting priorities matters as much as any single skill.

Please note this is a remote opportunity, but you "MUST" live in one of the following states to be considered: AZ, CO, FL, GA, IL, IN, KS, KY, MD, MA, MO, NC, OH, OK, PA, TN, UT, VA, WI

Duties/Responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and operate secure, highly available AWS infrastructure (EC2, VPC, IAM, ECS, S3, RDS, Route 53, CloudWatch, Systems Manager) following the AWS Well-Architected Framework, with an eye on security, cost, and disaster recovery.
  • Manage infrastructure as code (CloudFormation) and support CI/CD pipelines for container builds and deployments.
  • Run containerized workloads on Amazon ECS and ECS Anywhere, and administer Rancher native Cattle clusters.

Required Skills/Abilities:

  • Deep, hands-on AWS experience and strong knowledge of AWS security, networking, and best practices.
  • Expert-level Linux administration and strong Windows Server administration skills.
  • Hands-on experience with Rancher-native Cattle clusters and Amazon ECS / ECS Anywhere.
  • Strong hands-on experience administering Nutanix hyperconverged infrastructure, including Prism Element, Prism Central, and AHV.
  • Proficiency with CloudFormation, and PowerShell/Bash scripting; strong Python skills are a major plus.
  • Working knowledge of SMTP relay configuration and end-to-end SSL/TLS certificate management (CSRs, chains, OpenSSL, PEM/PFX).
  • Solid networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, DNS, load balancing, VPN, and security groups.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work independently in a remote environment.
  • Adaptable and comfortable wearing many hats, with the ability to shift between cloud, systems, and support work as priorities change.

Education/Experience:

  • 5+ years in Cloud Engineering, DevOps, SRE, and/or systems administration, including 3+ years supporting production workloads in AWS.
  • Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent practical experience.

Company Overview:

Verisys transforms provider data, workforce data, and relationship management. More than 400 healthcare, life science, and background screening organizations depend on us to credential providers, improve data quality, publish compliant provider directories, and conduct employment verifications. Our comprehensive solutions deliver accurate and secure information. As a result, we’re the largest outsourced credentials verification organization in the United States. Since we’ve partnered with the most complex institutions in healthcare for decades, we can help organizations of any size discover their true potential.

At Verisys, you can have a rewarding career on every level. In addition to challenging and meaningful work, you will have the chance to give back to your community, make a positive impact on the environment, participate in a range of diversity and inclusion initiatives, and find the support, coaching, and training it takes to advance your career. Our commitment to individual choice lets you customize aspects of your career path, your educational opportunities, and your benefits. And our culture of innovation means your ideas on how to improve our business and our clients will be heard.

Verisys is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We encourage all qualified persons of every heritage, nation, gender, veteran, or disability status, age, religion, or other protected status to apply.

title: Supervisor, Maintenance Shop Light Vehicle
description:
Elk Valley Resources (EVR) operates four steelmaking coal mines that employ over 5,000 people in the Elk Valley of British Columbia. We are committed to responsible resource development, environmental performance and building strong partnerships with communities and Indigenous Peoples.
EVR is proud to be part of the Glencore Group, contributing to a global portfolio of operations with a history that dates back more than 100 years in Canada.

Are you looking for a new career opportunity? Join our team.

Application Deadline: October 28th, 2026

What we offer:

At EVR, we're dedicated to supporting our workforce on their unique career journeys.

EVR recognizes our employees' skills, competencies, and performance and offers opportunities with competitive compensation and benefits. We also aim to promote employee health and wellness and provide opportunities for professional development.

We believe in the power of diversity and strive each day to create a workplace where each individual is valued and respected for their contributions.

We also believe that our employees are the reason we are accomplishing great things and are committed to supporting them through our many different programs.

About the role:

Reporting to the Maintenance Superintendent, the Supervisor, Maintenance will be responsible for all maintenance activities for a fleet of Light and Medium Duty Vehicles. The positions combine the responsibilities for trades, schedule execution, continuous improvement, and staffing to ensure company standards are maintained. The position follows a 4x4 schedule rotation of day shifts only.

To be successful, we are looking for someone with excellent organizational, interpersonal, and communication skills, who can coordinate the efforts of others to accomplish objectives. The successful individuals will thrive in a fast-paced environment with minimal direction and work well collaborating with a team. We are looking for professionals with strong problem solving and decision-making abilities, who is passionate about technology and continuous improvement.

Join us in the breathtaking Elk Valley of British Columbia. Here you will find outdoor adventure at your fingertips. Whether it's biking and skiing, or the laid-back atmosphere of fishing and hiking, there is something for everyone! Come experience what work life balance is all about!

Benefits:

  • Two Annual Bonus Plans
  • Comprehensive Benefits Plan
  • Retirement Package
  • Health Lifestyle Account
  • Relocation Assistance

In this role you will:

  • Participate in and adhere to health and safety programs and policies
  • Direct the technical troubleshooting of equipment failures to determine root cause and initiate appropriate remedial action
  • Oversee quality maintenance and repair of medium and light duty equipment to improve availability and reliability for production
  • Manage daily and weekly work schedules to ensure work is complete on time and on budget through usage of Short Interval Controls and ensure Preventative Maintenance compliance
  • Supervise contractors and employees, improving employee work performance, efficiency, and perform performance evaluations
  • Follow-up on current jobs and assist tradespeople with technical troubleshooting
  • Assist with the development of the schedule
  • Assist in sourcing and requisitioning maintenance supplies, equipment, and services within budgeted guidelines
  • Maintain team vacation schedules using Vacation Allotment guidelines, recommending, and approving overtime work
  • Manage Key Performance Indicators, such as downtime hours, schedule compliance, and labour factor

Requirements:

  • Trade certification, technical diploma, or degree in a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
  • Experience in maintenance and maintenance reliability in an industrial environment
  • Experience supervising or leading a team
  • Strong digital literacy and proficient in the Microsoft Office Suite®
Salary: $123,000 - $145,000 CAD/year

The actual base salary offered is determined based on the successful candidate’s relevant experience, skills, and competencies and considers internal equity.
To all applicants, your interest and effort are sincerely appreciated. While we thank everyone for their application, only those selected for an interview will be contacted. Successful candidates must be willing to satisfy the pre-employment requirements of a pre-employment drug screen and three professional references.
As part of our recruitment process, EVR uses AI tools to assist with reviewing and summarizing candidate information. Personal information provided in your application and interview may be processed by these tools. Your information will be handled in accordance with EVR’s Recruitment Privacy Policy, which you can view here.
About EVR
EVR is a Canadian steelmaking coal producer. We take our responsibilities to our people, to society and to the environment seriously. The high-quality steelmaking coal EVR produces is an essential input for steel that can be used for constructing products such as wind turbines and critical infrastructure including rail, bridges, hospitals and schools.

title: Festival Of Lights Hiring Event - Open Walk-In Interviews
description:
Pyramid Global Hospitality is a leading hospitality management company with a portfolio of more than 200 hotels and resorts and over 18,000 associates across the United States, Caribbean, and Europe. Our platform includes Benchmark Resorts & Hotels, a collection of distinctive independent properties; Axiom Hospitality, our European hotel management company; and PYRAMIDWORKS, which provides integrated workplace and facilities services. With corporate offices in Boston, The Woodlands, Texas, and London, Pyramid combines global scale with a hands-on approach focused on exceptional service, operational excellence, and long-term partnerships.


At Pyramid, our people are at the heart of everything we do. We are committed to creating an environment where associates are respected, supported, and empowered to grow their careers. Team members have the opportunity to collaborate directly with experienced leaders, take on meaningful stretch assignments, and gain exposure to a diverse portfolio of properties, brands, and markets. Whether you are beginning your hospitality career or bringing years of experience, you'll find opportunities to learn, develop, and make an impact.


Our commitment to associates, guests, owners, and the communities we serve has helped make Pyramid and our properties among the most recognized in hospitality. From being named among the best places to work by respected publications such as USA Today, The Boston Globe, and The Houston Chronicle to earning top travel accolades from Travel + Leisure, Condé Nast Traveler, Forbes Travel Guide, and U.S. News & World Report, these recognitions reflect the culture, service excellence, and commitment to people that define the Pyramid experience.

About our property:

Welcome to The Mission Inn Hotel & Spa, a legendary property in the Pyramid Global Hospitality portfolio located in the heart of Riverside, California. Featuring 238 guest rooms and over 160,000 sq ft of meeting and event space, this AAA Four-Diamond, National Historic Landmark spans an entire city block and offers a truly unique and dynamic environment for hospitality professionals.

At The Mission Inn Hotel & Spa, we are proud to deliver exceptional service within a setting rich in history and architectural beauty. As a member of our team, you’ll be part of a community-driven environment where collaboration and connection are at the core of everything we do. title: Hardware Validation Engineer
description:
About Mashgin
Mashgin powers the world's best checkout experience for over 40 million users. Customers just place their items on our kiosks and our AI rings up their entire order in less than a second. With Mashgin, lines are now optional.

Mashgin's technology powers over 1 billion transactions at your favorite locations, including over half of all US professional sports teams, 4,000 convenience stores, major airports, universities, and more.

We’re not just building cutting-edge AI—we’re creating real-world impact and unforgettable experiences. Backed by a well-funded Series B, we’re also one of the rare AI startups that’s already profitable.

Our secret? A culture of extreme ownership, autonomy, and customer obsession. At Mashgin, we are building something extraordinary by challenging conventional wisdom. We’ve thrown out the old rules to focus on what truly matters: creating a kickass product that makes people say, 'Wow'. We don’t care about short-term wins; we build systems that stand the test of time. If you thrive in a culture of excellence without compromise and want to see your work have an immediate, remarkable impact, you’re in the right place.

Mashgin is seeking a Hardware Validation Engineer to support validation and qualification of our custom hardware platforms and checkout systems. You will work closely with senior engineers to execute validation plans, build and automate test setups, troubleshoot hardware issues, and document results.

This is a hands-on role covering both component and system-level testing across compute platforms, cameras, USB devices, power systems, networking, and other peripherals.

This is a hybrid role that requires you to be onsite at least 2 days a week in San Jose, CA.

What We Value:

  • Impact: You will own significant responsibility and have total ownership over your work. We stay lean and efficient, so your work directly impacts the product we ship every day.
  • Simplicity: Complexity is a waste of time here—we take pride in building things that just work.
  • Hard Work: Forget the glamorous research papers. We prioritize the hard work it takes to achieve real-world clarity and accuracy. You will innovate relentlessly to push the boundaries of what’s possible in visual automation.
  • Humility: No task is beneath you. Whether it's high-level architecture or grunt work to fix a bug, we check our egos at the door and get real work done.
  • Ruthless Prioritization: If everything is on fire, nothing is. You will be expected to prioritize ruthlessly, cutting through distractions to focus on the most impactful product improvements.
  • Customer Innovation: We are customer-centric, not customer-pleasing. You won’t bend to every client demand; you will let innovation drive the product forward to solve the real problems our users face.
  • Efficiency: Meetings suck. We keep them short and only use them for alignment, giving you your time back to focus on real work.

You Will Be

- Executing functional, performance, stress, thermal, and reliability validation tests
- Building and maintaining hardware test setups and automated test tools
- Developing Python or similar scripts for test automation, data collection, and hardware communication
- Troubleshooting hardware and hardware/software integration issues
- Using lab equipment such as oscilloscopes, multimeters, power supplies, and logic analyzers
- Reviewing datasheets, specifications, and schematics to understand test requirements
- Reproducing failures, collecting data, and supporting root-cause analysis
- Testing new hardware revisions, supplier samples, and component changes
- Documenting test procedures, results, failures, and validation reports
- Maintaining hardware configuration and validation records
- Supporting prototype builds, pilot builds, and field testing as needed
- Collaborating with hardware, software, manufacturing, suppliers, and other engineering teams

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field
- A minimum of 2 years of experience in hardware validation, test engineering, or related work; relevant internship or project experience is welcome
- Hands-on experience testing and troubleshooting electrical or computer hardware
- Ability to read datasheets, technical specifications, and basic schematics
- Experience with common lab equipment such as oscilloscopes and multimeters
- Basic programming or scripting experience, preferably Python
- Comfortable working with Windows and/or Linux
- Strong troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with hardware validation, reliability, manufacturing test, or system integration
- Familiarity with USB, serial communication, Ethernet, Wi-Fi, and other hardware interfaces
- Experience with thermal, stress, burn-in, or lifecycle testing
- Familiarity with cameras, embedded systems, PC hardware, or other peripherals
- Experience with automated hardware testing or test fixtures

What Success Looks Like

You will become comfortable independently executing validation tests, troubleshooting failures, and documenting results. As you grow in the role, you will take ownership of defined validation tasks and help improve our test automation, coverage, and repeatability.

title: Technical Project Manager
description:
Gumball builds consumer web experiences and the internal tools used to manage them. Our work spans multiple brands and often combines product requirements, design, compliance, partner integrations, and engineering.


We are hiring a Technical Project Manager to turn business needs into clear, buildable work and guide that work from intake through release. This is a hands-on technical role for someone who is comfortable working closely with engineers, reviewing smaller changes, and using assisted coding tools to ship limited fixes.

What you will do

  • Turn stakeholder requests into clear requirements, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and test plans before engineering begins.
  • Manage intake and triage. Identify duplicate, incomplete, blocked, or low-priority work and, as you learn the products, take increasing ownership of what is ready to enter the engineering queue.
  • Coordinate work that crosses brands, products, or teams without allowing requirements and decisions to fragment across conversations.
  • Keep Linear current and make each ticket the reliable record of scope, decisions, ownership, and status.
  • Work with engineers to identify technical constraints, separate front-end, backend, data, and integration work, and surface missing decisions early.
  • Coordinate quality assurance with stakeholders and engineering. Make sure important user journeys are tested on the devices customers use and that results are recorded.
  • Review smaller pull requests for alignment with the ticket, obvious implementation risk, and test evidence. Escalate larger or riskier changes to the Engineering Lead.
  • Use Large Language Model (LLM)-assisted coding tools to deliver small, well-scoped fixes. You are responsible for understanding the proposed change, reviewing the diff, testing the result, and following the normal release process.
  • Guide work through development, quality assurance, technical review, and production release. Communicate what is moving, what is blocked, who owns the next action, and what is ready to ship.
  • Support production incidents when assigned by the Engineering Lead.

What we are looking for

  • Experience managing software delivery for a small, fast-moving engineering team.
  • Strong requirements writing: you can turn an incomplete request into behavior an engineer can build and another person can verify.
  • Working knowledge of modern web applications, browser behavior, application programming interfaces (APIs), databases, and GitHub pull requests.
  • Enough code literacy to review a focused diff, recognize when a change exceeds your depth, and safely deliver a small fix with assisted coding.
  • Experience coordinating quality assurance and releases across technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
  • Clear written communication and disciplined follow-through.
  • Availability during the team’s Eastern Time workday.

Helpful, not required

  • Experience with Linear, GitHub, Slack, Next.js, or TypeScript.
  • Experience with consumer web forms, multi-brand products, compliance-sensitive changes, affiliate marketing, or partner integrations.
  • Experience using LLM-assisted development tools in a controlled review and release process.

How the team works

You report to the Engineering Lead and work directly with engineers and stakeholders. Engineers own feature implementation. You own clarity, coordination, and delivery, with room to handle smaller technical changes yourself. The Engineering Lead retains responsibility for high-risk technical review, production decisions, and incident assignments.


Salary

$65,000.00 - $80,000.00 USD per year (Remote (United States))

title: Senior Associate Scientist, Neuroscience Discovery Biology
description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. The Neuroscience TRC is committed to the development of transformational therapeutics for patients with neurodegenerative, neuromuscular and neuropsychiatric diseases. A network of internal and external partnerships across neurodegenerative and neuropsychiatric diseases and treatment modalities (small molecules, biologics and genetic medicines) supports our ambition to become leaders in neuroscience.   • Collaborate closely with multidisciplinary teams including biology, medicinal chemistry, DMPK, translational medicine, computational biology.

title: Employment Adviser-1
description:
Reed in Partnership has been delivering public services since 1998. We are a British, family-owned company, whose mission has always been to positively transform people and their communities. This is reflected in our services, which we deliver to help people from all backgrounds and circumstances to change their lives for the better.

Pay Range

£30,000 - £31,500

Job Description

Are you passionate about making a difference and helping others to fulfil their potential?

Would you like to work in a role that puts the customer at the heart of everything we do, making a genuine positive impact?

Then consider the role of Employment Adviser at Reed in Partnership!

Please note, internal applications for this role close on 21/10/2026


This role is based across our Watford, Hemel Hempstead and St Albans offices, so the successful candidate must be comfortable travelling between the locations as required.


Who we are:

Reed in Partnership's Employability Division aims to positively transform lives by helping individuals who are unemployed, economically inactive, or facing challenges such as health conditions, disabilities, or caring responsibilities to find sustainable employment. Through a wide range of tailored support services including one-to-one careers guidance, CV writing, interview preparation, and skills training, we have supported over 250,000 people on their journey into work.

Our Restart Scheme, funded by the Department for Work and Pensions (DWP), focuses specifically on supporting the long-term unemployed who are referred and mandated to the scheme by their local Job Centre Plus. We provide them with up to 12 months of personalised support to enter or re-enter the workforce.

What is the role about?

Employment Advisers are the front line of Reed in Partnership, directly contributing to our mission by supporting jobseekers (our participants), engaging with local employers, and promoting the benefits of the Restart Scheme within the local community. Our participants are the lifeblood of our business and providing them with an excellent service is at the very core of the Employment Adviser role.

Just some of your day-to-day responsibilities will include:

Taking Ownership

  • Meeting with and supporting a caseload of long-term unemployed jobseekers, identifying their barriers and creating tailored action plans to progress them into employment.
  • Delivering personalised, one-to-one guidance to our participants including CV writing, interview preparation, and skills development.
  • Meeting and exceeding performance targets and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).

Working Together

  • Collaborating with participants to shift their mindset and build the confidence they need to find and sustain work.
  • Engaging with local employers to identify job opportunities.
  • Signposting participants to internal and external stakeholders to address specific barriers such as health, housing, or financial challenges.
  • Promoting the Restart Scheme within the community, raising awareness of it's benefits and impact.

Being Fair, Open, and Honest

  • Providing inclusive support and advice to people from all backgrounds.

What’s in it for you?

A generous base salary (pro-rata for part time), and great flexibility with your working schedule, we offer training, development and progression opportunities. You will have access to the range of Reed in Partnership benefits, which include:

  • 25 days annual leave (pro-rata for part time) plus statutory bank holidays
  • Reed Pension Scheme
  • Award Winning Management & Leadership training
  • Professional & Personal Development Funds
  • Bi-annual pay reviews
  • Plus much more that can be found on our website.

The Employment Adviser role offers immense satisfaction of connecting people with the tailored support that they need to fulfil their potential. At Reed in Partnership, our values - Fair, Open & Honest, Take Ownership, and Work Together - guide everything we do. Join us in delivering services that make a real difference.

To be successful in this role, we are looking for someone with:

  • Ability to demonstrate coaching/mentoring experience and persuasion/influencing skills through previous work or social activities.
  • Experience of working in a customer facing environment (i.e. Customer Services, Hospitality, Social Care, Customer Services, Sales)
  • Experience of working in a fast paced, performance target driven environment.
  • Willingness to travel locally (e.g. to meet customers/employers).
  • A minimum of 2 A-Levels or an equivalent Level 3 Diploma.
  • GCSE English Language at a minimum of a Grade B (or equivalent Level 2 qualification). OR achievement of a Level 2 in Literacy Assessment at interview stage OR International Equivalents.

Desirable Criteria:

  • Fluency in more than one language ​‌

We aim to ensure that no candidate or employee receives less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, race, disability, sexual orientation, religion or belief, age, gender reassignment, marital or civil partnership status, pregnancy or maternity. We offer a guaranteed interview scheme for disabled applicants who meet the minimum criteria.

title: Tax Analyst - International
description:
Tax Analyst - International
Pan-American Life Insurance Group (PALIG)

Department: Corporate Tax

Location: New Orleans, LA; Oak Brook, IL; or Coral Gables, FL | Hybrid Work Opportunities Available


About the Role:

Pan-American Life Insurance Group (PALIG) is seeking a Tax Analyst - International to support the Corporate Tax Department's U.S. international and non-U.S. tax reporting, compliance, planning, and controversy activities.


This role works directly with foreign affiliate finance and tax teams to collect, validate, and analyze tax information; prepare and maintain supporting workpapers; identify reporting and compliance issues; and assist with resolving those issues in a timely manner. The position is expected to bring a solid foundation in corporate tax and accounting while developing deeper expertise in U.S. international tax, ASC 740 reporting for foreign operations, transfer pricing, and audit support.


While the ideal candidate will be based in one of our office locations—New Orleans, Oak Brook, or Coral Gables—we remain open to remote arrangements for strong candidates whose experience aligns closely with the demands of this role.


Essential Functions:


Tax Financial Reporting and Analysis

  • Collaborate with foreign affiliate finance and tax teams to prepare, review, and maintain tax provision packages supporting U.S. GAAP financial reporting
  • Analyze tax accounts, attributes, uncertain tax positions, effective tax rate items, and supporting reconciliations; investigate exceptions and follow issues through resolution
  • Maintain organized support for foreign current and deferred tax balances and develop a working knowledge of tax laws and reporting positions in relevant jurisdictions

Tax Compliance

  • Prepare foreign tax credit calculations and support U.S. international tax provision calculations, including BEAT and NCTI
  • Prepare U.S. federal international tax workpapers, schedules, and forms, including Forms 5471, 8858, 8991, 8992, and 1118, as applicable
  • Maintain accurate, complete, and audit-ready records for U.S. international and foreign tax filings
  • Coordinate deliverables and follow up on missing or inconsistent information

Tax Planning and Transactions

  • Research enacted and proposed tax laws, regulations, and rulings and summarize practical implications
  • Model potential financial statement and cash tax impacts of tax law changes
  • Draft technical memoranda, issue summaries, and recommendations for review by tax leadership

Tax Systems and Operations

  • Document and improve recurring tax processes, calendars, controls, and workpaper standards
  • Assist in maintaining and optimizing tax software, financial systems, and data tools to improve reporting accuracy and efficiency

Cross-Border Coordination, Transfer Pricing, and Audit Support

  • Coordinate with foreign affiliates and external advisors on local tax matters, information requests, transfer pricing support, and tax authority examinations
  • Support responses to tax notices and audits by organizing facts, workpapers, documentation, and assigned action items

Education & Experience:


Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Taxation, or a related field
  • Minimum of 2 years of corporate tax, public accounting, or related tax experience
  • CPA, CPA candidate, or other relevant tax credential

Preferred:

  • Master's degree in Taxation, Accounting, or related graduate-level program
  • Experience with U.S. international tax, ASC 740, multinational financial reporting, insurance or financial services, and/or cross-border tax compliance

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities (KSAs):

  • Working knowledge of corporate income tax accounting concepts, including ASC 740 current and deferred tax principles
  • Familiarity with U.S. international tax concepts and reporting requirements, including Subpart F, Foreign Tax Credits, BEAT, NCTI, and Forms 5471, 8858, 8991, 8992, and 1118
  • Strong analytical, reconciliation, research, and problem-solving skills with close attention to detail
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and the ability to organize, analyze, and validate data from multiple sources
  • Ability to learn and utilize company financial systems, tax software, and data tools
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to work effectively with colleagues across multiple jurisdictions and cultures
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments, maintain documentation, proactively follow up, and meet reporting and filing deadlines
  • Knowledge of AI-enabled technologies (e.g., Microsoft Copilot) and the ability to apply them responsibly to improve business processes, data analysis, and reporting
  • Bilingual Spanish/English skills preferred

What We Offer:

  • Competitive compensation package (base salary & bonus)
  • Comprehensive benefits, including medical, dental, vision, 401(k), paid time off, and tuition reimbursement
  • Medical and dental coverage effective the first of the month following 30 days of service
  • Flexible work environment supporting work-life balance through a hybrid work arrangement
  • Opportunities for professional growth and career development within a global organization


About Us:

Pan-American Life Insurance Group (PALIG) serves the life, accident, and health insurance needs of individuals and businesses across 49 U.S. states, the District of Columbia, Puerto Rico, and the U.S. Virgin Islands through its U.S.-based member companies, Pan-American Life Insurance Company and Pan-American Assurance Company.


At PALIG, our employees are our greatest asset. We value collaboration, trust, innovation, and the confidence of our policyholders. Our long-standing commitment to excellence continues to drive our success.


Pan-American Life Insurance Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer and a Drug-Free Workplace.

title: Licensing Consultant
description:
About Us
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.


Pay Transparency

The estimated salary range for a new hire into this position is zł164,150 - zł269,675 which may include potential sales incentive payments (if applicable). Salary may vary depending on job-related factors which may include knowledge, skills, experience, and location. In addition, this position may be eligible for bonus and equity. Visa has a comprehensive benefits package for which this position may be eligible that includes Medical, Dental, Vision, Pension, Life Insurance, Annual Leave, and Wellness Program.


Job Description

As a Licensing Consultant, you’ll play an important role in bringing new and enhanced Visa products and services to life for our clients. You’ll work at the intersection of business and technology, partnering with clients and internal teams to understand their needs, define requirements, and shape effective implementation solutions.


You’ll provide consultative guidance on Visa regulations, fees, product features, and functionality, while translating complex client requirements into clear technical requirements for internal teams.


Digital fluency is important in all our roles, and you’ll be encouraged to use emerging technologies, including Generative AI tools such as ChatGPT and Microsoft Copilot, to work effectively and support your day-to-day activities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide customized consultative support on license requests of mid to high complexity, applying in-depth knowledge of Visa bylaws, rules, eligibility criteria, and regulatory requirements.
  • Offer upfront licensing consultancy to address and manage client expectations and clarify requirements for onboarding.
  • Work closely with client-facing teams to provide guidance and support to prospective and current clients on licensing and onboarding queries, including business expansions.
  • Coordinate internally with Onboarding and Implementation functions and other stakeholders to improve client onboarding experience and service offerings.
  • Monitor all license application workstreams across key stakeholders and update status in relevant systems.
  • Execute requests related to administration of clients’ licensing lifecycle, including sponsorship options, license upgrades/downgrades, mergers, acquisitions, and terminations.
  • Present to client and internal stakeholders on licensing processes, timings, and expectations, including creation and customization of materials.
  • Formulate recommendations and refer cases to management, identifying unusual scenarios or potential risks.
  • Provide training to new staff and partners to build awareness of licensing and facilitate smooth execution of requests.
  • Contribute to business requirements and enhancement requests for tools and systems, and perform acceptance testing.
  • Manage communication channels for licensing resources to ensure they are up to date, client-focused, and effective.

Visa requires at least 3 days in Warsaw office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

Qualifications

  • Relevant professional experience, supported by a Bachelor’s Degree or an Advanced Degree (e.g. Master’s, MBA, JD, MD, or PhD).
  • Experience in a client-facing role within financial services, payments, or a related regulated environment. Knowledge of end-to-end licensing processes, business drivers, and client expectations would be an advantage.
  • Experience managing multiple priorities and a high volume of work while maintaining attention to detail and meeting deadlines.
  • Experience supporting operational activities and identifying opportunities to improve efficiency.
  • Experience coordinating projects and supporting clients with the implementation of new products or services, ideally within a payments or financial services environment.
  • Strong ability to work effectively with cross-functional and multicultural teams, including in remote environments.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
  • Fluency in English, with strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • We’d also value experience in synthesizing technical information into practical business solutions, working with databases and workflow tools, improving processes, and training or sharing knowledge with others.

Visa is an EEO Employer

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

Visa welcome and encourages application from persons with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

title: Steward
description:

Our culture is caring and thoughtful, and we deliver good-natured and informed service, perfectly executed to evoke a sense of fulfillment and well-being. As a part of our team, you can look forward to activities and perks that drive your passion for nature such as:

As a mission-driven company, our purpose is our true north, and our compass guides the way. title: Engagement Coach
description:
The Role
The Engagement Coach is at the heart of our mission, building meaningful relationships with students to support their journey toward earning their high school diploma. Our coaches act as mentors and advocates, providing both academic and non-academic support while fostering an environment where students feel valued and empowered.

This role is highly relationship-driven and persistence-focused, requiring consistent outreach, problem-solving, and a commitment to understanding and removing barriers that prevent students from attending and progressing. This role is ideal for recent graduates or early-career professionals looking to build experience in education, student support, or case management.

This is a temporary, part-time Grant funded role.


Key Responsibilities

Enrollment

  • Assist with the registration and enrollment process for new students
  • Provide comprehensive support during student orientation to set the stage for success

Retention & Attendance

  • Act as a case manager for a designated cohort of students, monitoring and documenting regular attendance
  • Implement the Acceleration Academy Retention Protocol through proactive outreach including texts, calls, and home visits
  • Identify root causes of disengagement and work to remove barriers, not just complete outreach attempts
  • Utilize technology tools for efficient daily monitoring and maintenance of student attendance and retention records

Academics

  • Deliver one-on-one academic support and interventions to facilitate student learning and complement the work of center professionals
  • Proctor unit tests one-on-one and support small group proctoring in the virtual school setting
  • Collaborate closely with the student support team to track learning pathways, monitor behavior, and implement transition plans including incentive programs
  • Partner with team members to problem-solve student challenges and improve engagement outcomes
  • Engage in professional development activities to enhance academic support practices

Behavior Management & Site Operations

  • Support daily site-level behavior management including monitoring noise level, phone use, and language standards
  • Assist with check-in table and comeback corner monitoring on rotation with the broader team
  • De-escalate student conflict or irate situations calmly and professionally without escalating tensions
  • Hold Graduate Candidates to high expectations while validating their experiences and identifying solutions
  • Participate in academy meetings and school or community events
  • Support home visits and local travel as needed to re-engage students
  • Perform additional duties as assigned to support the overall mission of the academy

Advocacy

  • Advocate for students by assisting in identifying solutions and connecting them to academy staff for academic and non-academic support


What We're Looking For

Education: Associate degree preferred, but non-traditional life experience in education, youth mentorship, or case management will be considered

Experience: 2+ years of relevant experience preferred; candidates with lived experience navigating hardship, working while in school, or overcoming barriers to education will also be considered

Availability: Must be available to work the 5-6 hours a day

Relationship Building: Strong ability to build genuine, trust-based relationships with students and families while holding Graduate Candidates accountable

De-escalation: Comfortable managing disrespect, conflict, and escalated situations without escalating in return; ability to remain calm and solution-focused under pressure

Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication; strong outreach skills including consistent follow-up with students, families, and team members

Technology: Proficiency with learning management systems and educational technology tools

Passion: A genuine commitment to supporting students who have disengaged from traditional schooling and a drive to help them succeed


Preferred Qualifications

  • Teaching certification (active or in progress), certified candidates may be eligible to serve as teacher of record for select courses
  • Bilingual skills (Spanish preferred)
  • Experience in non-traditional or alternative educational settings
  • Comfort with project-based and competency-based learning approaches


Why Join Us?

Being part of Acceleration Academies means joining a team dedicated to transforming student outcomes. Here, you will directly impact students' lives, championing their growth, resilience, and path to graduation.


We Value Our Team's Well-Being

Competitive Compensation: up to $19.00/hour

Retirement Savings: 401(k) plan with up to a 4% company match


Physical & Work Environment

  • Regularly required to sit, talk, hear, and use hands
  • Occasionally lift up to 20 pounds
  • Work in a collaborative classroom or office setting and may involve exposure to outdoor weather during events
  • Occasional travel between nearby academy sites may be required to support student needs or operational coverage

Ready to Make a Difference?
If you’re passionate about making a meaningful impact and shaping the future of education, we’d love to hear from you. Join us in redefining what’s possible for students everywhere.


Third-Party Agency & Recruiter Notice for Acceleration Academies
Agencies presenting candidates must have an active, nonexpired Master Services Agreement and be formally engaged by an Acceleration Academies Recruiter. Resumes submitted outside these terms will be considered the property of Acceleration Academies.


Equal Opportunity Employer
Acceleration Academies is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by law.


All roles at Acceleration Academies include core responsibilities that are fundamental to student success and overall academy operations. Applicants should carefully review the job description to ensure they can meet these requirements. Essential duties typically include:

• Consistent, reliable attendance during scheduled work hours

• On-site presence (for roles designated as in-person/onsite)

• Management of assigned workload and productivity expectations

• Ability to perform job functions in an open, student-centered workspace

If you believe you may need a reasonable accommodation to perform the essential functions of the role, Acceleration Academies will engage in an interactive process in accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA). title: Principal Materials Engineer - Polymer Shaping and Molding
location: Fridley, Minnesota, United States of America
description:
We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on - 29 Oct 2026


Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

A Day in the Life

The Manufacturing Innovation & Technology (MIT) team within Medtronic’s Operations Innovation organization develops and advances manufacturing technologies that support product development, industrialization, and global manufacturing. As part of the integrated Center of Excellence (iCOE) Polymer Shaping & Molding (PSM) team, this role focuses on polymer molding, micro-molding, additive polymer manufacturing, and emerging material technologies to improve manufacturing capability and readiness across the enterprise.

This position may be based in Minneapolis, Minnesota or Fridley, Minnesota and follows an onsite work model, with employees working onsite four days per week.

Up to 25% travel is required to support collaboration with manufacturing sites, suppliers, academic partners, and external development organizations.

Principal Materials Engineer - Polymer Shaping and Molding, will support the development, evaluation, and implementation of polymer materials and manufacturing technologies within the Polymer Shaping & Molding Center of Excellence. This role combines hands-on technology development with technical consultation to advance manufacturing readiness, evaluate emerging materials and processes, and support integration of new technologies into product development and manufacturing environments.


Primary Responsibilities

  • Lead feasibility, readiness, and technology development activities for polymer molding, micro-molding, additive manufacturing, and related shaping technologies.
  • Evaluate and qualify new polymer materials, additives, tooling approaches, and forming techniques for manufacturing applications.
  • Apply materials science, chemistry, and physics principles to develop material specifications, processing parameters, and manufacturing solutions.
  • Partner with suppliers, contract manufacturers, academic institutions, and technology developers to mature materials and manufacturing processes.
  • Provide technical consultation to new product development, new product integration, and manufacturing teams on established materials and processing technologies.
  • Conduct material characterization, failure analysis, life prediction assessments, and technical investigations to support product and process performance.
  • Analyze experimental and manufacturing data and communicate findings through technical reports and recommendations.
  • Review and support approval of external material processing procedures and manufacturing practices when applicable.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree with 7+ years of relevant experience OR Master’s degree with 5+ years of relevant experience OR PhD with 3+ years of relevant experience.
  • Experience in polymer materials engineering and manufacturing process development.
  • Experience with polymer molding, micro-molding, additive manufacturing, dip molding, or related polymer processing technologies.
  • Experience analyzing technical data and documenting results in technical reports.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Materials Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or Biomedical Engineering.
  • Experience in medical device manufacturing or product development.
  • Experience collaborating with global stakeholders, suppliers, academic institutions, or contract manufacturers.
  • Experience supporting manufacturing technology transfer, industrialization, or new product introduction activities.

For Baccalaureate degrees earned outside of the United States, a degree that satisfies the requirements of 8 C.F.R. § 214.2(h)(4)(iii)(A) is required.
