title: Senior Specialist, MES Platform Engineer
description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.


Position Summary


As part of the Digital Plant department Manufacturing IT Systems & MES for the Leiden Cell Therapy Facility (CTF), the Senior Specialist, MES Platform Engineer is responsible for the administration, maintenance, configuration, and continuous improvement of the Syncade MES (Manufacturing Execution System) environment. The role combines technical system administration responsibilities with recipe authoring expertise to ensure reliable MES operations, GMP compliance, optimal system performance, and efficient execution of manufacturing processes.

The position serves as a key bridge between manufacturing operations, quality, validation, and IT teams by supporting MES infrastructure, user administration, master data management, recipe development, system enhancements, and business process improvements.


Duties / Responsibilities


MES System Administration & Maintenance

  • Manage and maintain the MES application environment, including integrations and peripheral devices such as scanners and label printers.
  • Monitor MES application health, availability, performance, and underlying hardware components.
  • Support installation, configuration, upgrades, patches, and lifecycle management activities.
  • Perform routine system reviews and execute corrective and preventive measures to maintain system reliability.
  • Collaborate with Shared Services and infrastructure teams to define and manage application versus infrastructure responsibilities.

Recipe Design & Configuration

  • Design, configure, document, and maintain Master Recipes using standardized corporate objects and approved building blocks.
  • Analyse business requirements and translate operational processes into MES solutions.
  • Maintain and enhance existing recipes while ensuring consistency, usability, and compliance.
  • Evaluate and implement new objects, templates, and configuration components supporting recipe development and manufacturing improvements.

Master Data & User Administration

  • Execute master data management activities to ensure data integrity and consistency within MES.
  • Manage MES user access in compliance with approved procedures and regulatory requirements.
  • Support periodic access reviews and maintain appropriate segregation of duties.
  • Configure and maintain MES system settings supporting manufacturing operations.

Reporting, Labels & Configuration Management

  • Create and maintain MES reports, labels, label formats, and related configuration designs.
  • Support manufacturing operations through effective reporting and labelling solutions.
  • Maintain documentation and traceability related to MES configuration changes.

Testing, Validation & Compliance

  • Develop and execute testing activities supporting new recipes, system changes, and MES enhancements.
  • Support creation of User Acceptance Test (UAT) scripts and validation deliverables.
  • Participate in dry runs, qualification activities, and validation reviews.
  • Ensure MES solutions remain compliant with GMP, GxP, Data Integrity, and Computer System Validation requirements.
  • Support risk assessments, impact assessments, and change control activities.

System Upgrades & Continuous Improvement

  • Support MES upgrade projects, platform enhancements, and technology lifecycle initiatives.
  • Identify opportunities to optimize MES processes, improve user experience, and increase manufacturing efficiency.
  • Partner with local and global MES teams to implement best practices and standardized solutions.
  • Contribute to the long-term MES roadmap and system sustainability initiatives.

Incident & Operational Support

  • Provide second-line support for MES incidents, service requests, and operational issues.
  • Troubleshoot application, configuration, recipe, integration, and performance issues.
  • Restore MES availability in alignment with business continuity requirements, urgency, and severity classifications.
  • Participate in investigations and implementation of corrective actions related to MES events and deviations.

Collaboration & Leadership Support

  • Work closely with Manufacturing, QA, MSAT, CSV, and IT stakeholders to ensure MES solutions meet business needs.
  • Collaborate with peer MES administrators and recipe authors across CTF sites.
  • Assist the Senior Manager Manufacturing IT Systems & MES in responsibilities associated with Technical System Ownership, Configuration Item Ownership, governance, and continuous improvement initiatives when required.

Reporting Relationship

Reports to Senior Manager – Manufacturing IT Systems & MES Lead


Collaborates With

  • MES Recipe Authors
  • Manufacturing Support IT
  • IT Automation
  • Shared Services IT
  • Quality Assurance (QA)
  • Manufacturing Science & Technology (MSAT)
  • Computer System Validation (CSV)
  • Manufacturing Operations
  • Global MES Teams

Qualifications


Required Knowledge & Experience

  • Strong understanding of Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) and manufacturing processes.
  • Experience with MES recipe authoring, configuration management, and system administration.
  • Knowledge of GMP, GxP, Data Integrity, and Computer System Validation practices.
  • Experience managing master data, user access, and system configuration.
  • Proficiency in troubleshooting, root cause analysis, system monitoring, and performance optimization.
  • Experience supporting MES upgrades, change management, and validation activities.
  • Strong problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a highly regulated biopharmaceutical manufacturing environment.

Technical Skills

  • Emerson Syncade MES
  • SQL
  • ISA-95
  • MES Reporting
  • Label and Form Design
  • Change Control & Validation Processes
  • Incident & Problem Management
  • Data Integrity Principles

title: Senior Associate, Product Management - Card Data
description:
Senior Associate, Product Management - Card Data

Product Management

Product Management at Capital One is a booming, vibrant craft that requires reimagining the status quo, finding value creation opportunities, and driving innovative and sustainable customer experiences through technology.

We believe our portfolio of businesses and investments in growth and transformation will result in a company with the scale, brand, capabilities, talent, and values to succeed as the digital revolution transforms our society and our industry.

Do you dream of well-designed and intuitive products and customer experiences? Do you want to be the one who introduces change to help tens of millions of customers make smarter financial choices? Do you want to change the way people manage their money? If you answered yes to all of these questions, then product management at Capital One may be a fit for you

About the Team:

Our team is a part of a horizontal organization that helps Capital One's businesses find, understand, and trust their data. We're building a data access layer that makes data easier to use by providing consumers across the company a consistent access point, shielding them from the churn of underlying data changes. As a product manager on this team, you'll work cross-functionally to shape requirements, build the solution, and iterate as we learn.

In this role, you’ll learn the essentials of being a product manager, and we’ll invest in you to grow in four key areas:

  • Human Centered

    • You’ll collaborate with tech teams to build comprehensive acceptance criteria, identifying and elevating any need for additional research to define future feature design

    • You'll breakdown business epics into features and further into user stories, driving your team towards lowest effort or Minimal Viable Product (MVP) for a valid feature test

  • Business Focused

    • Demonstrating a growth mindset, you’ll effectively use hypothesis-driven assessment of data to ensure your product or feature delivers on real business needs

    • You’ll own and prioritize feature development roadmaps, ensuring all necessary processes and procedures are followed to manage risk

  • Technology Driven

    • You’ll work autonomously in an agile environment, to conduct research and develop features that utilize new and evolving technology

    • You’ll collaborate with designers, technologists, data scientists and subject-matter experts to build cutting edge solutions to help customers

    • You’ll deliver well-managed product platforms for customers by seeking to understand technology trends and architecture strategy

  • Transformational Leadership

    • By actively participating in horizontal forums, you’ll harness a network of trusted relationships among tech teams, designers, key internal stakeholders and partner teams

    • You’ll articulate a succinct product roadmap to deliver business value and share with with stakeholders, elevating your team’s results and becoming a product matter expert

We want you if you are:

  • Intellectually Curious. You ask why, you explore, you're not afraid to blurt out your crazy idea or follow an email chain for weeks to find someone with an answer. Comfortable with ambiguity, a hunger to learn and a seeker of new challenges

  • Communicator & Influencer. You can communicate complex ideas clearly regardless of your audience. Our team knows their priorities and why they’re doing what they’re doing. You always can rally associates to work with you

Responsibilities:

The Senior IT Business Analyst provides leadership and expertise in business analysis, process optimization, and technology-enabled transformation within the Digital Strategy & Innovation Office (DSIO) in support of enterprise-wide initiatives and projects. Working independently and collaboratively with clinical, operational, digital, informatics, and information systems stakeholders, the role analyzes complex business needs, develops requirements, designs future-state workflows, and translates strategic priorities into scalable solutions. This role leads business analysis activities for assigned initiatives and provides subject matter expertise to support implementation, operational readiness, performance improvement, and sustained value delivery.

Within the Engagement pillar of DSIO, this role focuses on improving upon digital patient engagement, analyzing, and developing the use of digital tools for accessing and engaging in care.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

Strategy & Operational Support

  • Leads assigned business analysis workstreams supporting enterprise digital engagement initiatives. Partners with clinical, operational, digital, access, and IT/Informatics teams to identify and understand operational priorities. Translates DSIO and operational priorities into defined problems, improvement opportunities, recommendations, and actionable plans that advance patient engagement and patient activation. Supports and leads departments through issue resolution, workflow review, operational assessments, and adoption support. Participates and frequently leads governance, operational workgroups, and meetings to ensure a coordinated execution of digital engagement strategies.

Workflow Analysis & Optimization

  • Leads current- and future-state workflow assessments related to digital engagement to identify operational inefficiencies, barriers, and opportunities for improvement. Analyzes complex and interdependent processes, performs gap and root-cause analysis, facilitates workflow redesign, and recommends scalable improvements scalable improvements across patient education, MyChart, patient pathways, care navigation, communication, and experience initiatives.

Solution & Technology Support

  • Leads business analysis activities associated with the implementation, optimization, validation, and operational readiness of digital patient engagement capabilities, including Epic MyChart, questionnaires, Care Companion, automated outreach, patient education, patient pathways, care navigation, and patient communications. Influences solution design by translating engagement needs into functional requirements and practical recommendations.

Data Analysis, Reporting & Performance Insights

  • Interprets operational data, Epic reports, dashboards, and enterprise reporting tools to evaluate patient engagement adoption, utilization, outreach effectiveness, workflow performance, and related measures. Develops KPIs. Interprets Epic reports, dashboards, and enterprise analytics to evaluate. Identifies trends, performance gaps and improvement opportunities. Develops data-informed recommendations for operational decision-making and continuous improvement. Shares recommendations with operational and departmental leaders through reporting, data validation, KPI tracking, and actionable insights. Leads the development, maintenance, and standardization of reporting tools, dashboards, and operational metrics to support enterprise digital strategies.

Requirements Gathering & Documentation

  • Leads stakeholder meetings and requirements elicitation and facilitates design sessions with clinical, operational, digital, informatics, and technical stakeholders. Develops, reviews and defines process maps, use cases, functional requirements, operational workflows, standard operating procedures, and project documentation; resolves ambiguity and ensures stakeholder alignment around future-state needs.

Testing, Adoption & Continuous Improvement

  • Leads or coordinates test planning, user acceptance testing, workflow validation, implementation readiness, training coordination, communications, issue resolution, adoption and post-implementation evaluation. Uses stakeholder feedback and performance data to identify and address barriers, strengthen engagement, and sustain improvements. Leads issue tracking and continuous improvement efforts to support long-term operational success.

Other duties as assigned.

MINIMUM EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor's degree and 5 years of relevant experience required
  • Master’s degree in a related field preferred
  • Or equivalent combination of education and experience
  • Experience with project management from planning through implementation required
  • 1 year in a supervisory capacity preferred
  • Clinical or higher education experience preferred
  • ServiceNow, JIRA and/or Project Portfolio Management (PPM) software experience preferred
  • Experience in healthcare operations, business analysis, digital health, informatics, process improvement, information systems, clinical, higher education, or a related field preferred.
  • Experience working with operational workflows, process improvement, or healthcare systems preferred
  • Experience with Epic, MyChart, or equivalent healthcare technology platforms preferred.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES

  • Excellent leadership, verbal and written communication, presentation, analytical and problem solving skills required
  • Proven track record executing multiple work streams and producing consistent results required
  • Ability to distill technical information into succinct and digestible information for a broad, non-technical audience required
  • Extensive computer literacy, including experience in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Teams and Powerpoint preferred
  • Knowledge of healthcare operations, complex business analysis, and technology-enabled workflows preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience leading business analysis activities from discovery and requirements through solution design, testing, implementation, and optimization preferred.
  • Ability to analyze complex operational data, identify root causes and opportunities, and develop actionable recommendations preferred.
  • Understanding of digital health capabilities and healthcare technology environments preferred.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills preferred.

LICENSES AND CERTIFICATIONS

  • Certification of Capability in Business Analysis (CCBA) or Professional Business Analysis (PMI-PBA) upon hire preferred

We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. Position Summary

This Senior Director, Global Clinical Development serves as the Clinical Indication Lead for one or more indications of a given asset. This role is accountable for clinical strategy and execution in the given indication(s). This role leads a team of physicians and scientists in the design, execution, analysis, and interpretation of all clinical studies for respective indications of a given asset.

Clinical Strategy & Asset Leadership:


  • Owns and drives clinical development strategy across given asset indications, aligned to overall asset strategy, Target Product Profile (TPP), and relevant disease area strategy.
  • May lead the Clinical Development Team(s) for given indication(s) depending on program structure
  • Provides clinical and disease area expertise to integrated disease area and portfolio and therapeutic level strategies
  • Represents Clinical as the internal and external authority for the indication/disease area, including regulatory interactions and Business Development support.
  • Engages cross-functionally with internal leaders and partners with external investigators, key opinion leaders, and patient advocacy groups.
  • Presents clinical strategy, data, and risk assessments to governance bodies, health authorities, and senior leadership.

·

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
NCS is a leading technology services firm that operates across the Asia Pacific region in over 20 cities, providing consulting, digital services, technology solutions, and more. We believe in harnessing the power of technology to achieve extraordinary things, creating lasting value and impact for our communities, partners, and people. Our diverse workforce of 14,000 has delivered large‑scale, mission‑critical, and multi‑platform projects for governments and enterprises in Singapore and the APAC region.

Job Description

As a Cloud DevSecOps Engineer, your responsibilities will lie within the development and management of key components of the cloud infrastructure supporting our services, ensuring and improving availability and reliability of the infrastructure.

You will be working within a DevSecOps Lead to implement CICD pipelines. The customer cloud environment can encompass hundreds of servers and multiple implementations of cloud services in the form of SaaS, PaaS and IaaS, by supporting the team and infrastructure with strong up‑to‑date technical and hands‑on knowledge of cloud technologies and configuration of the cloud environment.

You will be expected to maintain up‑to‑date knowledge of technology standards, industry trends, emerging technologies, and software development best practices.

What will you do?

  • Setup, testing, implementation and maintenance of technologies on cloud environments (AWS)
  • Setup, testing and integration of CI/CD tools
  • Architecting and development of solutions to meet project requirements
  • Working in an agile, cross‑functional team, actively engaging to support the success of the team
  • Solving complex technical problems individually and as a team
  • Review and improve work processes based on best practices in industry, specific to service support operations for client IT Cloud infrastructure
  • Documentation of new processes
  • Maintain up‑to‑date knowledge of technology standards, industry trends, emerging technologies, and software development best practices
  • Demonstrate hands‑on knowledge of DevSecOps to Infrastructure as Code (IaC) development and deployment in project deliveries
  • Operate, manage and support the IT infrastructure and services implemented to meet prescribed service levels by the client
  • Review and improve work processes based on best practices in industry, specific to service support operations for client IT Cloud infrastructure
  • Ensure that project implementation and operations are aligned to client technology standards and policies
  • Provide AWS maintenance support for production system (eg. monitoring, tuning, patches updates/upgrades)
  • Reduction of time required for production through skills in AWS Cloud Formation technique to deploy automation infrastructure
  • Knowledge of AMI, ASG development and maintenance
  • Improvement of resources and working on resource tagging for designating costs and comprehensive planning for budgeting, reporting, and governance.

Qualifications

The ideal candidate should possess:

  • Diploma / Degree in Computer Science, Computer or Software Engineering or Information Technology or related disciplines
  • Minimum 1 to 2 years of relevant IT experience
  • Possess current hands‑on working experience with technologies involving CI/CD development (scripting such as Python, Ansible), Infrastructure automation using IaC such as Terraform, CloudFormation, cloud services on AWS to drive DevSecOps.
  • Experience in setting up, utilisation and optimisation of CI/CD pipelines, scripting and automated testing
  • Experience in coding or scripting languages such as Bash, Powershell, Perl, Python, etc.
  • Experience in setup and configuration of OS and services via scripting will be an added advantage
  • Knowledge of cloud concepts, services, technologies and architecting
  • Experience in utilisation, management and integration of software development and collaboration tools such as Git, Maven, Gradle and Bamboo, Jenkins
  • Excellent problem‑solving and analytical skills
  • Able to communicate (written and spoken) with clarity and effectively to customer and be able to position to stakeholders as a trusted team member
  • Possess an approachable attitude towards team members
  • Be a good cordial team player with an ability to work in a cross‑functional setting besides being an individual contributor

Good to have:

  • Experience in building cloud native applications eg. using Python, Node.js
  • In-depth knowledge of networking on the cloud
  • Technical qualifications related to Cloud (AWS/Azure)

Additional Information

We are driven by our AEIOU beliefs—Adventure, Excellence, Integrity, Ownership, and Unity—and we seek individuals who embody these values in both their professional and personal lives. We are committed to our Impact: Valuing our clients, Growing our people, and Creating our future.

Together, we make the extraordinary happen.

Learn more about us at ncs.co and visit our LinkedIn career site.

  • Coordinate and expedite supplier deliveries to meet critical project timelines.

This position is P3 level


What will you need to be successful?

Education

Experience

  • 3+ years of experience in: Purchasing Procurement Operations Material Planning Supply Chain Manufacturing Support
  • Experience working with: Bills of Material (BOMs) Demand forecasts Supplier management

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management abilities.

  • On-time material availability for builds and product launches.

Further information is available at . Follow @blackstone on LinkedIn, X (Twitter), and Instagram.

Blackstone’s Site Reliability Engineering team is responsible for improving the reliability of systems and services to meet the needs of the business. This is achieved through collaboration with the development and engineering teams to leverage SRE practices and principles. You’ll have the opportunity to identify and solve new problems as they arise, deploy and maintain observability systems and pipelines, mature the operations and support of services and platforms, and pursue emerging opportunities for efficiency and business value.

This position involves the selection, implementation, and maintenance of key observability tooling. It requires ongoing evaluation of the firm’s needs in observability, monitoring, alerting, resilience, and recovery. We work alongside service owners on design, implementation, and management of services for continuous improvement. We achieve the requisite reliability of services using clear definitions and measurable targets. We plan for and practice recovery from disaster scenarios and respond in real time to incidents. We guide the postmortem process in order to mitigate risks, prevent future disruptions, and improve the on-call experience. We aim to eliminate manual work, improve operational efficiency, and ensure the high quality outputs in all that we do.

  • Implementing strategic observability tools and working to control overhead in maintenance and cost
  • Participate in on-call rotations and respond to system incidents to ensure service availability and minimize operational impact
  • Using automation to manage, maintain, and scale SRE systems with minimal human intervention
  • Fostering a blameless culture while assisting in postmortem discussions and reporting

  • Ability to write automation scripts, as well as read and troubleshoot code (Python, C#, Typescript, etc.),

title: Clinic Director, Board Certified Behavior Analyst (BCBA) - Charlotte, NC
description:
Kind Behavioral Health is seeking a Clinic Director to join our Charlotte metro team! As a Clinic Director, you will coach and mentor clinicians and steward the daily operations of the clinic. The ideal Clinic Director will have a passion for improving the lives of children with Autism and their families. They are committed to a “gold standard” implementation of the science of ABA and evidence and data-based analyses and are looking to do their life's work in an environment where exceptional people can Think Big, Have Fun, Do Good, and Be KIND.

  • Serve as a liaison between the organization, staff, families, community, health care providers, etc.

What we're looking for:

  • Board Certified Behavior Analyst (BCBA) credential with at least 3 years of experience as a BCBA, Experience supervising other BCBAs strongly preferred.

  • Proven experience as an inspirational team leader (positive, motivating) that has created a following of talented individuals
  • Highly skilled in training, development and apprenticeship of other clinicians

  • The exemplar BCBA is constantly seeking knowledge and pursuing excellence in Applied Behavior Analysis. They are motivated, coachable, eager and kind. They are solution focused, take responsibility for their work, they celebrate the success of others and are always seeking to improve

title: Accenture Construct – Senior Landscape Architect, ANS

  • Serious investment in you. Leadership development, technical upskilling and certification support.
  • Work that outlasts you. People will use what you build for forty years without knowing your name. That's the point.
  • Recognition that means something in this industry. Accenture Construct is ranked #6 globally in ENR's 2026 Top 50 Program Management Firms and #4 in Building Design + Construction's Top 80 Construction Management Firms for 2026.

  • Accenture Construct is Accenture's global capital projects business.
  • The data centers behind AI. The grid behind the energy transition. The rail, water and airports everything else runs on.
  • We plan them, engineer them, deliver them and hand them over — and unlike most of this market, we're on the hook for whether they land on time. More than 5,000 practitioners across the Americas, EMEA and APAC. One team that owns the whole thing.

title: Principal Transformation Partner
description:
As passionate about our people as we are about our mission.


Why Join Q2?

Q2 is a leading provider of digital banking and lending solutions to banks, credit unions, alternative finance companies, and fintechs in the U.S. and internationally. Our mission is simple: build strong and diverse communities through innovative financial technology—and we do that by empowering our people to help create success for our customers.


What Makes Q2 Special?

Being as passionate about our people as we are about our mission. We celebrate our employees in many ways through our year-round Q2 ChangeMakers awards program and global moments of recognition and connection. We invest in the growth and development of our team members through ongoing learning opportunities, internal mobility, and meaningful leadership relationships. We also know that nothing builds trust and collaboration like having fun and giving back together. From company-wide volunteer days to events like our Q2 Homecoming Week—featuring learning, community service, and culture-building experiences—we create opportunities to connect, grow, and make an impact.


SUMMARY

Q2 is looking for a senior-level Transformation Partner to join our Transformation Team and partner with business leaders to identify, shape, and scale strategically important initiatives. Representative examples include translating Q2's internal AI strategy into measurable enterprise efficiency gains; modernizing systems and processes; integrating acquired companies as part of our M&A roadmap; and accelerating revenue growth.


In this role, you'll lead structured discovery efforts and apply design thinking, lean methodologies, and customer experience principles to uncover process and operating model improvement opportunities. You'll translate findings into compelling business cases, then remain engaged through adoption and measurement to ensure sustained business impact. This position requires a proven track record of applying structured critical thinking to ambiguous, complex problems. You'll need exceptional influence skills and the ability to shape thinking and drive alignment without formal authority. A continuous learner mindset, progressive career trajectory, and clear transformation experience spanning people, process, and technology are essential.


RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead end-to-end discovery engagements within assigned business functions using design thinking, lean/value stream mapping, and customer experience methodologies; identify and size efficiency opportunities spanning process-only and technology-enabled solutions.
  • Develop clear value theses and governance-ready proposals using structured critical thinking frameworks; define problems, options, tradeoffs, risks, and expected outcomes aligned to enterprise standards and decision frameworks.
  • Influence senior leaders without formal authority, operating effectively with ambiguity and incomplete information; partner with program/project managers to support rollout, change management, and stakeholder engagement.
  • Establish measurement approaches to track realized benefits against baselines and business KPIs; remain engaged post-launch to ensure adoption, sustained performance, and long-term impact.
  • Deliver executive communications and lead stakeholder management across large audiences and C-suite forums; serve as trusted strategic advisor to senior leadership.
  • Leverage AI tools (GenAI, Agentic AI) and enabling software (Excel, PowerPoint, Figma/Visio, Jira) to accelerate discovery, analysis, and recommendation communication.
  • Apply domain expertise across Sales, Marketing, Product and other functional areas to drive cross-functional transformation with measurable productivity and revenue impact.

EXPERIENCE AND KNOWLEDGE

  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field.
  • Minimum of 15 years of relevant professional experience in management consulting or similar industry roles (transformation offices, strategy, business operations, operational excellence); strong preference for enterprise software, SaaS, fintech, or similar corporate environments.
  • Proven experience leading complex, cross-functional initiatives from problem framing through execution, with demonstrated comfort operating in ambiguity and translating complex analysis into clear, executive-ready recommendations.
  • Strong capability in structured discovery using design thinking, LEAN/Six Sigma, customer experience, or product design methodologies; ability to translate findings into compelling business cases with measurable outcomes, KPIs, and benefits-realization frameworks tied to business results.
  • Extensive experience influencing senior stakeholders and driving alignment without formal authority; proven ability to support adoption and change execution through stakeholder engagement and communication planning.
  • Sound business judgment with an enterprise-wide mindset for identifying risks, dependencies, and escalation needs.
  • Exceptional executive communication and presentation skills; ability to present confidently to large audiences and senior leadership.
  • Proficiency in enabling tools (Excel, PowerPoint, Figma/Visio, Jira) and experience leveraging AI tools (GenAI, Agentic AI) to accelerate analysis and transformation.
  • Clear transformation experience spanning people, process, and technology.

PREFERRED SKILLS


  • Advanced degree (MBA) or professional certifications (Lean Six Sigma, PMP/PgMP, change management, design thinking, CX, AI-related credentials).
  • Prior experience building, scaling, or leading a transformation office, strategy function, or operational excellence practice.
  • Track record of scaling transformation initiatives across multiple business units or geographies.
  • Executive coaching, leadership development, or organizational design background.
  • Domain expertise in one or more of the following: Sales, Sales Operations, Marketing, Product, Engineering
  • Thought leadership, external speaking, or published work on transformation or organizational change topics.

This position requires fluent written and oral communication in English.

title: Project Manager, Development
description:
Link Logistics Real Estate (“Link”) is a leading operator of warehouses and business parks, specializing in last-mile logistics real estate. Established by Blackstone in 2019, the company connects consumption, technology, and the supply chain across its portfolio, which spans half a billion square feet. We leverage our scale, proprietary data and insights, and foundational focus on sustainability to drive success for our customers’ businesses and deliver value for our stakeholders. We put our people, customers, and communities first and find ways to make a conscious, positive impact where we live and work. Every day, we work to reinvent and lead our industry forward by thinking bigger and challenging the status quo.

Job Overview

The Project Manager, Development is responsible for supporting and managing the execution of industrial real estate development projects in the market. This role oversees projects from land entitlement through vertical construction and lease-up, ensuring alignment with Link Logistics’ design, financial, and operational standards. The Project Manager will coordinate with internal teams and external consultants, manage project budgets and schedules, and ensure timely delivery of high-quality assets.

This position requires a strong technical background in site and vertical construction, excellent project management skills, and a deep understanding of local market dynamics. The Project Manager will play a key role in advancing Link’s development pipeline and supporting strategic growth in the region.


Job Responsibilities

  • Manage multiple industrial development projects from entitlement through vertical construction and lease-up in the Central Region markets.
  • Track and report key project milestones and contractual obligations to ensure alignment with Link’s development objectives.
  • Develop and manage project budgets; prepare RFPs, development schedules, and bid packages for contractor selection and contract negotiations.
  • Collaborate with the Finance team to ensure accurate cost analysis and underwriting of development projects.
  • Source, engage, and manage third-party consultants including surveyors, engineers, and architects.
  • Monitor construction progress and ensure conformance with approved design plans and specifications.
  • Maintain a strong understanding of the local industrial real estate market, including pricing trends and best practices.
  • Assist with communication and coordination with local government officials to support entitlement and permitting efforts.
  • Participate in the preparation and implementation of departmental strategic initiatives.
  • Provide timely and transparent updates on change orders, risks, and issues that may impact project cost, schedule, or performance.
  • Assist in the pursuit and evaluation of new land acquisition and development opportunities, including preparation of preliminary budgets, schedules, and technical assessments.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Job Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, Real Estate, or a related technical field required.
  • 3–5 years of experience in real estate development, construction, or related fields.
  • Located in or willing to relocate to the Dallas or Austin, Texas area.
  • Strong technical knowledge of site planning, entitlement, infrastructure, and vertical construction.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and stakeholders in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience developing and managing project budgets, schedules, and consultant contracts.
  • Familiarity with local regulatory processes and permitting requirements for ground-up industrial developments
  • Strong analytical and organizational skills with close attention to detail.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Demonstrated leadership, initiative, and ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite; experience with project management and budgeting software is a plus.
  • Anticipates and responds to internal and external customer needs with professionalism.
  • Builds strong relationships and works effectively across teams and departments.
  • Applies creative thinking to solve business challenges and improve processes.
  • Takes ownership of responsibilities and delivers on commitments.
  • Seeks opportunities to enhance systems, workflows, and performance.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

title: Regional/ Industry Closing Associate
description:
Make banking a Fifth Third better®
We connect great people to great opportunities. Are you ready to take the next step? Discover a career in banking at Fifth Third Bank.

GENERAL FUNCTION:

The Regional Closing Associate is responsible for all aspects of closing commercial middle market transactions, with minimal supervision. This position interfaces with the client, relationship manager, outside attorneys, portfolio manager, regional closing manager, loan closing specialist, and funding / boarding team for all matters related to the loan/transaction closing. Ensures all documents, waivers, and management approvals required for closing are in place prior to issuing "clear to close". The Regional Closing Associate works directly with outside attorneys. Ensures all closing documents are ready for closing, and that the deal is funded and boarded accurately.

Responsible and accountable for risk by openly exchanging ideas and opinions, elevating concerns, and personally following policies and procedures as defined. Accountable for always doing the right thing for customers and colleagues, and ensures that actions and behaviors drive a positive customer experience. While operating within the Banks risk appetite, achieves results by consistently identifying, assessing, managing, monitoring, and reporting risks of all types.


ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Manages the entire closing process for middle market transactions, with minimal supervision.
  • Active member of the deal team working directly with the commercial client, relationship manager, regional closing manager, loan closing specialist and portfolio manager providing expertise to the team and client to ensure that policy, legal,compliance and regulatory matters necessary for closing are addressed early in the process.
  • Ensures that transactions are closed per the instructions as stated in the credit approval memo.
  • Directs the loan closing specialist in the completion of the master checklist to ensure timely and efficient execution.
  • Manages the closing calendar balancing the needs of multiple internal and external clients simultaneously.
  • Determines if internally generated documents or attorney prepared documents are needed and engages attorneys as necessary.
  • Engage and coordinate with outside attorneys involved in commercial loan closings.
  • Works directly with client for all matters related to closing and include other internal partners as needed. Reviews and sends draft closing package for the client's review prior to closing.
  • Ensures that all documents, waivers, and management approvals required for closing are in place prior to issuing a "clear to close" decision.
  • Obtains approval for trailing exceptions and missing documents and ensures that the appropriate follow-up actions are in place to insure receipt of any approved trailing documents.
  • Ensures that the funding and boarding team accurately executes on funding instructions.
  • Conducts post-boarding review working closely with the post-closing teams to make certain the loan is coded and boarded properly.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:
While this position does not have direct reports, there is the responsibility of providing direction to multiple parties while achieving shared goals.


MINIMUM KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES REQUIRED:

  • High School diploma or equivalent. Bachelor's degree or paralegal degree, or equivalent work experience preferred.
  • 2-4 years of related commercial banking and/or legal experience.
  • Proficient knowledge of commercial loan documentation and requirements.
  • Proficient knowledge of commercial lending credit policies and guidelines.
  • Proficient knowledge of loan regulatory rules (e.g., Insurance).
  • Thorough knowledge of loan closing procedures and policies preferred, but not required.
  • Thorough knowledge of CCAS, AFS, RIMS, Loan Doc Prep System (or equivalent vendor systems), and other banking systems preferred, but not required.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Demonstrate effective problem solving and analytical skills with ability to handle and prioritize multiple tasks with appropriate escalation of issues.
  • Demonstrate ability to coordinate tasks and resources and meet deadlines under pressure.
  • Possesses strong organizational skills.
  • Excellent knowledge of all Microsoft Office software.

title: #EG Senior AI Data Engineer
description:
Company Description

NCS is a leading technology services firm that operates across the Asia Pacific region in over 20 cities, providing consulting, digital services, technology solutions, and more. We believe in harnessing the power of technology to achieve extraordinary things, creating lasting value and impact for our communities, partners, and people. Our diverse workforce of 15,000 has delivered large-scale, mission-critical, and multi-platform projects for governments and enterprises in Singapore and the APAC region.

Job Description

Role Summary

You are an autonomous AI Engineer, responsible for creating the harness for designing and building the AI harness, agent framework, and reusable engineering components required to operate a modern data platform based on Apache Iceberg, Trino, and Parquet.

Your primary responsibility is not only to build data pipelines, but also to establish the agentic execution framework (AI Harness) that enables multiple specialized agents to collaborate, execute tasks, maintain state, orchestrate workflows, and deliver end-to-end data engineering capabilities.

Depending on your level of experience, your focus in the team will be on either task execution, independent delivery, or technical leadership.

Key Responsibilities

AI Harness Development

Design and implement the foundational agent framework that provides:

  • Agent orchestration and coordination
  • Workflow execution and state management
  • Memory and context handling
  • Tool and function calling
  • Agent-to-agent communication
  • Human approval workflows
  • Logging and audit trails
  • Error handling and recovery
  • Security and access controls
  • Observability and monitoring

The harness must support autonomous and multi-agent execution patterns.

Specialized Agents Creation

The agents will need to perform the following:

  • Discover Iceberg catalogs and schemas
  • Profile datasets
  • Generate metadata and lineage
  • Ingest data from databases, APIs, files, and streams
  • Create Parquet datasets
  • Register and maintain Iceberg tables
  • Generate Trino SQL
  • Build transformation workflows
  • Create curated and business-ready datasets
  • Validate schemas and data integrity
  • Detect anomalies
  • Generate reconciliation reports
  • Analyze Trino workloads
  • Recommend partitioning strategies
  • Optimize Iceberg tables and Parquet files
  • Classify sensitive information
  • Manage metadata and lineage
  • Apply retention and compliance policies
  • Monitor pipelines and agent activities
  • Detect failures and bottlenecks
  • Generate alerts and operational insights

Expected Deliverables

  • Iceberg table definitions and schemas
  • Trino SQL scripts and views
  • Python data pipeline code
  • Data quality validation suites
  • Metadata and lineage documentation
  • CI/CD deployment artifacts
  • Monitoring and observability configurations
  • Technical documentation and runbooks

Qualifications

Skills and Experience

The candidate should demonstrate expertise in:

  • Experience with Generative AI, Agentic AI, or LLM-based solutions.
  • Proficiency in Python, including FastAPI, Pydantic and Pandas.
  • Experience designing and implementing AI Harness or multi-agent frameworks.
  • Hands-on experience with LangChain & LangGraph.
  • Experience with Apache Iceberg, Trino, and Parquet-based lakehouse architectures.
  • Experience building data ingestion, transformation, and orchestration pipelines.
  • Strong knowledge of metadata management, data lineage, and data governance practices.
  • Experience developing REST APIs, SDKs, and reusable engineering frameworks.
  • Experience with observability, monitoring, tracing, and operational support practices.
  • Strong understanding of distributed systems, event-driven architectures, and microservices patterns.
  • Proven ability to design, develop, and operationalize enterprise-grade AI agents for data discovery, ingestion, transformation, optimization, governance, and observability.
  • Familiar with modern data engineering technologies, including DuckDB, dbt, and related engineering tools for data transformation, modelling, and pipeline development.
  • Senior engineers will be expected to have demonstrated evidence of leading technical designs, guiding junior engineering team members, working independently with clients and delivery teams, and translating AI/data requirements into scalable, secure, and deployable solutions.

Additional Information

We are driven by our AEIOU beliefs—Adventure, Excellence, Integrity, Ownership, and Unity—and we seek individuals who embody these values in both their professional and personal lives. We are committed to our Impact: Valuing our clients, Growing our people, and Creating our future.

Together, we make the extraordinary happen.

Learn more about us at ncs.co and visit our LinkedIn career site.

In addition to producing bulk canola oil and meal, our food products division produces a wide variety of canola-based margarines, oils and shortenings for the industrial, retail and food service markets.


Working with Richardson opens the door to a world of possibility. We currently have an opportunity for a Material Handling Operator at our Yorkton – Oilseed location. Material Handling Operators are responsible for providing effective customer service of the daily processes within the operations areas of the logistics department. They must ensure that all operational procedures are executed safely within minimal non-conformance and business interruptions.

title: Substitute After-school Tennis Instructors
description:
Manhattan Youth is looking for several part-time Substitute After-school Tennis Instructors to join our dedicated team for the 2026-2027 school year. We are seeking dynamic and energetic individuals to lead our competitive sports teams and clubs.

You will be notified 48-hours in advance.

Manhattan Youth runs organized sports teams and clubs for a variety of sports including, basketball, soccer, softball, baseball/teeball, lacrosse, cross country running, track & field, volleyball, floor hockey, wrestling, flag football, ultimate frisbee, table tennis, fencing, cheerleading, and tumbling/gymnastics. After-school teachers are expected to guide students in their social, emotional, and academic development across a range of areas including sports, arts, academic enrichment, and leadership. Qualified applicants are proactive, caring and results-oriented teachers devoted to evidence-based practices that promote student achievement and well-being. The ability to maintain a positive, caring, and fun attitude; to learn and grow from mistakes; and to set an example as a continuous, open-minded learner is critical. After-school teachers will exhibit creativity, innovation and passion in teaching and are expected to help create an environment that encourages in children creative thinking, verbal communication, independent exploration, self-confidence, self-awareness, and a problem-solving approach to conflict.
We are looking to fill multiple roles in order to return our after-school programs to in-person learning. These are part-time, hourly positions available during the school year from September through June, following the NYC DOE schedule. After-school programs operate Monday – Friday from 2:30 - 6:00pm and clubs are 1.25 to 2.5 hours long. Individual schedules will vary by school. Opportunities exist to teach multiple clubs at different schools.

  • Work with Education Directors to design program curriculum;

  • Participate in MY staff meetings, development sessions and comply with training requirements;
  • Ensure safety of groups of children during classroom activities, recreation and field trips, and address emergency situations;

  • 2+ years teaching experience with middle or elementary school children, after-school setting preferred;
  • Bachelor’s degree preferred;
  • Demonstrative knowledge of and passion for content area, professional experience a plus;
  • Experience with educational technology instruction and practice;
  • Ability to build and maintain positive and respectful relationships with families, students and coworkers of diverse backgrounds and identities;
  • Proactive problem-solver, able to anticipate issues and thoughtfully handle unanticipated events;
  • Willingness to hear feedback, self-reflect, learn and work to improve performance and outcomes;
  • Excellent communication skills, ability to articulate ideas and knowledge clearly;
  • Multi-site flexibility (may be asked to work at different sites depending on need);
  • Ability to love, understand, listen to, nurture, support, and accept all children;
  • Proficiency or coaching in some of Manhattan Youth’s program areas (sports, arts, academic enrichment, leadership, etc…), past participation in varsity or college sports and/or theatre a plus.
$44/hr.

title: Process Quality Analyst, People Services
description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.



We are seeking a highly skilled and detail-oriented Process Quality Analyst to join our Process Engineering team. As the Quality Analyst, you will play a crucial role in supporting the highest standards of quality across our People Services operations. You will be responsible for monitoring, supporting, and overseeing quality assurance measures to enhance efficiency, reduce defects, data quality, and optimize overall performance.


Major Responsibilities and Accountabilities:

Impact Event Management System Oversight

  • Maintain the comprehensive Impact Event Management System (IEMS) for service-related matters.
  • Work closely with teams across the organization to identify and document service quality issues.
  • Analyze issue data to identify trends, root causes, and opportunities for improvement in service delivery.
  • Review and recommend improvements to the IEMS based on customer feedback and observations.

CAPA Management

  • Oversee the Corrective Action Preventive Action (CAPA) process for service quality.
  • Collaborate with teams to develop effective corrective and preventive action plans for service-related issues.
  • Monitor and ensure timely implementation of CAPAs in service operations.
  • Verify the effectiveness of CAPAs through follow-up and data analysis.

Process Improvement

  • Identify process inefficiencies in service delivery and work with relevant teams to streamline operations.
  • Support Process Engineering Team with process documentation.
  • Develop and implement quality improvement initiatives based on CAPA findings and issue log analysis.
  • Monitor the progress of service improvement projects and report on results.

Training and Development

  • Train, team members on CAPA processes and best practices for delivering high-quality service.
  • Conduct regular training sessions and workshops to enhance staff knowledge and skills in service quality management.

Reporting and Analysis

  • Generate and analyze reports on issue logs, CAPA progress, and service quality metrics.
  • Provide regular updates to senior management on service quality performance and improvement initiatives.

Compliance

  • Ensure compliance with industry regulations and standards related to service quality.
  • Stay informed about industry trends and best practices in service quality management.

Qualifications

Minimum Requirements

  • Minimum education of a bachelor's degree in quality management, business administration, operations management, and/or relevant field is required.
  • Minimum of three (3) years of practical work experience in quality, project or change management is required.
  • Proficient in evaluating existing process flows for Workday, mapping against functionality available vs used, developing new process flows and/or implementing new functional capabilities to improve service delivery that yield a higher degree of customer centricity/intuitiveness as well as data quality.
  • Experience with process simulations and standard operating procedures.
  • Proficiency in data analysis, with the ability to leverage HR metrics and analytics tools.
  • Excellent problem-solving and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to identify and address process gaps.
  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate effectively with stakeholders at all levels. Demonstrated ability to effectively communicate ideas and influence others to accomplish goals and objectives
  • Detail-oriented with a focus on accuracy and precision in process design and documentation.
  • Certifications such as Six Sigma, Lean, or similar a plus.

title: Café Ambassador - Boulder
description:
Café Ambassador - Boulder

The Role

Do you find your purpose in empowering others? As a Café Ambassador, you are the face of Capital One’s mission to change banking for good. We’ve broken the mold of traditional banking—you won’t be found behind a teller line or a glass window. Instead, you’ll move throughout the Café, bridging the gap between digital innovation and human connection.

In this role, you’ll act as a high-end service specialist and a guide to digital banking. You aren't just serving a community; you’re building one by bringing Capital One’s mission to life within a vibrant, modern community hub.

What You’ll Actually Do

  • Be a Natural Connector: Proactively engage with guests in a high-energy environment that serves as both a community space and a local coffee shop. (Note: You are a banking guide, not a barista—you won’t be serving coffee!)
  • Serve as a Brand Advocate: You’ll share the value of Capital One’s products and services through genuine conversation rather than transactions. Because we focus on the guest experience, this role is free from traditional sales goals or high-pressure tactics. Your success is measured by the quality of the connection, not a quota.
  • Simplify the Complex: Guide customers through our digital ecosystem, helping them master mobile tools and troubleshooting tech challenges with ease.
  • Facilitate Purposeful Impact: Host and support local events that promote financial health. You’ll act as a brand steward, working within the framework of Capital One’s established programs and strategic community partnerships to ensure our impact is professional, focused, and effective.
  • Advocate & Problem-Solve: You’ll advocate for our customers, problem solve, and own issue resolution in alignment with compliance and regulatory requirements. Handling complaints and/or escalated situations is very important, and de-escalation may be a complex part of your role supporting our customers—we’ll ensure you’re supported with the tools, resources, and experience to ensure you’re up for the challenge!
  • Act as a Culture Carrier: Foster a supportive, inclusive environment where every guest feels welcome. You’ll be a team player who possesses a strong attention to detail, a positive attitude, and the ability to be flexible and embrace change.
  • Stay Agile & Engaged: This isn’t a traditional "behind-the-desk" banking role. You’ll be on the move and active throughout the day, moving through the Cafe to connect with the community and support the flow of the guest experience.

Why Join Us?

This isn't just a job—it’s work with a mission. Because we’ve removed the pressure of traditional sales quotas, you are free to focus on the depth of your impact on customers, teammates, and the community. We provide an inclusive environment where we invest in your confidence, service mindset, and professional growth. We ensure you have the tools to be stronger in your role and more effective in how you show up every day.

The Perks

We provide a comprehensive benefits package designed to fuel your journey. Whether you’re using our education assistance to prepare for your next career move, or taking advantage of our mental and physical health resources to stay at your best, we invest in you as a whole person. Our goal is to ensure that wherever your career takes you—within Capital One or into the wider world—you leave the Cafe stronger than when you started.

  • Day 1 coverage for Medical, Dental, Vision and Prescriptions, plus Flexible Spending Accounts, Life and Disability Insurance
  • Paid Time Off
  • Education Assistance
  • Matching 401(k) contribution up to 7.5%
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Mental Health support
  • Back-up Child or Elder Care
  • Fit check? Covered. We’ll hook you up with our signature Threads line—our treat
  • Custom beverage while working
  • And much more!

Essential Functions (Included, but not limited to)

  • Support surrounding Cafés as needed within a 50 mile radius, with occasional opportunities to assist other locations in the broader Region.
  • Available to work a flexible schedule, including nights, weekends, and holidays, with hours and days subject to change.
  • While the company provides reasonable notice for permanent schedule changes in accordance with state and local laws, the ability to adapt to business-driven schedule adjustments is required.
  • Applicants must be able to attend all required training sessions, which may occur on a schedule differing from the primary shift.
  • Lifting up to 25 pounds and moving/standing for extended periods of time
  • Regular and consistent attendance

Basic Qualifications

  • High School Diploma, GED, or Equivalent Certification
  • At least 1 year of Retail, Sales, or Customer Service experience

Preferred Qualifications

  • Associate’s degree
  • 2+ years of banking experience
  • 2+ years of Retail or Customer-facing experience
  • Proficient in G-Suite
  • Strong written and oral communication skills

Does this sound like the career move you’ve been looking for? Let’s build the future of banking together!

You may be required to take an assessment. It takes about 35 minutes to complete. If you’re selected to move forward, one of our recruiters will reach out to tell you more about the role and answer your questions.

Werk je graag samen met verschillende afdelingen en zorg je ervoor dat materialen, orders en processen soepel verlopen? Dan is de functie van Coördinator Supply Chain iets voor jou!

Wat ga je doen?

Als Coördinator Supply Chain ondersteun je de afdelingen Werkvoorbereiding, Inkoop en Magazijn. Je helpt bij het coördineren van materiaalstromen, het beheren van administratieve processen en het tijdig beschikbaar maken van materialen. Met jouw inzet draag je bij aan een soepel verlopend productieproces en een efficiënte supply chain.

Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit:

Werkvoorbereiding

  • Controleren, aanvullen en beheren van stuklijsten en productieorders.
  • Voorbereiden en klaarzetten van materialen voor productie.
  • Ondersteunen bij de productieplanning en het bewaken van de voortgang.
  • Bijhouden en actualiseren van documentatie, werkinstructies en orderinformatie.

Inkoop

  • Aanmaken, verwerken en opvolgen van inkooporders.
  • Controleren van orderbevestigingen, levertijden en prijzen.
  • Contact onderhouden met leveranciers over afwijkingen, levertijden en beschikbaarheid van materialen.
  • Ondersteunen bij voorraadanalyses en besteladviezen.

Magazijn

  • Verwerken van goederenontvangsten en controleren van binnenkomende leveringen.
  • Bijhouden van de voorraadadministratie en signaleren van afwijkingen.
  • Ondersteunen bij voorraadtellingen en cycle counts.
  • Uitgeven van materialen aan productie en registreren van materiaalverbruik.

Over jou

Je bent leergierig, praktisch ingesteld en neemt graag initiatief. Je vindt het prettig om overzicht te houden, prioriteiten te stellen en samen te werken met collega's van verschillende afdelingen. Je schakelt moeiteloos tussen administratieve werkzaamheden en praktische taken en denkt graag mee over verbeteringen in processen.

Daarnaast:

  • Beschik je over een mbo-diploma niveau 4, bij voorkeur in de richting Logistiek, Supply Chain, Inkoop of Administratie.
  • Heb je bij voorkeur ervaring met logistieke of administratieve werkzaamheden.
  • Heb je basiskennis van ERP-systemen, bijvoorbeeld Ridder IQ.
  • Kun je goed overweg met MS Office.
  • Ben je sterk in plannen en organiseren en weet je prioriteiten te stellen.
  • Communiceer je gemakkelijk met collega's en leveranciers.
  • Werk je proactief en signaleer je afwijkingen voordat ze problemen veroorzaken.
  • Ben je flexibel, oplossingsgericht en een echte teamspeler.
  • Heb je een hands-on mentaliteit en pak je werkzaamheden zelfstandig op.

Interesse?

Wil jij een belangrijke rol spelen in het organiseren van onze supply chain en ervoor zorgen dat onze productie soepel blijft draaien? Zoek je een afwisselende functie waarin je je verder kunt ontwikkelen en betrokken bent bij werkvoorbereiding, inkoop én magazijnbeheer?

Dan maken we graag kennis met je! Solliciteer.

title: Full Time Branch Ambassador - MacArthur
description:
Full Time Branch Ambassador - MacArthur

Welcome to the future of banking. At Capital One, we believe your bank should be as mobile, intuitive, and human as the rest of your life. We are reimagining the way people interact with their money by creating community hubs where technology meets human empathy.

As a Branch Ambassador, you are the heartbeat of our space. You don't just "process transactions"—you embody our culture of outstanding hospitality. You are a relationship-builder who blends friendly, attentive service with cutting-edge digital innovation. Whether you’re helping a client navigate our latest tools or empowering them to reach their financial goals, you are the face of an exceptional, human-centric experience.

We are looking for curious, empathetic, and tech-savvy individuals who thrive in a fast-moving environment. You are someone who doesn't wait to be asked; you anticipate needs, solve problems before they arise, and have a genuine passion for helping people thrive in an evolving digital world.

What You’ll Actually Do

The Guardian of Trust & Accuracy You are the bedrock of our environment’s safety and integrity. You’ll execute high-volume cash transactions—including deposits, withdrawals, and complex negotiable instrument processing—with 100% accuracy. You maintain a "compliance-first" mindset, ensuring all security, audit, BSA/AML, and federal regulatory standards are met with precision to keep our customers' assets safe.

The Digital Concierge You are a mentor in a digital world. You’ll educate clients on how to leverage mobile banking, remote deposit capture, and contactless payments, helping them gain convenience and security in their daily financial lives.

The First-Line Consultant You aren’t just answering questions; you’re identifying needs. By actively listening, you’ll uncover personal or business goals and pair them with the right digital tools or banking solutions to help them succeed.

The Hospitality Lead You move fluidly throughout the space, greeting customers and ensuring no one ever feels like just a "number." You balance the efficiency of a high-volume operation with the warmth of a community-focused partner.

What You Bring

  • A Hospitality Heart: You have a natural gift for making people feel welcome and heard.
  • Tech Fluency: You are an early adopter of apps and digital tools and love teaching others how to use them.
  • Precision and Detail: You find satisfaction in getting the numbers right every single time and following clear procedures.
  • Adaptability: You enjoy a "fluid" workspace where you might move from a cash drawer to a digital demo in minutes.
  • Curiosity: You want to know the "why" behind the "how" and are always looking for ways to improve the customer journey.

Why Join Us?

This isn't just a job—it’s work with a mission. Because we’ve removed the pressure of traditional sales quotas, you are free to focus on the depth of your impact on customers, teammates, and the community. We provide an inclusive environment where we invest in your confidence, service mindset, and professional growth. We ensure you have the tools to be stronger in your role and more effective in how you show up every day.

The Perks

We provide a comprehensive benefits package designed to fuel your journey. Whether you’re using our education assistance to prepare for your next career move, or taking advantage of our mental and physical health resources to stay at your best, we invest in you as a whole person. Our goal is to ensure that wherever your career takes you—within Capital One or into the wider world—you leave the Branch stronger than when you started.

  • Day 1 coverage for Medical, Dental, Vision and Prescriptions, plus Flexible Spending Accounts, Life and Disability Insurance
  • Paid Time Off
  • Education Assistance
  • Matching 401(k) contribution up to 7.5%
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Mental Health support
  • Back-up Child or Elder Care
  • And much more!

Essential Functions (Included, but not limited to)

  • Support surrounding Branches as needed within a 50 mile radius, with occasional opportunities to assist other locations in the broader Region.
  • Available to work a flexible schedule, including nights, weekends, with hours and days subject to change.
  • While the company provides reasonable notice for permanent schedule changes in accordance with state and local laws, the ability to adapt to business-driven schedule adjustments is required.
  • Applicants must be able to attend all required training sessions, which may occur on a schedule differing from the primary shift.
  • Lifting up to 25 pounds and moving/standing for extended periods of time
  • Regular and consistent attendance

Basic Qualifications

  • High School Diploma, GED, or Equivalent Certification
  • At least 1 year of Retail, Sales, or Customer Service experience
  • At least 6 months of cash handling experience

Preferred Qualifications

  • Associate’s degree
  • 2+ years of Retail or Customer-facing experience
  • Proficient in G-Suite
  • Strong written and oral communication skills

After you apply

You may be required to take an assessment. It takes about 35 minutes to complete. If you’re selected to move forward, one of our recruiters will reach out to tell you more about the role and answer your questions.

Does this sound like the career move you’ve been looking for? Let’s build the future of banking together!

title: Cardiac Rhythm Management Associate Clinical Specialist - Columbia, SC
location: Columbia, South Carolina, United States of America
description:
We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on - 21 Oct 2026


Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

A Day in the Life

The Cardiac Rhythm Management (CRM) portfolio delivers therapies designed to restore, support, and protect every heartbeat through advanced pacing, defibrillation, and remote monitoring solutions. CRM's unique ability to pair proven life-saving therapies with intelligent technology gives clinicians and patients greater confidence. Clinical impact and innovation come together to improve lives through meaningful patient outcomes.

Provide technical, educational, operational and sales support to assist the district in meeting Cardiac Rhythm Management (CRM) sales and customer service objectives. CRM seeks collaborative candidates who will meet our customer expectations by striving without reserve for the greatest possible reliability and quality in our products, processes, and systems by being accountable, having a voice and acting promptly.

This role supports the Columbia, SC territory and requires candidates to reside within the assigned area and travel regularly to customer accounts. Clinical Specialists must be available to support urgent customer needs and participate in weekend, holiday, and occasional after-hours coverage as business needs require. A valid driver's license, active auto insurance, and a driving record that meets company standards are required.

To find all Cardiac Rhythm Management Clinical Specialist roles available please use #crmcs in the key word search at Medtronic Careers

POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provide technical support for CRM devices and therapies by performing system checks/interrogations, supporting implants, troubleshooting issues, and applying knowledge gained through comprehensive CRM field training.
  • Coordinate operational support by ensuring accurate patient documentation, managing inventory and equipment resources, maintaining programmer software, and assisting with daily coverage logistics to meet customer and business needs.
  • Educate physicians, hospital staff, office personnel, and field team members on CRM products, therapies, and solutions, while supporting the onboarding and development of new Clinical Specialists and Sales Representatives.
  • Collaborate with sales leadership and field partners to understand customer needs, market dynamics, and the value of Medtronic CRM products and solutions.
  • Identify customer opportunities, support purchase order activities, monitor competitive trends, and provide actionable feedback to help achieve sales objectives.
  • Maintain technical expertise by staying current on new CRM products, therapies, solutions, and patient management offerings to effectively support customers and clinical outcomes.
  • Travel extensively within the assigned territory to support customer clinics, hospitals, and business meetings, with frequent independent driving – approximate 80% of the time
  • Perform physical job requirements, including frequent two-handed lifting of up to 40 lbs., sitting, standing, and walking for 8+ hours per day, and regularly bending, stooping, squatting, and maintaining balance.
  • Work effectively in clinical environments with exposure to eye protection, infectious disease, and radiation, while wearing 7-9 lbs. of lead for extended periods, utilizing computers and mobile devices, and maintaining the vision capabilities necessary to support patient care and field-based responsibilities.
  • Performs other duties as assigned

Required Qualifications

  • High School Diploma PLUS a minimum 4 years OR associate's degree PLUS a minimum 2 years' work experience in healthcare, field sales, or work experience utilizing complex mathematics, mechanical concepts, science or computing OR Bachelor’s Degree

NICE TO HAVE - DESIRED/PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • B.A./B.S. Degree in nursing, life sciences, biomedical engineering

For Baccalaureate degrees earned outside of the United States, a degree that satisfies the requirements of 8 C.F.R. § 214.2(h)(4)(iii)(A) is required.

title: QUALITY INSPECTOR
description:
Corporate Statement

American Armor Gloves is a privately-owned Nitrile Glove manufacturer. AAG products are proudly made in the USA! We are headquartered in West Columbia, South Carolina. The facility utilizes completely automated manufacturing, packaging, and distribution systems, in addition to high volume and redundant utility systems, to ensure production system availability.

Position Summary:

Quality Inspectors are responsible for inspecting and testing products and overseeing operations for a company to ensure they meet production standards, and they can work in any industry that involves production and assembly, such as glassware, textile, motor vehicles and food.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Read specifications, procedures and instructions to comprehend the quality expectations for the product and raw materials
  • Approve or reject raw materials or finished products with respect to quality standards as required by applicable procedures and specifications
  • Select samples as per established sampling plan, when required, check them using appropriate methods (measuring dimensions, testing functionality, comparing to specifications)
  • As appropriate, use tools such to perform product inspections
  • Maintain records of testing, information and various metrics
  • Evaluate production area to ensure production process adheres to approved procedures
  • Periodically review Production Records to ensure timely and accurate documentation of finished product manufacturing process
  • Monitor the use of equipment to ensure it is safe and well-maintained and report any that doesn't meet requirements
  • Prepare and submit reports to Production and Quality Supervisors

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

The primary accountabilities and knowledge, skills and abilities listed below are intended to describe the general content of and requirements of this position and are not intended to be an exhaustive statement of duties. Incumbents may perform all or most of the primary accountabilities listed below. Specific tasks or responsibilities will be documented in the incumbents’ performance objectives as outlined by the incumbents’ immediate supervisor or manager.

  • High School Diploma or GED preferred,
  • 1-3 years of experience in quality inspection in manufacturing environments of highly regulated industry (e.g. medical device, food, automotive or pharmaceutical)
  • At least 1 year of prior experience leading teams is highly preferred
  • 2-4 years of experience with MS Word, Excel, and PowerPoint preferred
  • Experience in assisting the monitoring of all quality areas and personnel for adherence to all cGMP, SOP’s, and safety regulations for purposes of product release
  • Good written and oral communication skills, including technical writing
  • Effective decision making based on approved procedures and specifications
  • Team Player, must be able to interact within all departments of the company
  • Ability to work independently, and dependable
  • Ability to accept accountability to drive results through effective actions
  • The ability to create and contribute environment that values people, encourages trust, teamwork, and open communication, and provides participation, learning, feedback and recognition
  • The ability to effectively manage oneself, demonstrate integrity, be productive under pressure, and achieve development goals
  • Position requires lifting (up to 40 lbs.), vision (20/20), standing, walking, talking, typing, and hearing
  • When appropriate incumbents will wear specified protective equipment
  • Strong attention to detail
  • Good visual acuity and observation skills
  • Must be able to stand for long periods
  • Must be able to work 12hr shifts. This is a 24/7 operation and will require weekends and/or holidays to be staffed

EEO Statement:

American Armor Gloves is an equal employment opportunity employer and does not discriminate against employees or job applicants on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, sexual orientation, age, national origin, mental or physical disability of a qualified individual, veteran or military status, pregnancy, marital status, familial status, genetic information, or any other consideration made unlawful by applicable federal, state or local law.

· Maintain presentation graphics that synthesize economic and real estate data into clear, compelling narratives for internal and external stakeholders

· Proactively communicate with matrix manager and other colleagues in Strategy & Research on project updates, data quality, and analytical findings to support timely research delivery.

· Support US and global research initiatives, including contributions to white papers and Insights, Strategy and Analysis (ISA) publications.

  • Excellent written and oral communication skills in English.

· Strong analytical skills and ability to manipulate and interpret data.

description:
