  • budujesz portfel o wysokiej wartości - pozyskujesz nowe relacje i jednocześnie rozwijasz współpracę z obecnymi klientami

  • znasz język angielski na poziomie min. B2
  • masz doświadczenie w aktywnym pozyskiwaniu nowych klientów
  • czynnie korzystasz z prawa jazdy kat. B
  • lubisz pracę z ludźmi – łatwo nawiązujesz relacje i w praktyce wiesz, jak wygląda skuteczna praca zespołowa
  • posiadasz wysoko rozwinięte umiejętności interpersonalne - potrafisz diagnozować i uświadamiać potrzeby klientów, prowadzić negocjacje oraz skutecznie stosować techniki sprzedaży

  • Dbamy o zdrowie i bezpieczeństwo - oferujemy pakiet medyczny i ubezpieczenie na życie dla Ciebie i Twoich bliskich, dostęp do platformy Mindgram z indywidualnymi konsultacjami ze specjalistami i webinariami. Pracując w ING masz możliwość dołączenia do Pracowniczego Programu Emerytalnego i Programu Profilaktyki Onkologicznej
  • Work life balance w praktyce to dodatkowe dni wolne: „dzień dla rodziny” (od Ciebie zależy jak go wykorzystasz), wolne dni w formie nagrody i wolne godziny na wolontariat czy profilaktykę zdrowotną
  • Dla rodziców mamy dodatkowe dni urlopu macierzyńskiego i ojcowskiego oraz dni wolne na opiekę nad dzieckiem, niezależenie od wykorzystanego limitu przez drugiego rodzica
  • Dołączając do nas decydujesz się na pracę w stabilnej i zorientowanej na komfortowe warunki pracy organizacji z certyfikatem Top Employer. Przyszłość to nasza wspólna inwestycja - razem z ING możesz zaangażować się w każdą inicjatywę wspierającą ESG i odpowiedzialność społeczną
  • Świętujemy wspólnie i poznajemy się na zespołowych wyjazdach, imprezach rodzinnych i sportowych, jak Dzień Dziecka, Biegnij Warszawo czy Turnieje sportowe

title: Sr. Strategic Sourcing Specialist
description:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

A Day in the Life

This role is part of the Strategic Sourcing function supporting the Medtronic Operations (MSO) manufacturing organization in Singapore. The team is responsible for supplier management, strategic sourcing, risk mitigation, and supply continuity to support stable production and operational performance. Through cross-functional collaboration, the function drives supplier performance, cost optimization, quality, and long-term sourcing strategies across key commodities and services.

The Sr. Strategic Sourcing Specialist is responsible for developing and executing sourcing strategies, managing supplier relationships, and supporting supply continuity for manufacturing operations. This role partners with cross-functional teams to optimize supplier performance, mitigate supply risks, negotiate commercial agreements, and drive improvements in cost, quality, delivery, and operational efficiency.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Lead strategic sourcing initiatives and commodity management projects across cross-functional teams.
  • Develop and execute long-term sourcing strategies that support quality, supply continuity, technology advancement, risk reduction, and total cost objectives.
  • Manage supplier relationships to ensure performance against quality, delivery, service, and business requirements.
  • Identify, assess, and mitigate supply chain risks that may impact manufacturing operations.
  • Negotiate supplier agreements, pricing, and commercial terms to achieve business objectives.
  • Monitor supplier performance and implement corrective actions to address supply, quality, or service issues.
  • Drive process, system, and sourcing improvements that enhance operational efficiency and reduce total cost of ownership.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders across manufacturing, engineering, quality, and supply chain functions to support strategic business initiatives.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree with 3+ years of experience in Strategic Sourcing, Project Management, Engineering, or Supplier Quality Engineering.
  • Experience managing supplier relationships and sourcing activities in a manufacturing or operations environment.
  • Experience leading cross-functional projects and influencing stakeholders across multiple functions.
  • Experience negotiating supplier agreements, contracts, or commercial terms.
  • Ability to analyze supply, cost, quality, and operational data to support business decisions.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in medical device, life sciences, or other regulated manufacturing industries.
  • Experience in supplier quality management, supplier development, or supply chain risk management.
  • Experience supporting manufacturing operations and production continuity initiatives.
  • Knowledge of strategic sourcing methodologies, commodity management, and supplier performance management.
  • Experience driving process improvement and cost optimization initiatives.

title: Traveling Construction Superintendent
description:

This role oversees jobsite safety, subcontractor coordination, scheduling, and project execution from groundbreaking through closeout. Candidates should have field experience overseeing ADA/accessibility scopes and concrete construction.

Travel: 90–100% nationwide travel required.

Project Types: May include commercial, government, federal, and public-sector construction projects, including ground-up construction, renovations, ADA/accessibility improvements, and structural and site concrete work.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

Lead Field Operations

  • Oversee all onsite construction activities and field operations
  • Direct subcontractors, vendors, and field crews to maintain productivity and progress
  • Ensure projects stay on schedule and meet key milestones

Scheduling & Coordination

  • Develop and manage short-term look-ahead schedules aligned with the master project schedule
  • Coordinate material deliveries, equipment, and labor to maintain workflow
  • Identify potential issues early and implement solutions to avoid delays

Safety Leadership

  • Enforce company safety policies and OSHA compliance
  • Conduct daily safety meetings, site inspections, and job hazard analysis
  • Ensure proper PPE use and maintain a strong safety culture onsite

Quality Control

  • Ensure work is performed according to plans, specifications, and quality standards
  • Perform regular jobsite walkthroughs and inspections
  • Coordinate required inspections, testing, and quality control procedures

Subcontractor Management

  • Manage subcontractor performance, scope execution, and schedule adherence
  • Coordinate trades to prevent conflicts and maintain project flow
  • Address field issues and escalate discrepancies when necessary

Project Documentation

  • Maintain daily reports including manpower, progress, weather, and safety updates
  • Communicate field updates and issues to the Project Manager
  • Assist with RFIs, change orders, and field directives as needed

  • Support delivery of as-builts, O&M manuals, and final documentation

Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or equivalent required; Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management or related field preferred
  • 7+ years of construction experience, including 3+ years as a Superintendent for a General Contractor
  • Experience managing commercial construction projects
  • Strong knowledge of construction methods, scheduling, and subcontractor coordination
  • Experience with Procore, Microsoft Office, and construction scheduling software (MS Project or Primavera P6 preferred)
  • Excellent leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills
  • OSHA 30 certification (or ability to obtain)

About Sevan

Sevan Multi-Site Solutions is a veteran-owned business that provides construction, program management, real estate & site development, and architecture & engineering services for restaurant, grocery, fuel and convenience store, retail, and government sectors nationwide. We work with leading brands like McDonald’s, Starbucks, Sprouts, and BP, to name a few. At Sevan, we provide the talent, technology, and trusted expertise needed to consistently deliver excellence in multi-site construction.

Sevan is nationally recognized for workplace culture, industry leadership, and safety. Recent honors include 12 consecutive years as a Great Place to Work®, placement on ENR's national Program and Construction Management rankings, recognition as one of America's Safest Companies for 2025, and the 2025 Platinum HIRE Vets Medallion Award.

Why Join Sevan?

At Sevan, we believe in creating a supportive and dynamic environment where your contributions truly matter. Here’s what you can expect as part of our team:

  • Live Our Values: Join a company that values integrity, respect, teamwork, excellence, and charity. These principles are at the heart of everything we do.
  • Champion Key Initiatives: Play a vital role in driving Sevan-wide initiatives like Safety and Sustainability, ensuring positive impacts for our people and the planet.

  • Grow With Us: Take charge of your personal and professional growth through hands-on experience, engaging training programs, and opportunities to mentor interns and co-ops.
  • Support Development of Top Brands: Opportunity to work behind the scenes supporting efforts for industry leaders like McDonald’s, Starbucks, and 7-Eleven.

Benefits include medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurances, flexible paid time off, paid holidays, sick time, and a matching 401K plan.

title: Senior Project Developer
description:
About Us
Highland Electric Fleets’ mission is to make electric fleets accessible and affordable for all, enabling communities to realize the benefits of cleaner, quieter and healthier fleets. Highland is North America’s leading provider of Electrification-as-a-Service (EaaS). Founded in 2019, Highland partners with school districts, municipalities, and fleet operators to make the transition to electric fleets simple and affordable.
Highland proudly serves as the Official Electric School Bus Provider of the LA28 Olympic and Paralympic Games and Team USA. From pioneering vehicle-to-grid technology to managing some of the nation’s largest electric school bus fleets, Highland delivers reliable, cost-effective solutions that support local communities and drive the future of transportation.

Job Summary:

The Senior Project Developer will deliver fully developed, execution-ready battery storage (BESS) and edge compute projects. This role will manage the permitting and utility interconnection process from preliminary design until construction handoff. The Senior Developer will manage external engineers and consultants to navigate major design and permitting issues and drive their portfolio of projects to power readiness.

This position reports directly to the Senior Manager, Development and Construction, preferably based in Boston, MA and an expectation of approximately 20% travel.

Job Overview:

  • Develop battery storage and edge compute projects from initial concept through construction readiness.
  • Establish the appropriate utility pathway for each project, distinguishing new electrical service for compute loads from BESS interconnection and any associated operating or export requirements.
  • Work with Highland’s interconnection team to drive towards power readiness at each site, managing utilities to adhere to schedule.
  • Develop and execute the entitlement and permitting strategy for each project, including zoning, land-use, building, electrical, fire, and applicable environmental approvals.
  • Lead early engagement with authorities having jurisdiction, planning staff, fire officials, utilities, and other reviewing agencies.
  • Manage complete permit submissions, responses to comments, public hearings, and approval conditions.
  • Work with Highland’s engineering team to review site plans, electrical one-lines, equipment layouts, and design assumptions sufficiently to identify development risks and coordination gaps.
  • Track project schedules, budgets, and subcontractor deliverables.
  • Engage construction teams to validate design and prep the project for handoff to Project Execution teams.

Qualifications:

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree or 8+ years of directly related professional experience.
  • 4+ years experience developing energy infrastructure projects, such as solar, BESS, transmission, or generation projects
  • Direct BESS development experience, including utility interconnection and engagement with permitting authorities.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop entitlement strategies, manage permit submissions, and represent projects before municipal boards or other approval bodies.
  • Experience evaluating project economics, development budgets, and tradeoffs among cost, schedule, technical feasibility, and risk.

Preferred:

  • Experience developing data center and/or edge compute projects
  • Experience with large, power-intensive projects with medium voltage/primary metered utility service
  • Project management experience in engineering and/or construction environments
What You Can Expect from Highland:
  • Competitive base salary and performance-based bonus program
  • A supportive, highly collaborative, team-oriented environment
  • Ability to work with bright, innovative, and forward-thinking colleagues
  • Health, Vision, and Dental coverage for employees & their dependents
  • Generous Paid Time Off
  • 401(k) program and company match
Highland Electric Fleets provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or genetics. In addition to federal law requirements, Highland Electric Fleets complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

title: Process Technologist
description:
Kepak Foods Division

Kepak Foods Division have developed a portfolio of brands that are successful in the chilled convenience, ambient and frozen meat categories in the UK, Ireland and chosen European markets for both Retail and Foodservice Customers. We have 5 Manufacturing Sites supported by shared services, with 1000 people supporting our vision to become a transformed, future proofed, profitable €0.5bn Food Business by 2030.

At Kepak, we're looking for a Process Technologist to play a key role in delivering product validation, process optimisation, and coordination of trials in our York site.

This is an exciting opportunity to work at the heart of our business, collaborating with Operations, Technical, Procurement, and NPD teams to ensure products are launched successfully, processes are optimised, and continuous improvement remains a priority.

Key Responsibilities

As a Process Technologist, you will support the delivery of projects through the Kepak Stage Gate process, helping to drive efficiency, quality, and value throughout the manufacturing journey.

Project & Process Delivery

  • Support the successful delivery of product development, cost optimisation, and process improvement projects.
  • Coordinate factory, kitchen, and production trials, ensuring accurate data collection and reporting.
  • Assist with product and process validation activities, including sensory, shelf-life, nutritional, and technical assessments.
  • Maintain project documentation and trial records to the highest standard.
  • Support first production runs and the implementation of approved process changes.

Continuous Improvement

  • Identify opportunities to improve manufacturing efficiency, increase yield, and reduce waste.
  • Support ingredient, supplier, and process trials that deliver cost savings and enhanced performance.
  • Analyse process data and assist with root cause investigations.

Passion for Food & Quality

  • Help deliver high-quality products that exceed customer and consumer expectations.
  • Evaluate the impact of process changes on product quality, consistency, and performance.
  • Participate in product assessments, sensory evaluations, and validation activities.

Requirements

  • A degree or qualification in Food Science, Food Technology, Process Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Previous 2+ years experience within a similar position ideally within the Meat Industry
  • Understanding of food production processes and factory operations.
  • Ability to analyse data and identify improvement opportunities.
  • Good communication and stakeholder engagement skills.
  • Competent in Microsoft Office applications.
  • Willingness to travel between sites when required.
  • Full UK Driving Licence

Benefits

What can we offer you?

  • Further Education support
  • Dedicated L&D Team
  • Bike to Work Scheme - You can buy a bike and safety equipment through a salary sacrifice scheme which reduces your taxable income – meaning you pay less tax!
  • Long Service Awards - We recognise, acknowledge and award the dedication and valuable contribution of long serving employees
  • BUPA Cash plan free of charge

title: Logistiikkapäällikkö, Vantaa
description:
We at Posti take care of a smoother flow of everyday life for you, companies and society while building a more sustainable future for us all with a diverse pool of professionals from mail deliverers and warehouse workers to artificial intelligence experts. As a large company, the range of possibilities we offer is huge – also internationally. Overall, we have 13,000 experts across the Nordics and Baltics. Join us to create the future Posti!

Haemme Logistiikkapäällikköä Vantaan Voutilan palveluvarastoalueellemme.

Etsimme kokenutta ja innostavaa Logistiikkapäällikköä vastaamaan Vantaan Voutilan palveluvarastoalueen operatiivisesta johtamisesta, tuloksellisesta toiminnasta sekä henkilöstön ja asiakkuuksien kehittämisestä.

Tehtävässäsi vastaat alueesi taloudellisesta tuloksesta, kustannusten hallinnasta, resursoinnista, työturvallisuudesta sekä asiakasyhteistyöstä. Johdat toimintaa tavoitteellisesti varmistaen liiketoiminnan, laadun ja asiakaskokemuksen tavoitteiden saavuttamisen. Vastaat myös toimintasuunnitelmien, budjettien ja ennusteiden laatimisesta sekä niiden toteutumisen seurannasta.

Roolissasi toimit myös suorana esihenkilönä muutamalle työnjohtajalle sekä vastaat tuotannon johtamismallien toteuttamisesta ja toimintatapojen jatkuvasta kehittämisestä vastuualueellasi. Työskentelet aktiivisesti niin asiakkaiden, henkilöstön kuin muiden sidosryhmien kanssa, joten on tärkeää, että onnistut rakentamaan luottamusta ja yhteistyötä erilaisissa tilanteissa.

Työturvallisuus ja henkilöstön hyvinvointi ovat sinulle keskeinen osa johtamista, ja ne näkyvät arjen päätöksissäsi sekä tavassasi johtaa ihmisiä. Vastuualueellasi työskentelee noin 70–100 logistiikan ammattilaista.

Tarjoamme sinulle monipuolisen ja vauhdikkaan toimintaympäristön, joka kattaa logistiikan toimitusketjun vastaanotosta lähetystoimintaan. Pääset kehittämään toimintaa, uudistamaan prosesseja ja vaikuttamaan liiketoiminnan tuloksiin osana osaavaa ja ammattitaitoista tiimiä.

Mitä odotamme sinulta?

  • Vähintään viiden vuoden kokemusta tulosvastuullisesta esihenkilötehtävästä
  • Tehtävään soveltuvaa korkeakoulututkintoa, muuta soveltuvaa koulutusta tai työn kautta hankittua tehtävän menestyksekkääseen hoitamiseen soveltuvaa osaamista
  • Vahvaa ymmärrystä varastoliiketoiminnan kustannusrakenteesta, kannattavuudesta ja ansaintalogiikasta
  • Analyyttistä ja dataohjautuvaa toimintatapaa sekä kykyä johtaa ja kehittää tuotantoa tiedolla
  • Näyttöjä tavoitteellisesta johtamisesta ja kyvystä saavuttaa tuloksia henkilöstön, turvallisuuden, asiakaskokemuksen ja liiketoiminnan näkökulmista
  • Valmentavaa ja osallistavaa johtamisotetta sekä kokemusta henkilöstön osaamisen kehittämisestä
  • Kykyä toimia ratkaisukeskeisesti muuttuvassa ja ajoittain hektisessä toimintaympäristössä
  • Erinomaisia vuorovaikutus-, yhteistyö- ja neuvottelutaitoja sekä asiakaslähtöistä toimintatapaa
  • Kokemusta varastologistiikan toiminnoista ja prosesseista; myös nykyaikaisten varastonohjausjärjestelmien tuntemus katsotaan eduksi
  • Erinomaista suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa sekä kykyä viestiä selkeästi eri sidosryhmien kanssa niin suullisesti kuin kirjallisesti

Miksi meille kannattaa tulla töihin?

Meillä pääset osaksi yritystä, jonka toiminta vaikuttaa miljoonien ihmisten jokapäiväiseen elämään. Olemme kasvaneet kansainväliseksi logistiikan moniosaajaksi, joka työllistää noin 13 000 ihmistä Pohjoismaissa ja Baltiassa. Kehitämme jatkuvasti uutta teknologiaa, ja olemme edelläkävijöitä kestävämmän tulevaisuuden rakentamisessa: olemme asettaneet kunnianhimoisen tavoitteen toimia fossiilittomasti vuoteen 2030 mennessä ja olla päästöissä nettonollassa vuoteen 2040 mennessä.

Edistämme monimuotoista ja yhdenvertaista työelämää. Kaikki esihenkilömme käyvät läpi Välittävä johtaja -koulutuksen, ja yhdessä rakennamme välittävää työkulttuuria. Sitoutumisemme mielen hyvinvointia tukevaan työhön on huomioitu Hyvän Mielen työpaikka- merkillä vuonna 2026. Meillä saat myös erinomaisen mahdollisuuden kehittää uraasi ja osaamistasi monipuolisten tehtävien, kehitysprojektien ja koulutusohjelmien kautta.

Henkilöstöetuina tarjoamme kattavan työterveyshuollon Mehiläisellä, ePassin kulttuuri-, urheilu- ja työmatkaedut sekä lounaan edulliseen henkilökuntahintaan. Lisäksi sinulla on mahdollisuus osallistua Posti-konsernin työhyvinvointisäätiön tarjoamiin tapahtumiin, kuten hyvinvointikursseille, huvipuistopäiviin, konsertteihin ja urheilutapahtumiin.

Asemapaikkasi sijaitsee Vantaan Voutilan varastollamme (Tikkurilantie 148), jossa pääset työskentelemään tiiviissä yhteistyössä tiimin kanssa paikan päällä. Hyödynnämme tässä roolissa on site -toimintamallia, mikä mahdollistaa sujuvan arjen ja nopean yhteistyön, joten etä- tai hybridityö ei ole tässä tehtävässä käytössä.

Heräsikö kysymyksiä? Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa Tuotantopäällikkö, Jouni Luoma (+358408623788 / jouni.luoma@posti.com) maanantaina 19.10.2026 klo. 12.00–13.00 tai torstaina 22.10.2026 klo. 14.00–15.00.

Näin rekrytointi etenee:
1. Yhteydenotto rekrytoivalta esihenkilöltä
2. Tapaaminen rekrytoivan esihenkilön kanssa
3. Soveltuvuusarvioinnit
4. Viimeiset tapaamiset ja työtarjous

Voisiko tämä olla seuraava askel urallasi? Haethan tehtävään 28.10.2026 mennessä Postin rekrytointijärjestelmän kautta. Aloitamme haastattelut jo hakuvaiheessa ja teemme henkilövalinnan heti sopivan osaajan löytyessä.

Arvostamme työyhteisössä monimuotoisuutta, yhdenvertaisuutta ja mukaan ottamista. Toivomme hakijoita erilaisista taustoista, kuten eri ikäisiä ja eri sukupuolia olevia henkilöitä sekä kieli-, kulttuuri- tai muihin vähemmistöihin kuuluvia henkilöitä.

Toivottavasti kuulemme sinusta pian!

Our common values – reliable, respectful, progressive - guide everything we do. Read more!

title: Director, Corporate Affairs Strategy & Innovation
description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.



Position Summary

The Director, Corporate Affairs Strategy & Innovation will lead the design and rollout of artificial intelligence capabilities across the Corporate Affairs function. Sitting at the intersection of AI and corporate communications, this role will define how the function identifies, builds, and scales AI-powered tools and ways of working — improving speed, quality, and impact across Corporate Affairs. This is a hands-on strategy and delivery role: the successful candidate will combine deep technical fluency in AI with real operating experience in Corporate Affairs and will act as the function's primary advocate for responsible, practical AI adoption.

This role will report to the Senior Director, Strategy & Operations, Corporate Affairs and is based in Princeton, NJ or Madison, NJ.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute the AI strategy for Corporate Affairs, setting a multi-year roadmap that identifies where AI can create the greatest value across communications workflows, content development, issues management, and stakeholder engagement.
  • Define the strategic pillars of the function's AI approach (e.g., content and creative acceleration, insights and monitoring, stakeholder engagement, workflow automation) and set clear goals and success metrics for each.
  • Align the AI strategy with the broader enterprise technology and data strategy, ensuring Corporate Affairs' roadmap complements — rather than duplicates — investments being made elsewhere in the organization.
  • Partner closely with BI&T, enterprise technology, and data teams to evaluate, build, and scale AI-powered solutions tailored to the specific needs of communications professionals, from tool selection and vendor evaluation to pilot design and enterprise rollout.
  • Serve as the function's primary resource and advocate for AI literacy, designing and delivering training programs, practical toolkits, and reference materials that build confidence and capability across teams of varying technical maturity. The ideal candidate will demonstrate superior collaboration skills to ensure all teams touching AI are coordinated and working together seamlessly.
  • Establish governance frameworks and usage guidelines for AI tools within Corporate Affairs, ensuring adoption is consistent with legal, compliance, brand, data privacy, and risk requirements.
  • Identify and prioritize high-impact use cases (e.g., content drafting and localization, media monitoring and analysis, message testing, executive briefing preparation, issues and crisis monitoring) and build the business case for investment.
  • Manage relationships with external AI vendors and technology partners, negotiating scope and ensuring solutions are fit for purpose, secure, and cost-effective.
  • Track and report on adoption, efficiency gains, and ROI from AI initiatives, and use those insights to continuously refine the function's AI strategy and priorities.
  • Monitor the external AI and digital landscape, including emerging tools, platforms, regulation, and industry best practices, and translate relevant developments into recommendations for the function.
  • Champion responsible and ethical AI use, ensuring solutions account for accuracy, bias, transparency, and reputational risk

Qualifications and Experience

  • 15+ years of experience in corporate communications, public affairs, digital strategy, or a related field, with demonstrated exposure to enterprise technology or AI implementation.
  • Deep, hands-on expertise in AI, including familiarity with large language models, generative AI tools, automation platforms, and emerging enterprise AI solutions.
  • Genuine fluency in how Corporate Affairs organizations operate, including the workflows, pressures, approval processes, and reputational sensitivities involved.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex technical AI capabilities into practical, adopted solutions for non-technical audiences.
  • Experience navigating large, matrixed organizations, with a track record of building cross-functional partnerships (particularly with IT, legal, and data/analytics teams).
  • Strong program and change management skills, with experience designing training, governance frameworks, or toolkits for enterprise-wide adoption.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present strategy and technical concepts to senior leaders.
  • Bachelor's degree in communications, business, data/computer science, or a related field; advanced degree a plus

title: Research Assistant
description:
Position Details

  • Part-time or Full-time Position (0.6FTE-1FTE) | Fixed Term until end of June 2027.
  • Higher Education Officer Level 5 | $84,599 - $93,366 p.a.
  • Location: Bedford Park / Kaurna Country
  • View Position Description

About the Role

Join the National Centre for Education and Training on Addiction (NCETA) Research Team and contribute to the impactful research led by the internationally recognised Centre that works as a catalyst for change in the alcohol and other drugs field. Working closely as part of the wider Research Team, the Centre Director and government stakeholders, you will have the opportunity to support a variety of research activities imbedded in diverse projects.


If you enjoy working collaboratively as part of a team on research and project-based tasks, we want to hear from you. Take a closer look at some of the everyday tasks you will have the opportunity to work on below:

  • Assisting in capturing and sharing project outcomes and organisational Key Performance Indicators.
  • Assisting with research ethics applications, grant applications and literature reviews.
  • Maintaining spreadsheets, databases, EndNote libraries and maintaining accurate records of research procedures.
  • Assisting with qualitative and quantitative data management, including data cleaning, coding, analysis, and summaries of findings.

This position makes a significant contribution to the University’s strategic plan to change 10 million lives, Every One Matters, by 2035, through directly contributing to the Strategic Driver of Research that Matters. This enabling role works to support innovative research with a goal of reducing the harms from alcohol and other drugs along the continuum from prevention through to treatment, to improve health outcomes for communities locally and globally.

About You

You are a proactive and detail-oriented research professional with a strong foundation in public health, health science or psychology, coupled with a passion for contributing to meaningful health research. Comfortable working both independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team, you bring excellent organisational skills, research rigour and a collaborative approach to supporting research projects from data collection through to reporting and communications.

To be successful in this position, you will also bring:

  • Completion of degree in relevant area (e.g. psychology, public health or science) or an equivalent combination of experience and/or education and/or training.
  • Demonstrated well-developed writing and communication skills, particularly related to assisting in scientific manuscript preparation, industry reports, grant writing, or research dissemination (e.g. via newsletters, websites, social media).
  • Well-developed qualitative and quantitative research skills.
  • Well-developed computer skills including Microsoft Office products such as Word, Excel, and PowerPoint, statistical software (e.g., SPSS, R) and Endnote.

College of Medicine and Public Health

At the College of Medicine and Public Health, we deliver clinical, population and lab-based research, integrated teaching programs and high-quality clinical services. Our footprint reaches out from our world class teaching hospital at the Flinders Medical Centre in South Australia to multiple rural clinical locations all the way to Darwin in the Northern Territory. Our research and teaching equip the next generation of leaders and innovators with the skill, commitment, and vision to protect vulnerable communities and truly advance health outcomes. It is at the heart of everything we do.

Life at Flinders

They say know your place. We say you've found it right here.

Flinders University was founded on the belief that learning should open minds, celebrate individuality and give people the freedom to pursue their own point of view. That spirit lives on in our community of thinkers, doers and changemakers who challenge convention, and each other, to shape what comes next.

Rising to a challenge is nothing new for Flinders. During our first 60 years, we’ve navigated revolutionary changes in social and cultural norms, and have responded to transformative economic, environmental and technological developments. Through it all, we’ve continued to deliver for our students and community, innovating in learning and research to prepare graduates for the changing world they help create.

Reaching beyond the limits of buildings, borders, and backgrounds, ours is an inclusive culture that believes absolutely in equality and opportunity for all. We don't just accommodate differences; we embrace and celebrate them.

So, why work at Flinders?

  • 17% Superannuation + salary packaging options
  • Flexible working arrangements
  • Awarded the AHEIA Higher Education Award for Workplace Culture Excellence due to our commitment to wellbeing through our Thriving@Flinders staff wellbeing program
  • Wide range of professional development activities and services, including exclusive staff study offers
  • We embrace diversity and promote equity and inclusion for all students and staff, as shown through our three SAGE Cygnet Awards.
  • Vibrant campus life and amenities including on campus health care services, gym and childcare centre (Bedford Park, South Australia).
  • Recognised as a Veteran Employer of Choice

Our Commitment to Reconciliation and Indigenous Employment


Flinders University is proud to be an organisation that is committed to our Reconciliation Action Plan and Indigenous Workforce Strategy. Our vision is to be a preferred employer for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples. We are committed to progressing Indigenous advancement in education, research, employment, and wellbeing, and strongly encourage applications from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples for all Flinders vacancies.

title: Ortopedteknisk Kundmottagare
description:
Life at ForMotion – Feel Good, Grow, Be Inspired


Vill du hjälpa människor till ett rörligare liv? Vi söker en Ortopedteknisk kundmottagare på deltid tidsbegränsad anställning till vår klinik i Uppsala. Kliniken består i dagsläget av cirka 14 medarbetare, och i den integrerade butiken arbetar 3 medarbetare med försäljning av bland annat skor, inlägg och ortoser.


Dina arbetsuppgifter

Som ortopedteknisk kundmottagare kommer din huvudsakliga uppgift vara att ta emot patienter och kunder i butiken. Du kommer att arbeta med försäljning av skor, inlägg, ortoser samt hantera kassan. Du kommer även att beställa, fylla på och packa upp varor till butiken. Kunderna är i olika åldrar och är i behov av olika typer av hjälpmedel, därmed kommer dina arbetsdagar att vara mycket varierande.


Vem vi söker

· Avklarad gymnasial utbildning

· Erfarenhet av butiksarbete

· Du behärskar svenska flytande i tal och skrift

· Grundläggande datorkunskaper

· Det är meriterande ifall du har arbetat med skoförsäljning

Som person ser vi gärna att du är kommunikativ, engagerad och har lätt för att bygga relationer. Du är mån om att hjälpa andra människor, är lösningsorienterad och har en god kreativ förmåga. För att trivas hos oss är det viktigt att du tycker om samarbete, är kundorienterad och gillar att arbeta i en miljö som är i ständig utveckling.


Vi erbjuder

Vi erbjuder generöst friskvårdsbidrag, personalrabatt samt kollektivavtalad tjänstepension. Du kommer att arbeta i en värderingsstyrd verksamhet som kännetecknas av högt engagemang och fokus på att hjälpa människor genom att ge bästa möjliga service. Du kommer dessutom att ha ett omväxlande och meningsfullt arbete - i slutändan hjälper du människor till ett rörligare liv!


Anställningen

Deltid 50%, tidsbegränsad anställning med start enligt överenskommelse fram till och med 2027-12-31. ForMotion har kollektivavtal.


Ansökan

Klicka på ”Ansök” och följ instruktionerna.

title: Project Manager (Northeast Warranty Advisor)
description:
Job Title

Project Manager (Northeast Warranty Advisor)

Job Description Summary

The Project Manager provides project management experience to designated new construction development projects within an assigned geographic area. Monitors and coordinates the execution of the various internal and external processes related to new ground-up construction projects by working closely with the client and their consultant teams. Will work closely and coordinate with one or more Real Estate Managers, Construction Managers, Project Managers, Architects, Civil Engineers, and/or General Contractors. Develop and monitor detailed project schedules to track multiple projects from due diligence to project grand opening, and work closely with internal stakeholders to manage and update internal platforms with accurate dates. Works closely with and provides detailed progress reports to the Account Manager/Director.

Job Description

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead and schedule meetings/calls, prepare agendas, develop and maintain master project schedules as required for each project and project phase to ensure overall project objectives and client needs are met.
  • Participate in client project calls and create detailed note summaries outlining current status of each project and identifying action items for both internal/external stakeholders. Provide appropriate follow-up in between project calls to ensure action is being taken to advance the project forward.
  • Work closely with a variety of both internal and external stakeholders throughout project life cycle such as Real Estate Managers, Project Managers, Construction Managers Architects, Civil Engineers, and/or General Contractors.
  • Maintain detailed project schedules in preferred project management software by working closely with internal/external stakeholders. Provide oversite to the client managed scheduling system to ensure dates are accurately maintained and reflected for reporting purposes.
  • Report to the Account Manager/Director regarding major problems and findings and results achieved along with specific, complete, and comprehensive recommendations.
  • Have the ability to lead and provide oversight to a regional workload of 30-50 new construction projects at any given time.
  • May be required to establish goals and objectives with timetables for the organizational unit and sub-units supervised

KEY COMPETENCIES

MUFG Bank (Europe) N.V. (MBE) is a fully-owned subsidiary of MUFG Bank, headquartered in Amsterdam. With offices throughout Europe, our teams provide clients with comprehensive financing solutions spanning Coverage & Structured Finance, Capital Markets and Transaction Banking, using MUFG’s global reach to provide bespoke solutions.

Please visit our website for more information –


Department overview

The Product Governance Department within MUFG is responsible for overseeing the end-to-end governance framework for products across their lifecycle. The team ensures that products are reviewed in compliance with regulatory requirements, internal policies, and risk management standards. Working closely with Product Management, Compliance, Legal, Risk, Operations, and Business stakeholders, the department drives product approvals, governance processes, target market assessments, product reviews, and regulatory change implementation to ensure fair customer outcomes and effective product oversight.

Function positioning

The Assistant Vice President (AVP) Product Governance supports the MBE Product Governance Framework, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements, internal policies and risk management standards across the product lifecycle. Acting as a key liaison across Front Office, Product Management, Risk, Compliance, Legal, Operations and Finance, the role coordinates product governance processes, committee activities, product approvals, governance reporting, audit and regulatory remediation, and continuous framework enhancement.

As part of the first line of defence, the AVP supports MBE's product governance process ownership, ensuring new products, material changes, conditions/restrictions, lifecycle reviews, product withdrawals, management information, records and escalations are managed through a robust and evidence-based governance framework, while preserving business ownership and independent 2LoD challenge.

The role includes the following / key responsibilities:

Product Governance Framework and Governance Oversight:

  • Support the implementation and continuous enhancement of the Bank's Product Governance Framework.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional SMEs and regional stakeholders to ensure alignment as well as to enhance efficiency in the governance
  • Manage governance documentation, procedures, standards, and operating guidelines.
  • Coordinate and manage the New Product Committee (NPC) meeting requirements.
  • Prepare governance packs, committee materials, meeting agendas, and minutes.
  • Track approval conditions, action items, and post-implementation reviews.
  • Manage the NPA intake pipeline, prioritisation and readiness gate process before submission to NPC.
  • Coordinate SME risk assessments, approvals, no-objections and challenge responses across Risk, Compliance, Legal, Operations, Finance, Financial Crime, Operational Resilience and other relevant stakeholders.
  • Track and evidence NPC decisions, approval conditions, restrictions, residual risk acceptance and escalation points.
  • Support CTC identification, SME assessments and approval tracking where required under the product governance process.
  • Maintain and support the product catalogue / product inventory, including alignment to product taxonomy and lifecycle status.
  • Support periodic and trigger-based product reviews, including PIRs, PAPs, lifecycle assessments and remedial action tracking.
  • Monitor conditions, restrictions and ongoing adherence requirements throughout the product lifecycle.
  • Ensure lifecycle decisions are supported by appropriate evidence, approvals, MI and escalation where required.
  • Manage documentation and record-keeping requirements in accordance with regulatory and internal governance standards.

SharePoint & Documentation Management:

  • Manage and maintain Product Governance SharePoint sites, repositories, workflows, and document libraries.
  • Ensure governance documentation is accurately maintained, version controlled, and readily accessible.
  • Drive improvements in document management, collaboration tools, and reporting capabilities using SharePoint.

In order to be successful in the role, you will need the following:

  • 7+ years' experience within Banking, Financial Services, Product Management, Product Governance, Risk, Compliance, or Operations.
  • Sound understanding of banking products, services and F2B operating model.
  • Experience supporting governance committees and approval processes.
  • Strong understanding of risk management and control frameworks.
  • Ability to produce senior management ready MI, dashboard, audit trails and governance evidence.
  • Experience working with senior stakeholders across multiple functions.
  • Experience coordinating cross-functional SMEs
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.
  • Hybrid working model with a minimum of 3 days in the office.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Advanced knowledge of SharePoint and Microsoft 365 applications.

Preferred:

  • Professional qualifications in Risk Management, Compliance, Product Management, or Banking.

title: Project Restore Program Director
description:
The Program Director provides overarching strategic, operational, fiscal, and administrative leadership for Project Restore. Serving as the primary liaison between KAVI, KCDA, ISLG, CFJ, Inside Circle, and municipal stakeholders, the Program Director ensures absolute fidelity to the Project Restore model. This position oversees the full multidisciplinary team across all grant phases and leads inter-agency governance, contract deliverables, budget management, and citywide network representation.

About Kings Against Violence Initiative (KAVI)

KAVI is a nonprofit 501(c)(3) youth-serving organization with a mission to prevent and eliminate interpersonal violence from the lives of young people through advocacy, peer leadership, community mobilization, and social justice.


KAVI promotes community wellness and healing by operating high-impact youth violence prevention and intervention programs in Brooklyn. Our programs take place in hospital-based, school, and community settings. We are building a team of individuals willing to work hard, be creative, build on opportunities, and think “out of the box.”


About Project Restore

Project Restore is an intensive, restorative community-based intervention initiative designed to support 28–30 young men (ages 15–28) across two cohorts in the Flatbush neighborhood of Brooklyn. Operated by KAVI in close partnership with the Kings County District Attorney’s Office (KCDA), CUNY Institute for State & Local Governance (ISLG), Center for Justice Innovation (CFJ), and Inside Circle, Project Restore delivers a holistic, trauma-informed model that integrates transformative credible mentoring, clinical mental health support, comprehensive case management, paid career-building internships, community activation events, and immersive retreats.


Job Description:

The Program Director provides overarching strategic, operational, fiscal, and administrative leadership for Project Restore. Serving as the primary liaison between KAVI, KCDA, ISLG, CFJ, Inside Circle, and municipal stakeholders, the Program Director ensures absolute fidelity to the Project Restore model. This position oversees the full multidisciplinary team across all grant phases and leads inter-agency governance, contract deliverables, budget management, and citywide network representation.

  • Oversee all aspects of Project Restore implementation, from pre-programming through post-programming/aftercare.
  • Serve as the primary liaison between KAVI, KCDA, ISLG, CFJ, Inside Circle, and other Project Restore partners.
  • Provide strategic program leadership and ensure fidelity to the Project Restore model.
  • Maintain fiscal oversight of the Project Restore budget.
  • Directly supervise the Program Manager and provide overall leadership to the full Project Restore team.
  • Lead recruitment, hiring, and onboarding of program staff during the Pre-Programming phase, in close consultation with KCDA.
  • Participate in regular partnership meetings, community events, and trainings.
  • Represent KAVI in the broader Project Restore network across Brooklyn.
  • Co-supervise the team alongside the Director of Community Restorative Justice Initiatives at KCDA, consistent with the RFP partnership structure.
  • Perform other duties as assigned by the Co-Executive Directors.

Qualifications & Competencies

  • Graduate degree preferred in criminal justice, social work, public administration, youth development, or a related field.
  • Significant experience managing programs in a nonprofit, criminal justice, or youth development setting.
  • Demonstrated experience supervising multidisciplinary teams.
  • Experience managing budgets and fiscal reporting for grant-funded programs.
  • Prior experience collaborating with courts, District Attorney’s offices, or other legal-system partners in New York City is strongly preferred.
  • Strong partnership management and relationship-building skills across government, nonprofit, and community stakeholders.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
  • Deep commitment to restorative and social justice and to serving young men impacted by the justice system.
  • Able to engage and work with individuals and organizations of diverse backgrounds.
  • Strong organizational, time-management, and problem-solving skills.
  • Connections to Central Brooklyn/Flatbush community networks a plus.


Compensation: This position is a range budgeted for an annual salary of $90,000-$100,000. Health Benefits and a 403 (b) are available.

title: 2027 Summer Intern PhD Student - Drug Product Development Analytical Sciences
description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.



Drug Product Development works with colleagues throughout the entire pharmaceutical development process, from discovery to commercial launch and beyond, to develop the formulations and processes that bring drug products from the lab to patients. We are looking for candidates who are proven team players; appreciate the challenge of pursuing unique scientific discovery in an emerging field; and who demonstrate solid operational, interpersonal, project management and collaborative skills. We believe this starts with our summer intern program.

Summer interns will work with mentors for ~10 weeks on a guided research project related to novel analytical methods, separation science, and process analytics (PAT) for drug product development. Depending on experience and interests, projects may include field-flow fractionation (asymmetric flow FFF with MALS, DLS, UV, and RI detection) to characterize nanoparticles, aggregates, polymers, and lipid-based excipients; emerging chromatography (SEC-MALS, 2D-LC, SFC, HILIC, and mixed-mode separations with PDA, CAD, ELSD, and high-resolution MS) to assess purity, related impurities, and degradation; excipient analysis of polymers, surfactants, lipids, and sugars; and in-line and at-line PAT tools and spectroscopy (Raman, NIR, IR) with chemometric models. Interns will develop, troubleshoot, and execute analytical methods, analyze, review, and document data in compliance with company requirements, and collaborate with formulation scientists, analytical chemists, process engineers, and process modelers. The program is organized to ensure that interns gain valuable industry and functional experience, work on challenging assignments, learn about BMS and meet diverse company representatives.

The program will feature:


  • An orientation, including an overview of company structure, products and brands
  • An introduction to the GPS and PD organizations
  • Exposure to senior management and business leaders
  • Hands-on training and working experiences in pharmaceutical manufacturing process areas and testing laboratories
  • Formal presentation at the end of your internship
  • A mentor program
  • Formal review and feedback sessions

Program Dates: Monday June 7, 2027 - Friday, August 13, 2027. Applications are currently being accepted and may be selected on a rolling basis. Those selected will be notified no later than February 2027.

Position is in New Brunswick, NJ.

Requirements:


  • Candidates must be currently enrolled in an accredited university program seeking a PhD degree in Chemistry, Analytical Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Polymer Science, Physical Chemistry, Materials Science, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or a related field, with a focus on separation science, chromatography, or PAT. Candidate must still be enrolled during Summer 2027.
  • Candidates are expected to graduate between Fall 2027 and 2028.
  • Must include GPA on resume for consideration (program requires GPA of 3.0 or greater).
  • All candidates must be authorized to work in the US both at the time of hire and for the duration of their employment. Please note that immigration or visa sponsorship is not available for this position.
  • Must have good oral/written communication skills and interpersonal skills, be able to work in a team environment, and be proficient in data analysis software and tools.
  • Excellent critical thinking skills and the ability to solve problems independently with minimal supervision.
  • Experience in one or more of the following: chromatography (RP-HPLC/UPLC, SEC, FFF, SFC, 2D-LC); detectors such as MALS, CAD, ELSD, or MS; polymer, lipid, or surfactant characterization; or spectroscopy, PAT, and chemometrics.

title: First Surgical Assistant - Cardiothoracic Team
description:
Start the day excited to make a difference…end the day knowing you did. Come join our team.

Job Summary:
The Cardiac Surgical First Assistant functions as the surgical first assistant under the direction and supervision of the surgeon during the intra-operative phase of cardiac surgery.

  • Assists with procedural set up and patient preparedness for specific procedures in positioning, prepping, and draping.

  • Inserts intravascular catheters, chest tubes, intra-aortic balloon pump catheters.

  • Assists with arterial and venous decannulation after termination of circulatory support.
  • Controls bleeding and routinely sutures tissue.
  • Establishes and maintains a safe peri-operative environment. Observes aseptic techniques in preparing for and assisting with procedures.
  • Participates in patient transport and room turnover as indicated by unit activity to facilitate utilization of services in a cost-effective manner.
  • Serves as educator, mentor and resource to patients and colleagues.
  • Performs other duties assigned.

  • Graduate of a Surgical First Assisting program required.

  • Registered and licensed with the Virginia Board of Medicine as a Surgical Assistant required.

  • Certified Surgical First Assistant with the National Board of National Board of Surgical Technology and Surgical Assisting (NBSTSA) or National Commission for the Certification of Surgical Assistants (NCCSA) required.

title: Compliance Advisory Director
description:
Nottingham Trent House (95002), United Kingdom, Nottingham, Nottinghamshire

Compliance Advisory Director

Job Title: Compliance Advisory Director


Location: London or Nottingham


Working Pattern: 3 days in-office (Tuesday-Thursday) and 2 days remote.


Our Mission


We’re on a mission to be a force for good in lending. Throughout our almost 30-year history, we’ve consistently been recognised as a great place to work; in 2026, Capital One was officially ranked 9th in the UK’s Best Workplaces™ list. Hear from our team about what it’s like working at Capital One UK.


About the Role


The Compliance Advisory Director provides senior-level compliance advice and counsel across the UK business, ensuring regulatory obligations are understood, embedded and effectively managed.

The role combines broad UK financial services compliance expertise with privacy experience, acting as a trusted adviser to senior executives and business leaders on complex regulatory, conduct, customer and data-related matters.

The role will help the UK business anticipate regulatory change, manage compliance risk and demonstrate good customer and regulatory outcomes, while providing effective oversight and challenge across the first and second lines of defence.


What you’ll do


  • Provide authoritative, pragmatic compliance advice on complex and emerging regulatory matters, acting as a senior escalation point for significant compliance issues and regulatory risk.
  • Provide effective second-line challenge to business decisions, products, processes and customer propositions.
  • Develop strong relationships with senior stakeholders, balancing commercial objectives with regulatory expectations.
  • Maintain a strong understanding of the UK financial services regulatory framework and anticipate regulatory changes—including emerging technology and AI regulation— translating these into practical business requirements.
  • Identify emerging regulatory risks and translate them into practical business requirements.
  • Provide input into compliance monitoring, assurance and thematic reviews.
  • Act as a senior compliance adviser on data protection matters, working closely with the DPO, Legal, Information Security and business teams.

What we’re looking for


  • Significant senior compliance advisory experience within UK financial services, backed by strong knowledge of the FCA regulatory framework.
  • Extensive hands-on experience with Consumer Duty, conduct risk, and translating complex regulatory requirements into practical business solutions.
  • Deep expertise in UK GDPR and the Data Protection Act 2018, with practical experience conducting or overseeing data protection risk assessments.
  • Proven ability to act as a constructive challenger and trusted adviser to senior stakeholders and executive governance committees.
  • A strategic, data-aware mindset with a strong focus on driving excellent customer outcomes and mitigating operational risks.
  • Ability to distinguish between technical compliance and the regulator’s likely expectations, applying proportionate and risk-based judgement.

Where and how you'll work


This is a permanent position based in either our Nottingham or London office. We embrace a hybrid approach to work.

You'll spend three days a week in the office (Tuesday-Thursday), with Monday and Friday being dedicated work-from-home days.

Our offices are designed to inspire and support you. At our Nottingham head office, you'll find an on-site gym, restaurant and dedicated Learning Loft. Our London office boasts a rooftop running track and coffee bar.


What’s in it for you


We invest in the growth of our people alongside our business. You will have extensive opportunities to learn and develop your career, including access to up to £5,000 in funding for external qualifications. In addition to career development, our comprehensive benefits package is designed to grow with you, ensuring your wellbeing is prioritised at every stage of your career:

  • Wealth & Future: Competitive pension and performance-based bonus schemes
  • Holidays: Start with 25 days of annual leave, increasing with tenure. Need more? You have the option to buy 5 additional days.
  • Health: Access premium care through our private medical insurance.
  • Family Support: We champion your milestones with enhanced parental leave.

A full list of our benefits is available here.


What you should know about how we recruit


We pride ourselves on hiring the best people, not the same people. Building diverse and inclusive teams is the right thing to do and the smart thing to do. We want to work with top talent: whoever you are, whatever you look like, wherever you come from. We know it’s about what you do, not just what you say. Stationary Engineer Apprentice


What this job involves: You'll be responsible for supporting the tasks of operating, maintaining, and monitoring building mechanical systems including boilers, chillers, HVAC equipment, electrical systems, and building automation systems. This role requires ensuring optimal performance of all mechanical equipment while maintaining safe, comfortable, and energy-efficient building operations for tenants and occupants.


What your day-to-day will look like:

  • The Apprentice Engineer shall assist the Stationary Engineer, the Assistant Chief Engineer and the Chief Engineer in the performance of his duties.
  • Attend all classes/training from International Union of Operating Engineers, Stationary Engineers, Local No. 39 to obtain certification.
  • Assist with operation, maintenance and repair of all boilers, heaters pumps, valves, appurtenances and lines used in the distribution of steam and heated or processed water.
  • Assist with operation, maintenance and repair of refrigerant compressors, condensers, evaporators, traps, transfer pumps, expansion valves, stop valves and float valves, together with all refrigerant lines and devices used to control temperature, and air conditioning systems in their entirety, including the use of approved recovery equipment and processes to comply with the law.
  • Assist with operation, maintenance and repair of pumps handling brines or other secondary refrigerating liquids, including water, together with all valves, appurtenances and lines used in the system.
  • Assist with operation, maintenance and repair of air compressors, together with distribution lines and all valves and devices for air control, including air dryer and filtering and separating systems.
  • Assist with operation, maintenance and repair of all natural and manufactured gas distribution lines, including all valves and devices for their distribution, regulation and control.
  • Assist with operation, maintenance and repair of water filters, softeners, piping, expansion tanks, and pumps used in conjunction with water distribution, including all sinks and toilet bowls, including all supply lines, drains, water lines, control devices and sprinkler systems.
  • Assist with operation, maintenance and repair of all types of electrical motors and engines used to power pumps, compressors, generators and fans.
  • Assist with maintenance of elevators, man lifts, escalators and hoist ways except where this type of equipment is serviced and maintained by specialized contractors, and only where the Engineer is properly licensed to do so.
  • Assist with all electrical/control systems work and repair including circuit diagnostics, tracing and troubleshooting, operating, maintaining, and repairing all motor controls and related equipment drivers such as variable frequency drive (VFD's).
  • Tools considered as necessary to the fulfillment of the duties of the engineer shall include all those which may be required in the performance of his duties, including such types of special equipment necessary to operate, maintain and repair the equipment listed.
  • Assist with operation, maintenance and repair of all fuel oil systems including piping, pumps, valves, strainers, filters, floats, separators, lines and controls.
  • Assist with operation, maintenance and repair of building automation systems for HVAC, lighting and other controlled mediums, including consoles, data gathering panels, remote sensors and indicating devices.
  • Assist with operation, maintenance and repair of sanitary sewer systems, sump pumps including basins and sumps, grease traps, water closets, urinals, flush valves, angle stops and piping. This includes clearing blockages in fixtures and lines as needed and on a preventative basis as well.
  • Assist with maintenance and repair of trash/recycling/composting/baling compactors, including electrical and hydraulic systems.
  • Assist with maintenance and repair of all kitchen equipment excluding tenant owned equipment.
  • Assist with operation, maintenance and repair of all life Safety related equipment, including support of testing for life safety related equipment.
  • Assist with inventory control for parts and materials required to perform such maintenance and repairs to the building systems.
  • Assist with equipment room maintenance and repairs to maintain the physical condition and appearance of these rooms and equipment located within them.

Required Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent
  • Candidates must register online, complete in-person verification, and pass an aptitude exam (requiring a minimum 72% score) with International Union of Operating Engineers, Stationary Engineers, Local No. 39
  • Knowledge of boilers, chillers, HVAC systems, electrical systems, and building automation
  • Ability to read and interpret blueprints, schematics, and technical manuals
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills
  • Physical ability to work in mechanical rooms, climb ladders, and lift up to 50 pounds
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Understanding of OSHA safety regulations and environmental compliance

Preferred Qualifications

  • Universal EPA certification for refrigerant handling
  • Obtain stationary Engineer License (Class 1, 2, or 3 depending on facility requirements) within 4 years
  • Experience operating and maintaining commercial building mechanical systems
  • Additional trade certifications (electrical, HVAC, plumbing)
  • Experience with computerized maintenance management systems (CMMS)
  • Knowledge of energy management and building optimization
  • Previous experience in critical facilities (hospitals, data centers, laboratories)

title: #EG Fullstack Developer – AI Applications
description:
Company Description

NCS is a leading AI Tech Services company. With a 15,000-strong team across the Asia Pacific, NCS scales its platforms and capabilities to provide clients with greater agility and AI expertise across a range of Industries. Embracing a strong ecosystem of global partners, NCS transforms technology services delivery combining AI with digital resilience to drive real business impact. NCS is a subsidiary of the Singtel Group.

Job Description

This role sits within NCS AI Central's (AIC) Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) model — the combined capability that takes AI solutions from proof-of-concept through to hardened production systems. As Fullstack Developer, you build both the frontend and backend of Gen AI applications — from UI through API and cloud deployment — operating across both fast-moving FDE engagements (POC/POV, pilot deployments) and steady-state system development and maintenance work.

What will you do:

1. Frontend Development

  • Build a simple, clean UI to support key POC and application workflows (upload, query, view results), using ReactJS.
  • Implement screens with usable UX, optimised for performance and cross-device compatibility.
  • Integrate with backend APIs for model inference, RAG results, and agentic workflow status and outputs.
  • Handle user inputs, file uploads, and display model/agent outputs responsively — accounting for the multi-step, non-deterministic nature of agentic workflows.
  • Add lightweight feedback/error handling for API failures or delayed responses; implement basic authentication or access control where required.

2. Backend Development

  • Design and develop backend services and APIs using Python (FastAPI/Flask) to support Gen AI functionality.
  • Implement endpoints for model inference requests, RAG workflows, agentic workflow orchestration (e.g. using frameworks such as AWS Strands or LangGraph), and document upload/processing/storage.
  • Integrate with cloud AI services for inference and model orchestration — AWS Bedrock, Azure AI Foundry, or Google Vertex AI depending on the engagement — including China-origin models (DeepSeek, Qwen, GLM) where self-hosted or exposed via compatible endpoints. Build lightweight pipelines for RAG (chunking, embeddings, retrieval).
  • Apply LLMOps practices to support model monitoring and versioning as applications mature toward production.
  • Manage data storage using Postgres (RDS or equivalent) and/or vector search services (OpenSearch, FAISS, or cloud-native equivalents).

3. Deployment & Quality

  • Containerise applications using Docker and deploy to AWS ECS Fargate/Lambda, Azure Container Apps/Functions, GCP Cloud Run, or equivalent Kubernetes-based services (EKS/AKS/GKE) where required.
  • Implement CI/CD pipelines for rapid iteration, using infrastructure-as-code (Terraform or CDK) where practical.
  • Perform code scans and reviews to identify security issues early (e.g. SonarQube, Fortify).

4. FDE & Development/Maintenance Coverage

  • During FDE engagements: prioritise speed, clarity, and flexibility over perfect design, iterating quickly based on user feedback and validation sessions.
  • During system development & maintenance engagements: harden the same application into production-grade code, with full CI/CD, monitoring, and security scanning in place.

5. Collaboration

  • Work closely with the Application Architect and Cloud Engineer/Architect to align API contracts and architecture.
  • Document API contracts, workflows, and deployment/UI steps for the team.

Role Levels We Are Hiring For

We are hiring at two levels for this role. All responsibilities above apply to both; the distinction is in scope of ownership, years of experience, and seniority of judgement expected.

Fullstack Developer – AI Applications

  • 2–4 years of relevant experience. Builds frontend and backend features for one engagement at a time, under guidance from a Senior Fullstack Developer or Application Architect.
  • Executes defined API/UI work; escalates architecture-level design decisions to the Application Architect.

Senior Fullstack Developer – AI Applications

  • 5+ years of relevant experience, including at least 2 years hands‑on in AI/Gen AI application development. Owns fullstack delivery across more complex engagements and works more independently with the Application Architect on design decisions.
