title: Scrum Master / Enterprise Agile Coach – SAFe, LeSS & Agile Transformation
description:
Job Summary

Synechron is seeking a Scrum Master / Enterprise Agile Coach to lead enterprise-wide Agile transformations, mentor multiple Scrum teams and Agile practitioners, and support a high-performance, self-organizing culture.

The role is responsible for driving organizational agility, scaling Agile practices across cross-functional organizations, removing systemic blockers, and aligning software delivery with strategic business value. The successful candidate will guide executive leadership, middle management, delivery teams, Product Owners, Scrum Masters, and Agile practitioners through cultural and delivery improvements.

This role contributes to business objectives by improving delivery transparency, flow efficiency, team effectiveness, collaboration, continuous improvement, and the alignment between software delivery outcomes and business priorities.



Software Requirements


Required Software Skills


  • Experience using enterprise Agile tooling, including Jira or comparable platforms, to manage backlogs, sprint information, program-level progress, dependencies, risks, and delivery metrics.
  • Ability to use Agile tools to support transparency, reporting, workflow visualization, planning, and progress tracking.
  • Working knowledge of tools and practices that support Agile metrics, including velocity, flow efficiency, cycle time, throughput, work-in-progress, predictability, and delivery outcomes.
  • Familiarity with tools and workflows supporting CI/CD, automated testing, DevOps collaboration, and software delivery visibility.
  • Experience working with software development lifecycle tools and platforms across multiple teams or delivery units.
  • Ability to work with the versions and configurations of Agile, collaboration, reporting, DevOps, and delivery tools used by the assigned Synechron environment.

Preferred Software Skills


  • Experience with enterprise Agile planning, portfolio management, dependency management, and roadmap tools.
  • Familiarity with dashboards and reporting tools used to communicate enterprise-level delivery progress and Agile maturity.
  • Experience with collaboration, documentation, knowledge-management, and community-of-practice tools.
  • Exposure to tools supporting value-stream mapping, outcome tracking, team health assessments, and continuous improvement.
  • Familiarity with automated metrics collection and delivery-performance reporting.

Equivalent tools and platforms may be considered where they provide comparable capabilities.



Overall Responsibilities


  • Guide executive leadership, middle management, delivery teams, and Agile practitioners on Agile mindset, values, principles, and cultural evolution.
  • Drive multi-team and cross-department scaling using frameworks such as SAFe and Scrum-at-Scale.
  • Support the application of LeSS and other appropriate scaling practices where relevant to organizational needs.
  • Conduct Agile maturity assessments to identify capability gaps, delivery constraints, organizational impediments, and improvement opportunities.
  • Define and monitor meaningful Agile metrics, including velocity, flow efficiency, predictability, cycle time, throughput, and outcome-based measures.
  • Develop and implement continuous improvement roadmaps based on assessment findings, delivery data, stakeholder feedback, and business priorities.
  • Build and lead an active community of practice for Scrum Masters, Agile Coaches, Product Owners, delivery leaders, and other Agile practitioners.
  • Mentor multiple Scrum teams and fellow coaches to improve facilitation, servant leadership, team self-management, and delivery effectiveness.
  • Facilitate complex Agile ceremonies, including Sprint Planning, Daily Standups, Reviews, Retrospectives, release planning, cross-team planning, and other high-impact sessions when required.
  • Coach teams toward complete self-management, effective decision-making, clear accountability, healthy collaboration, and sustainable delivery practices.
  • Act as a buffer against external distractions while helping teams maintain focus, flow, quality, and a sustainable pace.
  • Resolve high-stakes cross-team conflicts and build consensus without relying on direct authority.
  • Partner with Product Owners to optimize backlog refinement, release planning, prioritization, product goals, and outcome-focused delivery.
  • Champion modern engineering and DevOps practices, including CI/CD, automated testing, continuous integration, continuous delivery, and incremental value delivery.
  • Use Jira or comparable enterprise tooling to improve transparency and track team, program, and enterprise-level progress.
  • Identify systemic blockers and coordinate their resolution across organizational, process, technology, dependency, and governance boundaries.
  • Align Agile delivery practices with strategic business value, customer outcomes, quality expectations, and organizational goals.
  • Promote sustainable delivery by supporting manageable workloads, efficient collaboration, reduced rework, continuous learning, and responsible use of delivery resources.
  • Evaluate performance through measurable outcomes such as improved flow, reduced impediments, increased delivery predictability, stronger team ownership, improved collaboration, and progress against transformation objectives.


Technical Skills (By Category)


Programming Languages


Essential


  • Ability to understand software development discussions, technical dependencies, delivery risks, engineering practices, and SDLC activities.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with development, testing, architecture, DevOps, infrastructure, and product teams.

Preferred


  • Familiarity with one or more programming languages used by software delivery teams.
  • Practical understanding of how code development, testing, integration, deployment, and release activities affect Agile planning and delivery.
  • Exposure to technical practices that support automated testing, CI/CD, and engineering quality.

Databases/Data Management


Essential


  • Ability to interpret Agile delivery data, team metrics, program information, dependencies, risks, impediments, and outcome measures.
  • Understanding of data quality, consistency, transparency, and appropriate use of metrics in delivery decisions.
  • Ability to distinguish between activity metrics and outcome-based measures.

Preferred


  • Experience analyzing delivery data from Agile tools, dashboards, reporting systems, or enterprise planning platforms.
  • Familiarity with data-driven Agile maturity assessments and trend analysis.
  • Experience using metrics to identify bottlenecks, workflow constraints, delivery risks, and improvement opportunities.

Cloud Technologies


Essential


  • Understanding of how cloud-based applications, distributed teams, platform dependencies, environments, and deployment models affect software delivery.
  • Ability to facilitate collaboration between Agile teams and cloud, infrastructure, security, and operations teams.

Preferred


  • Experience supporting Agile delivery for cloud-native, distributed, or platform-based products.
  • Familiarity with cloud delivery practices, release coordination, DevOps, automation, and operational readiness.
  • Understanding of how cloud scalability, reliability, security, and cost considerations may influence product and delivery planning.

Frameworks and Libraries


Essential


  • Strong practical knowledge of Scrum and Agile principles.
  • Experience applying scaling frameworks such as SAFe, LeSS, or Scrum-at-Scale.
  • Ability to select and adapt Agile practices based on team structure, product complexity, organizational maturity, and business outcomes.
  • Understanding of servant leadership, team coaching, facilitation, backlog flow, product goals, release planning, and continuous improvement.

Preferred


  • Experience applying Kanban, Lean, flow-based delivery, value-stream mapping, or systems-thinking practices.
  • Familiarity with organizational change, team topology, product operating models, or enterprise transformation approaches.
  • Experience tailoring Agile frameworks to complex, multi-team, multi-geography environments.

Development Tools and Methodologies


Essential


  • Experience with Jira or comparable enterprise Agile tooling.
  • Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle.
  • Experience facilitating Sprint Planning, Daily Standups, Reviews, Retrospectives, backlog refinement, release planning, and cross-team planning.
  • Experience using Agile metrics such as velocity, flow efficiency, cycle time, throughput, predictability, and work-in-progress.
  • Understanding of CI/CD, automated testing, DevOps collaboration, incremental delivery, and modern engineering practices.
  • Experience conducting Agile maturity assessments and implementing continuous improvement roadmaps.
  • Experience coaching teams, Product Owners, Scrum Masters, delivery leaders, and organizational stakeholders.

Preferred


  • Experience with enterprise portfolio planning, program increment planning, dependency management, value-stream management, or transformation governance.
  • Familiarity with delivery dashboards, outcome tracking, team health assessments, and organizational change tools.
  • Experience building communities of practice and mentoring Agile Coaches or Scrum Masters.
  • Exposure to Lean, Kanban, DevOps transformation, product management, and outcome-based planning.

Security Protocols


Essential


  • Awareness of security, privacy, compliance, and risk considerations within software delivery and Agile planning.
  • Ability to ensure security, quality, compliance, and operational requirements are considered during backlog refinement, planning, delivery, and release activities.
  • Understanding of the need to protect delivery data, stakeholder information, access permissions, and enterprise reporting.

Preferred


  • Experience integrating security practices into Agile and DevOps workflows.
  • Familiarity with secure development, automated security testing, risk-based prioritization, audit readiness, and compliance controls.
  • Experience coaching teams to include security, privacy, resilience, and operational requirements in delivery planning.


Experience Requirements


  • 10+ years of total professional experience in software development, project management, technical delivery, SDLC, Agile delivery, or related areas.
  • 5+ years of specialized experience as an Agile Coach, Senior Scrum Master, or equivalent role in complex, cross-functional, multi-team, or multi-geography environments.
  • Proven experience leading enterprise Agile transformations and supporting cultural shifts.
  • Experience mentoring multiple Scrum teams and fellow Scrum Masters or Agile Coaches.
  • Experience driving organizational agility, scaling Agile practices, removing systemic blockers, and aligning delivery with strategic business value.
  • Experience with SAFe, LeSS, Scrum-at-Scale, or comparable scaling frameworks.
  • Experience conducting Agile maturity assessments, defining delivery metrics, and implementing continuous improvement roadmaps.
  • Experience partnering with Product Owners to improve backlog refinement, release planning, product goals, prioritization, and outcome-focused delivery.
  • Experience supporting modern engineering and DevOps practices, including CI/CD and automated testing.
  • Industry experience in technology, software development, enterprise delivery, financial services, or other complex delivery environments is preferred.
  • Candidates may also qualify through equivalent combinations of Scrum Mastery, Agile coaching, program delivery, transformation leadership, product delivery, technical project management, or organizational change experience that demonstrate the required capabilities and outcomes.


Day-to-Day Activities


  • Facilitate Agile ceremonies, transformation discussions, maturity assessments, coaching sessions, planning events, retrospectives, and cross-team alignment activities.
  • Collaborate with executive leaders, middle management, Product Owners, Scrum Masters, Agile Coaches, developers, and delivery teams to address priorities, dependencies, impediments, and improvement opportunities.
  • Review Agile metrics, maintain transformation roadmaps, support community-of-practice activities, mentor practitioners, and track progress using Jira or comparable enterprise tools.
  • Make facilitation and coaching decisions within the agreed transformation scope, resolve conflicts without direct authority, protect team focus, and escalate systemic risks requiring organizational action.


Qualifications


  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business, Engineering, Project Management, or a related field; equivalent relevant professional experience may be considered.
  • At least 10 years of total professional experience, including 5 or more years in advanced Agile coaching, Scrum Mastery, or scaling Agile frameworks across complex organizations.
  • Advanced Scrum or Agile certification is preferred, such as Certified Scrum Professional–ScrumMaster, SAFe Practice Consultant, or ICAgile Certified Professional–Agile Coaching.
  • Relevant training in Agile coaching, Scrum, SAFe, LeSS, Scrum-at-Scale, facilitation, conflict resolution, organizational change, metrics, DevOps, or product delivery is preferred.
  • Commitment to continuous professional development through Agile communities of practice, coaching education, knowledge sharing, certification maintenance, and awareness of evolving delivery practices.


Professional Competencies


  • Apply critical thinking, systems thinking, root-cause analysis, and evidence-based reasoning to identify systemic blockers and improve organizational delivery outcomes.
  • Lead through influence rather than formal authority, mentor Scrum Masters and Agile practitioners, and support teams in developing self-management and shared accountability.
  • Communicate clearly with executives, managers, Product Owners, delivery teams, technical specialists, and other stakeholders while facilitating alignment and constructive conflict resolution.
  • Adapt coaching approaches, Agile practices, scaling methods, and improvement plans to different team structures, organizational contexts, cultures, delivery needs, and levels of maturity.
  • Promote innovation through experimentation, modern engineering practices, outcome-focused planning, continuous improvement, and evidence-based Agile adoption.
  • Manage competing transformation priorities, coaching commitments, team needs, stakeholder expectations, metrics, dependencies, and delivery timelines with appropriate organization and focus.

title: Senior Data and Security Engineer
description:
Made Tech is seeking a Senior Security and Data Engineer to join our Cyber Practice. This is a technical delivery position, designed for an individual who excels at the intersection of security engineering, data management, and operational compliance. You will play a vital role in ensuring that the services millions of people rely on are secure, resilient, and built to rigorous standards. The core mission of this role is to bridge technical execution with operational compliance while working effectively alongside UK Government Civil Servants. You will be responsible for delivering security engineering within a Security Operations Centre (SOC) environment, translating complex technical requirements into actionable data flows to support detections and alerts. The position maintains a dual focus: hands-on security engineering, including SIEM and detection logic development, and streaming data engineering; specifically, the optimisation and manipulation of high-volume streaming data pipelines. You will support outcomes so that high-quality security engineering is an enabler of delivery rather than a bureaucratic hurdle.
Data Engineering & Ingestion
  • Pipeline Optimisation & Enrichment: Manage log ingestion pipelines on a Cribl cloud platform. You will intelligently help route, collate, filter, and normalise logs, ensuring data is tagged as soon as possible and enriched at the edge.

  • AWS Cloud Telemetry Integrity: Support the end-to-end flow of AWS security telemetry (CloudTrail management and data events, VPC Flow Logs, GuardDuty findings, EKS/container audit logs, and IAM activity) into the centralised log architecture.

  • Stream Processing & Pipeline Optimisation (Cribl Stream): Leverage stream processing (ideally Cribl) to parse, route, mask sensitive fields, and filter out high-volume, low-value debug noise before indexing into Splunk to maximise detection visibility.

  • Data Normalisation: Build and maintain efficient Splunk data models, accelerated searches, and field extractions mapped to OCSF, ensuring fast query performance and portable detection logic.

  • Troubleshooting Pipeline Bottlenecks: Diagnose and resolve systemic transport failure modes: SQS/S3 ingestion lag, universal forwarder dropouts, unparsed JSON structures, Cribl pipeline backpressure, and source type schema mismatches.

  • Advanced Log Management: Optimise log sources by summarising NetFlow data, trimming bulk data to remove unnecessary payloads, deduplicating identical logs, and pre-parsing complex regex strings.

  • Storage Architecture: Manage real-time streaming technologies (e.g., Kinesis) and security data storage solutions including S3 buckets and Amazon Security Lake.

  • Data Tiering: Support the classification of data into appropriate storage tiers—Hot (security events), Warm (application and performance), and Cold (compliance)—to reduce volume overhead and optimise costs.

  • Secure Ingestion: Verify that all data in transit and at rest is fully encrypted (KMS & TLS). Ensure all fields are normalised into standard schemas (OCSF) while enforcing least-privilege access controls.

Security Engineering & Detection

  • SIEM & EDR Logic Development: Support analysts in the creation and tuning of detection rules across platforms.

  • Detection Quality Assurance: Act as an enabler to establish and maintain regular monitoring cycles for detection rules, helping calculate Signal-to-Noise Ratios and rule trust scores to ensure high-fidelity alerting.
Required Technical Skills & Experience
Technical Core
  • Cloud Platforms: Proven hands-on experience designing and securing cloud infrastructures within AWS, and ideally with Azure and Google Cloud Platform.

  • SIEM & Detection: Experience in supporting analysts in the creation of Splunk (SPL) detection rules.

  • Data Tools & Protocols: Hands-on experience with Cribl, Kinesis, S3 buckets, and SQS Queues. Understanding of OCSF schemas and data normalisation.

  • Security Controls: Deep understanding of Zero Trust, identity-first security, secrets management (KMS), and network segmentation.
Government Context
  • Public Sector Experience: Prior experience working with or alongside UK Government Civil Servants.

  • Assurance Requirements: A good understanding of public sector security assurance requirements and the ability to operate within these regulatory environments.
  • Excellent Communication Skills: You will have excellent verbal and written skills, and you will appreciate the need for good engineering discipline.

  • Proportionate Judgement: You approach every engagement on its own terms, selecting and adapting frameworks and methodologies to fit the actual risk and context. You avoid "one-size-fits-all" approaches in favour of what is appropriate for the scale and complexity of the project.

  • Credibility with Clients: You build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders by engaging directly with their concerns.

  • Delivery Focus: You maintain momentum by taking ownership of outcomes. You view security engineering as a critical component that enables good delivery rather than a process that slows it down.

What We Offer
Working at Made Tech means doing work that matters. Our public sector clients are building and running services that millions of people rely on, and the security engineering work you do directly impacts whether those services can be trusted. You'll work in multidisciplinary teams alongside delivery managers, analysts and architects, with the ability to shape how security gets done. We invest in our people through structured development, an active internal community of practice, and support to engage externally. Whether that's contributing to cross-government security forums, speaking at events, or developing expertise in emerging areas of the UK government security landscape.

  • Impactful Work: The opportunity to work on high-impact public sector services that millions of people rely on daily.

  • Multidisciplinary Environment: Work within diverse teams alongside delivery managers, engineers, and architects.

  • Structured Development: Investment in your growth through internal communities of practice and structured career development.

  • External Engagement: Support for thought leadership, including contributing to cross-government security forums, speaking at events, and developing expertise in the emerging UK government security landscape.
Life at Made Tech
We’re committed to building a happy, inclusive and diverse workforce. You can get a sense of what it’s like working here from our blog, where we talk about mental health, communities of practice and neurodiversity (as well as our client work and best practice).

Like many organisations, we use Slack to foster a sense of community and connection. As well as special interest groups such as music, food and pets, we also have 10+ Slack channels dedicated to specific communities, allies, and identities as well as dedicated learning spaces called communities of practice (COPs). If you’d like to speak to someone from one of these groups about their experience as an employee, please do let a member of the Made Tech talent team know.

Benefits
We are always listening to our growing teams and evolving the benefits available to our people. As we scale, as do our benefits and we are scaling quickly. We've recently introduced a flexible benefit platform which includes a Smart Tech scheme, Cycle to work scheme, and an individual benefits allowance which you can invest in a Health care cash plan or Pension plan. We’re also big on connection and have an optional social and wellbeing calendar of events for all employees to join should they choose to.

Here are some of our most popular benefits listed below:

✈️ 30 days Holiday - we offer 30 days of paid annual leave
👶 Flexible Parental Leave - we offer flexible parental leave options
👩‍💻 Remote Working - we offer part time remote working for all our staff
🤗 Paid counselling - we offer paid counselling as well as financial and legal advice.
📈 Pension - 7% employer matched

An increasing number of our customers are specifying a minimum of SC (security check) clearance in order to work on their projects. As a result, we're looking for all successful candidates for this role to have eligibility.Eligibility for SC requires 5 years' UK residency and 5 year' employment history (or back to full-time education). Ideally, no more than 30 consecutive days spent outside the UK within the last five years. Please note that if at any point during the interview process it is apparent that you may not be eligible for SC, we won't be able to progress your application and we will contact you to let you know why.


Working hours: Our standard hours are Monday to Friday, but the nature of this role means some work outside normal hours may be required, for example during release and change windows, planned maintenance, or to align with client operating hours. This is occasional rather than routine, and we'll always give as much notice as we can and agree it with you in advance wherever possible.

title: MS SQL Database Developer – T-SQL, Query Optimization, Backup/Recovery & Data Security
description:
Job Summary

Synechron is seeking an MS SQL Developer to design, implement, maintain, and optimize database solutions that support business applications and technology initiatives. The role focuses on SQL Server database development, performance optimization, data integrity, security, troubleshooting, and backup management.

The MS SQL Developer will collaborate with application, engineering, infrastructure, security, and business teams to deliver reliable and maintainable database solutions. The role contributes to business objectives by improving database performance, availability, data quality, security, and operational continuity.



Software Requirements


Required Software Skills


  • Microsoft SQL Server: Practical experience with database development, administration support, query optimization, troubleshooting, backup, recovery, and performance monitoring.
  • SQL/T-SQL: Strong experience writing, reviewing, optimizing, and troubleshooting SQL queries, stored procedures, views, functions, and related database objects.
  • Database management systems: Strong knowledge of database concepts and experience with SQL Server or comparable platforms.
  • Database design: Experience designing tables, relationships, indexes, constraints, schemas, and data access structures.
  • Performance optimization: Experience analyzing execution plans, identifying bottlenecks, optimizing queries, and improving database performance.
  • Database security: Knowledge of access controls, authentication, authorization, permissions, encryption, auditing, and secure data-handling practices.
  • Backup and recovery: Experience implementing, monitoring, testing, or supporting database backup and recovery processes.
  • Programming languages: Familiarity with SQL and at least one additional language such as Python or Java.
  • Tool versions: Experience working with the Microsoft SQL Server versions, database tools, operating systems, monitoring tools, and development environments used by the assigned Synechron project.

Preferred Software Skills


  • Experience with Oracle or MySQL database platforms.
  • Familiarity with database monitoring, performance-management, reporting, and alerting tools.
  • Experience with source control, deployment automation, database migration, and release-management tools.
  • Exposure to cloud database platforms and managed database services.
  • Familiarity with high availability, disaster recovery, replication, clustering, or database scaling technologies.
  • Experience with data integration, ETL, reporting, or business intelligence tools.

Equivalent database platforms and tools may be considered where they provide comparable capabilities.



Overall Responsibilities


  • Design, implement, maintain, and enhance Microsoft SQL Server databases and related database objects.
  • Develop and optimize SQL queries, stored procedures, views, functions, indexes, and data-access solutions.
  • Monitor database performance, identify bottlenecks, analyze execution plans, and implement query and database optimizations.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support database-related initiatives, application enhancements, migrations, integrations, and releases.
  • Ensure data integrity, consistency, availability, confidentiality, and appropriate access controls.
  • Troubleshoot database issues involving performance, connectivity, data quality, capacity, configuration, and application integration.
  • Implement, monitor, document, and test database backup and recovery processes.
  • Participate in database design and implementation projects, including schema design, data modelling, migration, and deployment activities.
  • Support database changes through appropriate development, testing, approval, release, and rollback processes.
  • Document database structures, dependencies, operational procedures, performance findings, backup processes, and technical decisions.
  • Collaborate with application developers, infrastructure teams, security teams, testing teams, and business stakeholders to understand and deliver data requirements.
  • Identify opportunities to improve database reliability, maintainability, scalability, security, automation, and operational efficiency.
  • Support sustainable technology practices by optimizing storage, reducing unnecessary processing, improving resource utilization, and maintaining efficient database solutions.
  • Deliver database solutions that meet agreed requirements for performance, availability, security, data quality, and supportability.


Technical Skills (By Category)


Programming Languages


Essential


  • Strong proficiency in SQL and T-SQL for Microsoft SQL Server development and database management.
  • Ability to write maintainable and optimized queries, stored procedures, functions, and database scripts.
  • Familiarity with programming concepts relevant to database integration and application support.
  • Ability to analyze application-to-database interactions and troubleshoot data-related issues.

Preferred


  • Familiarity with Python or Java for automation, database integration, testing, or support activities.
  • Experience developing scripts for database monitoring, validation, deployment, backup verification, or routine administration.
  • Knowledge of additional scripting or programming languages used in the assigned technology environment.

Databases/Data Management


Essential


  • Strong knowledge of Microsoft SQL Server and relational database concepts.
  • Experience with database design, normalization, data modelling, schemas, tables, relationships, constraints, indexes, and transactions.
  • Experience with query optimization, execution plans, indexing strategies, performance monitoring, and database troubleshooting.
  • Experience ensuring data integrity, consistency, availability, and accuracy.
  • Experience implementing or supporting database backup, recovery, and restoration processes.
  • Understanding of database capacity, storage, availability, and operational support requirements.

Preferred


  • Experience with Oracle or MySQL.
  • Familiarity with replication, clustering, partitioning, high availability, disaster recovery, or database scaling.
  • Experience with ETL, data migration, data integration, reporting, or data-quality processes.
  • Exposure to relational and non-relational database technologies.

Cloud Technologies


Essential


  • Ability to understand how deployment environments, infrastructure, availability, security, monitoring, and resource capacity affect database operations.
  • Ability to collaborate with infrastructure and cloud teams on database implementation and support activities.

Preferred


  • Experience supporting Microsoft SQL Server databases in cloud or hybrid environments.
  • Familiarity with managed database services, cloud storage, cloud monitoring, backup, recovery, and access management.
  • Awareness of cloud resource optimization, storage efficiency, and sustainable database operations.

Frameworks and Libraries


Essential


  • Experience working with SQL Server database tools, database drivers, stored procedures, functions, and application integration components.
  • Ability to evaluate database dependencies, interfaces, schema changes, and compatibility considerations.
  • Understanding of database connectivity and integration with software applications.

Preferred


  • Familiarity with database migration, deployment, testing, monitoring, or automation frameworks.
  • Experience with data-access libraries, ORM tools, ETL frameworks, or reporting components.
  • Exposure to reusable database-development standards and configuration-driven deployment practices.

Development Tools and Methodologies


Essential


  • Experience with database design, development, implementation, optimization, troubleshooting, and maintenance.
  • Ability to follow software development lifecycle, change-control, release, testing, and documentation practices.
  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams on database-related initiatives.
  • Ability to support incident investigation, root-cause analysis, defect resolution, and operational improvements.
  • Experience documenting database structures, technical procedures, changes, issues, and recovery processes.

Preferred


  • Familiarity with source control and database version-management practices.
  • Experience with database deployment automation, schema migration, continuous integration, or continuous delivery.
  • Exposure to Agile development practices and iterative delivery.
  • Familiarity with database monitoring, alerting, logging, and performance-reporting tools.

Security Protocols


Essential


  • Knowledge of database security best practices.
  • Understanding of authentication, authorization, role-based access, permissions, least-privilege access, and secure data handling.
  • Awareness of encryption, auditing, credential management, sensitive-data protection, and access reviews.
  • Ability to identify and address database security risks in collaboration with security and infrastructure teams.

Preferred


  • Experience implementing encryption, data masking, auditing, secrets management, certificate management, or privileged access controls.
  • Familiarity with security testing, vulnerability remediation, compliance controls, and audit requirements.
  • Experience supporting databases containing sensitive, regulated, or business-critical information.


Experience Requirements


  • 3+ years of experience in database development, database administration, SQL development, or a related field.
  • Experience designing, implementing, maintaining, and optimizing relational databases.
  • Practical experience with Microsoft SQL Server and T-SQL.
  • Experience developing and optimizing queries, stored procedures, indexes, views, functions, and database objects.
  • Experience troubleshooting database performance, connectivity, data integrity, configuration, and application-integration issues.
  • Experience implementing or supporting database backups, recovery procedures, and operational maintenance.
  • Experience collaborating with application, infrastructure, security, testing, business, and technology teams.
  • Experience with Oracle or MySQL is preferred.
  • Industry experience in technology, software development, financial services, enterprise applications, or data-intensive environments is preferred.
  • Candidates may also qualify through equivalent combinations of SQL development, database administration, data engineering, application support, database performance engineering, or data-platform experience that demonstrate the required skills and outcomes.


Day-to-Day Activities


  • Monitor database performance, analyze execution plans, optimize queries and indexes, and maintain SQL Server database objects.
  • Collaborate with application, infrastructure, security, testing, and business teams to support database requirements, design activities, releases, and production issues.
  • Validate data integrity and security, troubleshoot database incidents, implement backup and recovery processes, and document technical changes and operational procedures.
  • Make database-design and optimization decisions within the agreed technical scope, prioritize support and development tasks, and escalate material risks or issues when required.


Qualifications


  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field; equivalent relevant professional experience may be considered.
  • At least 3 years of experience in database development, database administration, SQL development, or a related role is required.
  • Certification in database management, Microsoft SQL Server, data engineering, or a related discipline is preferred but not mandatory.
  • Relevant training in SQL Server, database design, performance optimization, security, backup and recovery, cloud databases, or data management is preferred.
  • Commitment to continuous professional development through technical training, hands-on learning, knowledge sharing, and awareness of evolving database technologies and practices.


Professional Competencies


  • Apply structured problem-solving and analytical reasoning to investigate database performance issues, data defects, connectivity problems, and operational incidents.
  • Work effectively with cross-functional teams, contribute to database initiatives, share technical knowledge, and support collaborative delivery.
  • Communicate technical findings, database requirements, risks, dependencies, optimization recommendations, and incident updates clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Adapt to changing application requirements, database technologies, platform versions, delivery priorities, and operational conditions.
  • Identify opportunities to improve database performance, reliability, security, automation, maintainability, storage efficiency, and sustainable resource usage.
  • Organize and prioritize database development, support, troubleshooting, backup, documentation, and delivery activities while meeting agreed timelines and quality expectations.

title: Recruitment and Onboarding Coordinator
description:
The Opportunity

We’re looking for a Recruitment and Onboarding Coordinator who will bring organisation and rigour to our fast-paced recruitment team, keeping the cogs turning in a rapidly growing engineering business.

You’ll help recruitment and onboarding run smoothly, give candidates and new starters a great experience and develop your own recruitment skills along the way.

This opportunity would suit someone organised, curious and proactive who enjoys bringing order to a busy workload, building relationships and finding ways to make things work better. You might already have recruitment or people experience, or bring strong coordination skills from another setting and be ready to develop in a new direction.

Who We Are

OpenWorks is a rapidly growing business operating globally with a passion for exceptional engineering and building on a legacy of defence innovation in the North East of England.

Our products provide ultra-high performance, real-time detection, tracking, identification and targeting of dynamic aerial threats. They have been deployed internationally to protect high profile military and civilian assets, and contribute towards the defeat of nuisance, misguided and maliciously deployed drones during operations.

We are very proud to have supported a wide range of law enforcement and military operators, protecting many of the most high profile sites and individuals around the world.

The amazing things we do are only possible because of a dedicated and passionate team.

Security Vetting Information

OpenWorks Engineering operates within the defence sector. As part of our recruitment and onboarding processes, we collect information that may be required to support future security vetting and clearance requirements, should these become necessary during employment.

Why You’ll Love Working With Us

Join a high-energy, collaborative team where great ideas thrive, challenges are embraced, and people genuinely love what they do.

Here’s what our benefits have to offer:

Rewarding Success - Competitive salary, starting from £30,000, plus a discretionary annual bonus of up to 25% of salary alongside a structured pay progression framework.

Enhanced Pension – Up to 8% employer-matched contributions to help you plan for the future.

More Time to Recharge – 25 days’ holiday plus public holidays, long-service rewards, and the option to buy up to 5 extra days.

Breakfast & Lunch on Us – Enjoy team breakfasts and freshly prepared lunches every day courtesy of Chef Mark and his team.

Health & Wellbeing – Private healthcare and life assurance for added peace of mind.

Sustainable Travel – Salary sacrifice schemes, including EV car and Cycle to Work options.

Team Socials – Regular events, from quiz nights and football to board games and more.

Learning & Growth – A culture that empowers you to challenge, grow and make an impact, plus a £250 annual learning budget to invest in the development that matters most to you.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Recruitment Coordination: Coordinate interviews, support the preparation of adverts and application forms, manage careers enquiries and maintain accurate right to work and security vetting records.
  • Onboarding Experience: Prepare onboarding materials, arrange buddies and introductions and follow up on essential documentation so people arrive informed and ready to get started.
  • Project Support: Support the Recruitment manager to implement candidate and hiring manager feedback, identify recurring themes and help us improve their experience.
  • Bring our employer brand to life: Support recruitment events, STEM activities and future talent initiatives through practical coordination, communications and follow-up.
  • Keep people informed: Prepare internal vacancy updates and new starter profiles using digital tools.
  • Turn data into insight: Produce recruitment reports, check data quality and highlight trends that help us understand performance and where we can improve.
  • Make processes work better: Help develop our Applicant Tracking System workflows and communications, suggest practical improvements and provide occasional front-of-house cover.

What we’re looking for:

Essential

  • Organisation and accuracy: You can manage competing priorities, adapt when plans change and keep track of the details that make a difference.
  • Clear communication: You write clearly, communicate professionally and feel confident building relationships and following up with people at different levels.
  • Confidence with systems and data: You’re comfortable using Microsoft Office and business systems, with strong working knowledge of Excel, including organising data and producing clear summaries.
  • Initiative and teamwork: You take ownership, spot what needs doing and work collaboratively across Recruitment, People, Marketing and the wider business.
  • Curiosity and ambition: You learn quickly, ask thoughtful questions and want to understand our roles, develop recruitment expertise and take on greater responsibility.
  • Sound judgement: You handle personal and sensitive information with care, recognise when to ask for guidance and suggest practical solutions to problems.

Desirable

  • Relevant experience: Experience in recruitment, people operations, onboarding or a similar coordination role, particularly within a growing organisation.
  • Recruitment technology and reporting: Experience using an ATS or HR system, producing KPI reports or using Excel pivot tables to summarise and analyse data.

More about us:

Vision

Help protect the territory and airspace of NATO countries and their allies.

Mission

Be a world-leading provider of autonomous technology for Surveillance applications and Defence

Values

Be a Good Egg: Earn respect, have mutual trust and be honest

Do cool stuff: We develop cool tech with an awesome team, and we get stuff done

Be empowered: We are autonomous, reliable and take personal responsibility

We are one team: Look out for each other and the team

Things go wrong: Fail fast, learn and move on

Have fun: We’re doing amazing things with passionate people

We Get It Done: Focus on what matters and work with energy to bring ideas to life

title: 2027 Summer Intern PhD Student - Drug Product Development Engineering
description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.



Drug Product Development works with colleagues throughout the entire pharmaceutical development process, from discovery to commercial launch and beyond, to develop novel formulations, processes, and medical devices that enable drug products at clinical and commercial stages. We are looking for candidates who are proven team players; appreciate the challenge of pursuing unique scientific discovery in an emerging field; and who demonstrate solid operational, interpersonal, project management and collaborative skills. We believe this starts with our summer intern program.

Summer interns will work with mentors for ~10 weeks on a guided research project related to applications of predictive modeling, data science, and AI/ML to drug product development. Depending on experience and interests, interns will design and implement computational models that analyze the effects of process variables and material properties on product attributes; apply machine learning and artificial intelligence techniques to large datasets to drive insights and mitigate product-related risks; develop and test predictive models of key pharmaceutical unit operations for oral solid and parenteral dosage forms, including drug delivery devices; collaborate with formulation, process development, and device engineering teams; and present results to a diverse audience at internal forums. The program is organized to ensure that interns gain valuable industry and functional experience, work on challenging assignments, learn about BMS and meet diverse company representatives.

The program will feature:

  • An orientation, including an overview of company structure, products and brands
  • An introduction to the GPS and PD organizations
  • Exposure to senior management and business leaders
  • Hands-on training and working experiences in pharmaceutical manufacturing process areas and testing laboratories
  • Formal presentation at the end of your internship
  • A mentor program
  • Formal review and feedback sessions

Program Dates: Monday June 7, 2027 - Friday, August 13, 2027. Applications are currently being accepted and may be selected on a rolling basis. Those selected will be notified no later than February 2027.

Position is in New Brunswick, NJ.

Requirements:

  • Candidates must be currently enrolled in an accredited university program seeking a PhD degree in engineering, materials science, computational sciences, or a related quantitative discipline. Candidate must still be enrolled during Summer 2027.
  • Candidates are expected to graduate between Fall 2027 and 2028.
  • Must include GPA on resume for consideration (program requires GPA of 3.0 or greater), along with a summary of current research, not exceeding two pages.
  • All candidates must be authorized to work in the US both at the time of hire and for the duration of their employment. Please note that immigration or visa sponsorship is not available for this position.
  • Must have strong oral/written communication skills, with the ability to present technical information to both scientific and non-technical audiences, and be able to work effectively in a collaborative, multidisciplinary team environment.
  • Ability to solve problems independently with minimal supervision.
  • Demonstrated experience in computational modeling (e.g., fluid dynamics, discrete element modeling, or similar techniques) and/or data science, including machine learning (ML) and artificial intelligence (AI) applied to large datasets, for engineering or pharmaceutical challenges.
  • Experience in one or more programming languages such as Python, MATLAB, R, or similar, with an emphasis on data analysis and modeling, is preferred.
  • Experience developing and/or implementing test methods to produce data inputs for computational modeling is preferred.
  • Knowledge of drug product development processes, pharmaceutical unit operations (parenteral or oral solid dosage forms), and/or medical devices is preferred.

title: Meat Wrapper FT
description:

Join the Vallarta Supermarkets Family!

At Vallarta Supermarkets, we’re more than just a grocery store, we’re a vibrant part of the communities we serve. The Meat Wrapper is responsible for wrapping, weighing, and pricing meat, seafood, and cremeria products for display in the self-service case.   • Stand and walk constantly (6–8+ hours/day).
  • Frequently bend neck and waist, squat, twist, and reach above/below shoulders.
  • Frequent repetitive hand use for grasping, fine manipulation, pushing, and pulling.
  • Lift and carry up to 25 lbs. frequently, and up to 50 lbs. occasionally.

  • Work near equipment and machinery, with exposure to noise and temperature/humidity changes.

  • Ability to learn all codes for meat, seafood, and cremeria products.

  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment.

  • Fast-paced retail meat department with direct customer interaction.
  • Exposure to perishable products, refrigerated coolers, and changing conditions.
  • Collaborative, team-focused workplace.
  • Must be able to work flexible schedules, including evenings, weekends, and holidays.

Benefits

Full-Time Team Members

  • Health medical plan: $25/week, plus free dental & vision.
  • Free $25,000 Basic Life and AD&D Insurance.
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan.
  • Paid vacation.
  • Access to legal services.

Part-Time & Full-Time Benefits

  • Paid sick time.
  • Premium pay for holidays.
  • Scholarship opportunities.
  • Savings marketplace & credit union membership.

We offer positions to match your lifestyle and career goals. Whether you’re seeking part-time or full-time, Vallarta Supermarkets provides a dynamic and rewarding workplace with real opportunities for growth.

title: Sr. I&E Technician (1st Shift)
description:
At DNOW, we believe our associates are the best in the business. We value and reward hardworking, creative, and dedicated employees that desire to be part of a team committed to outstanding customer service.

START YOUR CAREER NOW.

The Sr. I&E Technician will be responsible for installing, routing, and terminating instrumentation tubing systems, performing leak testing and system verification, and ensuring compliance with engineering specifications and industry standards. They will collaborate with project teams, maintain accurate documentation, and follow all safety protocols to support safe and reliable operations.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES


  • Install, route, and secure stainless steel and other tubing for instrumentation and electrical systems according to P&IDs, isometric drawings, and engineering specifications.
  • Perform precision bending, flaring, and swaging using manual and hydraulic tools.
  • Terminate and connect tubing to transmitters, gauges, valves, and other field devices.
  • Conduct leak testing, flushing, and system verification to ensure integrity and compliance.
  • Collaborate with electricians, instrument fitters, and engineers to coordinate installation schedules and resolve field challenges.
  • Maintain accurate documentation of work performed, including redlining drawings and updating as-builts.
  • Follow all safety protocols, including lockout/tagout and confined space procedures.

JOB REQUIREMENTS


  • Proven experience in I&E tubing installation in industrial environments (oil & gas, petrochemical, power generation, or similar).
  • Strong ability to read and interpret P&IDs, loop diagrams, and isometric drawings.
  • Proficiency with tubing tools such as benders, cutters, flaring tools, and swaging equipment.
  • Knowledge of industry standards (ISA, API, ASTM) and best practices for tubing installation.
  • Commitment to safety, quality, and precision in every task.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team in fast-paced environments.

BENEFITS:


  • Competitive Salary + bonus
  • 401(k)/ Retirement savings
  • Comprehensive Benefits (medical, dental, vision, life and disability coverage)
  • Friendly work environment
  • Paid vacation/holidays

title: Production Worker
description:
The Production Worker is responsible for performing all tasks involved in the production of the company's products. The individual in this position follows standard work methods and practices safe work habits to ensure production is as efficient and safe as possible.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential function.

  • Perform work on production line; run equipment and inspect, stack, separate, count, and pack product.

  • Conduct quality checks and properly record information.

  • Monitor machinery and equipment operation to ensure all product meets performance specifications and requirements. Promptly notify supervisor of any quality or production issue.

  • Assist with changeovers.

  • Maintain good housekeeping and regularly clean work area, machines, and equipment.

  • Identify and contribute to continuous improvement efforts to reduce costs or increase productivity without reducing effectiveness.

  • Maintain an open and candid working relationship with immediate supervisor/manager in discussing matters of importance.

  • Adhere to established company values, practices, policies and procedures at all times. Follow and support compliance with all applicable safety rules, laws, regulations, and standards.

  • Demonstrate regular and punctual attendance at the assigned work location.

This job description reflects management's assignment of essential functions; it does not prescribe or restrict the tasks that may be assigned

MARGINAL FUNCTIONS

The individual may be asked to perform other duties as requested.

REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES

An individual qualified for this job must be able to:

  • Keep up with machine production rates.

  • Accurately multiply, divide, add, and subtract whole numbers to resolve practical problems.

  • Operate a computer—PC proficiency; use spreadsheets and reporting software effectively.

  • Wear/use required PPE (personal protective equipment).

  • Understand written instruction and complete appropriate documentation as directed.

  • Use a logical approach to troubleshooting issues and prioritizing production needs.

  • Recognize problems when they occur and to work toward the solution of those problems.

  • Pay attention to details and pursue quality in accomplishing work duties and tasks. Look for opportunities to reduce costs or increase productivity without reducing effectiveness.

  • Handle challenges skillfully, thoroughly, and effectively.

  • Effectively and professionally communicate with co-workers, team members, and internal or external customers. Present information clearly and accurately.

  • Independently take advantage of opportunities to improve or increase skills, abilities and job knowledge.

  • Make sure that work is delivered on time and of high quality.

  • Develop good work practices in order to get the job done.

  • Use equipment, resources and time in an efficient and effective manner.

  • Use good judgment when making decisions.

  • Perform work in a safe manner at all times.

  • Work in a cooperative manner with management, co-workers, internal/external customers, and vendors.

  • Do the right thing, even when it is difficult.

MINIMUM EXPERIENCE, EDUCATION, AND CERTIFICATIONS

  • Entry level position (0 to 2 years’ experience).

  • Must be able to obtain forklift license through Highline Warren.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS OF ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an individual to successfully perform the Essential Functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • Remain in a stationary position when performing line operations.

  • Regularly move about when moving along the line as needed to perform job duties.

  • Transport products and materials weighing up to 58 pounds when moving products to the line and or emptying boxes to the load area.

  • Manipulate products on pallets, using force of up to 35 pounds.

  • Position oneself to retrieve products or materials from ground level.

  • Reach forward and overhead when inspecting product and moving pallets.

  • Ascend/descend stairs/ladders to access the machine, catwalk, and when climbing over machinery/line.

  • Position and handle product, boxes, and pallets.

  • Perceive the nature of sounds and have the ability to exchange detailed information while performing job duties in a manufacturing plant where noise level is moderate to high.

  • Move about the manufacturing facility to observe and effectively communicate with team members and perform job duties.

ENVIRONMENTAL CONDITIONS

The environmental conditions described here are representative of those the associate encounters while performing the Essential Functions of the job.

  • The individual in this position will be expected to work in a manufacturing plant environment, which may include being exposed to work in high/precarious places, moving machinery, marked changes in temperature and humidity, and dust, odors and fumes. Typical noise level is loud.

description:

title: Customer Experience Executive
description:
ABOUT ARTERA

Our Mission: Make healthcare #1 in customer service.
What We Deliver: Artera is an agentic company strengthening how healthcare providers communicate and care for patients. As an agentic partner, we bring over a decade of healthcare experience to address urgent workflows from day one and build custom solutions as healthcare providers’ needs evolve. Trusted by 1,000+ specialties, FQHCs, health systems, and federal agencies, Artera strengthens and protects and enhances patient relationships across every interaction - from intake and scheduling to referral management, post-visit care, and more.

Hear from our CEO, Guillaume de Zwirek, about why we are standing at the edge of the biggest technological shift in healthcare’s history!

Our award-winning culture: Our award-winning culture: Since founding in 2015, Artera has consistently been recognized for its innovative technology, business growth, and named a top place to work. Examples of these accolades include: Inc. 5000 Fastest Growing Private Companies (2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024); Deloitte Technology Fast 500 (2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025); Built In Best Companies to Work For (2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025, 2026). Artera has also been recognized by Forbes as one of “America’s Best Startup Employers,” Newsweek as one of the “World’s Best Digital Health Companies,” and named one of the top “44 Startups to Bet your Career on in 2024” by Business Insider.
Applicants must be currently authorized and have the ability to provide proof of full-time, long-term authorization to work in the United States. We are unable to provide visa sponsorship or support visa transfers now or in the future.

About the Role

The Customer Experience Executive (CXE) is Artera's single point of accountability for a portfolio of large health system accounts. You will carry a book of $300K–2M ARR customers and lead on the highest-stakes strategic deliverables at Artera. This is a relationship-first, outcomes-driven role built for someone who has spent meaningful time inside or alongside enterprise health systems and understands the operational realities of large-scale care delivery. You own the customer from pre-close introduction through implementation, go-live, ongoing engagement, renewal, and expansion. You won't execute every task but you're accountable for every date, including the work other teams touch.


This role sits within Artera's newly unified Customer Experience Management function, which combines our former Customer Success Management and Project Management teams into one accountable owner per account. The ideal background for this role is someone who has bridged both worlds: PM discipline applied to CS accountability. You'll run implementations, drive adoption, monitor account health, and quarterback expansion conversations alongside your counterparts from sales, configuration, and development. Health systems are complex, high-stakes accounts where C-suite visibility is constant and credibility is earned through delivery and outcomes, not tenure.

Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end post-sales experience for major enterprise accounts ($300K–$2M ARR), including implementation, project management, stakeholder management, ongoing success, referenceability, and growth.

  • 5+ years working with or inside large health systems (vendor, health system, payer, or EHR side). Enterprise health system experience is required, not preferred.

  • Personally execute complex configuration and problem-solving when it accelerates outcomes; do not pass off high-stakes work.

  • Serve as the credible closer on the hardest customer conversations — de-escalate, re-commit to dates, and hold the internal machine accountable to those re-commits.

  • Run the most complex enterprise programs; frequently execute advanced configuration and workflow design personally.

  • Serve as an escalation point for complex delivery risk across the CX function.

  • Design solutions to novel customer problems; orchestrate cross-functional execution.

  • Build and maintain VP-through-C-suite relationships in customer organizations; drive value attainment and adoption at the executive level.

  • Direct activities of other CX teammates on complex accounts when needed.

  • Create formal networks and coordinate across groups.

  • Execute advanced enterprise-grade configuration, integration design, and technical problem-solving directly.

  • Lead focus initiatives on product-driven improvements; frequently absorb work that previously required support-function specialists.

  • Serve as trusted broker between CX and support functions; drive structural fixes on high-friction handoffs.

  • Represent customer voice inside internal steering forums.

  • Consistently prioritize workflows that improve key customer metrics.

  • Assist with scoping and design consultations focused on solving business problems with existing platform functionality.

  • Develop personal brand as a thought leader in Artera-adjacent fields.

  • Able to travel a minimum of 25% of the quarter for onsite customer meetings and QBRs

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree with 8–12 years of related experience across customer success, project management, technical customer support, or healthcare technology; or an advanced degree with 4–8 years; or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

  • Experience. 6–10 years in customer success, account management, or implementation management in B2B SaaS; 5+ years working with or inside large health systems; demonstrated enterprise account ownership ($300K+ ARR) required; bachelor's degree or equivalent.

  • Domain expertise. EHR familiarity (Epic, Meditech, Oracle Health, or Athenahealth) and a track record of executing advanced platform configuration, integration design, and workflow architecture directly.

  • Executive presence. Confidence building and maintaining C-suite relationships, managing escalations, and framing ROI, workflow, and integration outcomes for executive and operational audiences.

  • Analytical and operational depth. Data analysis applied to customer outcomes (dashboards, reports, business cases); daily hands-on use of AI tools for drafting, prep, summarization, and follow-up; recognized internally as a subject-matter expert with peers seeking guidance on complex accounts.

  • Mindset and availability. Self-directed builder who hits the ground running; ability to travel a minimum of 25%.

Bonus Skills

  • Advanced business, technology, or healthcare degree.

  • PMP, LSS Black Belt, or equivalent process or program certification.

  • Prior experience partnering with AEs on expansion.

  • Published case studies, conference presentations, or evidence-based customer outcomes.

  • Product feedback contributions that resulted in shipped roadmap items.

  • Experience mentoring or informally leading CX teammates.

What Success Looks Like


You come in already fluent in the health system landscape -- that is table stakes for this role. In the first weeks, you are absorbing accounts, building relationships with operational and executive contacts, and establishing yourself as a credible presence with C-suite stakeholders. Within the first quarter, you have run your first clean executive business review and have a clear read on health signals across every account. Long-term, you are the person your health system customers call first -- a delivery-focused partner who understands their operations, can translate Artera's value into their language, and drives consistent retention and expansion across the portfolio.

OUR APPROACH TO WORK LOCATION

At Artera, we believe the best work happens when people are truly connected. Our AI services model has shown what’s possible when small, focused teams move fast together — the speed of collaboration, pace of career growth, and quality of what we build can become stronger when teams share space. As we grow, we want every new teammate to feel part of an in-person community from day one.

That’s why we are focusing our U.S. hiring in three cities, where we are investing in offices and building strong local teams:

  • Santa Barbara, CA (Our HQ)
  • Seattle, WA
  • Kansas City, KS/MO

Unless a role’s posting states otherwise, new U.S. roles are based in one of these three cities, and candidates should reside in (or be willing to relocate to) one of these areas. Each location follows an in-person schedule that reflects how our local teams work best; we’ll walk you through what to expect for your specific role and city during the interview process.

Focusing on offices and hiring in a few locations, rather than spreading thin across many cities, lets us invest deeply in each one so every team has real community, mentorship, and momentum in person.

WORKING AT ARTERA

Company benefits - Full health benefits (medical, dental, and vision), flexible spending accounts, company paid life insurance, company paid short-term & long-term disability, company equity, voluntary benefits, 401(k) and more!
Career development - Manager development resources, employee development funds
Generous time off - Company holidays, Winter & Summer break, and flexible time off
Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) - We believe that everyone should belong at their workplace. Our ERGs are available for identifying employees or allies to join.

title: Operation Executive
description:
Job Summary

We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented Operations Executive to support and manage daily business operations, ensure smooth workflow across departments, and maintain high standards of service delivery. The role requires strong organisational, coordination, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to monitor operational performance, resolve issues, and ensure that business activities are completed efficiently and in line with company objectives.

Key Responsibilities

1. Daily Operations Management

  • Oversee daily operational activities to ensure smooth and efficient business operations.
  • Monitor daily workloads, task allocation, and workflow to ensure activities are completed within established timelines.
  • Coordinate with different departments and service centres to ensure operational requirements are met.
  • Identify operational challenges and take appropriate action to minimise delays and disruptions.
  • Ensure that operational procedures and company policies are followed consistently.

2. Performance Monitoring and Reporting

  • Monitor operational performance against established KPIs, targets, and service-level agreements (SLAs).
  • Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly operational reports for management review.
  • Track productivity, transaction volumes, pending tasks, and service delivery performance.
  • Identify performance gaps and recommend practical improvements.
  • Follow up with relevant teams to ensure that operational targets are achieved.

3. Team Coordination and Support

  • Coordinate with operations teams to ensure tasks and responsibilities are clearly assigned.
  • Follow up on pending work and support teams in resolving operational issues.
  • Monitor attendance, shift coverage, and manpower requirements in coordination with the relevant departments.
  • Escalate staffing shortages, performance concerns, and operational risks to management.
  • Support the implementation of operational instructions and management decisions.

4. Process Improvement and Quality Control

  • Review existing operational processes and identify opportunities to improve efficiency.
  • Ensure accuracy, consistency, and quality in daily operations.
  • Identify recurring errors, delays, and service issues and recommend corrective actions.
  • Assist in developing and updating standard operating procedures (SOPs) and internal workflows.
  • Ensure proper documentation, recordkeeping, and compliance with internal operational standards.

5. Issue Resolution and Coordination

  • Handle day-to-day operational challenges and coordinate with the relevant teams to resolve them promptly.
  • Investigate service delays, customer complaints, and operational discrepancies.
  • Coordinate with internal departments, including HR, Finance, IT, and Customer Service, to address operational requirements.
  • Escalate critical issues to management with relevant details and recommended solutions.
  • Follow up on corrective actions to ensure issues are resolved effectively.

Requirements

Qualifications and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, or a related field is preferred.
  • Minimum 2–4 years of experience in operations management, operations coordination, or a similar role.
  • Experience in a multi-branch, service-oriented, or customer-facing business environment is an advantage.
  • Strong knowledge of operational workflows, KPI monitoring, reporting, and process improvement.
  • Experience using MS Excel, reporting tools, and operational management systems.
  • Excellent organisational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong communication and coordination skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work under pressure.

Key Competencies

  • Operational planning and coordination
  • KPI and performance monitoring
  • Analytical thinking and problem-solving
  • Process improvement
  • Reporting and documentation
  • Team coordination and accountability
  • Time management and prioritisation
  • Attention to detail

Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Achievement of operational targets and KPIs.
  • Timely completion of daily operational activities.
  • Reduction in pending tasks, processing delays, and operational errors.
  • Improvement in team productivity and workflow efficiency.
  • Compliance with internal procedures and service-level standards.
  • Timely submission and accuracy of operational reports.
  • Effective resolution of operational issues.

description:
