About Us

HireHawk connects skilled professionals around the world with career opportunities at U.S. and Canadian companies, with a strong focus on building high-performing remote teams. We value people who communicate clearly, take ownership of their work, and thrive with clear expectations and measurable outcomes. Team members work in a fully remote environment with structured onboarding, dedicated coordination, and opportunities to grow alongside a scaling global organization.

About the Role

As the Records Clerk Team Lead, you will lead the day-to-day performance of a team responsible for obtaining, tracking, reviewing, and organizing medical records and billing documentation for U.S. plaintiff personal injury cases. You will combine hands-on records retrieval knowledge with people leadership, making sure requests move forward, documentation is complete, and potential delays are addressed before they affect case progress.

This role is designed for someone who understands that strong records operations are critical to personal injury case preparation. You will have meaningful ownership over team productivity, quality control, coaching, reporting, and process improvement while partnering closely with Case Managers and other legal operations stakeholders.

Responsibilities

  • Lead and coordinate the daily workflow of Records Clerks and supporting team members, ensuring priorities are clear and assigned work is completed on schedule.
  • Own the team's medical records and billing retrieval process across hospitals, clinics, physicians, and other healthcare providers.
  • Keep outstanding requests moving by identifying delays, following up proactively, and resolving incomplete records, billing discrepancies, and provider-related issues.
  • Monitor turnaround times, pending requests, productivity, accuracy, and other performance indicators to maintain strong team accountability.
  • Coach and train Records Clerks on retrieval procedures, documentation standards, provider communication, HIPAA requirements, and team best practices.
  • Conduct quality assurance reviews so medical records, billing statements, and supporting documentation are complete, accurate, and properly organized.
  • Partner with Case Managers and other departments to ensure case documentation is available when needed for pre-litigation case preparation.
  • Identify recurring workflow bottlenecks and recommend practical process improvements that increase efficiency without sacrificing accuracy.
  • Maintain clear reporting on completed requests, outstanding documentation, follow-up activity, and individual and team productivity.
  • Take ownership of complex provider issues and operational escalations, resolving what you can independently and escalating appropriately when management involvement is required.

Requirements

Must-Have:

  • 3+ years of hands-on medical records retrieval experience supporting U.S. plaintiff personal injury matters.
  • 1+ year of experience leading, supervising, training, or providing day-to-day direction to Records Clerks or a similar legal support team.
  • Strong working knowledge of personal injury pre-litigation workflows and how medical records and bills support case preparation.
  • Proven experience requesting, tracking, reviewing, and following up on medical records and billing statements from U.S. healthcare providers.
  • Working knowledge of HIPAA requirements, medical authorizations, and appropriate handling of confidential patient information.
  • Experience using a legal case management platform such as Filevine, CasePeer, SmartAdvocate, or a comparable system, along with strong Excel and reporting skills.
  • Excellent written and spoken English, with the confidence to communicate professionally with healthcare providers, Case Managers, attorneys, and internal stakeholders.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience supporting a California plaintiff personal injury law firm.
  • Previous leadership experience within an offshore or globally distributed legal support team.
  • Experience building or improving records retrieval KPIs, productivity dashboards, or turnaround-time reporting.
  • A track record of improving team performance through coaching, quality reviews, workflow changes, or stronger accountability processes.

title: 2027 Summer Intern PhD Student - Drug Product Development Sterile Formulation
description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.



Drug Product Development works with colleagues throughout the entire pharmaceutical development process, from discovery to commercial launch and beyond, to deliver drug products of biologics and small molecules, including sterile formulations and novel drug delivery technologies. We are looking for candidates who are proven team players; appreciate the challenge of pursuing unique scientific discovery in an emerging field; and who demonstrate solid operational, interpersonal, project management and collaborative skills. We believe this starts with our summer intern program.

Summer interns will work with mentors for ~10 weeks on a guided research project related to sterile formulation development and novel drug delivery technologies for both biologics and small molecules, spanning liquid, lyophilized, and other advanced delivery platforms. This position integrates wet-lab and dry-lab functions: interns will conduct feasibility experiments with formulation and processing technologies, supporting formulation development, formulation screening, stability assessment, physicochemical and biophysical characterization of critical quality attributes, and process optimization. The project may also involve biopharmaceutical investigation of biologics, exploring structure-function relationships, degradation pathways, and stability-indicating strategies to inform formulation design and enable robust, patient-friendly drug products. The program is organized to ensure that interns gain valuable industry and functional experience, work on challenging assignments, learn about BMS and meet diverse company representatives.

The program will feature:


  • An orientation, including an overview of company structure, products and brands
  • An introduction to the GPS and PD organizations
  • Exposure to senior management and business leaders
  • Hands-on training and working experiences in pharmaceutical manufacturing process areas and testing laboratories
  • Formal presentation at the end of your internship
  • A mentor program
  • Formal review and feedback sessions

Program Dates: Monday June 7, 2027 - Friday, August 13, 2027. Applications are currently being accepted and may be selected on a rolling basis. Those selected will be notified no later than February 2027.

Position is in New Brunswick, NJ.

Requirements:


  • Candidates must be currently enrolled in an accredited university program seeking a PhD degree in Pharmaceutical Science, Pharmaceutical Chemistry, Biotechnology, Chemical or Biomedical Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Candidates are expected to graduate between Fall 2027 and 2028.
  • Must include GPA on resume for consideration (program requires GPA of 3.0 or greater).
  • All candidates must be authorized to work in the US both at the time of hire and for the duration of their employment. Please note that immigration or visa sponsorship is not available for this position.
  • Must have strong verbal, written, and interpersonal skills and be able to work in a team environment.
  • Ability to solve problems independently with minimal supervision.
  • Hands-on lab experience is expected.
  • Sound knowledge and understanding of the fundamental principles of pharmaceutical science, physical pharmacy, chemistry, stability, and/or biochemistry is required.
  • Prior experience with formulation development, formulation characterization, and novel drug delivery technologies (e.g., LNPs, polymer-based microparticles, ultra-high concentration protein formulations) is preferred; prior drug product development research experience is a plus.

title: Director, CMS Agentic Commerce, GTM Focus
description:
About Us
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Job Description

Director, Agentic Commerce (GTM focus)

Role Overview


Visa is seeking a Director of Agentic Commerce GTM to serve as the commercialization leader for one of the company's most strategic emerging growth areas. This role is responsible for defining how Visa brings Agentic Commerce capabilities to market, including go-to-market strategy, client engagement, sales enablement, partnership development, ecosystem expansion, and commercialization execution. Success in this role will be measured by market adoption, customer engagement, strategic partnerships, and the ability to translate emerging technology trends into scalable business opportunities for Visa and its clients.


Operating at the intersection of Product, Sales, Partnerships, and Regional teams, this leader will connect emerging capabilities with real-world customer needs, helping shape value propositions, commercialization strategies, and market-entry plans that drive adoption globally. The Director will work closely with clients, fintechs, technology partners, and internal stakeholders to identify opportunities, validate demand, accelerate ecosystem development, and establish repeatable go-to-market motions that scale.


As commerce increasingly evolves to include AI agents, autonomous procurement, intelligent treasury workflows, agent-enabled commerce platforms, and new digital intermediaries, this leader will help clients and partners understand how these shifts are reshaping payments while positioning Visa at the center of the next generation of commerce.


Key Responsibilities


Go-to-Market Strategy & Commercialization


  • Develop and execute go-to-market strategies for Visa’s Agentic Commerce initiatives across commercial payments, money movement, treasury, procurement, embedded finance, and other CMS use cases.
  • Translate new products and capabilities into clear value propositions, client narratives, and commercialization plans. Define priority customer segments, target markets, and market-entry strategies.
  • Partner with Product and Regional teams to drive adoption and revenue growth, developing scalable GTM playbooks for use across regions and segments.
  • Use adoption metrics, customer feedback, and market signals to refine GTM strategies.

Sales Enablement & Market Readiness


  • Support strategic client engagements, workshops, executive briefings, and industry events.
  • Develop client narratives, competitive positioning, solution messaging, and supporting materials, including executive presentations and thought leadership that articulate Visa CMS’s approach to scaling agentic commerce.
  • Work with regional GTM leaders to identify customer priorities, adoption barriers, market-specific opportunities, lighthouse clients, pilots, and commercialization pathways.
  • Work with Product and Solutioning teams to assess product gaps, market readiness, and client adoption pathways.

Market Validation & Opportunity Development


  • Gather customer feedback and field insights to inform product priorities and roadmap direction.
  • Support strategic accounts pursuing commerce and payments transformation. Facilitate ideation workshops with design partners, Design, and Product Management to develop new solutions.
  • Work with the Partnerships team to evaluate emerging participants, including agentic platforms, fintechs, and payment facilitators, and identify opportunities to extend Visa’s capabilities through partnerships and integrations.
  • Represent Visa in client meetings, industry forums, conferences, and strategic discussions, reinforcing Visa’s leadership in agent-enabled payments and commerce.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications

  • 10 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or at least 8 years of work experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters/MBA/JD/MD) or at least 3 years of work experience with a PhD.
  • Experience in creating vision statements and setting product goals.
  • Experience in defining product strategy.
  • Experience in product design.
  • Experience in customer discovery and the design of new products based on that discovery.
  • Experience in product execution.
  • Experience in defining and leading plans to achieve product goals.
  • Experience working in Agile frameworks and matrixed organizations.
  • Experience in process or core banking best practices.
  • Experience recruiting, growing, retaining, and leading technical talent.
  • Experience collaborating in global, cross-functional teams.
  • Strong commercial acumen and ability to forecast business trends.


Preferred Qualifications

  • 12 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or 8-10 years of experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 6+ years of work experience with a PhD.
  • Senior product management experience in Digital, Payments, and Financial Services.
  • Proven track record of launching and managing digital products for issuers.
  • Deep background in issuing institutions and managing large card portfolios.
  • Experience in developing or launching new solutions and managing engagement, UX, and UI transformation.
  • Experience leading difficult deal negotiations and managing third-party vendors.
  • Ability to structure and manage complex cross-enterprise projects and processes.
  • Superior analytical and problem-solving skills with demonstrated intellectual rigor.
  • Experience managing diverse teams with positive records.

Today, we’re one global team united by bold thinking, relentless drive, and a passion to exceed expectations. If you’re ready to embrace change and make an impact in your career, let’s go.


Why This Role Matters


As a Distribution Controller MEA, you will transform fragmented logistics and freight data into meaningful analytics that enable better operational and strategic decisions. By delivering accurate reporting, performance visibility, and actionable recommendations, you will help optimize distribution performance, improve cost control, and support service excellence across a diverse and dynamic regional supply chain.


Your work will directly influence how the business understands logistics performance, identifies improvement opportunities, and responds to an evolving global transportation environment.


What You'll Do


  • Transform complex and fragmented logistics data into meaningful business insights by developing reliable reporting, dashboards, and performance analytics that support Distribution and Supply Chain decision-making across the MEA region.
  • Build, maintain, and continuously improve Power BI dashboards, data models, and automated reporting solutions by consolidating data from multiple internal systems and external logistics providers.
  • Analyze freight spending, transportation performance, service levels, distribution costs, and operational KPIs to identify trends, risks, inefficiencies, and opportunities for continuous improvement.
  • Partner closely with Logistics, Supply Chain, Procurement, Customer Service, Sales, and regional leadership teams to provide data-driven recommendations that improve operational and financial performance.
  • Reconcile inconsistent and incomplete datasets by improving data quality, validating reporting accuracy, and creating standardized reporting structures across a complex logistics network.
  • Support strategic logistics initiatives by providing business analysis and performance visibility across multiple transportation modes, distribution channels, and international markets while adapting to evolving business requirements.
  • Drive reporting automation, process optimization, and business intelligence best practices that increase visibility, reduce manual reporting efforts, and enable faster, data-driven decision making.


What We're Looking For


  • Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Business Analytics, Economics, Engineering, Information Systems, or another related field.
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in Supply Chain Analytics, Logistics Analytics, Business Intelligence, Operations Analytics, or a similar analytical role within an international environment.
  • Advanced experience with Power BI, Power Query, Microsoft Excel, data modeling, dashboard development, and data visualization. Experience with additional BI tools is considered an advantage.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to work with multiple, fragmented, and incomplete data sources while transforming complex datasets into reliable business insights.
  • Good understanding of supply chain, transportation, freight operations, logistics cost drivers, distribution networks, and operational performance metrics.
  • Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex analytical findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Fluent English and a proactive, solution-oriented mindset, with the ability to work independently, manage ambiguity, and drive continuous improvement in a dynamic international environment.

title: Senior Systems Engineer
description:
Why Join Afero? The next wave of AI lives in everyday devices. Help build it.

Our vision is to make all the world's devices secure and AI-powered, through innovation and scale. Come build the products used by millions of people every day.

Afero is the IoT platform as a service trusted by manufacturers and brands to make connected devices both smart and secure. Today, Afero technology powers more than 20 million devices across 200+ products from 50+ manufacturers. Afero has more than 130 patents, one of the largest IoT patent portfolios globally, and was named a 2024 IoT Breakthrough Winner for IoT Security Platform of the Year. Afero is driven by a team of world-class executives and veterans in mobile, hardware, security, consumer and cloud, leveraging experience from Google, Apple, Microsoft, Amazon, Netflix, Disney, Roku and Danger.

Microcontrollers, the low-cost, low-power chips inside plugs, bulbs, locks, sensors, thermostats, and meters, ship at a rate of more than 4 billion a year, more than phones, laptops, and servers combined. Yet they lack a common software layer for identity, connectivity, provisioning, updates, fleet management, and enterprise-grade security. Afero delivers that layer: a unified platform, tested at scale in The Home Depot's Hubspace smart home ecosystem, for devices that cannot run a general-purpose operating system like Linux or Android. These devices form the far edge, connecting the physical and digital worlds so modern AI can meet people where they are.

To learn more, please visit .

What We’re Looking For

As a Senior Systems Engineer, you own how the pieces fit together. You'll define and review device protocols, debug problems that cross firmware, app and cloud boundaries, and be the technical point of contact for manufacturers and partners bringing new products onto Hubspace. You'll work closely with firmware, mobile, platform and product teams, and you'll often be the person who turns a vague integration problem into a clear spec.

Key Responsibilities

Device integration and protocols

  • Define, review and correct device-level protocols (UART, BLE, SPI) between supplier MCUs and the Hubspace Module.

  • Map device capabilities to Afero's attribute and data models, and keep specs accurate as products evolve.

  • Lead bring-up and debug of new devices with manufacturers, from first prototype through production.

  • Assess supplier-proposed designs and changes on technical merit, and flag scope impacts to product owners early.

    • Device-to-cloud systems

    • Trace and resolve issues that span firmware, the Hubspace mobile app and cloud services.

    • Contribute to architecture for multi-protocol products such as gateways and bridges (BLE, proprietary RF, Matter).

    • Work with platform engineers on GCP-hosted services, data flows and cost/performance trade-offs (e.g., BigQuery, Pub/Sub, Cloud SQL).

    • Improve factory and provisioning workflows so new devices onboard reliably at production scale.

      • Partner and cross-team enablement

      • Serve as technical liaison to manufacturers, retail and platform partners, and voice-assistant ecosystems.

      • Write clear technical documents: protocol specs, integration guides, design reviews and decision memos.

      • Translate deep technical detail into concise recommendations for product and executive stakeholders.

      • Support Partner Enablement tickets and mentor other engineers on systems thinking and debugging.

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years in systems, embedded or IoT engineering, with real products shipped at volume.

  • Clear, precise technical writing, and the ability to explain trade-offs to non-engineers.

  • Experience working directly with contract manufacturers or external hardware partners.

  • Hands-on experience with serial and wireless protocols (UART, SPI, I2C, BLE) and reading/writing protocol specs.

  • Understanding of IoT cloud patterns: MQTT, REST APIs, device provisioning and OTA updates.

  • Ability to debug across layers—device, mobile app and cloud—and isolate root cause quickly.

  • BS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science or equivalent experience.

Nice to Have

  • Working knowledge of embedded C on common MCUs (e.g., Nordic nRF52, ESP32, STM32) and comfort with logic analyzers, sniffers and debuggers.

  • Matter, Thread or Zigbee experience, including bridges or border routers.

  • Familiarity with smart home ecosystems and voice-assistant integrations.

  • Experience with GCP (BigQuery, Pub/Sub, Cloud SQL) or similar cloud data platforms.

  • Background in consumer electronics certification or retail product launches.

  • Experience with HVAC, lighting, locks or other connected home device categories.

  • Scripting in Python or similar for test tools, log analysis and automation.

Afero is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment regardless of race, color, national origin, religion, sex, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran or disability status.

title: Senior QA Engineer
description:
The Opportunity

We are hiring a Senior QA Engineer to own quality across the full delivery lifecycle, from business requirement through production sign off. At a regulated exchange where trading, clearing, and the payments that fund them all have to be correct, quality protects our customers' money and our regulatory standing. You will work across distributed backend services in Rust, web and mobile front ends in React and TypeScript, a cloud native platform on Kubernetes, and integrations with payment, identity, and market infrastructure partners.

Professional Experience

  • Owning quality across the full delivery lifecycle, from requirements through production sign off
  • Risk based test strategy and test design across unit, integration, end to end, performance, and exploratory testing
  • Hands on test automation and the frameworks behind it, integrated into CI/CD
  • Testing distributed backend services and modern web and mobile front ends
  • Reading and writing code and validating data directly, not testing only through the UI
  • Using AI coding and testing tools to accelerate work without lowering the quality bar

Qualifications

  • 5+ years in QA or quality engineering, including owning release sign off for production systems
  • Strong test design and risk analysis skills
  • Hands on test automation, ideally Playwright with TypeScript, plus API testing
  • Comfortable reading and writing code in at least one backend language (Rust is a plus)
  • Working SQL for data validation
  • Real, regular use of AI coding and testing tools, with examples you can share
  • CI/CD experience
  • Clear written communication
  • Preferred: financial services experience, including trading, payments, or fintech
  • Preferred: experience in regulated environments
  • Preferred: performance and load testing
  • Preferred: experience building AI agents, tooling, or LLM evaluations
  • Preferred: mobile testing

Position Responsibilities

  • Turn business requirements into clear, testable acceptance criteria before development starts
  • Define a risk based test strategy for each initiative, balancing unit, integration, end to end, performance, and exploratory testing
  • Design, build, and maintain automated test suites and frameworks, and integrate them into CI/CD
  • Review changes for test quality and coverage, and drive flaky or failing tests to root cause
  • Own the go or no go decision for production releases, with clear, auditable evidence of what was tested
  • Track escaped defects, feed the lessons back into requirements and tests, and raise the quality bar across the team
  • Use AI to turn requirements into test scenarios, edge cases, and automation
  • Run agent driven exploratory and UI testing
  • Build AI assisted tooling for test maintenance and failure triage, and reusable QA workflows the team can apply
  • Test and evaluate AI powered product features, verifying AI output against real system behavior before sign off

description:

Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

This position may be based in Lafayette, Colorado; Minneapolis, Minnesota; or Jacksonville, Florida.


This high-impact finance role offers the opportunity to shape where ENT invests and help turn bold ideas into technologies that improve patient care. You will partner with R&D, RPM, and PMO leaders to guide innovation strategy, lead the Enrich process, and influence portfolio decisions through rigorous financial insights, while expanding your leadership impact through the R&D Finance COE and a dedicated ENT analyst.


The Ear, Nose, and Throat (ENT) Operating Unit Finance team partners with Research & Development (R&D), Released Product Management (RPM), and Project Management Office (PMO) leaders to support innovation investments, portfolio management, and resource allocation decisions. The team provides financial leadership across the product lifecycle, helping evaluate strategic opportunities, prioritize investments, and guide long-range planning activities that support business growth and operational objectives.


As a Financial Consultant, you will serve as the strategic finance partner to ENT R&D, RPM, and PMO leadership. You will provide financial planning, portfolio analysis, investment evaluation, and decision support to help leaders prioritize resources, evaluate innovation opportunities, and optimize investments across the product portfolio.


At Medtronic, we bring bold ideas forward with speed and decisiveness to put patients first in everything we do. In-person exchanges are invaluable to our work. description:

title: NPD Materials Specialist
description:
Life Unlimited. At Smith and Nephew, we design and manufacture technology that takes the limits off living


We are seeking an experienced NPD Materials Specialist to play a pivotal role in ensuring material readiness for new product introductions and successful product launches. This position serves as the key connection between New Product Development Procurement and Manufacturing Operations, ensuring a smooth transition from product development into full-scale production.

If you are passionate about supply chain operations, procurement, material planning, and cross-functional collaboration, this is an exciting opportunity to make a direct impact on the success of innovative new products.



What will you need to be successful?


  • Develop and maintain Plans for Every Part (PFEPs) across multiple NPD projects, including BOM structures, supplier information, forecasts, pricing, lead times, and delivery status.
  • Coordinate material readiness to support validation builds, pilot runs, and product launches.
  • Manage temporary purchasing activities before SAP purchasing processes are established.
  • Expedite supplier deliveries to ensure project milestones and launch timelines are met.
  • Track and maintain open orders, shortages, and delivery performance reports.
  • Support SAP procurement master data setup required for successful product launches.
  • Assist in transitioning temporary purchasing activities into standard SAP purchasing processes.
  • Partner with NPD Procurement Engineers, planning teams, buyer/planners, and suppliers to proactively resolve supply risks and material issues.
  • Lead the formal handoff of suppliers, forecasts, purchase orders, and PFEP data to the manufacturing Buyer/Planner organization.
  • Support launch stabilization activities to ensure uninterrupted supply during production ramp-up.

What will you need to be successful?


Required Qualifications

  • Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Business, Manufacturing, Engineering Technology, Operations, or a related field preferred.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in: Procurement Purchasing Material Planning Supply Chain Operations Manufacturing Support Expediting

Preferred Experience

  • Supporting New Product Introductions (NPI/NPD) or product launch activities.
  • Working with Bills of Material (BOMs), forecasts, and supplier master data.
  • Experience with SAP, Ariba, or other ERP systems.

Key Skills

  • Advanced Microsoft Excel proficiency.
  • Strong understanding of procurement, materials management, and supplier operations.
  • Ability to interpret and manage Bills of Material and product structures.
  • Excellent organizational and project coordination skills.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management capabilities.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
  • Detail-oriented with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
  • Proactive problem-solving skills and the ability to mitigate supply risks before they impact the business.

What Success Looks Like

  • In this role, success will be measured by:
  • Accurate and complete PFEP management
  • On-time material availability for development builds and product launches
  • Effective management of temporary purchasing activities before SAP integration
  • Smooth transition into standard SAP purchasing processes
  • Successful handoff to manufacturing Buyer/Planner teams
  • Strong launch execution and supply continuity

This is more than a traditional purchasing role. The NPD Materials Specialist acts as the operational owner of material readiness during one of the most critical phases of the product lifecycle: the transition from development to manufacturing. You will work across global teams, suppliers, procurement, planning, and operations to ensure new products launch successfully and reach customers on time.

title: People & Culture Coordinator
description:
Your Opportunity at ARC’TERYX:

As the People & Culture Coordinator, you will serve as a key first point of contact for employees and people leaders, triaging inquiries, connecting individuals with the appropriate People & Culture resources and partners, and providing operational support across a range of people processes. Your passion for people, data and process improvement will drive the continuous evolution of P&C processes, projects, and programs, and contribute to an exceptional candidate and employee experience.

This role is based out of our New Westminster location and is mostly onsite with flexibility of schedule. Candidates must be eligible to work in Canada.

Meet Your Future Team:

Part of the greater People and Culture (P&C) team, the People and Culture Business Partner function leads, informs, and activates the People Strategy to meet and exceed business objectives. The team operates in strategic partnership with the business, driving the continuous evolution of people and leadership practices and fosters a culture that generates high-performance teams, strengths-based coaching, and values-based leadership.

If you were in the People & Culture Coordinator role now, here are some of the core activities you would be doing:

  • Acting as the first point of contact for all employee P&C inquiries, triaging requests and empowering our employees with the appropriate information, support, and resources
  • Processing and tracking employee lifecycle changes including new hires, requisitions, promotions, changes, terminations, leaves in Workday and other systems, while ensuring all relevant parties are informed
  • Managing day-to-day P&C administration, including creation of offer letters, promotion letters, employment changing letters, and termination documentation
  • driving continuous improvement initiatives to enhance operations, reduce turnaround times, streamline work processes, and work collaboratively to deliver high-quality support to People Leaders and employees
  • Partnering cross-functionally to coordinate communications and logistics on company events and activations, including listening sessions, huddles, workshops, celebrations and other brand initiatives to enhance employee experience
  • Collaborating with cross-functional P&C teams for preboarding and onboarding tasks, ensuring new hires are set up for success from day one and contributing to the execution of our Basecamp onboarding program
  • Acting as the gatekeeper of our people data, including maintaining and updating Supply Chain people data across systems, including Workday, ADP WFN, Lever, and other platforms, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and data integrity
  • Preparing Supply Chain people related data and reports as required to support effective decision making across the P&C and Supply Chain teams
  • Assisting Supply Chain P&C Business Partners and Generalists with employee relations tasks such as intake meetings, interviews and mediations
  • Collaborating with cross-functional teams on Data Analytics and Reporting - documenting process flows and standard operating procedures
  • Co-facilitating our Basecamp Onboarding program to welcome new faces to Arc’teryx
  • Engaging your public speaking skills and represent the P&C department in various speaking engagements such as team meetings, huddles and events
  • Supporting and assisting with Supply Chain P&C projects and programs

Here are some of the things you could be working on in the future:

  • Work closely with your leader on a customized development plan that will help you reach your professional goals
  • Develop and implement change management initiatives with people leaders and the P&C team
  • Engage in end-to-end employee relation cases for development and recommendations
  • Receiving mentorship and guidance from Generalists and Business Partners as part of a dynamic team

Are you our next People & Culture Coordinator?

  • You have a post-secondary education and minimum 1 years’ experience in an operational role within HR, customer service, administration, or other relevant field
  • You have strong verbal and written English communication skills
  • Your ability to speak a second language is an asset
  • You maintain professionalism in dealing with high volumes of sensitive and confidential information
  • You are exceptionally organized with an eye for detail and accuracy
  • You are open and approachable with a customer-service focused mentality
  • You consistently evaluate and evolve existing processes
  • You have a highly collaborative working style and the ability to build strong relationships across the company
  • You effectively balance autonomy and collaboration
  • You inspire breakthrough thinking and continuous improvement
  • You seek the best (sometimes not the easiest) solutions, with an unwavering commitment to do what is right
  • Your passion for your work is paralleled by your passion for getting outside and living it
Compensation:
  • The salary range for this role is CAD$62,000 - CAD$81,000

Total Rewards

Most new team members join between the start and midpoint of the range, where you can contribute right away while continuing to grow your craft, your collaborations, and your impact at Arc’teryx. This range reflects market alignment and the scope of the role. Individual pay is determined by your skills, experience, and level of responsibility.

We’re committed to fair, equitable, and competitive pay, reviewed regularly to ensure internal alignment and market relevance. Transparency is part of how we follow through on our commitments and how we honour the value you bring to our team.

In addition to base pay, Arc’teryx supports people through benefits designed to sustain both work and life:

  • Health & wellbeing - Extended health, dental, and vision coverage, including mental health support, fertility benefits, gender-affirming care and a 24/7 Employee Assistance Program (EAP).
  • Financial wellbeing - RRSP matching and eligibility for Arc'teryx Annual Incentive Plan and access to Employee Stock Purchase program (ESPP) where applicable.
  • Time & Flexibility - Paid time off, wellness time, and No Wasted Day program (dedicated paid days to get outside & explore).
  • Family support - Parental leave top-up and a nesting period for new parents.
  • Growth, community & gear - Professional development opportunities, Arc'teryx Academies (outdoor skill-building events), Employee Belonging Councils, and access to employee discounts and Pro Deals (exclusive discounted pricing on gear).

    *Eligibility for certain programs may vary by role.

Equal Opportunity

Arc’teryx is committed to actively creating and fostering a culture of inclusivity where voices are heard, people are seen, and values are respected. We care about the uniqueness of our applicants, employees, and guests, and we do so in a safe space fueled by curiosity and acceptance.

Creating an inclusive workplace is connected to our core value Do Right while also having the added benefit of helping make our business better. We believe inclusion helps us to create a healthier, happier workplace, drive creativity and innovation, and reflect the communities where we operate.

All applicants, employees, and guests can expect equality of opportunity and fair treatment in alignment with our values.

Leave it Better

We believe that the mountains transform us, that how we adventure matters, and that there’s always a better way.

Join us in creating positive change in ourselves, our communities, and the world.

Live it. Get out there - the mountains make us better
Disruptive evolution. In pursuit of better. Always.
Commit. We set bold objectives and see them through.

title: Planner
description:
Our Global Supply Chain is a network of more than 300 manufacturing plants, distribution centers and other facilities designed and located to support our direct sales, marketing and distribution activities. We enable company growth by delivering savings through more efficient operations and high levels of service that create competitive advantage while earning and keeping customers' trust.

We are seeking a Planner to manage a medium product portfolio, network, or division. As the Planner, you will be accountable for the Demand, Supply, or Raw Material plan to ensure customer requirements are met through S&OP, Mid-Long Term Capacity Planning, or Material Resolution. You will act as a liaison between production and various other internal and external stakeholders.

What’s in it For You:

  • Opportunity for a long-term career path that allows for exposure into all areas of Ecolab’s supply chain
  • Access to best-in-class resources, tools, and technology
  • Thrive in a company that values sustainability, drives a safety-focused culture and has been recognized as one of the most ethical companies in the world

What You Will Do:

  • Accountable for the Demand, Supply, or Raw Material plan to ensure customer requirements are met through S&OP, Mid-Long Term Capacity Planning, or Material Resolution
  • May also manage short-term supply or raw material scheduling/planning for a large facility and/or complex product line
  • Intermediate problem identification/solving and navigating ambiguous situations
  • Utilizes project management skills to participate in and/or lead small to medium scope/business impact continuous improvement activities
  • Applies knowledge of business and the marketplace to advance organizational goals
  • Builds internal/external partnerships and works collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives
  • May help design and establish new processes or solutions to drive value through increased efficiency or performance
  • Manages daily operational partnerships with internal plants, warehouses and/or external suppliers

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Business/Statistics, Supply Chain Management, Engineering or related field of study
  • 2 years of work experience in supply chain planning, finance, marketing or a related analytical discipline
  • Significant experience with ERPs, advanced planning systems, analytical or equivalent software
  • High level of proficiency with MS Office, primarily Excel and Word
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively and appropriately with different audiences
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to drive decisions and build consensus among stakeholders
  • Ability to navigate complex policy, process, and people-related organizational dynamics
  • A track record of successfully delivering to Key Performance Indicators and business objectives
  • Experience with cross-functional collaboration and communication skills
  • Demonstrated ability for using a strategic mindset

Preferred Qualifications

  • Advanced technical or business degree, MBA preferred
  • Experience in operational excellence and project management such as TPM, Lean Six Sigma, continuous improvement, Green Belt, etc.
  • APICS Certification

For years, Capital One has been leading the industry in using machine learning to create real-time, intelligent, automated customer experiences. From informing customers about unusual charges to answering their questions in real time, our applications of AI & ML are bringing humanity and simplicity to banking. We are committed to building world-class applied science and engineering teams and continue our industry leading capabilities with breakthrough product experiences and scalable, high-performance AI infrastructure. At Capital One, you will help bring the transformative power of emerging AI capabilities to reimagine how we serve our customers and businesses who have come to love the products and services we build.


Team Description:

The AI Foundations team is at the center of bringing our vision for AI at Capital One to life. Our work touches every aspect of the research life cycle, from partnering with Academia to building production systems. We work with product, technology and business leaders to apply the state of the art in AI to our business.


What You’ll Do:

  • Partner with a cross-functional team of data scientists, software engineers, machine learning engineers and product managers to deliver AI-powered products that change how customers interact with their money.
  • Leverage a broad stack of technologies — Pytorch, AWS Ultraclusters, Huggingface, Lightning, and more — to reveal the insights hidden within huge volumes of numeric and textual data.
  • Build AI foundation models through all phases of development, from design through training, evaluation, validation, and implementation.
  • Engage in high impact applied research to take the latest AI developments and push them into the next generation of customer experiences.
  • Flex your interpersonal skills to translate the complexity of your work into tangible business goals.
  • Collaborate with senior researchers to prepare internal tech reports or conference submissions summarizing novel methods or findings

The Ideal Candidate:

  • You love the process of analyzing and creating, but also share our passion to do the right thing. You know at the end of the day it’s about making the right decision for our customers
  • Innovative. You continually research and evaluate emerging technologies. You stay current on published state-of-the-art methods, technologies, and applications and seek out opportunities to apply them
  • Creative. You thrive on bringing definition to big, undefined problems. You love asking questions and pushing hard to find answers. You’re not afraid to share a new idea
  • A leader. You challenge conventional thinking and work with stakeholders to identify and improve the status quo. You’re passionate about talent development for your own team and beyond
  • Technical. You’re comfortable with open-source languages and are passionate about developing further. You have hands-on experience developing AI foundation models and solutions using open-source tools and cloud computing platforms
  • Has a deep understanding of the foundations of AI methodologies
  • Experience building large deep learning models, whether on language, images, events, or graphs, as well as expertise in one or more of the following: training optimization, self-supervised learning, robustness, explainability, RLHF
  • An engineering mindset as shown by a track record of delivering models at scale both in terms of training data and inference volumes
  • Experience in delivering libraries, platform level code or solution level code to existing products
  • A professional with a track record of coming up with high quality ideas or improving upon existing ideas in machine learning, demonstrated by accomplishments such as first author publications or projects
  • Possess the ability to own and pursue a research agenda, including choosing impactful research problems and autonomously carrying out long-running projects

Basic Qualifications:

  • Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining, a PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, AI, Mathematics, or related fields, with an exception that required degree will be obtained on or before the scheduled start date or M.S. in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, AI, Mathematics, or related fields plus 2 years of experience in Applied Research

Preferred Qualifications:

  • PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Computer Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Electrical Engineering or related fields
  • LLM
    • PhD focus on NLP or Masters with 5 years of industrial NLP research experience
    • Multiple publications on topics related to the pre-training of large language models (e.g. technical reports of pre-trained LLMs, SSL techniques, model pre-training optimization)
    • Member of team that has trained a large language model from scratch (10B + parameters, 500B+ tokens)
    • Publications in deep learning theory
    • Publications at ACL, NAACL and EMNLP, Neurips, ICML or ICLR
  • Optimization (Training & Inference)
    • PhD focused on topics related to optimizing training of very large deep learning models
    • Multiple years of experience and/or publications on one of the following topics: Model Sparsification, Quantization, Training Parallelism/Partitioning Design, Gradient Checkpointing, Model Compression
    • Experience optimizing training for a 10B+ model
    • Deep knowledge of deep learning algorithmic and/or optimizer design
    • Experience with compiler design
  • Finetuning
    • PhD focused on topics related to guiding LLMs with further tasks (Supervised Finetuning, Instruction-Tuning, Dialogue-Finetuning, Parameter Tuning)
    • Demonstrated knowledge of principles of transfer learning, model adaptation and model guidance
    • Experience deploying a fine-tuned large language model

Job Description Summary

The role
You will own integration architecture across C&W's data and application estate as the firm's go-to authority. You will set the standards, design and build the hardest integrations yourself, and raise the capability of delivery teams around you.

  • A track record of leading through influence and setting technical standards in a complex enterprise.

Nice to have

  • Experience retiring legacy ESB or point-to-point estates.
  • Familiarity with API management, message brokers and streaming platforms.
  • Experience in a global data organisation across time zones.

Location - Pune, Maharashtra


About the Project


The project supports implementation of a public health program that requires high-quality communication, awareness, training, and visibility materials for diverse audiences. The project will use a mix of print, digital, video, and social media content to communicate key messages, support capacity building, document activities, and strengthen stakeholder engagement. The Communications and Content Officer will work closely with program and technical teams to translate complex information into clear, accurate, audience-appropriate, and visually engaging products.


Key Responsibilities


· Design and develop high-quality creative materials for project communication and outreach, including posters, standees, banners, brochures, flyers, infographics, job aids, presentations, certificates, and digital creatives.

title: Regional Vice President of Revenue Management – Branded (Remote)
description:
Pyramid Global Hospitality is a leading hospitality management company with a portfolio of more than 200 hotels and resorts and over 18,000 associates across the United States, Caribbean, and Europe. Our platform includes Benchmark Resorts & Hotels, a collection of distinctive independent properties; Axiom Hospitality, our European hotel management company; and PYRAMIDWORKS, which provides integrated workplace and facilities services. With corporate offices in Boston, The Woodlands, Texas, and London, Pyramid combines global scale with a hands-on approach focused on exceptional service, operational excellence, and long-term partnerships.


At Pyramid, our people are at the heart of everything we do. We are committed to creating an environment where associates are respected, supported, and empowered to grow their careers. Team members have the opportunity to collaborate directly with experienced leaders, take on meaningful stretch assignments, and gain exposure to a diverse portfolio of properties, brands, and markets. Whether you are beginning your hospitality career or bringing years of experience, you'll find opportunities to learn, develop, and make an impact.


Our commitment to associates, guests, owners, and the communities we serve has helped make Pyramid and our properties among the most recognized in hospitality. From being named among the best places to work by respected publications such as USA Today, The Boston Globe, and The Houston Chronicle to earning top travel accolades from Travel + Leisure, Condé Nast Traveler, Forbes Travel Guide, and U.S. News & World Report, these recognitions reflect the culture, service excellence, and commitment to people that define the Pyramid experience.

About our property:

Pyramid Global Hospitality (“Pyramid”) is a leading hotel management company, operating in the US, Caribbean, and Western Europe. With portfolio revenues exceeding $3 billion, Pyramid manages 230 hotels, resorts, and conference centers, both branded and independent. The firm maintains offices in Boston (Headquarters), Cincinnati, Houston, and London. Additional information about Pyramid can be found at www.pyramidglobal.com In 2021, Pyramid and Benchmark Resorts and Hotels merged to add an additional 59 Managed or Asset Managed Resorts and over 10,000 additional team members. The two companies share the same company culture, values and philosophies. We are growing and opportunities abound! What really sets Pyramid apart from our competitors is our reputation as an employer. Professional growth is not just possible throughout the company but planned and encouraged. The Leadership Team at Pyramid consider team member development its first priority, understanding that success is only achieved in a workplace where every contributor is respected and recognized. This is why we deliver superior results. There is opportunity to work directly with senior leaders, experience stretch assignments and learn hospitality management from industry giants. You will come to know a distinctive people centric culture that is at the core of all we do. The decisions we make and the paths we take are bound by a commitment to our Owners, Associates, Customers and the Communities where we work. We attract the most talented associates in the industry, and actively encourage candidates with a “hospitality spirit” who may be thinking about a career change to join our team.

What you will have an opportunity to do:

POSITION SUMMARY:

The Regional Vice President of Revenue Management leads a high-performing team of Regional and property-level Revenue Directors and Managers, overseeing a portfolio of approximately 25 branded hotels across a defined region. This role is accountable for driving topline revenue performance through strategic leadership, proactive pricing, and market optimization, while maintaining a clear line of sight to profitability and owner expectations.

Success in this position is measured by the team’s ability to meet or exceed RGI goals, deliver accurate and agile forecasts, optimize topline revenue across all segments and channels, and execute channel strategies that protect NOI by managing the cost of customer acquisition. This leader develops talent, aligns commercial strategies across departments, and ensures consistency in revenue management standards and execution across the region.


ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

• Create, identify, develop, and implement revenue management strategies for all segments within the assigned region.

• Provide functional and business expertise and a strategic perspective to develop and implement profitable revenue strategies across the branded portfolio.

• Maintain accountability for revenue management strategy and execution throughout the assigned region.

• Proactively review and analyze inventory, pricing, rate management, demand, pace, production, and channel/source contribution.

• Communicate proactively with properties regarding restrictions, pricing, inventory, and market strategies.

• Evaluate market demand using turndown data, CRS/GDS reports, Demand360, and CoStar data.

• Drive revenue performance by evaluating segment needs across regional and high-impact markets.

• Develop, coordinate, and implement revenue-generating strategies in conjunction with annual business and marketing plans.

• Review and develop standard PGH revenue management position requirements, processes, and actions.

• Evaluate and recommend technology enhancements and field-level processes needed to support budgeted revenue attainment, including Delphi and business intelligence tools.

• Develop direct reports, including Portfolio Directors and all levels of Revenue Directors and Managers.

• Support Portfolio Directors of Revenue Management, as applicable, in developing and training property-level Revenue Managers on effective sell strategies and key areas of revenue management.

• Maintain consistent and professional communication with hotel ownership groups, providing weekly performance updates, monthly business reviews, and strategic insights to support revenue growth and alignment.

• Actively participate in strategy meetings, financial reviews, planning sessions, and other cross-functional forums to ensure alignment and drive revenue performance across all properties.

• As needed, support hotel development efforts to grow the PGH portfolio, including project feasibility, pro forma development, and due diligence.

• Comply with PGH standards and regulations to encourage professional, safe, and efficient operations.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Lead, assess, select, retain, and develop a diverse, high-caliber team of Portfolio Directors, Revenue Directors, and Revenue Managers. Champion leadership development and workforce planning priorities, strengthen the leadership bench, continually elevate revenue management talent, and partner with Human Resources to anticipate future talent needs based on business growth plans.


QUALIFICATIONS:

• 10+ years of progressive experience in hospitality revenue management.

• Proven leadership of multi-property or multi-brand portfolios.

• Expertise in Microsoft Office products, with advanced proficiency in Excel for analysis, formulation, and reporting.

• Solid understanding of general hotel operations and yield management philosophy.

• Ability to work with and understand financial information, data, and basic arithmetic functions.

• Ability to assimilate complex information from disparate sources and adjust or modify strategies to meet specific business needs.

• Critical-thinking skills to investigate changes in demand, pace, production, and channel/source contribution, anticipate an appropriate response, and communicate critical information.

• Excellent presentation, written, and verbal communication skills.

• Strong organizational management skills and the ability to handle multiple responsibilities at the same time.

• Ability to work effectively with owners, guests, and associates in a friendly, objective, and service-oriented manner.


WORK REQUIREMENTS:

description:
Job Title

Mechatronics & Robotics Technician

Job Description Summary

Job Description

At C&W Services, we live by the belief that Better Never Settles. We're dedicated to creating a positive impact globally, and we're looking for talented individuals to join our team.

C&W Services provides compelling benefits, including:

  • Weekly Pay
  • Comprehensive Benefits that start on your first day
  • Training, Development, and Advancement Opportunities
  • A Clean and Cutting-Edge Facility
  • A Safety-First Culture

About the Role

As a Mechatronics & Robotics Technician, you will use your skills to support the Operations Maintenance Team repairing and maintaining material handling equipment and pneumatic systems throughout the building. You will have the opportunity to install, maintain and repair automated packaging and distribution equipment.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Safety: Promote a safe working environment by following all safety procedures.
  • Maintenance: Complete preventative maintenance routines with proper documentation. Troubleshoot electrical and mechanical problems related to all Material Handling Equipment (MHE) which includes belts, motors, photo-eyes, relays, and more.
  • Monitoring: Create, assign, and close out work order with data including labor hours, equipment maintenance, and parts used. Track and store department inventory.
  • Support: Mentor junior technicians to grow in their roles.
  • Communication: Maintain positive working relationships across all of the Operations facility.

Basic Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • 2+ years of experience in the repair of material handling equipment (MHE) or automated conveyor systems and controls.
  • 2+ years of experience conducting predictive and preventative maintenance procedures.
  • 1+ years of blueprint and electrical schematic reading.
  • 1+ years of knowledge with electrical and electronic principles.
  • Experience with a Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS).
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Project, with the ability to create and manage documents effectively.
  • Ability to work flexible schedules/shifts.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Associates or higher degree from a vocational school or college with a focus on Mechanical or Electrical field.
  • Experience with Material Handling Equipment (MHE) safety standards accordance with Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) and Safety standards.
  • Experience with robotic operation and maintenance.
  • Able to troubleshoot basic input and output functions.

Physical Demands:

  • Must have ability to reach overhead, kneel, squat, climb steps/ladders, use an aerial lift, and frequently lift a maximum of 50 lbs. of equipment.
  • Ability to perform tasks wearing appropriate or required Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), which may include but is not limited to hard hat, face mask, face shield, and composite toe shoes.
  • Regularly required to crouch or bend and reach to install/move equipment.
  • Involves movement between departments, floors, and properties to facilitate work, averaging 6 to 12 miles per day.
  • Work in a warehouse environment with fluctuating temperatures.
  • Regularly required to type on a computer for 1-2 hours per day.

We're recognized by the Human Rights Foundation as a Best Place to Work for LGBTQI+ individuals and are dedicated to continuing to build a culture of inclusion and respect.
